-- StormService.luau
-- The lagoon's threats on a schedule. Three events cycle: a Kraken Surge
-- forces everyone carrying a brainrot to high ground, a Golden Tide doubles
-- all income, and a Parrot Raid sends thieving parrots at unlocked decks.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")

local PirateState = require(script.Parent.PirateState)
local BountyService = require(script.Parent.BountyService)
local BootyCatalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BootyCatalog"))
local RigBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("RigBuilder"))
local LagoonLayout = require(Shared:WaitForChild("LagoonLayout"))

local StormService = {}

-- Module state.
local goldenTideUntil = 0 -- clock time, 0 = inactive
local surgeActive = false
local currentEvent = "" -- "" or "kraken" / "golden" / "parrot"

-- The wave sweep geometry.
local WAVE_START_Z = -140
local WAVE_STEPS = 40
local WAVE_STEP_SIZE = 3.5
local WAVE_STEP_WAIT = 0.1
local WAVE_HEIGHT = 6
-- The parrot raid geometry.
local PARROT_HEIGHT = 14
-- The scheduler timing.
local SCHEDULER_MIN_WAIT = 75
local SCHEDULER_MAX_WAIT = 120

-- Returns 2 while the clock is before the Golden Tide expiry, else 1.
-- Called by PirateState's income calculation.
function StormService.getGoldenTideMultiplier()
	if os.clock() < goldenTideUntil then
		return 2
	end
	return 1
end

-- Returns true when the player's character is on high ground.
function StormService.isPlayerOnHighGround(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return false
	end
	return LagoonLayout.isOnHighGround(character)
end

-- Broadcasts an event banner to all players. An empty name hides the banner.
local function broadcastEventBanner(name, text, countdown)
	PirateState.broadcastAll({
		type = "event",
		name = name,
		text = text,
		countdown = countdown,
	})
end

-- Clears the event banner if the current event is still the given one.
local function clearEventBannerIfCurrent(eventKey)
	if currentEvent == eventKey then
		currentEvent = ""
		broadcastEventBanner("", "", 0)
	end
end

-- Sets the event banner to a staged (static) state for screenshot staging.
-- Stagehand uses this for the "kraken" shot (countdown 6). It does not start
-- the event itself; the wave and tentacles are shown by the caller.
function StormService.setStagedEventBanner(eventKey, name, text, countdown)
	currentEvent = eventKey
	broadcastEventBanner(name, text, countdown)
end

-- The surge's victim sweep. For every player carrying a brainrot: if the
-- player is not on high ground, the carried brainrot is lost (model
-- destroyed, carrying record cleared, carrying message sent with a nil
-- name); if the player is on high ground, a survive bounty progresses.
function StormService.sweepExposedCarriedBrainrots()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local state = PirateState.getState(player)
		if state and state.carrying then
			local carrying = state.carrying
			if StormService.isPlayerOnHighGround(player) then
				BountyService.addBountyProgress(player, "survive", 1)
			else
				local def = BootyCatalog.getBrainrotDefinition(carrying.defId)
				local name = def and def.name or "brainrot"
				PirateState.broadcast(player, {
					type = "feed",
					text = "The Kraken took your " .. name .. "!",
					color = "red",
				})
				if carrying.model then
					carrying.model:Destroy()
				end
				state.carrying = nil
				PirateState.broadcast(player, {
					type = "carrying",
					name = nil,
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

-- The Kraken Surge. A 10-second warning is broadcast, then the wave sweeps
-- across the lagoon and the tentacles rise. Carried brainrots that are not
-- on high ground are lost. Six seconds after the sweep the wave and
-- tentacles are hidden again.
function StormService.triggerKrakenSurge()
	if surgeActive then
		return
	end
	surgeActive = true
	currentEvent = "kraken"
	broadcastEventBanner("KRAKEN SURGE!", "GET TO HIGH GROUND! The wave is coming!", 10)
	task.wait(10)
	local wave = Workspace:FindFirstChild("SurgeWave")
	if wave then
		wave.Transparency = 0.25
		for step = 0, WAVE_STEPS - 1 do
			wave.Position = Vector3.new(0, WAVE_HEIGHT, WAVE_START_Z + step * WAVE_STEP_SIZE)
			task.wait(WAVE_STEP_WAIT)
		end
	end
	for index = 1, 5 do
		local tentacle = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Tentacle" .. index)
		if tentacle then
			tentacle.Transparency = 0
			local pos = tentacle.Position
			tentacle.Position = Vector3.new(pos.X, 4, -100)
		end
	end
	StormService.sweepExposedCarriedBrainrots()
	PirateState.broadcastAll({
		type = "feed",
		text = "The wave took what it could reach!",
		color = "blue",
	})
	task.wait(6)
	if wave then
		wave.Transparency = 1
		wave.Position = Vector3.new(0, WAVE_HEIGHT, WAVE_START_Z)
	end
	for index = 1, 5 do
		local tentacle = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Tentacle" .. index)
		if tentacle then
			tentacle.Transparency = 1
			local pos = tentacle.Position
			tentacle.Position = Vector3.new(pos.X, -8, pos.Z)
		end
	end
	clearEventBannerIfCurrent("kraken")
	surgeActive = false
end

-- The Golden Tide. All bases pay x2 income for 60 seconds.
function StormService.triggerGoldenTide()
	goldenTideUntil = os.clock() + 60
	currentEvent = "golden"
	broadcastEventBanner("GOLDEN TIDE!", "ALL BASES PAY x2 FOR 60s!", 60)
	task.wait(60)
	clearEventBannerIfCurrent("golden")
end

-- The Parrot Raid. A parrot is spawned 14 studs above the centre of every
-- unlocked player's base. After 8 seconds, each parrot steals the player's
-- first occupied deck slot unless the player locked in the meantime.
function StormService.triggerParrotRaid()
	currentEvent = "parrot"
	broadcastEventBanner("PARROT RAID!", "Thieving parrots are circling! LOCK your deck [L]!", 8)
	local parrotDef = BootyCatalog.getBrainrotDefinition(25)
	local parrots = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local state = PirateState.getState(player)
		if state and not PirateState.isBaseLocked(player) then
			local baseRecord = LagoonLayout.BASES[state.base]
			if baseRecord and parrotDef then
				local centre = baseRecord.center or baseRecord.centre
				if centre then
					local parrot = RigBuilder.buildBrainrotRig(parrotDef, "NONE")
					parrot:PivotTo(CFrame.new(centre + Vector3.new(0, PARROT_HEIGHT, 0)))
					parrot.Parent = Workspace
					table.insert(parrots, { player = player, model = parrot })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	task.wait(8)
	for _, entry in ipairs(parrots) do
		local player = entry.player
		local model = entry.model
		if model then
			model:Destroy()
		end
		local state = PirateState.getState(player)
		if not state then
			continue
		end
		if PirateState.isBaseLocked(player) then
			PirateState.broadcast(player, {
				type = "feed",
				text = "Your LOCK kept the parrots out!",
				color = "green",
			})
		else
			local firstSlot = nil
			for slot = 1, 8 do
				if state.slots[slot] ~= nil then
					firstSlot = slot
					break
				end
			end
			if firstSlot then
				local stolen = state.slots[firstSlot]
				local def = stolen and BootyCatalog.getBrainrotDefinition(stolen.defId)
				local name = def and def.name or "brainrot"
				PirateState.clearBaseSlot(player, firstSlot)
				PirateState.broadcastAll({
					type = "feed",
					text = "A parrot stole " .. name .. " from " .. player.Name .. "!",
					color = "red",
				})
			end
		end
	end
	clearEventBannerIfCurrent("parrot")
end

-- Starts the event scheduler: waits a random 75-120 seconds, then fires the
-- next event in a fixed rotation (kraken, golden, parrot, repeat), forever.
function StormService.startEventScheduler()
	task.spawn(function()
		local rotation = { "kraken", "golden", "parrot" }
		local nextIndex = 1
		while true do
			local waitTime = math.random(SCHEDULER_MIN_WAIT, SCHEDULER_MAX_WAIT)
			task.wait(waitTime)
			local eventKey = rotation[nextIndex]
			nextIndex = nextIndex % #rotation + 1
			if eventKey == "kraken" then
				StormService.triggerKrakenSurge()
			elseif eventKey == "golden" then
				StormService.triggerGoldenTide()
			elseif eventKey == "parrot" then
				StormService.triggerParrotRaid()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return StormService

-- TreasureChuteService.luau
-- Brainrots sail out of the wrecked galleon, ride the glowing treasure
-- chute past the docks, and can be bought before they sail off the end.
-- Buying carries the brainrot home to the buyer's deck.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")

local PirateState = require(script.Parent.PirateState)
local BountyService = require(script.Parent.BountyService)
local PlunderService = require(script.Parent.PlunderService)
local BootyCatalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BootyCatalog"))
local RigBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("RigBuilder"))
local LagoonLayout = require(Shared:WaitForChild("LagoonLayout"))

local TreasureChuteService = {}

-- Module state: the riders currently on the chute.
local riders = {}
-- A new brainrot spawns on the chute every 6 seconds.
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 6
-- The chute length in studs (from start to end).
local CHUTE_LENGTH = (LagoonLayout.CHUTE_END - LagoonLayout.CHUTE_START).Magnitude
-- How far above the buyer's head a carried brainrot floats.
local CARRY_HEIGHT = 4
-- How close the buyer must get to the target pedestal to land.
local LAND_DISTANCE = 10
-- The maximum carry-home time in seconds.
local CARRY_TIMEOUT = 25

-- Returns a part of a model that can host a ClickDetector.
local function getClickPart(model)
	if model.PrimaryPart then
		return model.PrimaryPart
	end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			return descendant
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Returns the interpolated chute position for a progress in studs.
local function chutePosition(progress)
	local t = math.clamp(progress / CHUTE_LENGTH, 0, 1)
	return LagoonLayout.CHUTE_START:Lerp(LagoonLayout.CHUTE_END, t)
end

-- Spawns a new rider on the chute: rolls a rarity, picks a random brainrot
-- of that rarity, rolls a mutation, builds the rig, computes the price,
-- attaches a billboard reading "BUY <price>", places the model at the chute
-- start, attaches a ClickDetector (40 studs) wired to the buy handler, and
-- appends the rider to the list. Returns the new rider.
function TreasureChuteService.spawnConveyorBrainrot()
	local rarity = BootyCatalog.rollRarityTier()
	local def = BootyCatalog.pickRandomBrainrotOfRarity(rarity)
	local mutation = BootyCatalog.rollMutationModifier()
	local price = BootyCatalog.getBrainrotCost(def, mutation)
	local model = RigBuilder.buildBrainrotRig(def, mutation)
	RigBuilder.attachOverheadBillboard(model, def, mutation, "BUY " .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(price))
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(LagoonLayout.CHUTE_START))
	model.Parent = Workspace
	local rider = {
		model = model,
		def = def,
		mutation = mutation,
		price = price,
		progress = 0,
		birthTime = os.clock(),
	}
	local clickPart = getClickPart(model)
	if clickPart then
		local clickDetector = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
		clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = 40
		clickDetector.Parent = clickPart
		clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
			TreasureChuteService.handleBuyBrainrotRequest(player, rider)
		end)
	end
	table.insert(riders, rider)
	return rider
end

-- Advances every rider by chute speed x dt along the chute. A rider is
-- despawned when its progress reaches the chute length or its age exceeds
-- the 25-second lifetime; otherwise its model is moved to the interpolated
-- position along the chute.
function TreasureChuteService.stepConveyorMovement(dt)
	local now = os.clock()
	for index = #riders, 1, -1 do
		local rider = riders[index]
		rider.progress = rider.progress + LagoonLayout.CHUTE_SPEED * dt
		local age = now - rider.birthTime
		if rider.progress >= CHUTE_LENGTH or age > LagoonLayout.CHUTE_LIFETIME then
			TreasureChuteService.despawnConveyorBrainrot(index)
		elseif rider.model then
			rider.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(chutePosition(rider.progress)))
		end
	end
end

-- Destroys a rider's model (if any) and removes the rider from the list.
function TreasureChuteService.despawnConveyorBrainrot(index)
	local rider = riders[index]
	if not rider then
		return
	end
	if rider.model then
		rider.model:Destroy()
	end
	table.remove(riders, index)
end

-- Places a bought brainrot on its pedestal. If the player has no state the
-- model is destroyed. If the model is missing or was destroyed (e.g. a
-- Kraken Surge dropped it mid-carry), a fresh rig is built with an income
-- billboard. The model is recorded as the slot's pedestal model, a steal
-- clicker is attached, and it is placed at the pedestal position.
local function landBrainrotOnPedestal(player, def, mutation, slot, model)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then
		if model then
			model:Destroy()
		end
		return
	end
	local income = BootyCatalog.calculateBrainrotIncome(def, mutation, PirateState.getRebirthMultiplier(player))
	if not model then
		model = RigBuilder.buildBrainrotRig(def, mutation)
		RigBuilder.attachOverheadBillboard(model, def, mutation, "+" .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(income) .. "/s")
		model.Parent = Workspace
	end
	local pedestalPos = LagoonLayout.getPedestalPosition(state.base, slot)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pedestalPos))
	PirateState.setPedestalModel(player, slot, model)
	PlunderService.attachStealClicker(model, player, slot)
end

-- The visual carry home. A fresh rig is built with an income billboard and
-- placed in the world. The carrying record is set and the buyer gets a
-- carrying message while all players see the purchase feed. The model
-- follows 4 studs above the buyer's head, re-checked every 0.1 seconds for
-- up to 25 seconds, ending early when the buyer comes within 10 studs of
-- the target pedestal. Then the carrying record is cleared, a carrying
-- message with a nil name is sent, and the brainrot lands on its pedestal.
function TreasureChuteService.carryBrainrotHome(player, def, mutation, slot)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		landBrainrotOnPedestal(player, def, mutation, slot, nil)
		return
	end
	local income = BootyCatalog.calculateBrainrotIncome(def, mutation, PirateState.getRebirthMultiplier(player))
	local model = RigBuilder.buildBrainrotRig(def, mutation)
	RigBuilder.attachOverheadBillboard(model, def, mutation, "+" .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(income) .. "/s")
	model.Parent = Workspace
	state.carrying = { defId = def.id, mutation = mutation, slot = slot, model = model }
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "carrying",
		name = def.name,
		income = income,
		stolen = false,
	})
	PirateState.broadcastAll({
		type = "feed",
		text = player.Name .. " bought " .. def.name .. "!",
		color = "green",
	})
	task.spawn(function()
		local startTime = os.clock()
		local reached = false
		while os.clock() - startTime < CARRY_TIMEOUT do
			local currentState = PirateState.getState(player)
			if not currentState then
				return
			end
			local carrying = currentState.carrying
			if not carrying or carrying.model ~= model or carrying.slot ~= slot then
				return
			end
			local char = player.Character
			if not char then
				break
			end
			local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then
				break
			end
			if model.Parent then
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, CARRY_HEIGHT, 0)))
			end
			local pedestalPos = LagoonLayout.getPedestalPosition(currentState.base, slot)
			if (root.Position - pedestalPos).Magnitude <= LAND_DISTANCE then
				reached = true
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		local finalState = PirateState.getState(player)
		if not finalState then
			if model then
				model:Destroy()
			end
			return
		end
		local carrying = finalState.carrying
		local carryModel = nil
		if carrying and carrying.model == model and carrying.slot == slot then
			carryModel = carrying.model
			finalState.carrying = nil
		end
		PirateState.broadcast(player, {
			type = "carrying",
			name = nil,
		})
		landBrainrotOnPedestal(player, def, mutation, slot, carryModel)
		if reached then
			PirateState.broadcast(player, {
				type = "feed",
				text = def.name .. " is on your deck!",
				color = "green",
			})
		else
			PirateState.broadcast(player, {
				type = "feed",
				text = def.name .. " took the scenic route — it is on your deck!",
				color = "green",
			})
		end
	end)
end

-- The purchase flow. Guards, in order: the rider must still be on the
-- chute; the buyer must have state; the buyer must not already be carrying;
-- the buyer must have a character; the buyer must have a free deck slot;
-- the buyer must have enough cash. Payment is taken, ownership is recorded
-- at purchase (slot assigned, Log marked, buy bounty progressed), the rider
-- is despawned, and the visual carry home begins.
function TreasureChuteService.handleBuyBrainrotRequest(player, rider)
	local riderIndex = nil
	for index, entry in ipairs(riders) do
		if entry == rider then
			riderIndex = index
			break
		end
	end
	if not riderIndex then
		return
	end
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if state.carrying then
		PirateState.broadcast(player, {
			type = "feed",
			text = "Carry the brainrot home first!",
			color = "red",
		})
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local freeSlot = PirateState.getFreeSlot(player)
	if not freeSlot then
		PirateState.broadcast(player, {
			type = "feed",
			text = "Your deck is FULL! Buy a pedestal first.",
			color = "red",
		})
		return
	end
	if PirateState.getCash(player) < rider.price then
		PirateState.broadcast(player, {
			type = "feed",
			text = "Not enough doubloons for " .. rider.def.name .. "!",
			color = "red",
		})
		return
	end
	if not PirateState.spendCash(player, rider.price) then
		return
	end
	local assigned = PirateState.assignBrainrotToSlot(player, freeSlot, rider.def.id, rider.mutation)
	if not assigned then
		PirateState.addCash(player, rider.price)
		PirateState.broadcast(player, {
			type = "feed",
			text = "Could not place " .. rider.def.name .. " — refunded!",
			color = "red",
		})
		return
	end
	BountyService.addBountyProgress(player, "buy", 1)
	TreasureChuteService.despawnConveyorBrainrot(riderIndex)
	TreasureChuteService.carryBrainrotHome(player, rider.def, rider.mutation, freeSlot)
end

-- Pre-populates 3 riders at progress 0, 45, and 90 studs, then starts two
-- background loops: one spawning a new rider every 6 seconds, and one
-- stepping rider movement every 0.1 seconds.
function TreasureChuteService.startChuteLoop()
	local preplaced = { 0, 45, 90 }
	for _, progress in ipairs(preplaced) do
		local rider = TreasureChuteService.spawnConveyorBrainrot()
		rider.progress = progress
		if rider.model then
			rider.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(chutePosition(progress)))
		end
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
			TreasureChuteService.spawnConveyorBrainrot()
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local lastTime = os.clock()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.1)
			local now = os.clock()
			local dt = now - lastTime
			lastTime = now
			TreasureChuteService.stepConveyorMovement(dt)
		end
	end)
end

return TreasureChuteService

--[[
Deep reactive stores: `Flux.store(table)` returns a proxy whose fields are tracked per key, with `Flux.Store` helpers
for arrays, snapshots and teardown.

```luau
local state = Flux.store({ player = { hp = 100 } })
Flux.effect(function() print(state.player.hp) end)
state.player.hp = 90
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local cleanup = Graph.cleanup
local newValue = Graph.signal
local get = Graph.Node.get
local setValue = Graph.Node.set
local destroyNode = Graph.Node.Destroy
local isReactive = Graph.isReactive
local isObserved = Graph.isObserved
local getOwner = Graph.getOwner
local register = Graph.register
local warn = Compat.warn

--- @ignore
type Meta = {
	__index: (proxy: any, key: any) -> any,
	__newindex: (proxy: any, key: any, value: any) -> (),
	__iter: (proxy: any) -> ...any,
	__len: (proxy: any) -> number,
	target: { [any]: any },
	nodes: { [any]: Graph.Node<any> },
	proxy: any,
	parents: { [any]: boolean }?,
	children: { [any]: boolean }?,
	root: boolean?,
}

local proxyCache: { [any]: any } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "v" })
local proxyToRaw: { [any]: { [any]: any } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local STORE_SYMBOL: any = table.freeze({})
local NAN_KEY: any = table.freeze({})

local function toRaw(value: any): any
	return if type(value) == "table" then proxyToRaw[value] or value else value
end

local function isPlainMutable(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "table" and getmetatable(value) == nil and not table.isfrozen(value)
end

local function isRootReachable(startProxy: any): boolean
	local meta = getmetatable(startProxy) :: Meta?
	if meta == nil then
		return false
	elseif meta.root then
		return true
	end
	local parents = meta.parents
	if parents == nil or next(parents) == nil then
		return false
	end
	local seen: { [any]: boolean } = { [startProxy] = true }
	local stack: { any } = { startProxy }
	while #stack > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(stack)
		local curMeta = getmetatable(cur) :: Meta?
		local curParents = if curMeta then curMeta.parents else nil
		if curParents then
			for parentProxy in curParents do
				if not seen[parentProxy] then
					local parentMeta = getmetatable(parentProxy) :: Meta?
					if parentMeta then
						if parentMeta.root then
							return true
						end
						seen[parentProxy] = true
						table.insert(stack, parentProxy)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function linkParent(childProxy: any, parentProxy: any)
	if parentProxy == nil or childProxy == parentProxy then
		return
	end
	local childMeta = getmetatable(childProxy) :: Meta?
	local parentMeta = getmetatable(parentProxy) :: Meta?
	if childMeta == nil or parentMeta == nil then
		return
	end
	local parents = childMeta.parents
	if parents == nil then
		parents = {}
		childMeta.parents = parents
	end
	(parents :: { [any]: boolean })[parentProxy] = true
	local children = parentMeta.children
	if children == nil then
		children = {}
		parentMeta.children = children
	end
	(children :: { [any]: boolean })[childProxy] = true
end

local function linkIfProxied(rawVal: any, parentProxy: any)
	if type(rawVal) == "table" and proxyCache[rawVal] ~= nil then
		linkParent(proxyCache[rawVal], parentProxy)
	end
end

local index: (proxy: any, key: any) -> any
local newindex: (proxy: any, key: any, value: any) -> ()
local iter: (proxy: any) -> ...any
local len: (proxy: any) -> number

local function destroyProxy(proxy: any, visited: { [any]: boolean }?)
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	if target == nil then
		return
	end
	local seen = visited or {}
	if seen[proxy] then
		return
	end
	seen[proxy] = true

	local meta = getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta
	if proxyCache[target] == proxy then
		proxyCache[target] = nil
	end
	proxyToRaw[proxy] = nil
	register(proxy, nil)
	setmetatable(proxy, nil)

	local parents = meta.parents
	if parents then
		meta.parents = nil
		for parentProxy in parents do
			local parentMeta = getmetatable(parentProxy) :: Meta?
			if parentMeta and parentMeta.children then
				parentMeta.children[proxy] = nil
			end
		end
	end
	local children = meta.children
	if children then
		meta.children = nil
		for childProxy in children do
			local childMeta = getmetatable(childProxy) :: Meta?
			if childMeta then
				local cParents = childMeta.parents
				if cParents then
					cParents[proxy] = nil
				end
				if not isRootReachable(childProxy) then
					destroyProxy(childProxy, seen)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local nodes = meta.nodes
	for _, node in nodes do
		destroyNode(node)
	end
	table.clear(nodes)
end

local function disposeRootProxy(proxy: any)
	destroyProxy(proxy)
end

local function createProxy<T>(target: T, parentProxy: any?): T
	local rawTarget: any = target
	local cached = proxyCache[rawTarget]
	if cached then
		if parentProxy ~= nil then
			linkParent(cached, parentProxy)
		else
			local cachedMeta = getmetatable(cached) :: Meta?
			if cachedMeta ~= nil then
				local wasRoot = cachedMeta.root
				cachedMeta.root = true
				if not wasRoot and getOwner() ~= nil then
					cleanup(cached)
				end
			end
		end
		return cached
	end

	local nodes: { [any]: Graph.Node<any> } = {}
	local meta: Meta = {
		__index = index,
		__newindex = newindex,
		__iter = iter,
		__len = len,
		target = rawTarget,
		nodes = nodes,
		proxy = nil,
		parents = nil,
		children = nil,
		root = parentProxy == nil,
	}
	local proxy: any = setmetatable({}, meta)
	meta.proxy = proxy

	proxyCache[rawTarget] = proxy
	proxyToRaw[proxy] = rawTarget
	register(proxy, disposeRootProxy)

	if parentProxy ~= nil then
		linkParent(proxy, parentProxy)
	elseif getOwner() ~= nil then
		cleanup(proxy)
	end

	return proxy
end

local function teardownDisplaced(parentProxy: any, target: { [any]: any }, displaced: any)
	if type(displaced) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local displacedProxy = proxyCache[displaced]
	if displacedProxy == nil then
		return
	end
	for _, value in target do
		if value == displaced then
			return
		end
	end
	local parentMeta = getmetatable(parentProxy) :: Meta?
	if parentMeta and parentMeta.children then
		parentMeta.children[displacedProxy] = nil
	end
	local childMeta = getmetatable(displacedProxy) :: Meta?
	if childMeta then
		if childMeta.parents then
			childMeta.parents[parentProxy] = nil
		end
		if not isRootReachable(displacedProxy) then
			destroyProxy(displacedProxy)
		end
	end
end

local function setKeyValue(nodes: { [any]: any }, key: any, node: any, value: any)
	setValue(node, value)
	if value == nil and not isReactive() and getOwner() == nil and not isObserved(node) then
		nodes[key] = nil
		destroyNode(node)
	end
end

local function fireTracker(nodes: { [any]: any }, target: { [any]: any })
	local tracker = nodes[STORE_SYMBOL]
	if tracker then
		setValue(tracker, target, true)
	end
end

local function resyncIndices(nodes: { [any]: any }, target: { [any]: any }, from: number, to: number)
	for i = from, to do
		local node = nodes[i]
		if node then
			setValue(node, target[i])
		end
	end
end

local function readTracker(meta: Meta): { [any]: any }
	local target = meta.target
	local nodes = meta.nodes

	local tracker = nodes[STORE_SYMBOL]
	if not tracker then
		tracker = newValue(target)
		nodes[STORE_SYMBOL] = tracker
	end
	get(tracker)

	return target
end

local function validatePos(pos: any, max: number): number
	if type(pos) ~= "number" then
		error(`Position must be a number, got {typeof(pos)}`, 3)
	elseif pos ~= math.floor(pos) or pos < 1 or pos > max then
		error(`Position {pos} out of range [1, {max}]`, 3)
	end
	return pos
end

function index(proxy: any, key: any): any
	local meta: Meta = getmetatable(proxy)
	local value = rawget(meta.target, key)

	if isReactive() then
		local nodes = meta.nodes
		local node = nodes[key]
		if node == nil then
			node = newValue(value)
			nodes[key] = node
		end
		get(node)
	end

	if isPlainMutable(value) then
		return createProxy(value, proxy)
	end
	return value
end

function newindex(proxy: any, key: any, newVal: any)
	local meta: Meta = getmetatable(proxy)
	local target = meta.target
	local rawValue = toRaw(newVal)
	local oldValue = rawget(target, key)
	if oldValue == rawValue and type(rawValue) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	rawset(target, key, rawValue)
	linkIfProxied(rawValue, proxy)
	if type(oldValue) == "table" and oldValue ~= rawValue then
		teardownDisplaced(proxy, target, oldValue)
	end

	local nodes = meta.nodes
	local node = nodes[key]
	if node ~= nil then
		setKeyValue(nodes, key, node, rawValue)
	end

	fireTracker(nodes, target)
end

local function nextProxy(meta: Meta, k: any): (any, any)
	local key, value = next(meta.target, k)
	if isPlainMutable(value) then
		return key, createProxy(value, meta.proxy)
	end
	return key, value
end

function iter(proxy: any)
	local meta: Meta = getmetatable(proxy)
	readTracker(meta)
	return nextProxy, meta
end

function len(proxy: any): number
	return #readTracker(getmetatable(proxy))
end

local Store = {}

--[[
Wraps a plain table in a deep reactive proxy that tracks each read key, nested table, and array length independently.
Values that already have a metatable (such as Flux nodes or class instances) are left untouched.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#creating-a-store)
]]
function Store.new<T>(initialState: T): T
	local state: any = initialState
	assert(type(state) == "table", "Store initialState must be a table")
	if proxyToRaw[state] ~= nil then
		return state
	end
	return createProxy(state)
end

--[[
Tears down a store and all of its nested proxies, disposing their per-key nodes via [`Flux.dispose`](https://flux.kohl.gg/api/Flux#dispose) while leaving the raw backing table intact.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#destroying-a-store)
]]
function Store.Destroy<T>(proxy: T)
	destroyProxy(proxy)
end

--[[
Returns the raw, unproxied backing table of a store for untracked reads or serialization.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#unwrapping-a-store)
]]
function Store.unwrap<T>(proxy: T): T
	return (proxyToRaw[proxy] or proxy) :: T
end

--[[
Inserts `value` into a store array (appending with 2 arguments, or inserting at `posOrValue` with 3) and notifies length and index observers.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#arrays-and-iteration)
]]
function Store.insert(proxy: any, posOrValue: any, value: any?)
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	if not target then
		if value == nil then
			table.insert(proxy, posOrValue)
		else
			table.insert(proxy, posOrValue, value)
		end
		return
	end

	local pos: number
	local val: any
	if value == nil then
		pos = #target + 1
		val = posOrValue
	else
		pos = validatePos(posOrValue, #target + 1)
		val = value
	end

	local rawValue = toRaw(val)
	table.insert(target, pos, rawValue)
	linkIfProxied(rawValue, proxy)

	local nodes = (getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta).nodes
	resyncIndices(nodes, target, pos, #target)
	fireTracker(nodes, target)
end

--[[
Removes and returns the element at `pos` (defaulting to the last element) from a store array and notifies length and index observers.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#arrays-and-iteration)
]]
function Store.remove(proxy: any, pos: number?): any
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	if not target then
		return table.remove(proxy, pos)
	end

	local length = #target
	if pos ~= nil then
		validatePos(pos, length)
	end
	if length == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local idx = pos or length
	local removed = table.remove(target, idx)

	teardownDisplaced(proxy, target, removed)

	local nodes = (getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta).nodes
	resyncIndices(nodes, target, idx, length - 1)
	local tailNode = nodes[length]
	if tailNode then
		setKeyValue(nodes, length, tailNode, nil)
	end

	fireTracker(nodes, target)
	return removed
end

--[[
Moves the element at 1-based index `from` to `to` in a single tracked step without tearing down nested item proxies.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#arrays-and-iteration)
]]
function Store.move(proxy: any, from: number, to: number)
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	if not target then
		table.insert(proxy, to, table.remove(proxy, from))
		return
	end

	local length = #target
	validatePos(from, length)
	validatePos(to, length)
	if from == to then
		return
	end

	table.insert(target, to, table.remove(target, from))

	local nodes = (getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta).nodes
	resyncIndices(nodes, target, math.min(from, to), math.max(from, to))
	fireTracker(nodes, target)
end

local function isArrayLike(t: { [any]: any }): boolean
	return rawget(t, 1) ~= nil
end

local function isArrayIndex(key: any, arrayLen: number): boolean
	return type(key) == "number" and key >= 1 and key <= arrayLen and key == math.floor(key)
end

local reconcileTable: (
	proxy: any,
	target: { [any]: any },
	newData: { [any]: any },
	reconcileKey: string?,
	seen: { [any]: boolean }?
) -> ()

local function destroyOrphanedProxy(rawVal: any)
	if type(rawVal) == "table" then
		local p = proxyCache[rawVal]
		if p ~= nil and not isRootReachable(p) then
			destroyProxy(p)
		end
	end
end

local function syncUnproxied(
	old: { [any]: any },
	newData: { [any]: any },
	reconcileKey: string?,
	seen: { [any]: boolean }
)
	if seen[old] then
		return
	end
	seen[old] = true
	for field, oldFieldVal in old do
		if rawget(newData, field) == nil then
			old[field] = nil
			destroyOrphanedProxy(oldFieldVal)
		end
	end
	for field, value in newData do
		local rawNew = toRaw(value)
		local oldVal = rawget(old, field)
		if isPlainMutable(oldVal) and isPlainMutable(rawNew) then
			local subProxy = proxyCache[oldVal]
			if subProxy ~= nil then
				reconcileTable(subProxy, oldVal, rawNew, reconcileKey, seen)
			elseif oldVal ~= rawNew then
				syncUnproxied(oldVal, rawNew, reconcileKey, seen)
			end
		else
			rawset(old, field, rawNew)
			if oldVal ~= rawNew then
				destroyOrphanedProxy(oldVal)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function reconcileLeaf(
	proxy: any,
	target: { [any]: any },
	nodes: { [any]: any },
	key: any,
	rawNew: any,
	reconcileKey: string?,
	seen: { [any]: boolean }
): boolean
	local oldValue = rawget(target, key)
	if oldValue == rawNew then
		return false
	end
	if isPlainMutable(oldValue) and isPlainMutable(rawNew) then
		local oldProxy = proxyCache[oldValue]
		if oldProxy ~= nil then
			reconcileTable(oldProxy, oldValue, rawNew, reconcileKey, seen)
		else
			syncUnproxied(oldValue, rawNew, reconcileKey, seen)
		end
		return false
	end
	rawset(target, key, rawNew)
	if type(oldValue) == "table" then
		teardownDisplaced(proxy, target, oldValue)
	end
	linkIfProxied(rawNew, proxy)
	local node = nodes[key]
	if node ~= nil then
		setKeyValue(nodes, key, node, rawNew)
	end
	return true
end

local function reconcileArray(
	proxy: any,
	target: { [any]: any },
	newData: { [any]: any },
	nodes: { [any]: any },
	seen: { [any]: boolean }
): (number, boolean)
	local oldLen = #target
	local newLen = #newData
	local span = if oldLen > newLen then oldLen else newLen
	local structural = false

	for i = 1, span do
		structural = reconcileLeaf(proxy, target, nodes, i, toRaw(rawget(newData, i)), nil, seen) or structural
	end

	return span, structural
end

local function toKeySlot(k: any): any
	return if k ~= k then NAN_KEY else k
end

local function reconcileArrayKeyed(
	proxy: any,
	target: { [any]: any },
	newData: { [any]: any },
	nodes: { [any]: any },
	reconcileKey: string,
	seen: { [any]: boolean }
): (number, boolean)
	local oldLen = #target
	local newLen = #newData
	local span = if oldLen > newLen then oldLen else newLen
	local structural = false

	local oldElems = table.create(span)
	local oldByKey: { [any]: any } = {}
	for i = 1, span do
		local el = rawget(target, i)
		if el == nil then
			continue
		end
		oldElems[i] = el
		if type(el) == "table" then
			local k = rawget(el, reconcileKey)
			if k ~= nil then
				oldByKey[toKeySlot(k)] = el
			end
		end
	end

	local matched: { [any]: boolean } = {}
	local seenKeys: { [any]: boolean } = {}
	for i = 1, span do
		local rawNew = toRaw(rawget(newData, i))

		local placed = rawNew
		if isPlainMutable(rawNew) then
			local k = rawget(rawNew, reconcileKey)
			local reuse
			if k ~= nil then
				local kSlot = toKeySlot(k)
				if seenKeys[kSlot] then
					warn(
						`[Flux] Store.reconcile: duplicate key "{tostring(k)}" on field "{reconcileKey}"; keys must be unique or the duplicate aliases one element`
					)
				else
					seenKeys[kSlot] = true
				end
				reuse = oldByKey[kSlot]
			else
				local old: any = oldElems[i]
				if isPlainMutable(old) and rawget(old, reconcileKey) == nil then
					reuse = old
				end
			end
			if reuse ~= nil and isPlainMutable(reuse) then
				matched[reuse] = true
				local childProxy = proxyCache[reuse]
				if childProxy ~= nil then
					reconcileTable(childProxy, reuse, rawNew, reconcileKey, seen)
				else
					syncUnproxied(reuse, rawNew, reconcileKey, seen)
				end
				placed = reuse
			end
		end

		if rawget(target, i) ~= placed then
			structural = true
			rawset(target, i, placed)
			if placed == rawNew then
				linkIfProxied(placed, proxy)
			end
			local node = nodes[i]
			if node ~= nil then
				setKeyValue(nodes, i, node, placed)
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, span do
		local el = oldElems[i]
		if type(el) == "table" and not matched[el] then
			teardownDisplaced(proxy, target, el)
		end
	end

	return span, structural
end

function reconcileTable(
	proxy: any,
	target: { [any]: any },
	newData: { [any]: any },
	reconcileKey: string?,
	seen: { [any]: boolean }?
)
	local visited = seen or {}
	if visited[target] then
		return
	end
	visited[target] = true
	local nodes = (getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta).nodes
	local structural = false

	local arrayLen = 0
	if isArrayLike(target) or isArrayLike(newData) then
		if reconcileKey ~= nil then
			arrayLen, structural = reconcileArrayKeyed(proxy, target, newData, nodes, reconcileKey, visited)
		else
			arrayLen, structural = reconcileArray(proxy, target, newData, nodes, visited)
		end
	end

	for key, newVal in newData do
		if isArrayIndex(key, arrayLen) then
			continue
		end
		structural = reconcileLeaf(proxy, target, nodes, key, toRaw(newVal), reconcileKey, visited) or structural
	end

	for key in target do
		if isArrayIndex(key, arrayLen) then
			continue
		end
		if rawget(newData, key) == nil then
			structural = true
			reconcileLeaf(proxy, target, nodes, key, nil, reconcileKey, visited)
		end
	end

	if structural then
		fireTracker(nodes, target)
	end
end

--[[
Diffs `newData` into the store `proxy` in place, firing only changed leaf nodes and reusing unchanged nested proxies.
Pass `key` to match array elements by `element[key]` instead of array index.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#reconciling-snapshots)
]]
function Store.reconcile<T>(proxy: T, newData: T, key: string?): T
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	assert(target ~= nil, "Store.reconcile expects a store proxy")
	assert(type(newData) == "table", "Store.reconcile newData must be a table")

	local rawNew: { [any]: any } = toRaw(newData)
	reconcileTable(proxy, target, rawNew, key)
	return proxy
end

return table.freeze(Store)

-- UpgradeService: spend doubloons on permanent ship upgrades. Every upgrade
-- is a level with a price, and the HUD shows level and next price.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local BootyCatalog = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BootyCatalog"))
local PirateState = require(script.Parent.PirateState)
local BountyService = require(script.Parent.BountyService)

local UpgradeService = {}

UpgradeService.UPGRADES = {
	speed = { name = "SWIFT SAILS", desc = "+2 walk speed", base = 3000, max = 6 },
	lock = { name = "IRON NET", desc = "+10s base lock", base = 4700, max = 5 },
	slots = { name = "EXTRA PEDESTAL", desc = "+1 base slot", base = 900, max = 2 },
	income = { name = "GOLDEN COMPASS", desc = "+10% income", base = 5000, max = 5 },
}

function UpgradeService.getUpgradeCost(key, level)
	local def = UpgradeService.UPGRADES[key]
	if not def then return 0 end
	return def.base * (2 ^ level)
end

function UpgradeService.buyUpgrade(player, key)
	local def = UpgradeService.UPGRADES[key]
	if not def then return false end
	local level = PirateState.getUpgradeLevel(player, key)
	if level >= def.max then
		PirateState.broadcast(player, { type = "feed", text = def.name .. " is MAXED!", color = "red" })
		return false
	end
	local cost = UpgradeService.getUpgradeCost(key, level)
	if not PirateState.spendCash(player, cost) then
		PirateState.broadcast(player, { type = "feed", text = "Not enough doubloons for " .. def.name .. "!", color = "red" })
		return false
	end
	PirateState.setUpgradeLevel(player, key, level + 1)
	UpgradeService.applyUpgradeToCharacter(player, key)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if state then
		PirateState.broadcast(player, { type = "upgrades", upgrades = state.upgrades })
	end
	PirateState.broadcast(player, { type = "feed", text = "Bought " .. def.name .. " LV " .. tostring(level + 1) .. "!", color = "green" })
	BountyService.addBountyProgress(player, "upgrades", 1)
	return true
end

function UpgradeService.applyUpgradeToCharacter(player, key)
	if key ~= "speed" then return end
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16 + 2 * PirateState.getUpgradeLevel(player, "speed")
end

function UpgradeService.applyAllUpgradesToCharacter(player)
	UpgradeService.applyUpgradeToCharacter(player, "speed")
end

return UpgradeService

--!strict
--[[
Network-synchronized signals shared between the server and clients.
Writes batch once per frame over a single `RemoteEvent` (or `UnreliableRemoteEvent`), and clients sync automatically on join.

```luau
-- Shared
local round = Flux.Sync("Round", "Lobby")
local coins = Flux.Sync("Coins", 0)
local theme = Flux.Sync("Theme", "Dark", function(player, value)
	return value == "Dark" or value == "Light" -- clients may write it; the server validates
end)

-- Server
round("Fighting") -- every client
coins:of(player)(250) -- only that player

-- Client
Flux.new "TextLabel" { Text = function() return `{round()}: {coins()} coins` end }
theme("Light") -- optimistic; rolled back if the server rejects it
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local Instance = Compat.Instance
local compatTask = Compat.task
local warn = Compat.warn

local sampleSignal: any = Graph.signal(nil)
local SignalMT: any = getmetatable(sampleSignal)
local rawGet = SignalMT.get
local rawSet = SignalMT.set
local rawDestroy = SignalMT.Destroy

local function newSignal(initial: any, mt: any): any
	local raw: any = Graph.signal(initial)
	return setmetatable(raw, mt)
end

--[[
Validates a client write on the server (`fn(player, value)`).
Return `true` to accept (`true, replacement` to store `replacement`), or `false`/`nil` to reject without yielding.
]]
export type Validator<T> = (player: Player, value: T) -> (boolean?, ...T?)

--[[
A signal synchronized between the server and clients.
Server writes replicate to all clients, and client writes are validated on the server.
]]
export type SyncSignal<T = any> = Graph.State<T> & {
	--[[
	Returns a per-player signal on the server whose writes replicate only to `player` (returns `self` on the client).
	]]
	of: (self: any, player: Player) -> Graph.State<T>,
	--[[
	Clears `player`'s per-player override on the server so they see the shared value again.
	]]
	clear: (self: any, player: Player) -> (),
	--[[
	Sets the server-side validator that allows clients to write to this signal (`nil` makes it server-only).
	]]
	validate: (self: any, fn: Validator<T>?) -> SyncSignal<T>,
	--[[
	Configures this signal to replicate over an `UnreliableRemoteEvent` instead of a reliable `RemoteEvent`.
	]]
	unreliable: (self: any, enabled: boolean?) -> SyncSignal<T>,
}

export type SyncNamespace = setmetatable<{
	--[[
	Sends all pending synced changes immediately instead of waiting for the end of the frame.
	]]
	read flush: () -> (),
	--[[
	Read-only node that is `true` on the server and turns `true` on the client once the initial sync arrives.
	]]
	read ready: Graph.Node<boolean>,
	read [string]: SyncSignal<any>,
}, {
	read __call: <T>(self: unknown, key: string, initial: T, validate: Validator<T>?) -> SyncSignal<T>,
}>

-- Each synced signal stores its graph node at `[1]` alongside Sync's `_` bookkeeping fields.
type Synced = {
	_sync: Sync,
	_key: string,
	_id: string?,
	_validator: Validator<any>?,
	_unreliable: boolean,
	-- written (or given an initial) since creation, so a later `Flux.Sync(key, initial)` must not overwrite it
	_touched: boolean,
	-- server: per-player signals, created by the first `:of` (which routes accepted client writes per player)
	_own: { [any]: PlayerSignal }?,
	_ownCount: number,
	_yieldWarned: boolean?,
	-- client: the stamp of the last batch that carried this signal
	_lastSent: number,
}

type PlayerSignal = {
	_owner: Synced?,
	_player: any,
}

-- One side of the protocol. `reliable`/`unreliable` are the remotes, or tables with the same Fire methods in tests.
type Sync = {
	isServer: boolean,
	reliable: any,
	unreliable: any,
	signals: { [string]: Synced },
	byId: { [string]: Synced },
	ready: Graph.State<boolean>,
	connections: { RBXScriptConnection },
	-- server
	count: number,
	-- joined players -> client batches received (the ack they get back)
	received: { [any]: number },
	-- players who left; weak keys
	gone: { [any]: true },
	ackDirty: { [any]: boolean },
	playerDirty: { [any]: { [Synced]: boolean } },
	rollbackDirty: { [any]: { [Synced]: boolean } },
	globalDirty: { [Synced]: boolean },
	announce: { Synced },
	validating: Synced?,
	validatingPlayer: any,
	wrote: boolean,
	localOnly: boolean?,
	-- client
	joined: boolean,
	sent: number,
	acked: number,
	outDirty: { [Synced]: boolean },
}

local MAX_BATCH_PAIRS = 256
local instances: { [Sync]: true } = {}
local default: Sync? = nil

-- Batch buffers reused by every flush (flushes never nest: remotes serialize their arguments on the spot).
local reliableBuf: { any } = {}
local unreliableBuf: { any } = {}
local scopedBuf: { Synced } = {}

local function push(list: { any }, n: number, id: any, value: any): number
	list[n + 1] = id
	list[n + 2] = value
	return n + 2
end

local function pushEntry(
	reliableList: { any },
	rn: number,
	unreliableList: { any },
	un: number,
	entry: Synced,
	value: any
): (number, number)
	if entry._unreliable then
		return rn, push(unreliableList, un, entry._id, value)
	end
	return push(reliableList, rn, entry._id, value), un
end

local function idOf(n: number): string
	if n < 256 then
		return string.char(n)
	elseif n < 65536 then
		return string.pack("<I2", n)
	end
	error("Flux.Sync: more than 65536 synced signals", 5)
end

local function nodeValue(signal: any): any
	local inner = rawget(signal, 1)
	return if inner ~= nil then inner[1] else nil
end

local function valueFor(entry: Synced, player: any): any
	local own = entry._own
	local mine = own and own[player]
	return nodeValue(mine or entry)
end

local function markPlayer(sync: Sync, entry: Synced, player: any)
	local dirty = sync.playerDirty[player]
	if dirty == nil then
		dirty = {}
		sync.playerDirty[player] = dirty
	end
	dirty[entry] = true
end

local function written(sync: Sync, entry: Synced, player: any?)
	if not sync.isServer then
		sync.outDirty[entry] = true
		return
	end
	if sync.validating == entry and (player == nil or player == sync.validatingPlayer) then
		sync.wrote = true
	end
	if player == nil then
		sync.globalDirty[entry] = true
	else
		markPlayer(sync, entry, player)
	end
end

-- Drops `player`'s own signal; true if there was one.
local function drop(entry: Synced, player: any): boolean
	local own = entry._own
	local mine = if own then own[player] else nil
	if own == nil or mine == nil then
		return false
	end
	own[player] = nil
	entry._ownCount -= 1
	mine._owner = nil
	rawDestroy(mine)
	return true
end

local function call(self: any, value: any?, force: boolean?): any
	if value == nil and not force then
		return rawGet(self)
	end
	return self:set(value, force)
end

-- Forces a write of the current value so in-place table mutations replicate, or updates from the current value untracked when `fn` is given.
local function update(self: any, fn: ((current: any) -> any)?): any
	if fn ~= nil then
		if type(fn) ~= "function" then
			error(`Flux.Sync:update expected a function or nil, got {typeof(fn)}`, 2)
		end
		local current = self:peek()
		local nextValue = if Graph.isReactive()
			then Graph.untrack(function()
				return fn(current)
			end)
			else fn(current)
		self:set(nextValue)
		return self
	end
	self:set(nodeValue(self), true)
	return self
end

local SyncMT: any = table.clone(SignalMT)
SyncMT.__index = SyncMT
SyncMT.__call = call
SyncMT.update = update

local PlayerMT: any = table.clone(SignalMT)
PlayerMT.__index = PlayerMT
PlayerMT.__call = call
PlayerMT.update = update

function SyncMT.set(self: Synced, value: any, force: boolean?): any
	if rawget(self :: any, 1) == nil then
		return rawSet(self, value, force)
	end
	local old = nodeValue(self)
	rawSet(self, value, force)
	local sync = self._sync
	if sync.isServer and sync.validating == self then
		sync.wrote = true
	end
	self._touched = true
	if old ~= value or force then
		written(sync, self, nil)
	end
	return value
end

function PlayerMT.set(self: PlayerSignal, value: any, force: boolean?): any
	if rawget(self :: any, 1) == nil then
		return rawSet(self, value, force)
	end
	local old = nodeValue(self)
	rawSet(self, value, force)
	local owner = self._owner
	if owner then
		local sync = owner._sync
		if sync.isServer and sync.validating == owner and self._player == sync.validatingPlayer then
			sync.wrote = true
		end
		if old ~= value or force then
			written(sync, owner, self._player)
		end
	end
	return value
end

function SyncMT.Destroy(_self: Synced)
	error("Flux.Sync: synced signals cannot be destroyed directly", 2)
end

function SyncMT.of(self: Synced, player: any): any
	local sync = self._sync
	if not sync.isServer then
		return self
	end
	local own = self._own
	local mine = if own then own[player] else nil
	if mine then
		return mine
	elseif sync.gone[player] then
		error(`Flux.Sync: {player} left; "{self._key}" has no value for them anymore`, 2)
	end
	local node: PlayerSignal = newSignal(nodeValue(self), PlayerMT)
	node._owner = self
	node._player = player
	if own then
		own[player] = node
	else
		self._own = { [player] = node }
	end
	self._ownCount += 1
	-- the player may not have been sent the shared value this node starts from yet
	markPlayer(sync, self, player)
	return node
end

function SyncMT.clear(self: Synced, player: any)
	local sync = self._sync
	if sync.isServer and sync.validating == self and player == sync.validatingPlayer then
		sync.wrote = true
	end
	if drop(self, player) then
		written(sync, self, player)
	end
end

function PlayerMT.Destroy(self: PlayerSignal)
	local owner = self._owner
	if owner then
		SyncMT.clear(owner, self._player)
	else
		rawDestroy(self)
	end
end

function SyncMT.validate(self: Synced, fn: Validator<any>?): any
	self._validator = fn
	return self
end

function SyncMT.unreliable(self: Synced, enabled: boolean?): any
	self._unreliable = enabled ~= false
	return self
end

table.freeze(SyncMT)
table.freeze(PlayerMT)

local function createEntry(sync: Sync, key: string, initial: any): Synced
	local id = if sync.isServer then idOf(sync.count) else nil
	local entry: Synced = newSignal(initial, SyncMT)
	entry._sync = sync
	entry._key = key
	entry._id = id
	entry._unreliable = false
	entry._touched = initial ~= nil
	entry._ownCount = 0
	entry._lastSent = 0
	sync.signals[key] = entry
	if id then
		sync.count += 1
		sync.byId[id] = entry
		if next(sync.received) ~= nil then
			table.insert(sync.announce, entry)
		end
	end
	return entry
end

local function signal(sync: Sync, key: string, initial: any, validate: Validator<any>?): Synced
	if type(key) ~= "string" then
		error(`Flux.Sync: the key must be a string, got {typeof(key)}`, 3)
	end
	local entry = sync.signals[key]
	if entry == nil then
		entry = createEntry(sync, key, initial)
	elseif initial ~= nil and not entry._touched then
		entry._touched = true
		rawSet(entry, initial)
		if sync.isServer then
			sync.globalDirty[entry] = true
		end
	end
	if validate then
		entry._validator = validate
	end
	return entry
end

-- client: applies a server value unless the client has a write the server has not answered yet
local function applyRemote(sync: Sync, entry: Synced?, value: any)
	if entry == nil or sync.outDirty[entry] or entry._lastSent > sync.acked then
		return
	end
	entry._touched = true
	rawSet(entry, value)
end

local function link(sync: Sync, links: any, handshake: boolean)
	if type(links) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	for id, data in links do
		if type(id) ~= "string" or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data[1]) ~= "string" then
			continue
		end
		local key = data[1]
		local entry = sync.signals[key] or createEntry(sync, key, nil)
		entry._id = id
		sync.byId[id] = entry
		applyRemote(sync, entry, data[2])
	end
	if handshake and not sync.joined then
		sync.joined = true
		sync.ready:set(true)
	end
end

local function unpackResume(ok: boolean, ...: any): (boolean, number, any, any)
	return ok, select("#", ...), ...
end

-- Runs `entry`'s validator on a coroutine so a yield is caught (and rejected) instead of leaking `validating` into
-- other remote threads. Returns whether to store a value and which one.
local function runValidator(
	sync: Sync,
	entry: Synced,
	validator: Validator<any>,
	player: any,
	value: any
): (boolean, any)
	local thread = coroutine.create(validator)
	sync.validating, sync.validatingPlayer, sync.wrote = entry, player, false
	local ok, count, accepted, replacement = unpackResume(coroutine.resume(thread, player, value))
	sync.validating, sync.validatingPlayer = nil, nil
	if coroutine.status(thread) ~= "dead" then
		coroutine.close(thread)
		if not entry._yieldWarned then
			entry._yieldWarned = true
			warn(
				`[Flux] Sync validator for "{entry._key}" yielded; validators must not yield, so the write is rejected`
			)
		end
		return false, nil
	elseif not ok then
		warn(`[Flux] Sync validator for "{entry._key}" errored: {accepted}`)
		return false, nil
	end
	if not accepted or sync.wrote then
		return false, nil
	end
	return true, if count >= 2 then replacement else value
end

local function applyServer(sync: Sync, entry: Synced, player: any, value: any)
	local accepted = false
	local validator = entry._validator
	if validator then
		local accept, stored = runValidator(sync, entry, validator, player, value)
		if accept then
			accepted = true
			local target: any = if entry._own then SyncMT.of(entry, player) else entry
			target:set(stored)
		end
	end
	if valueFor(entry, player) ~= value then
		if entry._unreliable then
			local rollback = sync.rollbackDirty[player]
			if rollback == nil then
				rollback = {}
				sync.rollbackDirty[player] = rollback
			end
			rollback[entry] = true
		elseif not (accepted and entry._ownCount == 0 and sync.globalDirty[entry]) then
			written(sync, entry, player)
		end
	else
		-- the client already shows this value; skip echoing it back to them
		local dirty = sync.playerDirty[player]
		if dirty then
			dirty[entry] = nil
		end
		local rollback = sync.rollbackDirty[player]
		if rollback then
			rollback[entry] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function hello(sync: Sync, player: any)
	if sync.received[player] or sync.gone[player] then
		return
	end
	sync.received[player] = 0
	sync.playerDirty[player] = nil
	sync.rollbackDirty[player] = nil
	local links = {}
	for key, entry in sync.signals do
		links[entry._id :: string] = { key, valueFor(entry, player) }
	end
	sync.reliable:FireClient(player, links, true)
end

-- Server -> client messages: `(id, value, ...)` batches, `(ack, id, value, ...)` per-player batches (ack = client
-- batches processed), `(links)` new ids and `(links, true)` the join handshake, links being
-- `{ [id] = { key, value } }`. Client -> server: `()` hello and `(id, value, ...)` batches.
local function receive(sync: Sync, ...: any)
	local n = select("#", ...)
	if sync.isServer then
		local player = ...
		if n == 1 then
			hello(sync, player)
			return
		end
		local received = sync.received[player]
		if received == nil then
			return
		end
		sync.received[player] = received + 1
		sync.ackDirty[player] = true
		local args = { ... }
		local byId = sync.byId
		local lastArg = math.min(n, 1 + MAX_BATCH_PAIRS * 2)
		if lastArg <= 3 then
			local id = args[2]
			local entry = if type(id) == "string" then byId[id] else nil
			if entry then
				applyServer(sync, entry, player, args[3])
			end
		else
			local seenIndex: { [string]: number } = {}
			local entries: { Synced } = {}
			local values: { any } = {}
			local uniqueCount = 0
			for i = 2, lastArg, 2 do
				local id = args[i]
				local entry = if type(id) == "string" then byId[id] else nil
				if entry then
					local slot = seenIndex[id]
					if slot ~= nil then
						values[slot] = args[i + 1]
					else
						uniqueCount += 1
						seenIndex[id] = uniqueCount
						entries[uniqueCount] = entry
						values[uniqueCount] = args[i + 1]
					end
				end
			end
			for i = 1, uniqueCount do
				applyServer(sync, entries[i], player, values[i])
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if n == 0 then
		return
	end
	local first, second = ...
	if type(first) == "table" then
		link(sync, first, second == true)
		return
	end
	local start = 1
	if type(first) == "number" then
		sync.acked = math.max(sync.acked, first)
		start = 2
	end
	if n < start then
		return
	end
	local args = { ... }
	local byId = sync.byId
	for i = start, n, 2 do
		local id = args[i]
		applyRemote(sync, if type(id) == "string" then byId[id] else nil, args[i + 1])
	end
end

local ensureServerRemotes: (sync: Sync) -> (any, any)

local function flushServer(sync: Sync)
	if sync.localOnly then
		table.clear(sync.globalDirty)
		table.clear(sync.announce)
		return
	end
	local reliable, unreliable
	if sync == default then
		reliable, unreliable = ensureServerRemotes(sync)
	else
		reliable = sync.reliable
		unreliable = sync.unreliable or reliable
	end
	local received, globalDirty, playerDirty, rollbackDirty, ackDirty =
		sync.received, sync.globalDirty, sync.playerDirty, sync.rollbackDirty, sync.ackDirty

	local announce = sync.announce
	if #announce > 0 then
		local anyScoped = false
		for _, entry in announce do
			if entry._ownCount > 0 then
				anyScoped = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not anyScoped then
			local hasRecipients = next(received) ~= nil
			local links = if hasRecipients then {} else nil
			for _, entry in announce do
				if links then
					links[entry._id] = { entry._key, nodeValue(entry) }
				end
				globalDirty[entry] = nil
				for _, dirty in playerDirty do
					dirty[entry] = nil
				end
			end
			table.clear(announce)
			if links then
				reliable:FireAllClients(links)
			end
		else
			for player in received do
				local dirty = playerDirty[player]
				local links = {}
				for _, entry in announce do
					links[entry._id] = { entry._key, valueFor(entry, player) }
					if dirty then
						dirty[entry] = nil
					end
				end
				reliable:FireClient(player, links)
			end
			for _, entry in announce do
				globalDirty[entry] = nil
			end
			table.clear(announce)
		end
	end

	-- shared values of signals with per-player overrides go out per player, skipping players with their own
	local sn = 0
	for entry in globalDirty do
		if entry._ownCount > 0 then
			sn += 1
			scopedBuf[sn] = entry
		end
	end

	local rn, un
	for player, ack in received do
		local dirty = playerDirty[player]
		local hasDirty = dirty ~= nil and next(dirty) ~= nil
		local rollback = rollbackDirty[player]
		local hasRollback = rollback ~= nil and next(rollback) ~= nil
		if not hasDirty and not hasRollback and sn == 0 and not ackDirty[player] then
			continue
		end
		reliableBuf[1] = ack
		rn, un = 1, 0
		if hasRollback and rollback ~= nil then
			for entry in rollback do
				rn = push(reliableBuf, rn, entry._id, valueFor(entry, player))
				if dirty then
					dirty[entry] = nil
				end
			end
			table.clear(rollback)
		end
		if dirty ~= nil and hasDirty then
			for entry in dirty do
				rn, un = pushEntry(reliableBuf, rn, unreliableBuf, un, entry, valueFor(entry, player))
			end
		end
		for i = 1, sn do
			local entry = scopedBuf[i]
			local own = entry._own
			if (own == nil or own[player] == nil) and not (dirty ~= nil and dirty[entry]) then
				rn, un = pushEntry(reliableBuf, rn, unreliableBuf, un, entry, nodeValue(entry))
			end
		end
		if dirty ~= nil and hasDirty then
			table.clear(dirty)
		end
		if rn > 1 or ackDirty[player] then
			ackDirty[player] = nil
			reliable:FireClient(player, table.unpack(reliableBuf, 1, rn))
		end
		if un > 0 then
			unreliable:FireClient(player, table.unpack(unreliableBuf, 1, un))
		end
	end

	if next(globalDirty) ~= nil then
		if next(received) ~= nil then
			rn, un = 0, 0
			for entry in globalDirty do
				if entry._ownCount == 0 then
					rn, un = pushEntry(reliableBuf, rn, unreliableBuf, un, entry, nodeValue(entry))
				end
			end
			if rn > 0 then
				reliable:FireAllClients(table.unpack(reliableBuf, 1, rn))
			end
			if un > 0 then
				unreliable:FireAllClients(table.unpack(unreliableBuf, 1, un))
			end
		end
		table.clear(globalDirty)
	end

	-- release the values the buffers still reference
	table.clear(reliableBuf)
	table.clear(unreliableBuf)
	table.clear(scopedBuf)
end

local function flushClient(sync: Sync)
	local outDirty = sync.outDirty
	if not sync.joined or next(outDirty) == nil then
		return
	end
	local stamp = sync.sent + 1
	local n = 0
	for entry in outDirty do
		local id = entry._id
		if id then
			n = push(reliableBuf, n, id, nodeValue(entry))
			entry._lastSent = stamp
			outDirty[entry] = nil
		end
	end
	if n > 0 then
		sync.sent = stamp
		sync.reliable:FireServer(table.unpack(reliableBuf, 1, n))
		table.clear(reliableBuf)
	end
end

local function flush(sync: Sync)
	if sync.isServer then
		flushServer(sync)
	else
		flushClient(sync)
	end
end

local function playerRemoving(sync: Sync, player: any)
	sync.gone[player] = true
	for _, entry in sync.signals do
		drop(entry, player)
	end
	sync.received[player] = nil
	sync.ackDirty[player] = nil
	sync.playerDirty[player] = nil
	sync.rollbackDirty[player] = nil
end

local function start(sync: Sync)
	if not sync.isServer then
		sync.reliable:FireServer()
	end
end

local function destroy(sync: Sync)
	instances[sync] = nil
	for _, conn in sync.connections do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(sync.connections)
	if default == sync then
		default = nil
	end
	rawDestroy(sync.ready)
end

-- Method form for tests (`inst:flush()`); the module calls the functions directly.
local InstanceMT = table.freeze({
	__index = table.freeze({
		signal = signal,
		flush = flush,
		receive = receive,
		start = start,
		destroy = destroy,
		playerRemoving = playerRemoving,
	}),
})

local function newSync(isServer: boolean, reliable: any, unreliable: any, localOnly: boolean?): Sync
	local raw: any = setmetatable({
		isServer = isServer,
		reliable = reliable,
		unreliable = unreliable,
		signals = {},
		byId = {},
		ready = Graph.signal(isServer),
		connections = {},
		count = 0,
		received = {},
		gone = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		ackDirty = {},
		playerDirty = {},
		rollbackDirty = {},
		globalDirty = {},
		announce = {},
		validating = nil,
		validatingPlayer = nil,
		wrote = false,
		localOnly = if localOnly then true else nil,
		joined = false,
		sent = 0,
		acked = 0,
		outDirty = {},
	}, InstanceMT)
	local sync: Sync = raw
	instances[sync] = true
	return sync
end

local function onEvent(...: any)
	receive(default :: Sync, ...)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	-- deferred so other PlayerRemoving handlers (saving data, say) can still read `sig:of(player)`
	compatTask.defer(playerRemoving, default :: Sync, player)
end

local function connectClient(sync: Sync, container: Instance)
	local event = container:WaitForChild("SyncEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	local unreliableEvent = container:WaitForChild("SyncUnreliable") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
	if default ~= sync then
		return
	end
	sync.reliable = event
	table.insert(sync.connections, event.OnClientEvent:Connect(onEvent))
	table.insert(sync.connections, unreliableEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(onEvent))
	start(sync)
end

local function findOrCreate(container: Instance, name: string, class: "RemoteEvent" | "UnreliableRemoteEvent"): any
	local remote = container:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not remote then
		remote = Instance.new(class)
		remote.Name = name
		remote.Parent = container
	end
	return remote
end

function ensureServerRemotes(sync: Sync): (any, any)
	local reliable = sync.reliable
	if reliable == nil or reliable.Parent ~= script then
		if sync.connections[1] then
			sync.connections[1]:Disconnect()
		end
		reliable = findOrCreate(script, "SyncEvent", "RemoteEvent")
		sync.reliable = reliable
		sync.connections[1] = reliable.OnServerEvent:Connect(onEvent)
	end
	local unreliable = sync.unreliable
	if unreliable == nil or unreliable.Parent ~= script then
		unreliable = findOrCreate(script, "SyncUnreliable", "UnreliableRemoteEvent")
		sync.unreliable = unreliable
	end
	return reliable, unreliable or reliable
end

-- Wires the default instance to remotes under this module: the server creates them, a client waits for them in the
-- background so creating signals never yields. Clients only send on the reliable remote, so the server only listens
-- there.
local function getDefault(): Sync
	if default then
		if default.isServer and not default.localOnly then
			ensureServerRemotes(default)
		end
		return default
	end
	local runService = Compat.getService("RunService")
	local players = Compat.getService("Players")
	if not Compat.isRoblox or not runService or not players then
		error("Flux.Sync needs Roblox; headless tests use Sync._internal.create", 3)
	end
	local okEdit, isEdit = pcall(function()
		return runService:IsEdit()
	end)
	if (okEdit and isEdit == true) or (runService:IsStudio() and not runService:IsRunning()) then
		local sync = newSync(true, nil, nil, true)
		default = sync
		return sync
	end
	if runService:IsServer() then
		local event: RemoteEvent = findOrCreate(script, "SyncEvent", "RemoteEvent")
		local unreliableEvent: UnreliableRemoteEvent = findOrCreate(script, "SyncUnreliable", "UnreliableRemoteEvent")
		local sync = newSync(true, event, unreliableEvent)
		default = sync
		sync.connections[1] = event.OnServerEvent:Connect(onEvent)
		sync.connections[2] = players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
		return sync
	end
	local sync = newSync(false, nil, nil)
	default = sync
	compatTask.spawn(connectClient, sync, script)
	return sync
end

-- `Flux.Sync` and test namespaces share this metatable; a test namespace holds its instance at `_sync`.
local NamespaceMT = {}

function NamespaceMT.__index(ns: any, key: any): any
	local sync = rawget(ns, "_sync") or getDefault()
	if key == "ready" then
		return sync.ready
	end
	return signal(sync, key, nil)
end

function NamespaceMT.__call(ns: any, key: string, initial: any, validate: Validator<any>?): any
	return signal(rawget(ns, "_sync") or getDefault(), key, initial, validate)
end

function NamespaceMT.__newindex(_ns: any, key: any, _value: any)
	error(`Flux.Sync is read-only (attempted to assign key "{tostring(key)}")`, 2)
end

table.freeze(NamespaceMT)

local function flushDefault()
	if default then
		flush(default)
	end
end

local function stepAll()
	for sync in instances do
		flush(sync)
	end
end

-- Tests: a namespace over remote-shaped tables (`FireClient`/`FireAllClients` or `FireServer`), plus its instance.
local function createInternal(isServer: boolean, reliable: any, unreliable: any?): (SyncNamespace, any)
	local sync = newSync(isServer, reliable, unreliable)
	local function flushThis()
		flush(sync)
	end
	local ns: any = setmetatable({ _sync = sync, flush = flushThis }, NamespaceMT)
	return ns, sync
end

local Sync: any = setmetatable({ flush = flushDefault }, NamespaceMT)

--- @ignore
rawset(
	Sync,
	"_internal",
	table.freeze({
		-- Flushes every Sync instance; init.luau runs it each frame after the graph flush.
		flushAll = stepAll,
		step = stepAll,
		create = createInternal,
	})
)

return Sync :: SyncNamespace & { _internal: any }

-- SOFTWARE.

-- init.server.luau
-- Boots Rotbeard's Lagoon: creates the remotes, paints the world sign and
-- pedestal numbers, fills the rival deck, starts every loop, and wires
-- player join/leave plus client actions.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Create the remotes BEFORE any require, so the client never waits on a
-- remote that only appears after the require chain. PirateState reuses the
-- LagoonUpdate remote created here.
local LagoonAction = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
LagoonAction.Name = "LagoonAction"
LagoonAction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local LagoonUpdate = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
LagoonUpdate.Name = "LagoonUpdate"
LagoonUpdate.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

-- Require the modules. Rojo builds this file into a Script named "Server"
-- whose children are the server modules, so the requires are of the form
-- require(script.<ModuleName>). Shared modules come from ReplicatedStorage.
local PirateState = require(script.PirateState)
local TreasureChuteService = require(script.TreasureChuteService)
local DoubloonService = require(script.DoubloonService)
local PlunderService = require(script.PlunderService)
local StormService = require(script.StormService)
local RivalCrewService = require(script.RivalCrewService)
local LegendService = require(script.LegendService)
local UpgradeService = require(script.UpgradeService)
local BountyService = require(script.BountyService)
local Stagehand = require(script.Stagehand)

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local BootyCatalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BootyCatalog"))
local RigBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("RigBuilder"))
local LagoonLayout = require(Shared:WaitForChild("LagoonLayout"))

-- The slap range in studs (for finding the nearest other player).
local SLAP_RANGE = 14

-- Sends the full snapshot to a player: cash, income per second, rebirths,
-- rebirth multiplier, slots, upgrades, the bounty list, the found set, the
-- base, and the remaining lock seconds.
local function sendSnapshot(player)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "snapshot",
		cash = state.cash,
		income = PirateState.getIncomePerSecond(player),
		rebirths = state.rebirths,
		multiplier = PirateState.getRebirthMultiplier(player),
		slots = state.slots,
		upgrades = state.upgrades,
		bounties = BountyService.getBountyList(player),
		found = state.found,
		base = state.base,
		remaining = math.floor(PirateState.getBaseLockRemaining(player)),
	})
end

-- Sets up a player who joined: creates the state, wires character spawn
-- (wait 1 second, apply all upgrades, apply the rebirth aura if the player
-- has any rebirths), and sends the snapshot 1 second after join.
local function setupPlayer(player)
	PirateState.initPlayerState(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		task.wait(1)
		if not PirateState.getState(player) then
			return
		end
		UpgradeService.applyAllUpgradesToCharacter(player)
		local state = PirateState.getState(player)
		if state and state.rebirths > 0 then
			LegendService.applyRebirthAura(player)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(1)
		sendSnapshot(player)
	end)
end

-- Finds the nearest other player within 14 studs of the given player, by
-- HumanoidRootPart distance. Returns nil when no other player is in range.
local function findNearestPlayerInRange(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	local nearest = nil
	local nearestDistance = SLAP_RANGE
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if other ~= player then
			local otherChar = other.Character
			if otherChar then
				local otherRoot = otherChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if otherRoot then
					local distance = (otherRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if distance <= nearestDistance then
						nearest = other
						nearestDistance = distance
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest
end

-- Paint the lagoon sign, then the pedestal numbers for bases A, B, and R.
RigBuilder.paintLagoonSign()
RigBuilder.paintPedestalNumbers("A")
RigBuilder.paintPedestalNumbers("B")
RigBuilder.paintPedestalNumbers("R")

-- Fill the rival plot, start the chute loop, start the income loop, and
-- start the event scheduler.
RivalCrewService.populateSoloRivalPlot()
TreasureChuteService.startChuteLoop()
DoubloonService.startIncomeLoop()
StormService.startEventScheduler()

-- Expire base locks every 5 seconds.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(5)
		PlunderService.expireBaseLocks()
	end
end)

-- Handle players already in the server at boot, then new joins and leaves.
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	setupPlayer(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	PirateState.removePlayerState(player)
end)

-- Dispatch client actions from the LagoonAction remote.
LagoonAction.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, arg1, arg2)
	if action == "snapshot" then
		sendSnapshot(player)
	elseif action == "lock" then
		PlunderService.activateBaseLock(player)
	elseif action == "slap" then
		local nearest = findNearestPlayerInRange(player)
		if nearest then
			PlunderService.handleSlapPlayer(player, nearest)
		end
	elseif action == "rebirth" then
		if LegendService.canPlayerRebirth(player) then
			LegendService.performPlayerRebirth(player)
		end
	elseif action == "buyUpgrade" then
		UpgradeService.buyUpgrade(player, arg1)
	elseif action == "stealFrom" then
		PlunderService.startStealBrainrot(player, arg1, arg2)
	elseif action == "stealRival" then
		RivalCrewService.handleStealFromRivalPlot(player, arg1)
	end
end)

-- Keep the Stagehand module referenced so the TOUR steps can require it.
local _stagehand = Stagehand
local _catalog = BootyCatalog
local _layout = LagoonLayout
local _update = LagoonUpdate

print("[Rotbeard's Lagoon] Server booted. 40 brainrots, 3 events, rival crew live.")

--!strict

--[[
	Disable this script if server authority is disabled to avoid equipping tool lag
	https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/server-authority
]]

const requestToolEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
requestToolEvent.Name = "RequestToolEvent"
requestToolEvent.Parent = script

const function onRequestTool(player: Player, tool: Tool?)
	const character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	const humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	if tool == nil then
		humanoid:UnequipTools()
	elseif typeof(tool) == "Instance" and tool:IsA("Tool") then
		-- Only tools the player already owns
		if tool.Parent == character or tool.Parent == player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") then
			humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
		end
	end
end

requestToolEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(onRequestTool)

-- panel, missions, prompts, monsoon banner, notices and pause.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
