local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local BrainrotData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.BrainrotData)
local UiKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.UiKit)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(Config.RemoteFolderName)

local function remote(name)
	return remotes:WaitForChild(name)
end

local BuyEvent = remote(Config.Remotes.Buy)
local PlaceEvent = remote(Config.Remotes.Place)
local SellEvent = remote(Config.Remotes.Sell)
local RebirthEvent = remote(Config.Remotes.Rebirth)
local LockEvent = remote(Config.Remotes.Lock)
local StateEvent = remote(Config.Remotes.State)
local NoticeEvent = remote(Config.Remotes.Notice)
local IncomeEvent = remote(Config.Remotes.Income)

local state = nil
local muted = false
local paused = false
local popupCount = 0

local NAVY = Color3.fromRGB(22, 28, 45)
local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BazaarGui"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Top bar: cash, rate, multiplier, rebirths.
local topBar = UiKit.Frame(gui, {
	Name = "TopBar",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 620, 0, 46),
	BackgroundColor3 = NAVY,
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
})
UiKit.Corner(topBar, 12)
UiKit.Stroke(topBar)
local cashLabel = UiKit.Label(topBar, {
	Name = "Cash",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 1, 0),
	Text = "$250",
	TextSize = 22,
	TextColor3 = GOLD,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
})
local rateLabel = UiKit.Label(topBar, {
	Name = "Rate",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 1, 0),
	Text = "$0/s",
	TextSize = 18,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
})
local multLabel = UiKit.Label(topBar, {
	Name = "Multiplier",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 1, 0),
	Text = "x1.0",
	TextSize = 18,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
})
local rebirthLabel = UiKit.Label(topBar, {
	Name = "Rebirths",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 490, 0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 116, 1, 0),
	Text = "Rebirth 0",
	TextSize = 18,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
})

-- Mission panel, left side.
local missionPanel = UiKit.Frame(gui, {
	Name = "MissionPanel",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 90),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 150),
	BackgroundColor3 = NAVY,
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
})
UiKit.Corner(missionPanel, 12)
UiKit.Stroke(missionPanel)
UiKit.Label(missionPanel, {
	Name = "Header",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24),
	Text = "MISSIONS",
	TextSize = 17,
	TextColor3 = GOLD,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
})
local missionLines = {
	"1. Buy your first brainrot (E)",
	"2. Fill all 8 pedestals",
	"3. Rebirth for +25% income",
}
for i, line in ipairs(missionLines) do
	UiKit.Label(missionPanel, {
		Name = "Mission" .. i,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 36 + (i - 1) * 32),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28),
		Text = line,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
end

-- My Base panel, right side, with one row per pedestal.
local basePanel = UiKit.Frame(gui, {
	Name = "BasePanel",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 90),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 330),
	BackgroundColor3 = NAVY,
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
})
UiKit.Corner(basePanel, 12)
UiKit.Stroke(basePanel)
UiKit.Label(basePanel, {
	Name = "Header",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24),
	Text = "MY BASE",
	TextSize = 17,
	TextColor3 = GOLD,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
})
local slotRows = {}
for slot = 1, Config.PedestalCount do
	local row = UiKit.Frame(basePanel, {
		Name = "Slot" .. slot,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 38 + (slot - 1) * 34),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 42, 62),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
	})
	UiKit.Corner(row, 8)
	local nameLabel = UiKit.Label(row, {
		Name = "SlotName",
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0),
		Text = "Empty pedestal",
		TextSize = 13,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	local sellButton = UiKit.Button(row, {
		Name = "SellButton",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 22),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 60, 60),
		Text = "SELL",
		TextSize = 12,
		Visible = false,
	})
	UiKit.Corner(sellButton, 6)
	sellButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		SellEvent:FireServer(slot)
	end)
	slotRows[slot] = { Name = nameLabel, Sell = sellButton }
end

-- Action buttons under the base panel.
local lockButton = UiKit.Pill(gui, UDim2.new(1, -294, 0, 434), UDim2.new(0, 132, 0, 40), Color3.fromRGB(60, 110, 200), "LOCK BASE", 14)
lockButton.Name = "LockButton"
local rebirthButton = UiKit.Pill(gui, UDim2.new(1, -152, 0, 434), UDim2.new(0, 138, 0, 40), Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 180), "REBIRTH", 14)
rebirthButton.Name = "RebirthButton"
lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	LockEvent:FireServer()
end)
rebirthButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	RebirthEvent:FireServer()
end)

-- Prompts bar along the bottom.
local promptsBar = UiKit.Frame(gui, {
	Name = "PromptsBar",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -12),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 640, 0, 34),
	BackgroundColor3 = NAVY,
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
})
UiKit.Corner(promptsBar, 10)
UiKit.Label(promptsBar, {
	Name = "Prompts",
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
	Text = "E Buy   |   F Place   |   L Lock   |   R Rebirth   |   P Pause   |   M Mute",
	TextSize = 15,
})

-- Monsoon banner, hidden until the warning.
local monsoonBanner = UiKit.Frame(gui, {
	Name = "MonsoonBanner",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 66),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 460, 0, 40),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 90, 140),
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
	Visible = false,
})
UiKit.Corner(monsoonBanner, 10)
UiKit.Stroke(monsoonBanner, Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255))
local monsoonText = UiKit.Label(monsoonBanner, {
	Name = "MonsoonText",
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
	Text = "MONSOON INCOMING",
	TextSize = 18,
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 235, 255),
})

-- Notice popup.
local noticeLabel = UiKit.Label(gui, {
	Name = "Notice",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 116),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 34),
	Text = "",
	TextSize = 17,
	Visible = false,
})

-- Pause panel.
local pausePanel = UiKit.Frame(gui, {
	Name = "PausePanel",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 180),
	BackgroundColor3 = NAVY,
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
	Visible = false,
})
UiKit.Corner(pausePanel, 14)
UiKit.Stroke(pausePanel, GOLD)
UiKit.Label(pausePanel, {
	Name = "PauseTitle",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
	Text = "PAUSED",
	TextSize = 32,
	TextColor3 = GOLD,
})
UiKit.Label(pausePanel, {
	Name = "PauseHint",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 92),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
	Text = "Press P to resume",
	TextSize = 16,
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 220),
})

-- Title screen on top of everything.
local titleScreen = UiKit.Frame(gui, {
	Name = "TitleScreen",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 30),
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
})
UiKit.Label(titleScreen, {
	Name = "Title",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 130),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 700, 0, 70),
	Text = "BRAINROT BAZAAR",
	TextSize = 54,
	TextColor3 = GOLD,
})
UiKit.Label(titleScreen, {
	Name = "Subtitle",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 205),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 700, 0, 32),
	Text = "A floating market of Indonesian street-food brainrots",
	TextSize = 19,
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 215, 230),
})
UiKit.Label(titleScreen, {
	Name = "Controls",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 270),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 700, 0, 90),
	Text = "Buy brainrots at the stalls, carry them home, place them on your pedestals.\nEarn cash every second. Rebirth to multiply it. Beware the monsoon and the thief.",
	TextSize = 16,
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200),
})

playButton.Name = "PlayButton"
playButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	titleScreen.Visible = false
end)

local function showNotice(text)
	noticeLabel.Text = text
	noticeLabel.Visible = true
	noticeLabel.TextTransparency = 0
	task.delay(2.5, function()
		TweenService:Create(noticeLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.8), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		task.delay(0.8, function()
			noticeLabel.Visible = false
		end)
	end)
end

local function spawnIncomePopup(amount)
	popupCount += 1
	local slot = (popupCount - 1) % 5
	local popup = UiKit.Label(gui, {
		Name = "IncomePopup",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -120 + slot * 50, 0, 160),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30),
		Text = "+$" .. amount,
		TextSize = 20,
		TextColor3 = GREEN,
	})
	local tween = TweenService:Create(popup, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -120 + slot * 50, 0, 110),
		TextTransparency = 1,
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		popup:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function refreshBasePanel()
	if not state then
		return
	end
	for slot = 1, Config.PedestalCount do
		local row = slotRows[slot]
		local entry = state.Pedestals[slot]
		if entry then
			local data = BrainrotData.Find(entry.Name)
			local rate = data and math.floor(BrainrotData.IncomePerSecond(data, entry.Mutation, state.Rebirths)) or 0
			row.Name.Text = entry.Name .. "  $" .. rate .. "/s"
			row.Name.TextColor3 = BrainrotData.RarityColors[data.Rarity]
			row.Sell.Visible = true
		else
			row.Name.Text = "Empty pedestal"
			row.Name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)
			row.Sell.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function refreshTopBar()
	if not state then
		return
	end
	cashLabel.Text = "$" .. state.Cash
	rateLabel.Text = "$" .. state.Rate .. "/s"
	multLabel.Text = "x" .. string.format("%.2f", state.Multiplier)
	rebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirth " .. state.Rebirths
	if state.Locked then
		lockButton.Text = "LOCKED " .. state.LockLeft .. "s"
		lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110)
	else
		lockButton.Text = "LOCK BASE"
		lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 110, 200)
	end
end

StateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	state = payload
	refreshTopBar()
	refreshBasePanel()
end)

IncomeEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(gain, cash, rate)
	if state then
		state.Cash = cash
		state.Rate = rate
		refreshTopBar()
	end
	spawnIncomePopup(gain)
end)

local monsoonCounting = false
NoticeEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text)
	showNotice(text)
	if string.find(text, "MONSOON INCOMING", 1, true) and not monsoonCounting then
		monsoonCounting = true
		monsoonBanner.Visible = true
		task.spawn(function()
			for left = Config.MonsoonWarning, 1, -1 do
				monsoonText.Text = "MONSOON IN " .. left .. "s - TAKE SHELTER!"
				task.wait(1)
			end
			monsoonText.Text = "MONSOON WAVE!"
		end)
	elseif text == "The monsoon has passed." then
		monsoonBanner.Visible = false
		monsoonCounting = false
	end
end)

local function nearestStallIndex()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	local best = nil
	local bestDistance = Config.InteractRange
	for index, stallPos in ipairs(Config.StallPositions) do
		local distance = (root.Position - stallPos).Magnitude
		if distance <= bestDistance then
			best = index
			bestDistance = distance
		end
	end
	return best
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end
	local key = input.KeyCode
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		paused = not paused
		pausePanel.Visible = paused
		return
	end
	if paused then
		return
	end
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.M then
		muted = not muted
		showNotice(muted and "Sound muted." or "Sound on.")
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		local stall = nearestStallIndex()
		if stall then
			BuyEvent:FireServer(stall)
		else
			showNotice("Get closer to a market stall.")
		end
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F then
		PlaceEvent:FireServer()
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.L then
		LockEvent:FireServer()
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.R then
		RebirthEvent:FireServer()
	end
end)

--!strict
-- Type-level machinery for property tables and component props: `Properties`, `EditProperties`, `PropertyType`,
-- `Merge`, `Partial`, `Pick`, `Omit`, `NonNil`, and the child types.

local Graph = require("./Graph")
local Instances = require("@self/Instances")

type GraphNode = Graph.Node<any>

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type Map<T> = { [T]: any }

type _ATTR = "__ATTR"
type _CLEAN = "__CLEAN"
type _EVENT = "__EVENT"
type _REF = "__REF"
type _TAG = "__TAG"

-- A handle returned by `Flux.portal(target, children)` that mounts UI into `target` on parent cleanup or portal removal.
export type Portal = { read __fluxPortal: true }
-- A component schema marker returned by `Flux.prop(default)` that makes `default` optional in `Flux.Props` and non-nil in `Flux.split`.
export type DefaultProp<T> = { read __fluxDefault: T }

-- Anything a property table accepts at a numeric index: a child Instance, a node yielding children, a portal, an init
-- action run with the instance, or a nested property table flattened into its parent.
export type Child = Instance | GraphNode | Portal | ((instance: Instance) -> ()) | { [any]: any }
export type Children = { Child }

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function Properties(instance: type?)
	local function indexerTable(indexType: type, valueType: type): type
		local t = types.newtable()
		t:setindexer(indexType, valueType)
		return t
	end

	local function readProp(t: type, key: type, name: string): type?
		if t:is("table") then
			return t:readproperty(key)
		elseif t:is("extern") then
			for k, prop in t:properties() do
				if k:value() == name then
					return prop.read
				end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local result = indexerTable(types.number, types.any)
	-- `__EVENT`: a change listener per property, called with the new value. Signals connect at the top level.
	local events = types.newtable(nil, { index = types.number, readresult = types.never, writeresult = types.never })
	local connectKey = types.singleton("Connect")

	type MemberInfo = {
		key: type,
		signal: type?,
		read: type?,
		write: type?,
	}

	local function collectMembers(component: type?): { [string]: MemberInfo }
		local members: { [string]: MemberInfo } = {}
		local class: type? = component
		while class and (class:is("extern") or class:is("table")) do
			for i, v in class:properties() do
				local propName = i:value()
				if type(propName) ~= "string" or members[propName] ~= nil then
					continue
				end
				local connector = if v.read then readProp(v.read, connectKey, "Connect") else nil
				local isSignal = false
				local sigListener: type? = nil
				if connector then
					if connector:is("function") then
						local params = connector:parameters().head
						if params and params[2] then
							sigListener = params[2]
							isSignal = true
						end
					elseif v.read and v.read:is("extern") then
						isSignal = true
					end
				end
				if isSignal then
					members[propName] = { key = i, signal = sigListener }
				else
					members[propName] = { key = i, read = v.read, write = v.write }
				end
			end
			class = if class:is("extern") then class:readparent() else nil
		end
		return members
	end

	local function uniqueUnion(list: { type }): type
		local unique: { type } = {}
		for _, t in list do
			if not table.find(unique, t) then
				table.insert(unique, t)
			end
		end
		return if #unique == 1 then unique[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(unique))
	end

	local function uniqueIntersection(list: { type }): type
		local unique: { type } = {}
		for _, t in list do
			if not table.find(unique, t) then
				table.insert(unique, t)
			end
		end
		return if #unique == 1 then unique[1] else types.intersectionof(table.unpack(unique))
	end

	local nodeProperties = if GraphNode:is("table") then GraphNode:properties() else nil
	local nodeMetatable = if GraphNode:is("table") then GraphNode:metatable() else nil
	local function nodeOf(valueType: type): type
		if nodeProperties == nil then
			return GraphNode
		end
		local nodeTable = types.newtable()
		local getterFn = types.newfunction({ head = { types.any } }, { head = { valueType } })
		for key, prop in nodeProperties do
			local name = key:value()
			if name == "peek" or name == "get" then
				nodeTable:setreadproperty(key, getterFn)
			else
				local propType = prop.read or prop.write
				if propType then
					nodeTable:setreadproperty(key, propType)
				end
			end
		end
		if nodeMetatable then
			nodeTable:setmetatable(nodeMetatable)
		end
		return nodeTable
	end

	local function emitMember(info: MemberInfo)
		if info.signal then
			result:setreadproperty(info.key, types.optional(info.signal))
			return
		end
		if info.read then
			local changedListener = types.optional(types.newfunction({ head = { info.read } }))
			events:setproperty(info.key, changedListener)
			local propName = info.key:value()
			if type(propName) == "string" then
				result:setreadproperty(types.singleton("_" .. propName), changedListener)
			end
		end
		if info.write then
			local t = types.optional(
				types.unionof(info.write, types.newfunction({}, { head = { info.write } }), nodeOf(info.write))
			)
			result:setreadproperty(info.key, t)
		elseif info.read then
			result:setreadproperty(info.key, types.singleton(nil))
		end
	end

	local function collectBranchMembers(root: type?): { [string]: MemberInfo }
		local merged: { [string]: MemberInfo } = {}
		local function walk(component: type?)
			if component and component:is("intersection") then
				for _, part in component:components() do
					walk(part)
				end
				return
			end
			for propName, info in collectMembers(component) do
				local prev = merged[propName]
				if prev == nil then
					merged[propName] = info
				else
					merged[propName] = {
						key = prev.key,
						signal = info.signal or prev.signal,
						read = info.read or prev.read,
						write = info.write or prev.write,
					}
				end
			end
		end
		walk(root)
		return merged
	end

	if instance and instance:is("union") then
		local branchMaps: { { [string]: MemberInfo } } = {}
		for _, part in instance:components() do
			if not part:is("nil") then
				table.insert(branchMaps, collectBranchMembers(part))
			end
		end
		if #branchMaps == 1 then
			for _, info in branchMaps[1] do
				emitMember(info)
			end
		elseif #branchMaps > 1 then
			local first = branchMaps[1]
			for propName, firstInfo in first do
				local allPresent = true
				local allSignal = firstInfo.signal ~= nil
				local allWrite = firstInfo.write ~= nil
				local sigs: { type } = {}
				local reads: { type } = {}
				local writes: { type } = {}
				for _, map in branchMaps do
					local m = map[propName]
					if m == nil then
						allPresent = false
						break
					end
					if m.signal then
						table.insert(sigs, m.signal)
					else
						allSignal = false
					end
					if m.read then
						table.insert(reads, m.read)
					end
					if m.write then
						table.insert(writes, m.write)
					else
						allWrite = false
					end
				end
				if allPresent then
					if allSignal and #sigs > 0 then
						emitMember({ key = firstInfo.key, signal = uniqueIntersection(sigs) })
					elseif not allSignal then
						emitMember({
							key = firstInfo.key,
							read = if #reads == #branchMaps then uniqueUnion(reads) else nil,
							write = if allWrite and #writes > 0 then uniqueIntersection(writes) else nil,
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	else
		for _, info in collectBranchMembers(instance) do
			emitMember(info)
		end
	end

	local attrListener = types.newfunction({ head = { types.any } })
	events:setproperty(
		_ATTR,
		types.optional(
			types.newtable(nil, { index = types.string, readresult = attrListener, writeresult = attrListener })
		)
	)
	local tagListener = types.newfunction({ head = { types.boolean } })
	events:setproperty(
		_TAG,
		types.optional(
			types.newtable(nil, { index = types.string, readresult = tagListener, writeresult = tagListener })
		)
	)

	result:setreadproperty(_ATTR, types.optional(indexerTable(types.string, types.any)))
	local tag = types.unionof(types.string, GraphNode, types.newfunction({}, { head = { types.any } }))
	result:setreadproperty(_TAG, types.optional(types.unionof(tag, indexerTable(types.number, tag))))
	result:setreadproperty(_CLEAN, types.optional(indexerTable(types.number, types.any)))
	result:setreadproperty(_EVENT, types.optional(events))
	local refType = if instance then instance else types.any
	local refCallback = types.newfunction({ head = { refType } }, { tail = types.any })
	local refState = types.newtable()
	refState:setreadproperty(
		types.singleton("set"),
		types.newfunction({ head = { types.any, refType, types.optional(types.boolean) } }, { head = { types.any } })
	)
	refState:setreadproperty(
		types.singleton("get"),
		types.newfunction({ head = { types.any } }, { head = { types.any } })
	)
	result:setreadproperty(_REF, types.optional(types.unionof(refCallback, refState)))

	return result
end

-- Merges table types into one, later properties winning. `Flux.Props` uses it to add a component's own props to an
-- instance's property table: a table literal checks against one merged table, but not against an intersection.
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function Merge(base: type, extra: type)
	local result = types.newtable()
	local defaultKey = types.singleton("__fluxDefault")
	local function unwrapDefault(t: type): type?
		if t:is("table") then
			return t:readproperty(defaultKey)
		elseif t:is("union") then
			local parts = {}
			local found = false
			for _, part in t:components() do
				if not part:is("nil") then
					local inner = if part:is("table") then part:readproperty(defaultKey) else nil
					if inner then
						found = true
						table.insert(parts, inner)
					else
						table.insert(parts, part)
					end
				end
			end
			if found and #parts > 0 then
				return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function addTable(target: type, source: type, makeOptional: boolean)
		for key, prop in source:properties() do
			local value = prop.read or prop.write
			if value then
				local def = unwrapDefault(value)
				local out = if def or makeOptional then types.optional(def or value) else value
				target:setreadproperty(key, out)
			end
		end
		local indexer = source:indexer()
		if indexer then
			target:setindexer(indexer.index, indexer.readresult)
		end
	end
	local function combineUnion(list: { type }): type
		local unique: { type } = {}
		for _, t in list do
			if not table.find(unique, t) then
				table.insert(unique, t)
			end
		end
		return if #unique == 1 then unique[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(unique))
	end
	local function add(target: type, source: type, makeOptional: boolean)
		if source:is("nil") then
			return
		elseif source:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in source:components() do
				add(target, part, makeOptional)
			end
			return
		elseif source:is("union") then
			local nonNil = {}
			local hasNil = false
			for _, part in source:components() do
				if part:is("nil") then
					hasNil = true
				else
					table.insert(nonNil, part)
				end
			end
			local opt = makeOptional or hasNil
			if #nonNil == 1 then
				add(target, nonNil[1], opt)
				return
			elseif #nonNil > 1 then
				local branchTables: { type } = {}
				local keyByName: { [any]: type } = {}
				for _, part in nonNil do
					local branch = types.newtable()
					add(branch, part, false)
					table.insert(branchTables, branch)
					for key in branch:properties() do
						local name = key:value()
						if name ~= nil and keyByName[name] == nil then
							keyByName[name] = key
						end
					end
				end
				for _, key in keyByName do
					local parts = {}
					local allPresent = true
					for _, branch in branchTables do
						local val = branch:readproperty(key)
						if val == nil then
							allPresent = false
						else
							table.insert(parts, val)
						end
					end
					if #parts > 0 then
						local combined = combineUnion(parts)
						if opt or not allPresent then
							combined = types.optional(combined)
						end
						target:setreadproperty(key, combined)
					end
				end
				for _, branch in branchTables do
					local idx = branch:indexer()
					if idx then
						target:setindexer(idx.index, idx.readresult)
					end
				end
			end
			return
		elseif not source:is("table") then
			return
		end
		addTable(target, source, makeOptional)
	end
	add(result, base, false)
	add(result, extra, false)
	return result
end

-- The property table `Flux.edit` accepts: the same as `Properties`. Selectors (`Flux.Find`) sit at numeric indices.
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type EditProperties<T> = Properties<T>

-- The type of `instance[key]` for `Flux.property`: the property's read type, `boolean` for `"#Tag"` / `"_tag_Tag"`, or
-- `any` for `"$Attribute"` / `"_attr_Attribute"`, an event, or a key the class doesn't have (or a key that isn't a
-- string literal).
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function PropertyType(instance: type, key: type)
	if not key:is("singleton") then
		return types.any
	end
	local name = key:value()
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		return types.any
	end
	local prefix = string.sub(name, 1, 1)
	if prefix == "$" then
		return types.any
	elseif prefix == "#" then
		return types.boolean
	elseif prefix == "_" then
		if string.sub(name, 1, 6) == "_attr_" then
			return types.any
		elseif string.sub(name, 1, 5) == "_tag_" then
			return types.boolean
		end
	end

	local connectKey = types.singleton("Connect")
	local function readProp(t: type, propKey: type, propName: string): type?
		if t:is("table") then
			return t:readproperty(propKey)
		elseif t:is("extern") then
			for k, prop in t:properties() do
				if k:value() == propName then
					return prop.read
				end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function lookup(component: type): type?
		local class: type? = component
		while class and (class:is("extern") or class:is("table")) do
			for propKey, prop in class:properties() do
				if propKey:value() == name then
					local value = prop.read
					if value == nil or readProp(value, connectKey, "Connect") ~= nil then
						return types.any
					end
					return value
				end
			end
			class = if class:is("extern") then class:readparent() else nil
		end
		return nil
	end

	if instance:is("union") then
		local parts: { type } = {}
		for _, part in instance:components() do
			if not part:is("nil") then
				local found = lookup(part)
				if found == nil or found:is("any") then
					return types.any
				elseif not table.find(parts, found) then
					table.insert(parts, found)
				end
			end
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			return types.any
		end
		return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
	end

	local components = if instance:is("intersection") then instance:components() else { instance }
	for _, component in components do
		local found = lookup(component)
		if found ~= nil then
			return found
		end
	end
	return types.any
end

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type Creatable = Instances.Creatable
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type Editable = Instances.Editable

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type Resolve<Name> = index<Creatable & { [string]: Instance }, Name>

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function NonNil(t: type): type
	if t:is("nil") then
		return types.never
	elseif not t:is("union") then
		return t
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, part in t:components() do
		if not part:is("nil") then
			table.insert(parts, part)
		end
	end
	return if #parts == 0 then types.never elseif #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
end

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function Truthy(t: type): type
	if t:is("nil") or (t:is("singleton") and t:value() == false) then
		return types.never
	elseif not t:is("union") then
		return t
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, part in t:components() do
		if not part:is("nil") and not (part:is("singleton") and part:value() == false) then
			table.insert(parts, part)
		end
	end
	return if #parts == 0 then types.never elseif #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
end

-- Merges component schema tables into a single read-only schema table, preserving literal unions.
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function MergeOwn(a: type, b: type, c: type, d: type): type
	local result = types.newtable()
	local function add(source: type)
		if source:is("nil") then
			return
		elseif source:is("union") then
			for _, part in source:components() do
				if not part:is("nil") then
					add(part)
				end
			end
			return
		elseif source:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in source:components() do
				add(part)
			end
			return
		elseif not source:is("table") then
			return
		end
		for key, prop in source:properties() do
			local value = prop.read or prop.write
			if value then
				result:setreadproperty(key, value)
			end
		end
		local indexer = source:indexer()
		if indexer then
			result:setindexer(indexer.index, indexer.readresult)
		end
	end
	add(a)
	add(b)
	add(c)
	add(d)
	return result
end

-- `T` with every property optional.
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function Partial(t: type): type
	if t:is("nil") then
		return t
	elseif t:is("union") then
		local parts = {}
		for _, part in t:components() do
			if not part:is("nil") then
				table.insert(parts, Partial(part))
			end
		end
		return if #parts == 0
			then types.newtable()
			elseif #parts == 1 then parts[1]
			else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
	elseif t:is("intersection") then
		local merged = types.newtable()
		local hasTable = false
		local function collect(source: type)
			if source:is("intersection") then
				for _, part in source:components() do
					collect(part)
				end
				return
			elseif not source:is("table") then
				return
			end
			hasTable = true
			for key, prop in source:properties() do
				local valueType = prop.read or prop.write
				if valueType then
					merged:setproperty(key, types.optional(valueType))
				end
			end
			local indexer = source:indexer()
			if indexer then
				merged:setindexer(indexer.index, indexer.readresult)
			end
		end
		collect(t)
		return if hasTable then merged else t
	elseif not t:is("table") then
		return t
	end
	local result = types.newtable()
	for key, prop in t:properties() do
		local valueType = prop.read or prop.write
		if valueType then
			result:setproperty(key, types.optional(valueType))
		end
	end
	local indexer = t:indexer()
	if indexer then
		result:setindexer(indexer.index, indexer.readresult)
	end
	return result
end

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function CloneProps(t: type): type
	if t:is("nil") then
		return types.newtable()
	elseif t:is("union") then
		for _, part in t:components() do
			if part:is("nil") then
				return Partial(t)
			end
		end
	end
	return t
end

--- @ignore
type function groupKeys(group: type): type
	local keys = types.newtable()
	if group:is("nil") then
		return keys
	elseif group:is("union") or group:is("intersection") then
		for _, part in group:components() do
			local partKeys = groupKeys(part)
			if partKeys:is("string") then
				return partKeys
			end
			for key, prop in partKeys:properties() do
				keys:setproperty(key, prop.read or prop.write or key)
			end
		end
		return keys
	elseif not group:is("table") then
		return types.string
	end
	local indexer = group:indexer()
	if indexer then
		local result = indexer.readresult
		for _, part in if result:is("union") then result:components() else { result } do
			local name = if part:is("singleton") then part:value() else nil
			if name ~= nil and name ~= true and name ~= false then
				keys:setproperty(part, part)
			elseif name ~= true then
				return types.string
			end
		end
	end
	for key, prop in group:properties() do
		keys:setproperty(key, prop.read or prop.write or key)
	end
	return keys
end

--- @ignore
type function pickWhere(t: type, group: type, prior: type, inGroup: type): type
	local wantAll = inGroup:is("singleton") and inGroup:value() == false
	local function isSchema(src: type): boolean
		if src:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in src:components() do
				if not isSchema(part) then
					return false
				end
			end
			return true
		elseif src:is("union") then
			for _, part in src:components() do
				if not part:is("nil") and not isSchema(part) then
					return false
				end
			end
			return true
		end
		return src:is("table") and src:indexer() == nil
	end
	local schemaGroup = isSchema(group)
	local defaultKey = types.singleton("__fluxDefault")

	local function unwrapDefault(src: type): type?
		if src:is("table") then
			return src:readproperty(defaultKey)
		elseif src:is("union") then
			local parts = {}
			local found = false
			for _, part in src:components() do
				if not part:is("nil") then
					local inner = if part:is("table") then part:readproperty(defaultKey) else nil
					if inner then
						found = true
						table.insert(parts, inner)
					else
						table.insert(parts, part)
					end
				end
			end
			if found and #parts > 0 then
				return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function canBeNil(src: type): boolean
		if src:is("nil") then
			return true
		elseif src:is("union") then
			for _, part in src:components() do
				if part:is("nil") then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function stripNil(src: type): type
		if src:is("nil") then
			return types.never
		elseif not src:is("union") then
			return src
		end
		local parts = {}
		for _, part in src:components() do
			if not part:is("nil") then
				table.insert(parts, part)
			end
		end
		return if #parts == 0 then types.never elseif #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
	end

	local function resolveSchemaGroup(src: type, makeOptional: boolean): type
		local keys = groupKeys(src)
		if keys:is("string") then
			return src
		end
		local out = types.newtable()
		for key, prop in keys:properties() do
			local propType = prop.read or prop.write
			if propType then
				local def = unwrapDefault(propType)
				if def then
					out:setproperty(key, def)
				else
					out:setproperty(key, if makeOptional then types.optional(propType) else propType)
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end

	local function flatten(source: type): (type?, boolean)
		if source:is("nil") then
			return nil, true
		elseif source:is("union") then
			local nonNil = {}
			local hasNil = false
			for _, part in source:components() do
				if part:is("nil") then
					hasNil = true
				else
					table.insert(nonNil, part)
				end
			end
			if #nonNil == 1 then
				local inner, innerNil = flatten(nonNil[1])
				return inner, hasNil or innerNil
			end
			return nil, hasNil
		elseif source:is("intersection") then
			local merged = types.newtable()
			local hasTable = false
			local function collect(partSource: type)
				if partSource:is("intersection") then
					for _, part in partSource:components() do
						collect(part)
					end
					return
				elseif partSource:is("union") then
					local inner = flatten(partSource)
					if inner then
						collect(inner)
					end
					return
				elseif not partSource:is("table") then
					return
				end
				hasTable = true
				for key, prop in partSource:properties() do
					local valueType = prop.read or prop.write
					if valueType then
						merged:setproperty(key, valueType)
					end
				end
				local indexer = partSource:indexer()
				if indexer then
					merged:setindexer(indexer.index, indexer.readresult)
				end
			end
			collect(source)
			return if hasTable then merged else nil, false
		elseif source:is("table") then
			return source, false
		end
		return nil, false
	end

	local flat, wasOptional = flatten(t)
	if flat == nil then
		if t:is("union") and not t:is("nil") then
			local parts = {}
			for _, part in t:components() do
				if not part:is("nil") then
					local sub = pickWhere(part, group, prior, inGroup)
					local entry = if wasOptional then Partial(sub) else sub
					if wasOptional and not wantAll and schemaGroup and entry:is("table") then
						local schemaKeys = groupKeys(group)
						if not schemaKeys:is("string") then
							for sKey, sProp in schemaKeys:properties() do
								local sType = sProp.read or sProp.write
								local def = if sType then unwrapDefault(sType) else nil
								if def then
									local curProp = entry:readproperty(sKey)
									if canBeNil(def) then
										local nonNil = if curProp then stripNil(curProp) else types.never
										entry:setproperty(sKey, if nonNil:is("never") then def else curProp :: type)
									else
										local nonNil = if curProp then stripNil(curProp) else types.never
										entry:setproperty(sKey, if nonNil:is("never") then def else nonNil)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					table.insert(parts, entry)
				end
			end
			if #parts > 0 then
				return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
			end
		end
		if wantAll and t:is("nil") then
			return types.newtable()
		elseif not t:is("any") and not wantAll and schemaGroup then
			return resolveSchemaGroup(group, wasOptional)
		end
		return t
	end
	if not wantAll and group:is("nil") then
		return Partial(flat)
	end
	local wanted, excluded = groupKeys(group), groupKeys(prior)
	if wanted:is("string") or excluded:is("string") then
		return Partial(flat)
	end
	local function has(names: type, key: type): boolean
		return names:readproperty(key) ~= nil
	end
	local result = types.newtable()
	for key, prop in flat:properties() do
		local valueType = prop.read or prop.write
		local inWanted = has(wanted, key)
		local outType = if wasOptional and valueType then types.optional(valueType) else valueType
		if not wantAll and schemaGroup and inWanted and valueType then
			local schemaProp = wanted:readproperty(key)
			local def = if schemaProp then unwrapDefault(schemaProp) else nil
			if def then
				if canBeNil(def) then
					local nonNil = stripNil(valueType)
					if nonNil:is("never") then
						outType = def
					elseif wasOptional then
						outType = types.optional(nonNil)
					else
						outType = valueType
					end
				else
					local nonNil = stripNil(valueType)
					outType = if nonNil:is("never") then def else nonNil
				end
			end
		end
		if outType and not has(excluded, key) and inWanted ~= wantAll then
			result:setproperty(key, outType)
		end
	end
	if not wantAll and schemaGroup then
		for key, prop in wanted:properties() do
			if result:readproperty(key) == nil and not has(excluded, key) then
				local fallbackType = prop.read or prop.write
				if fallbackType then
					local def = unwrapDefault(fallbackType)
					result:setproperty(key, if def then def else types.optional(fallbackType))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local indexer = flat:indexer()
	if indexer and wantAll then
		result:setindexer(indexer.index, indexer.readresult)
	end
	return result
end

-- Merges 1-4 table types left-to-right into one read-only type, narrowing optional overrides over earlier non-nil values.
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function MergeTables(a: type, b: type, c: type, d: type): type
	local result = types.newtable()

	local function canBeNil(src: type): boolean
		if src:is("nil") then
			return true
		elseif src:is("union") then
			for _, part in src:components() do
				if part:is("nil") then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function stripNil(src: type): type
		if src:is("nil") then
			return types.never
		elseif not src:is("union") then
			return src
		end
		local parts = {}
		for _, part in src:components() do
			if not part:is("nil") then
				table.insert(parts, part)
			end
		end
		return if #parts == 0 then types.never elseif #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
	end

	local function combine(aType: type, bType: type): type
		local parts: { type } = {}
		local function add(t: type)
			if t:is("never") then
				return
			elseif t:is("union") then
				for _, part in t:components() do
					add(part)
				end
			elseif not table.find(parts, t) then
				table.insert(parts, t)
			end
		end
		add(aType)
		add(bType)
		return if #parts == 0 then types.never elseif #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
	end

	local function mergeProp(prev: type?, nextVal: type, srcOptional: boolean): type
		if prev == nil then
			return if srcOptional then types.optional(nextVal) else nextVal
		elseif not srcOptional and not canBeNil(nextVal) then
			return nextVal
		end
		return combine(prev, stripNil(nextVal))
	end

	local function mergeInto(target: type, source: type, srcOptional: boolean)
		if source:is("nil") then
			return
		elseif source:is("union") then
			local nonNil = {}
			local hasNil = false
			for _, part in source:components() do
				if part:is("nil") then
					hasNil = true
				else
					table.insert(nonNil, part)
				end
			end
			local branchOptional = srcOptional or hasNil
			if #nonNil == 0 then
				return
			elseif #nonNil == 1 then
				mergeInto(target, nonNil[1], branchOptional)
				return
			end
			local branchTables: { type } = {}
			local keyByName: { [any]: type } = {}
			for _, part in nonNil do
				local branch = types.newtable()
				mergeInto(branch, part, false)
				table.insert(branchTables, branch)
				for key in branch:properties() do
					local name = key:value()
					if name ~= nil and keyByName[name] == nil then
						keyByName[name] = key
					end
				end
			end
			for _, key in keyByName do
				local combined: type? = nil
				local allPresentAndNonNil = true
				for _, branch in branchTables do
					local val = branch:readproperty(key)
					if val == nil then
						allPresentAndNonNil = false
					else
						if canBeNil(val) then
							allPresentAndNonNil = false
						end
						local stripped = stripNil(val)
						combined = if combined == nil then stripped else combine(combined, stripped)
					end
				end
				if combined ~= nil then
					local propOptional = branchOptional or not allPresentAndNonNil
					target:setreadproperty(key, mergeProp(target:readproperty(key), combined, propOptional))
				end
			end
			local idxKey: type? = nil
			local idxVal: type? = nil
			local allHaveIndexer = true
			for _, branch in branchTables do
				local idx = branch:indexer()
				if idx == nil then
					allHaveIndexer = false
				else
					idxKey = if idxKey == nil then idx.index else combine(idxKey, idx.index)
					idxVal = if idxVal == nil then idx.readresult else combine(idxVal, idx.readresult)
				end
			end
			if idxKey ~= nil and idxVal ~= nil then
				local finalVal = if branchOptional or not allHaveIndexer then types.optional(idxVal) else idxVal
				target:setindexer(idxKey, finalVal)
			end
			return
		elseif source:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in source:components() do
				mergeInto(target, part, srcOptional)
			end
			return
		elseif not source:is("table") then
			return
		end
		for key, prop in source:properties() do
			local val = prop.read or prop.write
			if val then
				target:setreadproperty(key, mergeProp(target:readproperty(key), val, srcOptional))
			end
		end
		local indexer = source:indexer()
		if indexer then
			local idxVal = if srcOptional then types.optional(indexer.readresult) else indexer.readresult
			local curIdx = target:indexer()
			if curIdx then
				target:setindexer(combine(curIdx.index, indexer.index), combine(curIdx.readresult, idxVal))
			else
				target:setindexer(indexer.index, idxVal)
			end
		end
	end

	mergeInto(result, a, false)
	mergeInto(result, b, false)
	mergeInto(result, c, false)
	mergeInto(result, d, false)
	if result:indexer() == nil then
		result:setindexer(types.number, types.any)
	end
	return result
end

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type Pick<T, G> = pickWhere<T, G, nil, true>

--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type Omit<T, G> = pickWhere<T, nil, G, false>

-- Extracts the first payload type accepted by a signal's `Connect` / `connect` listener, defaulting to `any`.
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function SignalPayload(sig: type): type
	local connectKey = types.singleton("Connect")
	local lowerConnectKey = types.singleton("connect")

	local function fromObject(t: type): type?
		local current: type? = t
		while current and (current:is("extern") or current:is("table")) do
			local connector: type? = nil
			if current:is("table") then
				connector = current:readproperty(connectKey) or current:readproperty(lowerConnectKey)
			else
				for k, prop in current:properties() do
					local kn = k:value()
					if kn == "Connect" then
						connector = prop.read
						break
					elseif kn == "connect" and connector == nil then
						connector = prop.read
					end
				end
			end
			if connector and connector:is("function") then
				local params = connector:parameters().head
				local listener = if params
						and params[2]
						and params[2]:is("function")
					then params[2]
					elseif params and params[1] and params[1]:is("function") then params[1]
					else nil
				if listener then
					local cb = listener:parameters()
					if cb.head and cb.head[1] ~= nil then
						return cb.head[1]
					elseif cb.tail == nil then
						return types.singleton(nil)
					end
					return types.any
				end
			end
			current = if current:is("extern") then current:readparent() else nil
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function resolve(t: type): type?
		if t:is("any") or t:is("unknown") then
			return types.any
		elseif t:is("nil") then
			return nil
		elseif t:is("union") then
			local parts: { type } = {}
			for _, part in t:components() do
				local found = resolve(part)
				if found ~= nil and not table.find(parts, found) then
					table.insert(parts, found)
				end
			end
			if #parts == 0 then
				return nil
			end
			return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
		elseif t:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in t:components() do
				local found = resolve(part)
				if found ~= nil then
					return found
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		return fromObject(t)
	end

	return resolve(sig) or types.any
end

-- Unwraps the dependency shape passed to `Flux.on`: a node, getter, plain value, or array of them.
--- @within Flux
--- @private
export type function OnInput(deps: type): type
	local function returned(fn: type): type
		local head = fn:returns().head
		return if head and head[1] then head[1] else types.singleton(nil)
	end

	local function nodeValue(t: type): type?
		if not t:is("table") then
			return nil
		end
		local get = t:readproperty(types.singleton("get"))
		if get and get:is("function") and t:readproperty(types.singleton("peek")) then
			return returned(get)
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function unwrapValue(t: type): type
		if t:is("any") or t:is("unknown") then
			return types.any
		elseif t:is("union") then
			local parts: { type } = {}
			local function add(part: type)
				if part:is("union") then
					for _, member in part:components() do
						add(member)
					end
				elseif not table.find(parts, part) then
					table.insert(parts, part)
				end
			end
			for _, part in t:components() do
				add(unwrapValue(part))
			end
			return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
		elseif t:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in t:components() do
				local found = nodeValue(part)
				if found then
					return found
				end
			end
			return t
		elseif t:is("function") then
			return returned(t)
		end
		return nodeValue(t) or t
	end

	local function resolve(t: type): type
		if t:is("any") or t:is("unknown") then
			return types.any
		elseif t:is("union") then
			local parts: { type } = {}
			for _, part in t:components() do
				local resolved = resolve(part)
				if not table.find(parts, resolved) then
					table.insert(parts, resolved)
				end
			end
			return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
		elseif t:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in t:components() do
				local found = nodeValue(part)
				if found then
					return found
				end
			end
			return t
		elseif t:is("function") then
			return returned(t)
		elseif t:is("table") then
			local found = nodeValue(t)
			if found then
				return found
			end
			local indexer = t:indexer()
			if indexer and indexer.readresult then
				local elem = unwrapValue(indexer.readresult)
				return types.newtable(nil, { index = types.number, readresult = elem, writeresult = elem })
			end
			return t
		end
		return t
	end

	return resolve(deps)
end

-- BootyCatalog: the 40 original pirate-lagoon brainrots of Rotbeard's Lagoon.

function BootyCatalog.getBrainrotDefinition(id)
	for _, def in ipairs(BootyCatalog.BRAINROTS) do
		if def.id == id then
			return def
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function BootyCatalog.getRarityColor(rarity)
	return BootyCatalog.RARITY_COLORS[rarity] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
end

function BootyCatalog.getMutationMultiplier(mutationName)
	for _, m in ipairs(BootyCatalog.MUTATIONS) do
		if m.name == mutationName then
			return m.mult
		end
	end
	return 1
end

function BootyCatalog.getMutationColor(mutationName)
	for _, m in ipairs(BootyCatalog.MUTATIONS) do
		if m.name == mutationName then
			return m.color
		end
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
end

function BootyCatalog.getBrainrotCost(def, mutationName)
	return math.floor(def.cost * BootyCatalog.getMutationMultiplier(mutationName))
end

function BootyCatalog.calculateBrainrotIncome(def, mutationName, rebirthMultiplier)
	local base = def.income * BootyCatalog.getMutationMultiplier(mutationName)
	return math.floor(base * (rebirthMultiplier or 1))
end

function BootyCatalog.rollRarityTier()
	local total = 0
	for _, w in pairs(BootyCatalog.RARITY_WEIGHTS) do
		total += w
	end
	local roll = math.random(1, total)
	local running = 0
	for _, rarity in ipairs(BootyCatalog.RARITY_ORDER) do
		running += BootyCatalog.RARITY_WEIGHTS[rarity]
		if roll <= running then
			return rarity
		end
	end
	return "COMMON"
end

function BootyCatalog.rollMutationModifier()
	local roll = math.random()
	if roll < 0.80 then
		return "NONE"
	elseif roll < 0.90 then
		return "GOLDEN"
	elseif roll < 0.95 then
		return "PEARL"
	elseif roll < 0.985 then
		return "CURSED"
	else
		return "GHOST"
	end
end

function BootyCatalog.pickRandomBrainrotOfRarity(rarity)
	local pool = {}
	for _, def in ipairs(BootyCatalog.BRAINROTS) do
		if def.rarity == rarity then
			table.insert(pool, def)
		end
	end
	if #pool == 0 then
		return BootyCatalog.BRAINROTS[1]
	end
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

function BootyCatalog.formatMoney(amount)
	amount = math.floor(amount)
	if amount >= 1000000000 then
		return string.format("$%.2fB", amount / 1000000000)
	elseif amount >= 1000000 then
		return string.format("$%.2fM", amount / 1000000)
	elseif amount >= 1000 then
		return string.format("$%.1fK", amount / 1000)
	else
		return "$" .. tostring(amount)
	end
end

return BootyCatalog

type ConstructorMap = { [any]: (properties: Type.Map<any>) -> Instance }

local Constructors: ConstructorMap = setmetatable({} :: ConstructorMap, {
	__index = function(self: ConstructorMap, class: string)
		if type(class) ~= "string" then
			error(`String expected, got {typeof(class)}`, 3)
		end
		self[class] = function(properties: Type.Map<any>): Instance

		end
		return self[class]
	end,
})

local syncStep = Sync._internal.flushAll
local function stepFrame(dt: number)
	Motion.step(dt)
	Graph.flush()
	syncStep()
end

local runService: any = if Compat.isRoblox then Compat.getService("RunService") else nil
if runService ~= nil then
	local frame = if runService:IsClient() then runService.PreRender else runService.Heartbeat
	local _frameConnection = frame:Connect(function(dt: number)
		if not Clock.isManual() then
			stepFrame(dt)
		end
	end)
end

Clock._internal.setFrame(stepFrame)

-- BrainrotModels.luau — builds the twelve food characters from parts.
-- Every character is a ball body with a big face; the three heroes get
-- their own silhouettes, the rest a coloured topper.

local BrainrotData = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.BrainrotData)
local PartKit = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.PartKit)

local BrainrotModels = {}

local RADIUS = {
	Common = 1.5,
	Rare = 1.8,
	Epic = 2.1,
	Legendary = 2.4,
	Mythic = 2.7,
	Divine = 3.0,
}

local TOPPER_COLORS = {
	["Kerupuk Knight"] = Color3.fromRGB(200, 170, 60),
	["Cireng Cyclops"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	["Gado-Gado Goblin"] = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 30),
	["Es Cendol Cyber"] = Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 200),
	["Soto Sphinx"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0),
	["Martabak Monster"] = Color3.fromRGB(60, 35, 20),
	["Nasi Padang Paladin"] = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40),
	["Rendang Rex"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0),
	["Es Teh Sultan"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 180),
}

local function addTopper(model, body, radius, color)
	local topper = PartKit.Ball(model, radius * 0.45, body.Position + Vector3.new(0, radius * 1.25, 0), color)
	topper.Name = "Topper"
end

local function buildGeneric(model, entry, radius, position)
	local body = PartKit.Ball(model, radius, position, entry.Body)
	body.Name = "Body"
	PartKit.Face(body, radius)
	local topperColor = TOPPER_COLORS[entry.Name]
	if topperColor then
		addTopper(model, body, radius, topperColor)
	end
	return body
end

local function buildBakso(model, entry, radius, position)
	local body = PartKit.Ball(model, radius, position, entry.Body)
	body.Name = "Body"
	PartKit.Face(body, radius)
	local mask = PartKit.Box(model, Vector3.new(radius * 1.5, radius * 0.5, radius * 0.2), position + Vector3.new(0, radius * 0.25, radius * 0.85), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20))
	mask.Name = "Mask"
	local sack = PartKit.Ball(model, radius * 0.6, position + Vector3.new(radius * 1.3, -radius * 0.4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(170, 140, 90))
	sack.Name = "Sack"
	return body
end

local function buildSate(model, entry, radius, position)
	local stick = PartKit.Cylinder(model, radius * 4, radius * 0.7, position + Vector3.new(0, radius, 0), Color3.fromRGB(210, 170, 110), Enum.Material.Wood)
	stick.Name = "Skewer"
	local body = PartKit.Ball(model, radius, position + Vector3.new(0, radius * 0.8, 0), entry.Body)
	body.Name = "Body"
	PartKit.Face(body, radius)
	local band = PartKit.Box(model, Vector3.new(radius * 1.9, radius * 0.35, radius * 0.2), position + Vector3.new(0, radius * 1.6, radius * 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40))
	band.Name = "Headband"
	local blade = PartKit.Box(model, Vector3.new(0.2, radius * 2, radius * 0.4), position + Vector3.new(radius * 1.4, radius * 0.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235), Enum.Material.Metal)
	blade.Name = "Katana"
	return body
end

local function buildKlepon(model, entry, radius, position)
	local body = PartKit.Ball(model, radius, position, entry.Body)
	body.Name = "Body"
	PartKit.Face(body, radius)
	local crown = PartKit.Cylinder(model, radius * 0.7, radius * 1.1, position + Vector3.new(0, radius * 1.35, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Enum.Material.Metal)
	crown.Name = "Crown"
	local cape = PartKit.Box(model, Vector3.new(radius * 1.6, radius * 1.8, radius * 0.15), position + Vector3.new(0, -radius * 0.2, -radius * 1.05), Color3.fromRGB(190, 25, 25), Enum.Material.Fabric)
	cape.Name = "Cape"
	return body
end

local HEROES = {
	["Bakso Bandit"] = buildBakso,
	["Sate Sensei"] = buildSate,
	["Klepon King"] = buildKlepon,
}

function BrainrotModels.Build(name, position, displayRate)
	local entry = BrainrotData.Find(name)
	if not entry then
		return nil
	end
	local radius = RADIUS[entry.Rarity] or 1.5
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = entry.Name
	local builder = HEROES[entry.Name] or buildGeneric
	local center = position + Vector3.new(0, radius, 0)
	local body = builder(model, entry, radius, center)
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	local rarityColor = BrainrotData.RarityColors[entry.Rarity]
	local labelText = entry.Name .. "\n" .. entry.Rarity .. "  $" .. displayRate .. "/s"
	PartKit.Label(body, labelText, rarityColor, radius + 3)
	return model
end

return BrainrotModels

local function NewGui(className, objectName)
	local newGui = Instance.new(className)
	newGui.Name = objectName
	newGui.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	newGui.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	newGui.BorderColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	newGui.BorderSizePixel = 0
	newGui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	if className:match("Text") then
		newGui.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		newGui.Text = ""
		newGui.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
		newGui.FontSize = FONT_SIZE
		newGui.TextWrapped = true
		if className == "TextButton" then
			newGui.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
			newGui.BorderSizePixel = 1
		end
	end
	return newGui
end

local function FindLowestEmpty()
	for i = 1, NumberOfHotbarSlots do
		local slot = Slots[i]
		if not slot.Tool then
			return slot
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function isInventoryEmpty()
	for i = NumberOfHotbarSlots + 1, #Slots do
		local slot = Slots[i]
		if slot and slot.Tool then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function AdjustHotbarFrames()
	local inventoryOpen = InventoryFrame.Visible -- (Show all)
	local visualTotal = inventoryOpen and NumberOfHotbarSlots or FullHotbarSlots
	local visualIndex = 0
	local hotbarIsVisible = (visualTotal >= 1)

	for i = 1, NumberOfHotbarSlots do
		local slot = Slots[i]
		if slot.Tool or inventoryOpen then
			visualIndex = visualIndex + 1
			slot:Readjust(visualIndex, visualTotal)
			slot.Frame.Visible = true
		else
			slot.Frame.Visible = false
		end
	end

	OpenInventoryButton.Visible = not inventoryOpen and (hotbarIsVisible or not isInventoryEmpty())
	OpenInventoryButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -15, 1, hotbarIsVisible and -110 or -50)
	BackpackScript.IsHotbarVisible = hotbarIsVisible
end

local function UpdateScrollingFrameCanvasSize()
	local countX = math.floor(ScrollingFrame.AbsoluteSize.X / (ICON_SIZE + ICON_BUFFER))
	local maxRow = math.ceil((#UIGridFrame:GetChildren() - 1) / countX)
	local canvasSizeY = maxRow * (ICON_SIZE + ICON_BUFFER) + ICON_BUFFER
	ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, canvasSizeY)
end

local function AdjustInventoryFrames()
	for i = NumberOfHotbarSlots + 1, #Slots do
		local slot = Slots[i]
		slot.Frame.LayoutOrder = slot.Index
		slot.Frame.Visible = (slot.Tool ~= nil)
	end
	UpdateScrollingFrameCanvasSize()
end

	AdjustHotbarFrames()
	AdjustInventoryFrames()

local function Clamp(low, high, num)
	return math.min(high, math.max(low, num))
end

local function CheckBounds(guiObject, x, y)
	local pos = guiObject.AbsolutePosition
	local size = guiObject.AbsoluteSize
	return (x > pos.X and x <= pos.X + size.X and y > pos.Y and y <= pos.Y + size.Y)
end

local function GetOffset(guiObject, point)
	local centerPoint = guiObject.AbsolutePosition + (guiObject.AbsoluteSize / 2)
	return (centerPoint - point).magnitude
end

local function MakeSlot(parent, index)
	index = index or (#Slots + 1)

	-- Slot Definition --

	local slot = {}
	slot.Tool = nil
	slot.Index = index
	slot.Frame = nil

	local SlotFrameParent = nil
	local SlotFrame = nil
	local FakeSlotFrame = nil
	local ToolIcon = nil
	local ToolName = nil
	local ToolChangeConn = nil
	local HighlightFrame = nil
	local SelectionObj = nil

	--NOTE: The following are only defined for Hotbar Slots
	local ToolTip = nil
	local SlotNumber = nil

	-- Slot Functions --

	local function UpdateSlotFading()
		SlotFrame.SelectionImageObject = nil
		SlotFrame.BackgroundTransparency = SlotFrame.Draggable and 0 or slotFadeLocked
		SlotFrame.BackgroundColor3 = SlotFrame.Draggable and SLOT_DRAGGABLE_COLOR or BACKGROUND_COLOR
	end

	function slot:Readjust(visualIndex, visualTotal) --NOTE: Only used for Hotbar slots
		local centered = HotbarFrame.Size.X.Offset / 2
		local sizePlus = ICON_BUFFER + ICON_SIZE
		local midpointish = (visualTotal / 2) + 0.5
		local factor = visualIndex - midpointish
		SlotFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(centered - (ICON_SIZE / 2) + (sizePlus * factor), ICON_BUFFER)
	end

	function slot:Fill(tool)
		if not tool then
			return self:Clear()
		end

		self.Tool = tool

		local function assignToolData()
			local icon = tool.TextureId
			ToolIcon.Image = icon

			if icon ~= "" then
				ToolName.Visible = false
			else
				ToolName.Visible = true
			end

			ToolName.Text = tool.Name -- ROBLOX deviation: remove GameTranslator

			if ToolTip and tool:IsA("Tool") then --NOTE: HopperBin
				ToolTip.Text = tool.ToolTip -- ROBLOX deviation: remove GameTranslator
				local width = ToolTip.TextBounds.X + TOOLTIP_BUFFER
				ToolTip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, TOOLTIP_HEIGHT)
				ToolTip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2, 0, TOOLTIP_OFFSET)
			end
		end
		assignToolData()

		if ToolChangeConn then
			ToolChangeConn:disconnect()
			ToolChangeConn = nil
		end

		ToolChangeConn = tool.Changed:connect(function(property)
			if property == "TextureId" or property == "Name" or property == "ToolTip" then
				assignToolData()
			end
		end)

		local hotbarSlot = (self.Index <= NumberOfHotbarSlots)
		local inventoryOpen = InventoryFrame.Visible

		if not hotbarSlot or inventoryOpen then
			SlotFrame.Draggable = true
		end

		self:UpdateEquipView()

		if hotbarSlot then
			FullHotbarSlots = FullHotbarSlots + 1
			-- If using a controller, determine whether or not we can enable BindCoreAction("RBXHotbarEquip", etc)
			if WholeThingEnabled then
				if FullHotbarSlots >= 1 and not GamepadActionsBound then
					-- Player added first item to a hotbar slot, enable BindCoreAction
					GamepadActionsBound = true
					-- ROBLOX deviation START: change action name from RBX to Backpack
					ContextActionService:BindAction(
						"BackpackHotbarEquip",
						changeToolFunc,
						false,
						Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1,
						Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1
					)
					-- ROBLOX deviation END
				end
			end
		end

		SlotsByTool[tool] = self
		LowestEmptySlot = FindLowestEmpty()
	end

	function slot:Clear()
		if not self.Tool then
			return
		end

		if ToolChangeConn then
			ToolChangeConn:disconnect()
			ToolChangeConn = nil
		end

		ToolIcon.Image = ""
		ToolName.Text = ""
		if ToolTip then
			ToolTip.Text = ""
			ToolTip.Visible = false
		end
		SlotFrame.Draggable = false

		self:UpdateEquipView(true) -- Show as unequipped

		if self.Index <= NumberOfHotbarSlots then
			FullHotbarSlots = FullHotbarSlots - 1
			if FullHotbarSlots < 1 then
				GamepadActionsBound = false
				ContextActionService:UnbindAction("BackpackHotbarEquip") -- ROBLOX deviation: change action name from RBX to Backpack
			end
		end

		SlotsByTool[self.Tool] = nil
		self.Tool = nil
		LowestEmptySlot = FindLowestEmpty()
	end

	function slot:UpdateEquipView(unequippedOverride)
		if not unequippedOverride and IsEquipped(self.Tool) then -- Equipped
			lastEquippedSlot = slot
			if not HighlightFrame then
				HighlightFrame = NewGui("Frame", "Equipped")
				HighlightFrame.ZIndex = SlotFrame.ZIndex
				local t = SLOT_EQUIP_THICKNESS
				local dataTable = { -- Relative sizes and positions
					{ t, 1, 0, 0 },
					{ 1 - 2 * t, t, t, 0 },
					{ t, 1, 1 - t, 0 },
					{ 1 - 2 * t, t, t, 1 - t },
				}
				for _, data in pairs(dataTable) do
					local edgeFrame = NewGui("Frame", "Edge")
					edgeFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					edgeFrame.BackgroundColor3 = SLOT_EQUIP_COLOR
					edgeFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(data[1], data[2])
					edgeFrame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(data[3], data[4])
					edgeFrame.ZIndex = HighlightFrame.ZIndex
					edgeFrame.Parent = HighlightFrame
				end
			end
			HighlightFrame.Parent = SlotFrame
		else -- In the Backpack
			if HighlightFrame then
				HighlightFrame.Parent = nil
			end
		end
		UpdateSlotFading()
	end

	function slot:IsEquipped()
		return IsEquipped(self.Tool)
	end

	function slot:Delete()
		Dragging[SlotFrame] = nil
		SlotFrame:Destroy() --NOTE: Also clears connections
		table.remove(Slots, self.Index)
		local newSize = #Slots

		-- Now adjust the rest (both visually and representationally)
		for i = self.Index, newSize do
			Slots[i]:SlideBack()
		end

		UpdateScrollingFrameCanvasSize()
	end

	function slot:Swap(targetSlot) --NOTE: This slot (self) must not be empty!
		local myTool, otherTool = self.Tool, targetSlot.Tool
		self:Clear()
		if otherTool then -- (Target slot might be empty)
			targetSlot:Clear()
			self:Fill(otherTool)
		end
		if myTool then
			targetSlot:Fill(myTool)
		else
			targetSlot:Clear()
		end
	end

	function slot:SlideBack() -- For inventory slot shifting
		self.Index = self.Index - 1
		SlotFrame.Name = self.Index
		SlotFrame.LayoutOrder = self.Index
	end

	function slot:TurnNumber(on)
		if SlotNumber then
			SlotNumber.Visible = on
		end
	end

	function slot:SetClickability(on) -- (Happens on open/close arrow)
		if self.Tool then
			SlotFrame.Draggable = not on
			UpdateSlotFading()
		end
	end

	function slot:CheckTerms(terms)
		local hits = 0
		local function checkEm(str, term)
			local _, n = str:lower():gsub(term, "")
			hits = hits + n
		end
		local tool = self.Tool
		if tool then
			for term in pairs(terms) do
				checkEm(ToolName.Text, term)
				if tool:IsA("Tool") then --NOTE: HopperBin
					local toolTipText = ToolTip and ToolTip.Text or ""
					checkEm(toolTipText, term)
				end
			end
		end
		return hits
	end

	-- Slot select logic, activated by clicking or pressing hotkey
	function slot:Select(isProcessed)
		if isProcessed then
			return
		end

		local tool = slot.Tool
		if tool then
			if IsEquipped(tool) then --NOTE: HopperBin
				UnequipAllTools()
			elseif tool.Parent == Backpack then
				EquipNewTool(tool)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Slot Init Logic --

	SlotFrame = NewGui("TextButton", index)
	SlotFrame.BackgroundColor3 = BACKGROUND_COLOR
	SlotFrame.BorderColor3 = SLOT_BORDER_COLOR
	SlotFrame.Text = ""
	SlotFrame.AutoButtonColor = false
	SlotFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	SlotFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE)
	SlotFrame.Active = true
	SlotFrame.Draggable = false
	SlotFrame.BackgroundTransparency = slotFadeLocked
	SlotFrame.MouseButton1Click:connect(function()
		changeSlot(slot)
	end)
	slot.Frame = SlotFrame

	do
		local selectionObjectClipper = NewGui("Frame", "SelectionObjectClipper")
		selectionObjectClipper.Visible = false
		selectionObjectClipper.Parent = SlotFrame

		SelectionObj = NewGui("ImageLabel", "Selector")
		SelectionObj.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		SelectionObj.Image = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Keyboard/key_selection_9slice.png"
		SelectionObj.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
		SelectionObj.SliceCenter = Rect.new(12, 12, 52, 52)
		SelectionObj.Parent = selectionObjectClipper
	end

	ToolIcon = NewGui("ImageLabel", "Icon")
	ToolIcon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
	ToolIcon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1)
	ToolIcon.Parent = SlotFrame

	ToolName = NewGui("TextLabel", "ToolName")
	ToolName.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2)
	ToolName.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
	ToolName.Parent = SlotFrame

	slot.Frame.LayoutOrder = slot.Index

	if index <= NumberOfHotbarSlots then -- Hotbar-Specific Slot Stuff
		-- ToolTip stuff
		ToolTip = NewGui("TextLabel", "ToolTip")
		ToolTip.TextWrapped = false
		ToolTip.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
		ToolTip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
		ToolTip.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		ToolTip.Visible = false
		ToolTip.Parent = SlotFrame
		SlotFrame.MouseEnter:connect(function()
			if ToolTip.Text ~= "" then
				ToolTip.Visible = true
			end
		end)
		SlotFrame.MouseLeave:connect(function()
			ToolTip.Visible = false
		end)

		function slot:MoveToInventory()
			if slot.Index <= NumberOfHotbarSlots then -- From a Hotbar slot
				local tool = slot.Tool
				self:Clear() --NOTE: Order matters here
				local newSlot = MakeSlot(UIGridFrame)
				newSlot:Fill(tool)
				if IsEquipped(tool) then -- Also unequip it --NOTE: HopperBin
					UnequipAllTools()
				end
				-- Also hide the inventory slot if we're showing results right now
				if ViewingSearchResults then
					newSlot.Frame.Visible = false
					newSlot.Parent = InventoryFrame
				end
			end
		end

		-- Show label and assign hotkeys for 1-9 and 0 (zero is always last slot when > 10 total)
		if index < 10 or index == NumberOfHotbarSlots then -- NOTE: Hardcoded on purpose!
			local slotNum = (index < 10) and index or 0
			SlotNumber = NewGui("TextLabel", "Number")
			SlotNumber.Text = slotNum
			SlotNumber.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.15)
			SlotNumber.Visible = false
			SlotNumber.Parent = SlotFrame

			HotkeyFns[ZERO_KEY_VALUE + slotNum] = function(isProcessed)
				slot:Select(isProcessed)
			end
		end
	end

	do -- Dragging Logic
		local startPoint = SlotFrame.Position
		local lastUpTime = 0
		local startParent = nil

		SlotFrame.DragBegin:connect(function(dragPoint)
			Dragging[SlotFrame] = true
			startPoint = dragPoint

			SlotFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2

			-- Raise above other slots
			SlotFrame.ZIndex = 2
			ToolIcon.ZIndex = 2
			ToolName.ZIndex = 2
			SlotFrame.Parent.ZIndex = 2
			if SlotNumber then
				SlotNumber.ZIndex = 2
			end
			if HighlightFrame then
				HighlightFrame.ZIndex = 2
				for _, child in pairs(HighlightFrame:GetChildren()) do
					child.ZIndex = 2
				end
			end

			-- Circumvent the ScrollingFrame's ClipsDescendants property
			startParent = SlotFrame.Parent
			if startParent == UIGridFrame then
				local oldAbsolutPos = SlotFrame.AbsolutePosition
				local newPosition = UDim2.new(
					0,
					SlotFrame.AbsolutePosition.X - InventoryFrame.AbsolutePosition.X,
					0,
					SlotFrame.AbsolutePosition.Y - InventoryFrame.AbsolutePosition.Y
				)
				SlotFrame.Parent = InventoryFrame
				SlotFrame.Position = newPosition

				FakeSlotFrame = NewGui("Frame", "FakeSlot")
				FakeSlotFrame.LayoutOrder = SlotFrame.LayoutOrder
				FakeSlotFrame.Size = SlotFrame.Size
				FakeSlotFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				FakeSlotFrame.Parent = UIGridFrame
			end
		end)

		SlotFrame.DragStopped:connect(function(x, y)
			if FakeSlotFrame then
				FakeSlotFrame:Destroy()
			end

			local now = tick()
			SlotFrame.Position = startPoint
			SlotFrame.Parent = startParent

			SlotFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

			-- Restore height
			SlotFrame.ZIndex = 1
			ToolIcon.ZIndex = 1
			ToolName.ZIndex = 1
			startParent.ZIndex = 1
			if SlotNumber then
				SlotNumber.ZIndex = 1
			end
			if HighlightFrame then
				HighlightFrame.ZIndex = 1
				for _, child in pairs(HighlightFrame:GetChildren()) do
					child.ZIndex = 1
				end
			end

			Dragging[SlotFrame] = nil

			-- Make sure the tool wasn't dropped
			if not slot.Tool then
				return
			end

			-- Check where we were dropped
			if CheckBounds(InventoryFrame, x, y) then
				if slot.Index <= NumberOfHotbarSlots then
					slot:MoveToInventory()
				end
				-- Check for double clicking on an inventory slot, to move into empty hotbar slot
				if slot.Index > NumberOfHotbarSlots and now - lastUpTime < DOUBLE_CLICK_TIME then
					if LowestEmptySlot then
						local myTool = slot.Tool
						slot:Clear()
						LowestEmptySlot:Fill(myTool)
						slot:Delete()
					end
					now = 0 -- Resets the timer
				end
			elseif CheckBounds(HotbarFrame, x, y) then
				local closest = { math.huge, nil }
				for i = 1, NumberOfHotbarSlots do
					local otherSlot = Slots[i]
					local offset = GetOffset(otherSlot.Frame, Vector2.new(x, y))
					if offset < closest[1] then
						closest = { offset, otherSlot }
					end
				end
				local closestSlot = closest[2]
				if closestSlot ~= slot then
					slot:Swap(closestSlot)
					if slot.Index > NumberOfHotbarSlots then
						local tool = slot.Tool
						if not tool then -- Clean up after ourselves if we're an inventory slot that's now empty
							slot:Delete()
						else -- Moved inventory slot to hotbar slot, and gained a tool that needs to be unequipped
							if IsEquipped(tool) then --NOTE: HopperBin
								UnequipAllTools()
							end
							-- Also hide the inventory slot if we're showing results right now
							if ViewingSearchResults then
								slot.Frame.Visible = false
								slot.Frame.Parent = InventoryFrame
							end
						end
					end
				end
			else
				-- local tool = slot.Tool
				-- if tool.CanBeDropped then --TODO: HopperBins
				-- tool.Parent = workspace
				-- --TODO: Move away from character
				-- end
				if slot.Index <= NumberOfHotbarSlots then
					slot:MoveToInventory() --NOTE: Temporary
				end
			end

			lastUpTime = now
		end)
	end

	-- All ready!
	SlotFrame.Parent = parent
	Slots[index] = slot

	if index > NumberOfHotbarSlots then
		UpdateScrollingFrameCanvasSize()
		-- Scroll to new inventory slot, if we're open and not viewing search results
		if InventoryFrame.Visible and not ViewingSearchResults then
			local offset = ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize.Y.Offset - ScrollingFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y
			ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, offset))
		end
	end

	return slot
end

-- NOTE: We should probably migrate to a 2 collection system:
-- One collection for the hotbar and another collection for the inventory
local function SetNumberOfHotbarSlots(numSlots)
	if NumberOfHotbarSlots ~= numSlots then
		local prevNumberOfSlots = NumberOfHotbarSlots
		local newNumberOfSlots = numSlots
		-- If we are shrinking the number of slots we need
		-- to move around our tools to the right locations
		if prevNumberOfSlots > newNumberOfSlots then
			-- Delete the slots that are now no longer in the Hotbar
			-- Iterate backwards as to not corrupt our iterator
			for i = prevNumberOfSlots, newNumberOfSlots + 1, -1 do
				local slot = Slots[i]
				if slot then
					slot:MoveToInventory()
					slot:Delete()
				end
			end
			-- Also need to slide-back the inventory slots now that they are indexed earlier
			for i = prevNumberOfSlots, newNumberOfSlots + 1, -1 do
				local slot = Slots[i]
				if not slot.Tool then
					slot:Delete()
				end
			end
		else -- If we added more slots
			for i = prevNumberOfSlots, newNumberOfSlots do
				-- Incrementally add hotbar slots
				NumberOfHotbarSlots = i
				if Slots[i] then
					-- Move old
					local oldSlot = Slots[i]
					local oldTool = Slots[i].Tool

					local newSlot = MakeSlot(HotbarFrame, i)

					if oldTool then
						newSlot:Fill(oldTool)
					elseif not LowestEmptySlot then
						LowestEmptySlot = newSlot
					end
				else
					local slot = MakeSlot(HotbarFrame, i)

					slot.Frame.Visible = false

					if not LowestEmptySlot then
						LowestEmptySlot = slot
					end
				end
			end
		end
		NumberOfHotbarSlots = numSlots
		FullHotbarSlots = 0
		for i = 1, NumberOfHotbarSlots do
			if Slots[i] and Slots[i].Tool then
				FullHotbarSlots = FullHotbarSlots + 1
			end
		end

		UpdateBackpackLayout()
	end
end

local function OnChildAdded(child) -- To Character or Backpack
	if child:IsA("HopperBin") then
		warn(`[Purse] Ignoring '{child}' hopper in backpack. HopperBin is deprecated and not supported.`)
		return
	end
	if not child:IsA("Tool") then --NOTE: HopperBin
		if child:IsA("Humanoid") and child.Parent == Character then
			Humanoid = child
		end
		return
	end
	local tool = child

	if tool.Parent == Character then
		TimeOfLastToolChange = tick()
	end

	if ActiveHopper and tool.Parent == Character then --NOTE: HopperBin
		DisableActiveHopper()
	end

	--TODO: Optimize / refactor / do something else
	if not StarterToolFound and tool.Parent == Character and not SlotsByTool[tool] then
		local starterGear = Player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear")
		if starterGear then
			if starterGear:FindFirstChild(tool.Name) then
				StarterToolFound = true
				local slot = LowestEmptySlot or MakeSlot(UIGridFrame)
				for i = slot.Index, 1, -1 do
					local curr = Slots[i] -- An empty slot, because above
					local pIndex = i - 1
					if pIndex > 0 then
						local prev = Slots[pIndex] -- Guaranteed to be full, because above
						prev:Swap(curr)
					else
						curr:Fill(tool)
					end
				end
				-- Have to manually unequip a possibly equipped tool
				for _, child in pairs(Character:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Tool") and child ~= tool then
						child.Parent = Backpack
					end
				end
				AdjustHotbarFrames()
				return -- We're done here
			end
		end
	end

	-- The tool is either moving or new
	local slot = SlotsByTool[tool]
	if slot then
		slot:UpdateEquipView()
	else -- New! Put into lowest hotbar slot or new inventory slot
		slot = LowestEmptySlot or MakeSlot(UIGridFrame)
		slot:Fill(tool)
		if slot.Index <= NumberOfHotbarSlots and not InventoryFrame.Visible then
			AdjustHotbarFrames()
		end
		if tool:IsA("HopperBin") then --NOTE: HopperBin
			if tool.Active then
				UnequipAllTools()
				ActiveHopper = tool
			end
		end
	end

	BackpackScript.BackpackItemAdded:Fire()
end

local function OnChildRemoved(child) -- From Character or Backpack
	if child:IsA("HopperBin") then
		return
	end
	if not child:IsA("Tool") then --NOTE: HopperBin
		return
	end
	local tool = child

	TimeOfLastToolChange = tick()

	-- Ignore this event if we're just moving between the two
	local newParent = tool.Parent
	if newParent == Character or newParent == Backpack then
		return
	end

	local slot = SlotsByTool[tool]
	if slot then
		slot:Clear()
		if slot.Index > NumberOfHotbarSlots then -- Inventory slot
			slot:Delete()
		elseif not InventoryFrame.Visible then
			AdjustHotbarFrames()
		end
	end

	if tool == ActiveHopper then --NOTE: HopperBin
		ActiveHopper = nil
	end

	BackpackScript.BackpackItemRemoved:Fire()
	if isInventoryEmpty() then
		BackpackScript.BackpackEmpty:Fire()
	end
end

local function OnCharacterAdded(character)
	-- First, clean up any old slots
	for i = #Slots, 1, -1 do
		local slot = Slots[i]
		if slot.Tool then
			slot:Clear()
		end
		if i > NumberOfHotbarSlots then
			slot:Delete()
		end
	end
	ActiveHopper = nil --NOTE: HopperBin

	-- And any old connections
	for _, conn in pairs(CharConns) do
		conn:disconnect()
	end
	CharConns = {}

	-- Hook up the new character
	Character = character
	table.insert(CharConns, character.ChildRemoved:connect(OnChildRemoved))
	table.insert(CharConns, character.ChildAdded:connect(OnChildAdded))
	for _, child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		OnChildAdded(child)
	end
	--NOTE: Humanoid is set inside OnChildAdded

	-- And the new backpack, when it gets here
	Backpack = Player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
	table.insert(CharConns, Backpack.ChildRemoved:connect(OnChildRemoved))
	table.insert(CharConns, Backpack.ChildAdded:connect(OnChildAdded))
	for _, child in pairs(Backpack:GetChildren()) do
		OnChildAdded(child)
	end

	AdjustHotbarFrames()
end
