local function getInputDirection(inputObject)
	local buttonModifier = 1
	if inputObject.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
		buttonModifier = -1
	end

	if inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 then
		local magnitude = inputObject.Position.magnitude

		if magnitude > 0.98 then
			local normalizedVector =
				Vector2.new(inputObject.Position.x / magnitude, -inputObject.Position.y / magnitude)
			selectDirection = normalizedVector
		else
			selectDirection = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		end
	elseif inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then
		selectDirection = Vector2.new(selectDirection.x - 1 * buttonModifier, selectDirection.y)
	elseif inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight then
		selectDirection = Vector2.new(selectDirection.x + 1 * buttonModifier, selectDirection.y)
	elseif inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp then
		selectDirection = Vector2.new(selectDirection.x, selectDirection.y - 1 * buttonModifier)
	elseif inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown then
		selectDirection = Vector2.new(selectDirection.x, selectDirection.y + 1 * buttonModifier)
	else
		selectDirection = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end

	return selectDirection
end

local selectToolExperiment = function(actionName, inputState, inputObject)
	local inputDirection = getInputDirection(inputObject)

	if inputDirection == Vector2.new(0, 0) then
		return
	end

	local angle = math.atan2(inputDirection.y, inputDirection.x) - math.atan2(-1, 0)
	if angle < 0 then
		angle = angle + (math.pi * 2)
	end

	local quarterPi = (math.pi * 0.25)

	local index = (angle / quarterPi) + 1
	index = math.floor(index + 0.5) -- round index to whole number
	if index > NumberOfHotbarSlots then
		index = 1
	end

	if index > 0 then
		local selectedSlot = Slots[index]
		if selectedSlot and selectedSlot.Tool and not selectedSlot:IsEquipped() then
			selectedSlot:Select()
		end
	else
		UnequipAllTools()
	end
end

changeToolFunc = function(actionName, inputState, inputObject)
	if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return
	end

	if lastChangeToolInputObject then
		if
			(
				lastChangeToolInputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1
				and inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1
			)
			or (
				lastChangeToolInputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1
				and inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1
			)
		then
			if (tick() - lastChangeToolInputTime) <= maxEquipDeltaTime then
				UnequipAllTools()
				lastChangeToolInputObject = inputObject
				lastChangeToolInputTime = tick()
				return
			end
		end
	end

	lastChangeToolInputObject = inputObject
	lastChangeToolInputTime = tick()

	delay(maxEquipDeltaTime, function()
		if lastChangeToolInputObject ~= inputObject then
			return
		end

		local moveDirection = 0
		if inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
			moveDirection = -1
		else
			moveDirection = 1
		end

		for i = 1, NumberOfHotbarSlots do
			local hotbarSlot = Slots[i]
			if hotbarSlot:IsEquipped() then
				local newSlotPosition = moveDirection + i
				local hitEdge = false
				if newSlotPosition > NumberOfHotbarSlots then
					newSlotPosition = 1
					hitEdge = true
				elseif newSlotPosition < 1 then
					newSlotPosition = NumberOfHotbarSlots
					hitEdge = true
				end

				local origNewSlotPos = newSlotPosition
				while not Slots[newSlotPosition].Tool do
					newSlotPosition = newSlotPosition + moveDirection
					if newSlotPosition == origNewSlotPos then
						return
					end

					if newSlotPosition > NumberOfHotbarSlots then
						newSlotPosition = 1
						hitEdge = true
					elseif newSlotPosition < 1 then
						newSlotPosition = NumberOfHotbarSlots
						hitEdge = true
					end
				end

				if hitEdge then
					UnequipAllTools()
					lastEquippedSlot = nil
				else
					Slots[newSlotPosition]:Select()
				end
				return
			end
		end

		if lastEquippedSlot and lastEquippedSlot.Tool then
			lastEquippedSlot:Select()
			return
		end

		local startIndex = moveDirection == -1 and NumberOfHotbarSlots or 1
		local endIndex = moveDirection == -1 and 1 or NumberOfHotbarSlots
		for i = startIndex, endIndex, moveDirection do
			if Slots[i].Tool then
				Slots[i]:Select()
				return
			end
		end
	end)
end

function getGamepadSwapSlot()
	for i = 1, #Slots do
		if Slots[i].Frame.BorderSizePixel > 0 then
			return Slots[i]
		end
	end
end

function changeSlot(slot)
	local gamepadCursorEnabled = GamepadService.GamepadCursorEnabled

	if slot.Frame == GuiService.SelectedObject and not gamepadCursorEnabled then
		local currentlySelectedSlot = getGamepadSwapSlot()

		if currentlySelectedSlot then
			currentlySelectedSlot.Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
			if currentlySelectedSlot ~= slot then
				slot:Swap(currentlySelectedSlot)
				VRInventorySelector.SelectionImageObject.Visible = false

				if slot.Index > NumberOfHotbarSlots and not slot.Tool then
					if GuiService.SelectedObject == slot.Frame then
						GuiService.SelectedObject = currentlySelectedSlot.Frame
					end
					slot:Delete()
				end

				if currentlySelectedSlot.Index > NumberOfHotbarSlots and not currentlySelectedSlot.Tool then
					if GuiService.SelectedObject == currentlySelectedSlot.Frame then
						GuiService.SelectedObject = slot.Frame
					end
					currentlySelectedSlot:Delete()
				end
			end
		else
			local startSize = slot.Frame.Size
			local startPosition = slot.Frame.Position
			slot.Frame:TweenSizeAndPosition(
				startSize + UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
				startPosition - UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5),
				Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
				0.1,
				true,
				function()
					slot.Frame:TweenSizeAndPosition(
						startSize,
						startPosition,
						Enum.EasingDirection.In,
						Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
						0.1,
						true
					)
				end
			)
			slot.Frame.BorderSizePixel = 3
			VRInventorySelector.SelectionImageObject.Visible = true
		end
	else
		slot:Select()
		VRInventorySelector.SelectionImageObject.Visible = false
	end
end

function enableGamepadInventoryControl()
	local goBackOneLevel = function(actionName, inputState, inputObject)
		if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			return
		end

		local selectedSlot = getGamepadSwapSlot()
		if selectedSlot then
			local selectedSlot = getGamepadSwapSlot()
			if selectedSlot then
				selectedSlot.Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
				return
			end
		elseif InventoryFrame.Visible then
			BackpackScript.OpenClose()
		end
	end

	-- ROBLOX deviation START: change action name from RBX to Backpack
	ContextActionService:BindAction("BackpackHasGamepadFocus", noOpFunc, false, Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1)
	ContextActionService:BindAction(
		"BackpackCloseInventory",
		goBackOneLevel,
		false,
		Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB,
		Enum.KeyCode.ButtonStart
	)
	-- ROBLOX deviation END

	-- Gaze select will automatically select the object for us!
	if not UseGazeSelection() then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = HotbarFrame:FindFirstChild("1")
	end
end

function disableGamepadInventoryControl()
	unbindAllGamepadEquipActions()

	for i = 1, NumberOfHotbarSlots do
		local hotbarSlot = Slots[i]
		if hotbarSlot and hotbarSlot.Frame then
			hotbarSlot.Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		end
	end

	if GuiService.SelectedObject and GuiService.SelectedObject:IsDescendantOf(MainFrame) then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	end
end

	if WholeThingEnabled and not GamepadActionsBound then

		-- ROBLOX deviation START: change action name from RBX to Backpack
		ContextActionService:BindAction(
			"BackpackHotbarEquip",

			false,
			Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1,

		)

	end

function gamepadDisconnected()
	if not VRService.VREnabled then
		GamepadEnabled = false
		disableGamepadInventoryControl()
	end
end

function gamepadConnected()
	if not VRService.VREnabled then
		GamepadEnabled = true
		GuiService:AddSelectionParent("BackpackSelection", MainFrame) -- ROBLOX deviation: change action name from RBX to Backpack

		if FullHotbarSlots >= 1 then
			bindBackpackHotbarAction()
		end

		if InventoryFrame.Visible then
			enableGamepadInventoryControl()
		end
	end
end

local function resizeGamepadHintsFrame()
	gamepadHintsFrame.Size =
		UDim2.new(HotbarFrame.Size.X.Scale, HotbarFrame.Size.X.Offset, 0, (IsTenFootInterface and 95 or 60))
	gamepadHintsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
		HotbarFrame.Position.X.Scale,
		HotbarFrame.Position.X.Offset,
		InventoryFrame.Position.Y.Scale,
		InventoryFrame.Position.Y.Offset - gamepadHintsFrame.Size.Y.Offset
	)

	local spaceTaken = 0

	local gamepadHints = gamepadHintsFrame:GetChildren()
	--First get the total space taken by all the hints
	for i = 1, #gamepadHints do
		gamepadHints[i].Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -5)
		gamepadHints[i].Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		spaceTaken = spaceTaken + (gamepadHints[i].HintText.Position.X.Offset + gamepadHints[i].HintText.TextBounds.X)
	end

	--The space between all the frames should be equal
	local spaceBetweenElements = (gamepadHintsFrame.AbsoluteSize.X - spaceTaken) / (#gamepadHints - 1)
	for i = 1, #gamepadHints do
		gamepadHints[i].Position = (
			i == 1 and UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
			or UDim2.new(
				0,
				gamepadHints[i - 1].Position.X.Offset + gamepadHints[i - 1].Size.X.Offset + spaceBetweenElements,
				0,
				0
			)
		)
		gamepadHints[i].Size =
			UDim2.new(0, (gamepadHints[i].HintText.Position.X.Offset + gamepadHints[i].HintText.TextBounds.X), 1, -5)
	end
end

	local function search()
		local terms = {}
		for word in searchBox.Text:gmatch("%S+") do
			terms[word:lower()] = true
		end

		local hitTable = {}
		for i = NumberOfHotbarSlots + 1, #Slots do -- Only search inventory slots
			local slot = Slots[i]
			local hits = slot:CheckTerms(terms)
			table.insert(hitTable, { slot, hits })
			slot.Frame.Visible = false
			slot.Frame.Parent = InventoryFrame
		end

		table.sort(hitTable, function(left, right)
			return left[2] > right[2]
		end)
		ViewingSearchResults = true

		local hitCount = 0
		for i, data in ipairs(hitTable) do
			local slot, hits = data[1], data[2]
			if hits > 0 then
				slot.Frame.Visible = true
				slot.Frame.Parent = UIGridFrame
				slot.Frame.LayoutOrder = NumberOfHotbarSlots + hitCount
				hitCount = hitCount + 1
			end
		end

		UpdateScrollingFrameCanvasSize()

	end

		if xButton.ZIndex > 0 then

-- LagoonLayout: every fixed position of Rotbeard's Lagoon in one place, so the
-- services, the renderer and the HUD all agree on where things are.
local LagoonLayout = {}

LagoonLayout.CHUTE_START = Vector3.new(-70, 6.5, -40)
LagoonLayout.CHUTE_END = Vector3.new(70, 6.5, -40)
LagoonLayout.CHUTE_SPEED = 6 -- studs per second along the chute
LagoonLayout.CHUTE_LIFETIME = 25 -- seconds before an unsold brainrot sails off

LagoonLayout.HIGH_GROUND_Y = 10 -- standing above this survives the Kraken Surge
LagoonLayout.LIGHTHOUSE_TOP = Vector3.new(-100, 16, -30)
LagoonLayout.GALLEON_DECK = Vector3.new(100, 11, -30)

LagoonLayout.BASES = {
	A = { center = Vector3.new(-45, 2, 30), spawn = Vector3.new(-45, 3, 8) },
	B = { center = Vector3.new(45, 2, 30), spawn = Vector3.new(45, 3, 8) },
	R = { center = Vector3.new(0, 2, -70), spawn = Vector3.new(0, 3, -52) },
}

function LagoonLayout.getPedestalPosition(prefix, slot)
	local base = LagoonLayout.BASES[prefix]
	if not base then
		return Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	end
	local col = (slot - 1) % 4
	local row = math.floor((slot - 1) / 4)
	local x = base.center.X + (col - 1.5) * 9
	local z = base.center.Z + (row == 0 and -6 or 6)
	return Vector3.new(x, 2.6, z)
end

function LagoonLayout.getPedestalPart(prefix, slot)
	return workspace:FindFirstChild("Pedestal" .. prefix .. slot)
end

function LagoonLayout.getLockDome(prefix)
	return workspace:FindFirstChild("LockDome" .. prefix)
end

function LagoonLayout.isOnHighGround(character)
	if not character then
		return false
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	return root.Position.Y > LagoonLayout.HIGH_GROUND_Y
end

return LagoonLayout

--!nonstrict
local env = require("./env")

local GraphModel = {}

export type Options = {
	faults: boolean?, -- fault injection: a fault signal makes bodies throw after their reads
	teardown: boolean?, -- weight scopes, destroys, children and cleanups up
	trackedOnly: boolean?, -- bodies read tracked only, so quiescent values don't depend on run order
	lazy: boolean?, -- check laziness (default true)
	solid: boolean?, -- exercise getter/setter/createSignal/createMemo/createEffect
}

GraphModel.RERUN_LIMIT = 100
local RUNAWAY = 1000 -- runs of one node within one top-level op that count as a hang
local FALLBACK = 7 -- Flux.safe's fallback

local Fault = {
	__tostring = function(fault)
		return `[GraphModel] injected fault {fault.fault}`
	end,
}

local function modEq(a: any, b: any): boolean
	if type(a) == "number" and type(b) == "number" then
		return a % 10 == b % 10
	end
	return a == b
end

local function rawEq(a: any, b: any): boolean
	return a == b
end

local function norm(v: any): number
	return if type(v) == "number" then v % 10 else 0
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Generator

local TRACKED = { get = true, read = true, pcallRaw = true, getter = true }

type Def = { kind: string, level: number, closure: { [number]: boolean }, dead: boolean, owner: number? }

local function closureOfBody(defs: { Def }, body: any): ({ [number]: boolean }, number)
	local set, level = {}, -1
	local function add(id: number)
		if set[id] then
			return
		end
		set[id] = true
		local def = defs[id]
		if def.kind == "signal" then
			level = math.max(level, def.level)
		end
		for other in def.closure do
			if not set[other] then
				add(other)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, read in body.reads do
		add(read.id)
	end
	if body.child then
		for _, read in body.child.body.reads do
			add(read.id)
		end
	end
	return set, level
end

local function newGenerator(g: any, options: Options)
	local tiny = g.size < 8
	local maxDepth = if tiny then 1 else 3
	local st = { defs = {} :: { Def }, loopDone = false, written = {} }

	local function ids(filter: (Def) -> boolean): { number }
		local list = {}
		for id, def in st.defs do
			if filter(def) then
				table.insert(list, id)
			end
		end
		table.sort(list)
		return list
	end
	local function readables()
		return ids(function(def)
			return def.kind == "signal" or def.kind == "computed"
		end)
	end
	local function pool(owner: number?, encl: { number }?): { number }
		local chain = {}
		local function walk(id: number?)
			while id do
				chain[id] = true
				id = st.defs[id].owner
			end
		end
		walk(owner)
		for _, id in encl or {} do
			walk(id)
		end
		local list = {}
		for _, id in readables() do
			local ok = not chain[id]
			if ok then
				for other in chain do
					if st.defs[id].closure[other] then
						ok = false
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if ok then
				table.insert(list, id)
			end
		end
		return list
	end
	local function with(encl: { number }, id: number?): { number }
		local list = table.clone(encl)
		if id then
			table.insert(list, id)
		end
		return list
	end
	local function signals()
		return ids(function(def)
			return def.kind == "signal"
		end)
	end

	local function define(kind: string, level: number, closure, owner: number?): number
		table.insert(st.defs, { kind = kind, level = level, closure = closure or {}, dead = false, owner = owner })
		return #st.defs
	end

	local function readMode(): string
		if options.trackedOnly then
			return if options.solid then g:pick({ "get", "read", "getter" }) else g:pick({ "get", "read" })
		elseif tiny then
			return g:pick({ "get", "peek" })
		elseif options.solid then
			return g:weighted({
				{ 4, "get" },
				{ 4, "getter" },
				{ 2, "read" },
				{ 1, "untrack" },
				{ 1, "peek" },
				{ 1, "raw" },
				{ 1, "rawGetter" },
				{ 1, "bare" },
				{ 2, "pcallRaw" },
			})
		end
		return g:weighted({
			{ 6, "get" },
			{ 2, "read" },
			{ 1, "untrack" },
			{ 1, "peek" },
			{ 1, "raw" },
			{ 1, "rawGetter" },
			{ 1, "bare" },
			{ 3, "pcallRaw" },
		})
	end

	local function genBody(kind: string, ctxKnown: boolean, child: boolean, owner: number?): any
		local body = { reads = {} }
		local pool = pool(owner)
		local count = if tiny then 1 else g:int(1, 3)
		for i = 1, count do
			local read = { id = g:pick(pool), mode = if kind == "on" then "get" else readMode() }
			if kind == "on" then
				read.dep = i == 1 or options.trackedOnly or g:bool(0.5)
				if not read.dep then
					read.mode = "peek"
				end
			elseif not tiny and i > 1 and g:bool(0.25) then
				read.cond = { at = g:int(1, i - 1), k = g:int(0, 1) }
			end
			body.reads[i] = read
		end
		local pCleanup = if options.teardown then 0.6 else 0.35
		if g:bool(pCleanup) then
			body.cleanup = {}
			if not tiny and g:bool(0.3) then
				body.cleanup.read = g:pick(signals())
			end
		end
		if options.faults and g:bool(0.35) then
			body.fault = true
		end
		if child then
			return body
		end
		if not tiny and g:bool(0.1) then
			body.dispose = g:pick(signals())
		end
		if ctxKnown and not tiny and g:bool(0.3) then
			body.ctx = true
		end
		if kind ~= "on" and not tiny and g:bool(if options.teardown then 0.35 else 0.15) then
			body.child = { kind = g:pick({ "effect", "computed" }), body = genBody("child", false, true, owner) }
		end
		if kind == "effect" then
			if not tiny and g:bool(0.1) then
				body.flush = true
			end
			local _, level = closureOfBody(st.defs, body)
			local targets = ids(function(def)
				return def.kind == "signal" and def.level > level
			end)
			if options.trackedOnly then
				local free = {}
				for _, id in targets do
					if not st.written[id] then
						table.insert(free, id)
					end
				end
				targets = free
			end
			if #targets > 0 and g:bool(0.3) then
				body.write = { id = g:pick(targets) }
				st.written[body.write.id] = true
			end
		end
		return body
	end

	local genOps

	local function genOp(depth: number, ctxKnown: boolean, owner: number?, encl: { number }): any
		local nRead, nSig = #pool(owner), #signals()
		local teardown = options.teardown
		local kind = g:weighted({
			{ if nRead == 0 then 10 else 3, "signal" },
			{ if nRead > 0 then 3 else 0, "computed" },
			{ if nRead > 0 then 3 else 0, "effect" },
			{ if nSig > 0 and not tiny and not options.trackedOnly then 1 else 0, "converge" },
			{ if nSig > 0 then 4 else 0, "set" },
			{ if nSig > 0 and not tiny then 1 else 0, "force" },
			{ if nSig > 0 and not tiny then 1 else 0, "update" },
			{ if #readables() > 0 then 2 else 0, "read" },
			{ if depth < maxDepth then (if teardown then 3 else 1) else 0, "scope" },
			{ if depth < 3 and not tiny then 1 else 0, "provide" },
			{ if depth < maxDepth and #st.defs > 0 then (if teardown then 2 else 1) else 0, "withOwner" },
			{ if depth == 0 and #st.defs > 0 then (if teardown then 3 else 1) else 0, "destroy" },
			{ if depth == 0 then 3 elseif tiny then 0 else 1, "flush" },
			{ if options.faults then 2 else 0, "fault" },
			{ if depth == 0 and not st.loopDone then 3 else 0, "loop" },
		})
		if kind == "signal" then
			local value, eqMod = g:int(0, if tiny then 1 else 9), not tiny and g:bool(0.25)
			local level = if tiny then 0 else g:int(0, 3)
			local id = define("signal", level, nil, nil)
			st.defs[id].closure = {}
			local solid = if options.solid then g:bool(0.5) else nil
			return {
				op = "signal",
				id = id,
				value = value,
				eqMod = eqMod or nil,
				level = level,
				onDestroy = (not tiny and not solid and g:bool(0.2)) or nil,
				solid = solid or nil,
			}
		elseif kind == "computed" then
			local variant = if tiny then "computed" else g:weighted({ { 6, "computed" }, { 1, "safe" }, { 1, "on" } })
			local body = genBody(variant, ctxKnown, false, owner)
			local eqMod = not tiny and g:bool(0.25)
			local closure, level = closureOfBody(st.defs, body)
			local id = define("computed", level, closure, owner)
			local solid = if options.solid and variant == "computed" and body.child == nil then g:bool(0.5) else nil
			return {
				op = "computed",
				id = id,
				variant = variant,
				body = body,
				eqMod = eqMod or nil,
				onDestroy = (not tiny and not solid and g:bool(0.2)) or nil,
				solid = solid or nil,
			}
		elseif kind == "effect" then
			local body = genBody("effect", ctxKnown, false, owner)
			local closure, level = closureOfBody(st.defs, body)
			local id = define("effect", level, closure, owner)
			local solid = if options.solid and body.child == nil then g:bool(0.5) else nil
			return {
				op = "effect",
				id = id,
				body = body,
				onDestroy = (not tiny and not solid and g:bool(0.2)) or nil,
				solid = solid or nil,
			}
		elseif kind == "converge" then
			local target = g:pick(signals())
			local body = { reads = { { id = target, mode = "get" } }, write = { id = target, cap = g:int(1, 5) } }
			local extra = pool(owner)
			if #extra > 0 and g:bool(0.4) then
				table.insert(body.reads, { id = g:pick(extra), mode = readMode() })
			end
			if g:bool(0.3) then
				body.cleanup = {}
			end
			local closure, level = closureOfBody(st.defs, body)
			local id = define("effect", level, closure, owner)
			return { op = "effect", id = id, body = body }
		elseif kind == "set" or kind == "force" then
			local viaSetter = if options.solid then g:bool(0.5) else nil
			return {
				op = kind,
				id = g:pick(signals()),
				value = g:int(0, if tiny then 1 else 9),
				setter = viaSetter or nil,
			}
		elseif kind == "update" then
			return { op = "update", id = g:pick(signals()) }
		elseif kind == "read" then
			local modes = if options.solid then { "get", "peek", "raw", "getter" } else { "get", "peek", "raw" }
			return {
				op = "read",
				id = g:pick(readables()),
				mode = if tiny then "peek" else g:pick(modes),
			}
		elseif kind == "scope" then
			local id = define("scope", -1, nil, owner)
			local ops = genOps(depth + 1, ctxKnown, id, with(encl, id))
			return { op = "scope", id = id, ops = ops, cleanup = g:bool(0.4) or nil }
		elseif kind == "provide" then
			local value = g:int(1, 9)
			return { op = "provide", value = value, ops = genOps(depth + 1, true, owner, encl) }
		elseif kind == "withOwner" then
			local owners = ids(function(def)
				return def.kind == "scope" or def.kind == "computed" or def.kind == "effect"
			end)
			local target = if #owners > 0 and g:bool(0.8) then g:pick(owners) else nil
			return {
				op = "withOwner",
				target = target,
				cleanup = (target ~= nil and g:bool(0.4)) or nil,
				ops = genOps(depth + 1, ctxKnown, target, with(encl, target)),
			}
		elseif kind == "destroy" then
			local id = g:int(1, #st.defs)
			st.defs[id].dead = true
			return { op = "destroy", id = id }
		elseif kind == "flush" then
			local arg = if depth == 0 and g:bool(0.5) then 0.016 else nil
			return { op = "flush", arg = arg }
		elseif kind == "fault" then
			return { op = "fault", value = g:int(0, if tiny then 1 else 2) }
		elseif kind == "loop" then
			st.loopDone = true
			local signalId = define("signal", 4, nil, nil)
			local id = define("effect", 4, { [signalId] = true }, owner)
			return { op = "loop", signal = signalId, id = id, cleanup = g:bool(0.5) or nil }
		end
		error(`unknown op kind {kind}`)
	end

	function genOps(depth: number, ctxKnown: boolean, owner: number?, encl: { number }): { any }
		local max = if depth == 0 then g.size else (if tiny then 1 else 3)
		return g:list(function()
			return genOp(depth, ctxKnown, owner, encl)
		end, 1, max)
	end

	return genOps
end

local format

function GraphModel.generate(g: any, options: Options?): any
	local opts = options or {}
	local genOps = newGenerator(g, opts)
	local ops = genOps(0, false, nil, {})
	local program = { ops = ops }
	for _, op in ops do
		g:note("%s", format(op))
	end
	return program
end

function format(value: any): string
	if type(value) == "table" then
		if #value > 0 or next(value) == nil then
			local parts = {}
			for _, item in value do
				table.insert(parts, format(item))
			end
			return "{ " .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. " }"
		end
		local keys = {}
		for key in value do
			table.insert(keys, key)
		end
		table.sort(keys, function(a, b)
			if a == "op" then
				return b ~= "op"
			elseif b == "op" then
				return false
			end
			return tostring(a) < tostring(b)
		end)
		local parts = {}
		for _, key in keys do
			table.insert(parts, `{key} = {format(value[key])}`)
		end
		return "{ " .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. " }"
	elseif type(value) == "string" then
		return string.format("%q", value)
	end
	return tostring(value)
end

GraphModel.format = format

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Model

local Model = {}
Model.__index = Model

local PREFIX = {
	signal = "s",
	computed = "c",
	safe = "f",
	on = "o",
	effect = "e",
	scope = "x",
	root = "r",
	loop = "l",
}

local READERS = {
	get = function(_, node)
		return node:get()
	end,
	getter = function(Flux, node)
		if rawget(node, "_solid") then
			return node:get()
		end
		return Flux.getter(node)()
	end,
	read = function(Flux, node)
		if rawget(node, "_solid") then
			return Flux.read(node._get)
		end
		return Flux.read(node)
	end,
	untrack = function(Flux, node)
		return Flux.untrack(function()
			return node:get()
		end)
	end,
	peek = function(_, node)
		return node:peek()
	end,
	raw = function(Flux, node)
		if rawget(node, "_solid") then
			return Flux.raw(node._get)
		end
		return Flux.raw(node)
	end,
	rawGetter = function(Flux, node)
		return Flux.raw(function()
			return node:get()
		end)
	end,
	bare = function(Flux, node)
		Flux.untrack()
		local value = node:get()
		Flux.retrack()
		return value
	end,
	pcallRaw = function(Flux, node)
		pcall(Flux.raw, function()
			node:get()
			error("model: throwing getter", 0)
		end)
		return node:get()
	end,
}

local function isComputed(rec: any): boolean
	return rec.kind == "computed" or rec.kind == "safe" or rec.kind == "on"
end

function Model.new(Flux: any, options: Options)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Model)
	self.Flux = Flux
	self.options = options
	self.lazy = options.lazy ~= false
	self.recs = {}
	self.all = {}
	self.epoch = 0
	self.seq = 0
	self.execs = 0
	self.fails = {}
	self.kills = 0
	self.curOwner = nil
	self.ctxVal = nil
	self.stack = {}
	self.pendingSafe = {}
	self.flushing = false
	self.dynamic = 0
	self.tokens = {}
	self.ctx = Flux.context(0)
	self.F = self:newRec("signal", "F", nil)
	self.F.name = "fault"
	self.F.value, self.F.held = 0, 0
	self.F.node = Flux.signal(0)
	return self
end

function Model:fail(message: string)
	table.insert(self.fails, message)
end

function Model:raise(where: string)
	local first = self.fails[1]
	if first then
		error(`{first}\n   (at {where}; {#self.fails} violation(s))`, 0)
	end
end

function Model:newRec(kind: string, id: any, owner: any): any
	local rec = {
		kind = kind,
		id = id,
		owner = owner,
		children = {},
		tokens = {},
		dtokens = {},
		alive = true,
		lastChange = 0,
		burst = 0,
		closure = {},
		closureSet = {},
	}
	rec.name = if type(id) == "number" then (PREFIX[kind] or "?") .. id else tostring(id)
	table.insert(self.all, rec)
	if owner then
		table.insert(owner.children, rec)
	end
	return rec
end

function Model:setClosure(rec: any, body: any)
	local list, set = {}, {}
	local function add(target: any)
		if set[target] then
			return
		end
		set[target] = true
		table.insert(list, target)
		for _, other in target.closure do
			add(other)
		end
	end
	for _, read in body.reads do
		add(self.recs[read.id])
	end
	if body.child then
		for _, read in body.child.body.reads do
			add(self.recs[read.id])
		end
	end
	rec.closure, rec.closureSet = list, set
end

function Model:tainted(rec: any, dying: boolean?): boolean
	if rec.ctxTaint or (not rec.alive and not dying) then
		return true
	end
	for _, other in rec.closure do
		if not other.alive then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function Model:changed(rec: any)
	self.epoch += 1
	rec.lastChange = self.epoch
end

function Model:token(owner: any, kind: string, checkOld: boolean): any
	local token = { owner = owner, kind = kind, fired = 0, checkOld = checkOld }
	token.name = `{kind} of {owner.name}`
	table.insert(self.tokens, token)
	return token
end

function Model:fire(token: any, old: any, destroyed: any)
	token.fired += 1
	self.seq += 1
	token.seq = self.seq
	if token.fired > 1 then
		self:fail(`{token.name} ran {token.fired} times`)
	end
	token.old, token.destroyed = old, destroyed
end

function Model:expectFired(token: any, destroyed: boolean, old: any, why: string)
	if token.fired ~= 1 then
		self:fail(`{token.name} ran {token.fired} times by {why}, expected once`)
		return
	end
	if token.kind == "cleanup" and token.destroyed ~= destroyed then
		self:fail(`{token.name} got destroyed = {token.destroyed} at {why}, expected {destroyed}`)
	end
	if token.checkOld and not self:tainted(token.owner, true) then
		local eq = if token.owner.eqMod then modEq else rawEq
		if not eq(token.old, old) then
			self:fail(`{token.name} got old value {token.old} at {why}, expected {old}`)
		end
	end
end

local function subtreeMaxSeq(rec: any, acc: number): number
	for _, token in rec.tokens do
		acc = math.max(acc, token.seq or 0)
	end
	for _, token in rec.dtokens do
		acc = math.max(acc, token.seq or 0)
	end
	for _, child in rec.children do
		acc = subtreeMaxSeq(child, acc)
	end
	return acc
end

function Model:checkOrder(rec: any, children: { any }, tokens: { any }, why: string)
	local last = 0
	for _, child in children do
		last = subtreeMaxSeq(child, last)
	end
	for _, token in tokens do
		if token.seq and token.seq < last then
			self:fail(`{token.name} ran before {rec.name}'s children were torn down ({why})`)
			return
		end
	end
end

local function untrackedCause(rec: any): boolean
	local seen = {}
	while rec and not seen[rec] do
		seen[rec] = true
		local cur = rec.cur
		local cause = cur and not cur.ok and cur.cause
		if not cause or cause.fault then
			return false
		elseif not cause.tracked then
			return true
		end
		rec = cause.rec
	end
	return false
end

function Model:flushSafe()
	if #self.pendingSafe == 0 then
		return
	end
	local pending = self.pendingSafe
	self.pendingSafe = {}
	for _, entry in pending do
		local why = `{entry.rec.name}'s fallback`
		for _, child in entry.children do
			self:kill(child, why)
		end
		self:checkOrder(entry.rec, entry.children, entry.tokens, why)
		for _, token in entry.tokens do
			self:expectFired(token, false, entry.held, why)
		end
	end
end

function Model:kill(rec: any, why: string)
	self:flushSafe()
	if not rec.alive then
		return
	end
	rec.alive = false
	self.kills += 1
	local children, tokens = rec.children, rec.tokens
	for _, child in children do
		self:kill(child, why)
	end
	if rec.kind ~= "signal" then
		self:checkOrder(rec, children, tokens, why)
	end
	for _, token in tokens do
		self:expectFired(token, true, rec.held, why)
	end
	for _, token in rec.dtokens do
		self:expectFired(token, true, rec.held, why)
	end
	rec.tokens = {}
end

function Model:reap(rec: any, why: string)
	if rec.alive then
		return
	end
	for _, child in rec.children do
		self:kill(child, why)
	end
	for _, token in rec.tokens do
		self:expectFired(token, true, nil, why)
	end
end

function Model:legitRun(rec: any): boolean
	for _, target in self.stack do
		if target == rec or target.closureSet[rec] then
			return true
		end
		if rec.dynamic and (target == rec.owner or target.closureSet[rec.owner]) then
			return true
		end
	end
	if self.flushing then
		if rec.dynamic then
			return true
		end
		for _, other in self.all do
			if other.kind == "effect" and other.alive and other.closureSet[rec] then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function Model:beginRun(rec: any)
	self:flushSafe()
	self.execs += 1
	rec.burst += 1
	rec.flushRuns = (rec.flushRuns or 0) + 1
	if rec.burst > RUNAWAY then
		self:fail(`{rec.name} ran more than {RUNAWAY} times in one op (a loop the graph did not stop)`)
		error("[GraphModel] runaway", 0)
	end
	if not rec.alive then
		self:fail(`{rec.name} ran after it was destroyed`)
	end
	if isComputed(rec) and self.lazy and not self:legitRun(rec) then
		self:fail(`{rec.name} ran while nothing read it (not lazy)`)
	end

	local prev = rec.cur
	if prev and prev.ok and not rec.ctxTaint then
		local justified = false
		for _, read in prev.reads do
			if read.tracked and (read.rec.lastChange > read.epoch or not read.rec.alive) then
				justified = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not justified then
			self:fail(`{rec.name} re-ran though nothing it tracked changed (spurious run)`)
		end
	end

	local children, tokens = rec.children, rec.tokens
	for _, child in children do
		self:kill(child, `{rec.name}'s re-run`)
	end
	self:checkOrder(rec, children, tokens, `{rec.name}'s re-run`)
	for _, token in tokens do
		self:expectFired(token, false, rec.held, `{rec.name}'s re-run`)
	end
	rec.children, rec.tokens = {}, {}
	rec.cur = { reads = {} }
end

function Model:endRun(rec: any, ok: boolean, result: any)
	local cur = rec.cur
	if rec.kind == "safe" and not ok then
		table.insert(self.pendingSafe, {
			rec = rec,
			children = rec.children,
			tokens = rec.tokens,
			held = rec.held,
		})
		rec.children, rec.tokens = {}, {}
		ok, result = true, FALLBACK
	end
	if rec.kind == "effect" then
		result = nil
	end
	cur.ok = ok
	if ok then
		local eq = if rec.eqMod then modEq else rawEq
		if rec.lastOk ~= true or not eq(rec.held, result) then
			self:changed(rec)
			rec.held = result
		end
		rec.lastOk = true
	else
		cur.err = result
		self:changed(rec)
		rec.lastOk = false
	end
end

function Model:readIn(rec: any, target: any, mode: string): any
	local stack = self.stack
	table.insert(stack, target)
	local ok, value = pcall(READERS[mode], self.Flux, target.node)
	table.remove(stack)
	self:flushSafe()
	local cur = rec.cur
	if not ok then
		cur.cause = { rec = target, tracked = TRACKED[mode] == true }
		table.insert(cur.reads, { rec = target, tracked = TRACKED[mode] == true, epoch = self.epoch, failed = true })
		error(value, 0)
	end
	table.insert(cur.reads, { rec = target, v = norm(value), tracked = TRACKED[mode] == true, epoch = self.epoch })
	return value
end

function Model:write(target: any, value: any, mode: string, useSetter: boolean?)
	if not target.alive then
		return
	end
	local node = target.node
	if mode == "update" then
		node:update()
		self:changed(target)
		return
	end
	local eq = if target.eqMod then modEq else rawEq
	local changing = mode == "force" or not eq(target.value, value)
	local setFn = if useSetter and not rawget(node, "_solid") then self.Flux.setter(node) else nil
	if mode == "force" then
		if setFn then
			setFn(value, true)
		else
			node:set(value, true)
		end
	else
		if setFn then
			setFn(value)
		else
			node:set(value)
		end
	end
	if changing then
		target.value, target.held = value, value
		self:changed(target)
	end
end

function Model:bodyFn(rec: any): (any) -> any
	local Flux = self.Flux
	local body = rec.body

	local function finish(total: number, raws: { any }): number
		if body.ctx then
			total += norm(self.ctx:get())
		end
		if body.dispose then
			local target = self.recs[body.dispose]
			Flux.dispose(function()
				target.node:get()
			end)
		end
		if body.flush then
			Flux.flush()
		end
		if body.fault then
			local fault = self:readIn(rec, self.F, "get")
			if norm(fault) ~= 0 then
				rec.cur.cause = { fault = true, tracked = true }
				error(setmetatable({ fault = fault }, Fault), 0)
			end
		end
		local write = body.write
		if write then
			local target = self.recs[write.id]
			local value
			if write.cap then
				value = math.min((raws[1] or 0) + 1, write.cap)
				if value <= (raws[1] or 0) then
					value = nil
				end
			elseif write.loop then
				value = (raws[1] or 0) + 1
			else
				value = total % 10
			end
			if value ~= nil then
				self:write(target, value, "set")
				target.writer = rec
			end
		end
		return total
	end

	local function start()
		if body.cleanup then
			local token = self:token(rec, "cleanup", not rec.solid)
			local readId = body.cleanup.read
			Flux.cleanup(function(old, destroyed)
				self:fire(token, old, destroyed)
				if readId then
					self.recs[readId].node:get()
				end
			end)
			table.insert(rec.tokens, token)
		end
	end

	local function child(): number
		local spec = body.child
		if not spec then
			return 0
		end
		self.dynamic += 1
		local kid = self:newRec(spec.kind, `k{self.dynamic}<{rec.name}`, rec)
		kid.dynamic = true
		kid.body = spec.body
		self:setClosure(kid, spec.body)
		local fn = self:bodyFn(kid)
		kid.node = if spec.kind == "effect" then Flux.effect(fn) else Flux.computed(fn)
		local token = self:token(kid, "onDestroy", true)
		kid.node:onDestroy(function(old)
			self:fire(token, old, true)
		end)
		table.insert(kid.dtokens, token)
		if spec.kind == "computed" then
			return norm(self:readIn(rec, kid, "get"))
		end
		return 0
	end

	local inner
	if rec.kind == "on" then
		local deps, extras = {}, {}
		for _, read in body.reads do
			local target = self.recs[read.id]
			if read.dep then
				table.insert(deps, function()
					return self:readIn(rec, target, "get")
				end)
			else
				table.insert(extras, target)
			end
		end
		if body.fault then
			table.insert(deps, function()
				return self:readIn(rec, self.F, "get")
			end)
		end
		local onFn = Flux.on(deps, function(input)
			local total = 0
			for i = 1, #input do
				if body.fault and i == #input then
					if norm(input[i]) ~= 0 then
						rec.cur.cause = { fault = true, tracked = true }
						error(setmetatable({ fault = input[i] }, Fault), 0)
					end
				else
					total += norm(input[i])
				end
			end
			for _, target in extras do
				total += norm(self:readIn(rec, target, "peek"))
			end
			if body.ctx then
				total += norm(self.ctx:get())
			end
			return total
		end)
		inner = function(prev)
			start()
			return onFn(prev)
		end
	else
		inner = function()
			start()
			local vals, raws, total = {}, {}, 0
			for i, read in body.reads do
				local cond = read.cond
				if cond and (vals[cond.at] == nil or vals[cond.at] % 2 ~= cond.k) then
					continue
				end
				local value = self:readIn(rec, self.recs[read.id], read.mode)
				raws[i] = value
				vals[i] = norm(value)
				total += vals[i]
			end
			total += child()
			return finish(total, raws)
		end
	end

	return function(prev)
		if self.closed then
			return 0
		end
		self:beginRun(rec)
		local ok, result = pcall(inner, prev)
		self:endRun(rec, ok, result)
		self:reap(rec, `the end of {rec.name}'s run, after its death`)
		if not ok then
			error(result, 0)
		end
		return result
	end
end

local TAINT = { taint = true }
local ERR = { err = true }

function Model:ref(rec: any, memo: any): any
	if not rec.alive then
		return TAINT
	end
	if rec.kind == "signal" then
		return { v = rec.value }
	end
	if memo and memo[rec] then
		return memo[rec]
	end
	local result = self:cached(rec, memo)
	if result == nil then
		result = self:evalBody(rec, rec.body, memo)
		if rec.kind == "safe" and result.err then
			result = { v = FALLBACK }
		end
	end
	if memo then
		memo[rec] = result
	end
	return result
end

function Model:cached(rec: any, memo: any): any
	local last = rec.cur
	if last and not last.ok and untrackedCause(rec) then
		return TAINT
	elseif last == nil or not last.ok or rec.lastOk ~= true then
		return nil
	end
	for _, read in last.reads do
		if read.tracked then
			local target = read.rec
			if not target.alive then
				return TAINT
			elseif target.lastChange > read.epoch then
				return nil
			elseif target.kind ~= "signal" then
				local now = self:ref(target, memo)
				if now.taint then
					return TAINT
				end
				local eq = if target.eqMod then modEq else rawEq
				if now.err or target.lastOk ~= true or not eq(target.held, now.v) then
					return nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return { v = rec.held }
end

function Model:evalBody(rec: any, body: any, memo: any): any
	if rec.ctxTaint or self:tainted(rec) then
		return TAINT
	end
	local vals, total = {}, 0
	for i, read in body.reads do
		local cond = read.cond
		if cond and (vals[cond.at] == nil or vals[cond.at] % 2 ~= cond.k) then
			continue
		end
		local result = self:ref(self.recs[read.id], memo)
		if result.taint or result.err then
			return result
		end
		vals[i] = norm(result.v)
		total += vals[i]
	end
	if body.child and body.child.kind == "computed" then
		local result = self:evalBody({ closure = {}, alive = true }, body.child.body, memo)
		if result.taint or result.err then
			return result
		end
		total += norm(result.v)
	end
	if body.ctx then
		total += norm(rec.ctx)
	end
	if body.fault and norm(self.F.value) ~= 0 then
		return ERR
	end
	return { v = total }
end

function Model:checkRead(rec: any, mode: string, memo: any)
	local Flux = self.Flux
	local kills = self.kills
	table.insert(self.stack, rec)
	local ok, value = pcall(READERS[mode], Flux, rec.node)
	table.remove(self.stack)
	self:flushSafe()
	if memo and self.kills ~= kills then
		table.clear(memo)
	end
	if not rec.alive then
		if not ok or value ~= nil then
			self:fail(`destroyed {rec.name} read {if ok then tostring(value) else "an error"} via {mode}, expected nil`)
		end
		return
	end
	local ref = self:ref(rec, memo)
	if ref.taint then
		return
	elseif ref.err then
		if ok then
			self:fail(`{rec.name} read {value} via {mode}, expected an error (fault)`)
		end
	elseif not ok then
		self:fail(`{rec.name} raised via {mode}: {tostring(value)}; expected {ref.v}`)
	elseif norm(value) ~= norm(ref.v) then
		self:fail(`{rec.name} read {value} via {mode}, expected {ref.v} (mod 10)`)
	end
end

function Model:idle(where: string)
	local message = env.idle(self.Flux, {
		contexts = { { context = self.ctx, default = 0 } },
	})
	self:flushSafe()
	if message then
		self:fail(message)
	end
	self:raise(where)
end

function Model:quiescent(where: string)
	local Flux = self.Flux
	local execs = self.execs
	self.flushing = true
	local drained = env.drained(Flux)
	self.flushing = false
	self:flushSafe()
	if drained then
		self:fail(drained)
	end
	if self.execs ~= execs then
		self:fail(`{self.execs - execs} reaction run(s) were still pending after a flush`)
	end
	local memo = {}
	for _, rec in self.all do
		if rec.kind == "effect" and rec.alive and not self:tainted(rec) then
			local last = rec.cur
			if last == nil then
				self:fail(`{rec.name} never ran though it is alive after a flush`)
			elseif last.ok then
				local failing = false
				for _, read in last.reads do
					if read.tracked and self:ref(read.rec, memo).err then
						failing = true
					end
				end
				for _, read in last.reads do
					if read.tracked and not failing then
						local ref = self:ref(read.rec, memo)
						if not ref.taint and norm(ref.v) ~= read.v then
							self:fail(
								`{rec.name} last saw {read.rec.name} = {read.v}, but it is {norm(ref.v)} (missed update)`
							)
						end
					end
				end
			else
				local cause = last.cause
				if cause == nil then
					self:fail(`{rec.name} failed with an unexpected error: {tostring(last.err)}`)
				elseif cause.fault then
					if norm(self.F.value) == 0 then
						self:fail(`{rec.name} failed on a fault that has been cleared (did not recover)`)
					end
				elseif cause.tracked and not cause.rec.dynamic and not untrackedCause(cause.rec) then
					local ref = self:ref(cause.rec, memo)
					if not ref.taint and not ref.err then
						self:fail(`{rec.name} failed reading {cause.rec.name}, which has recovered (did not recover)`)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, rec in self.all do
		if isComputed(rec) and not rec.dynamic then
			self:checkRead(rec, "peek", memo)
		end
	end
	self:raise(where)
end

local function makeSolidSignalAdapter(Flux: any, value: any, eq: any): any
	local get, set
	local scope = Flux.scope(function()
		get, set = Flux.createSignal(value, eq)
	end)
	local dead = false
	local function getWrapped()
		if dead then
			return nil
		end
		return get()
	end
	return {
		_solid = true,
		_get = getWrapped,
		get = getWrapped,
		peek = function()
			if dead then
				return nil
			end
			return Flux.untrack(get)
		end,
		set = function(_, v: any, force: boolean?)
			if not dead then
				set(v, force)
			end
		end,
		update = function()
			if not dead then
				set(Flux.untrack(get), true)
			end
		end,
		Destroy = function()
			if not dead then
				dead = true
				scope:Destroy()
			end
		end,
	}
end

local function makeSolidMemoAdapter(Flux: any, fn: any, eq: any): any
	local get
	local scope = Flux.scope(function()
		get = Flux.createMemo(fn, eq)
	end)
	return {
		_solid = true,
		_get = get,
		get = function()
			return get()
		end,
		peek = function()
			return Flux.untrack(get)
		end,
		Destroy = function()
			scope:Destroy()
		end,
	}
end

local function makeSolidEffectAdapter(Flux: any, fn: any): any
	local scope = Flux.scope(function()
		Flux.createEffect(fn)
	end)
	return {
		_solid = true,
		Destroy = function()
			scope:Destroy()
		end,
	}
end

function Model:create(op: any, kind: string): any
	local Flux = self.Flux
	local rec = self:newRec(kind, op.id, if kind == "signal" then nil else self.curOwner)
	self.recs[op.id] = rec
	rec.ctx = self.ctxVal
	rec.solid = op.solid == true
	if kind == "signal" then
		rec.value, rec.held, rec.eqMod = op.value, op.value, op.eqMod
		local eq = if op.eqMod then modEq else nil
		if op.solid then
			rec.node = makeSolidSignalAdapter(Flux, op.value, eq)
		else
			rec.node = Flux.signal(op.value, eq)
		end
	else
		rec.body = op.body
		rec.eqMod = op.eqMod
		if op.body.ctx and rec.ctx == nil then
			rec.ctxTaint = true
		end
		self:setClosure(rec, op.body)
		local fn = self:bodyFn(rec)
		local eq = if op.eqMod then modEq else nil
		if kind == "effect" then
			if op.solid and self.curOwner == nil then
				rec.node = makeSolidEffectAdapter(Flux, fn)
			else
				rec.solid = false
				rec.node = Flux.effect(fn)
			end
		elseif kind == "safe" then
			rec.node = Flux.safe(fn, FALLBACK, eq)
			self:flushSafe()
		else
			if op.solid and self.curOwner == nil then
				rec.node = makeSolidMemoAdapter(Flux, fn, eq)
			else
				rec.solid = false
				rec.node = Flux.computed(fn, eq)
			end
		end
	end
	if op.onDestroy then
		local token = self:token(rec, "onDestroy", kind ~= "scope")
		rec.node:onDestroy(function(old)
			self:fire(token, old, true)
		end)
		table.insert(rec.dtokens, token)
	end
	return rec
end

function Model:block(ops: { any }, depth: number)
	local Flux = self.Flux
	local owner = Flux.getOwner()
	for _, op in ops do
		self:exec(op, depth)
		if Flux.getOwner() ~= owner then
			self:fail(`the owner was not restored after {op.op} inside a block`)
		end
	end
end

function Model:exec(op: any, depth: number)
	local Flux = self.Flux
	local kind = op.op
	if kind == "signal" then
		self:create(op, "signal")
	elseif kind == "computed" then
		self:create(op, op.variant or "computed")
	elseif kind == "effect" then
		self:create(op, "effect")
	elseif kind == "loop" then
		self:create({ id = op.signal, value = 0 }, "signal")
		local body = { reads = { { id = op.signal, mode = "get" } }, write = { id = op.signal, loop = true } }
		if op.cleanup then
			body.cleanup = {}
		end
		local rec = self:create({ id = op.id, body = body }, "effect")
		rec.loop = true
		self.loopRec = rec
	elseif kind == "scope" then
		local rec = self:newRec("scope", op.id, self.curOwner)
		self.recs[op.id] = rec
		rec.ctx = self.ctxVal
		local saved = self.curOwner
		rec.node = Flux.scope(function(node)
			rec.node = node
			self.curOwner = rec
			self:block(op.ops, depth + 1)
			if op.cleanup then
				local token = self:token(rec, "cleanup", false)
				Flux.cleanup(function(old, destroyed)
					self:fire(token, old, destroyed)
				end)
				table.insert(rec.tokens, token)
			end
		end)
		self.curOwner = saved
		self:reap(rec, `the end of {rec.name}'s body, after its death`)
	elseif kind == "withOwner" then
		local target = if op.target then self.recs[op.target] else nil
		local arg, ownerRec, root = nil, nil, nil
		if target and target.alive and not target.solid then
			arg, ownerRec = target.node, target
		elseif target and not target.solid then
			arg = target.node
			self.dynamic += 1
			root = self:newRec("root", `r{self.dynamic}`, nil)
			ownerRec = root
		end
		local savedOwner, savedCtx = self.curOwner, self.ctxVal
		self.curOwner = ownerRec
		if ownerRec == target and target and target.ctx ~= nil then
			self.ctxVal = target.ctx
		end
		Flux.withOwner(arg, function()
			self:block(op.ops, depth + 1)
			if op.cleanup and ownerRec then
				local token = self:token(ownerRec, "cleanup", ownerRec ~= root and ownerRec.kind ~= "scope")
				Flux.cleanup(function(old, destroyed)
					self:fire(token, old, destroyed)
				end)
				table.insert(ownerRec.tokens, token)
			end
		end)
		self.curOwner, self.ctxVal = savedOwner, savedCtx
		if root then
			self:kill(root, "the end of withOwner(destroyed owner)")
		elseif ownerRec then
			self:reap(ownerRec, `the end of withOwner({ownerRec.name}), after its death`)
		end
	elseif kind == "provide" then
		local saved = self.ctxVal
		self.ctxVal = op.value
		self.ctx:provide(op.value, function()
			self:block(op.ops, depth + 1)
		end)
		self.ctxVal = saved
	elseif kind == "set" or kind == "force" then
		self:write(self.recs[op.id], op.value, kind, op.setter)
		self.recs[op.id].writer = nil
	elseif kind == "update" then
		self:write(self.recs[op.id], nil, "update")
	elseif kind == "fault" then
		self:write(self.F, op.value, "set")
	elseif kind == "read" then
		self:checkRead(self.recs[op.id], op.mode)
	elseif kind == "destroy" then
		local rec = self.recs[op.id]
		rec.node:Destroy()
		self:kill(rec, `destroy {rec.name}`)
	elseif kind == "flush" then
		for _, rec in self.all do
			rec.flushRuns = 0
		end
		local wasFlushing = self.flushing
		self.flushing = true
		if op.arg ~= nil then
			Flux.flush(op.arg)
		else
			Flux.flush()
		end
		self.flushing = wasFlushing
		self:flushSafe()
		local loop = self.loopRec
		if loop and loop.alive and loop.flushRuns > 1 then
			local limit = GraphModel.RERUN_LIMIT + 2
			if loop.flushRuns > limit then
				self:fail(`{loop.name} ran {loop.flushRuns} times in one flush; the loop guard allows {limit}`)
			end
			self:kill(loop, "the loop guard")
		end
	else
		error(`unknown op {kind}`)
	end
end

function Model:snapshot(): string
	local memos = { [false] = {}, [true] = {} }
	local function tainted(rec: any, writer: boolean?): boolean
		local memo = memos[writer == true]
		local known = memo[rec]
		if known ~= nil then
			return known
		end
		memo[rec] = false
		local result = self:tainted(rec, writer) or (rec.writer ~= nil and tainted(rec.writer, true))
		if not result then
			for _, other in rec.closure do
				if other.writer ~= nil and tainted(other.writer, true) then
					result = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
		memo[rec] = result
		return result
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, rec in self.all do
		if rec.dynamic or rec.kind == "root" then
			continue
		end
		local text = `{rec.name}:{if rec.alive then "live" else "dead"}`
		if rec.alive and not tainted(rec) then
			if rec.kind == "signal" then
				text ..= `={norm(rec.value)}`
			elseif isComputed(rec) then
				table.insert(self.stack, rec)
				local ok, value = pcall(rec.node.peek, rec.node)
				table.remove(self.stack)
				self:flushSafe()
				text ..= if ok then `={norm(value)}` else "=error"
			elseif rec.kind == "effect" and rec.cur then
				if rec.cur.ok then
					local seen = {}
					for _, read in rec.cur.reads do
						if read.tracked then
							table.insert(seen, `{if read.rec.dynamic then "child" else read.rec.name}={read.v}`)
						end
					end
					text ..= ` saw[{table.concat(seen, ",")}]`
				else
					text ..= " failed"
				end
			end
		end
		table.insert(parts, text)
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "; ")
end

function Model:teardown()
	for index = #self.all, 1, -1 do
		local rec = self.all[index]
		if not rec.dynamic and rec.kind ~= "root" and rec.alive and rec.node then
			rec.node:Destroy()
			self:kill(rec, `final destroy of {rec.name}`)
		end
	end
	self.flushing = true
	self.Flux.flush()
	self.flushing = false
	self:flushSafe()
	for _, token in self.tokens do
		if token.fired ~= 1 then
			self:fail(`{token.name} ran {token.fired} times by the end, expected once`)
		end
	end
end

function GraphModel.run(Flux: any, program: any, options: Options?): string
	local opts = options or {}
	local model = Model.new(Flux, opts)
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		model:idle("start")
		for index, op in program.ops do
			for _, rec in model.all do
				rec.burst = 0
			end
			model:exec(op, 0)
			local where = `op {index} ({op.op})`
			model:idle(where)
			if op.op == "flush" then
				model:quiescent(where)
			end
		end
		for _, rec in model.all do
			rec.burst = 0
		end
		model:exec({ op = "flush" }, 0)
		model:quiescent("the final flush")
		local snapshot = model:snapshot()
		model:teardown()
		model:idle("teardown")
		return snapshot
	end)
	model.closed = true
	if not ok then
		for index = #model.all, 1, -1 do
			local rec = model.all[index]
			if rec.node then
				pcall(rec.node.Destroy, rec.node)
			end
		end
		pcall(Flux.flush)
		error(result, 0)
	end
	return result
end

return table.freeze(GraphModel)

-- GameServer.server.luau — the heart of BRAINROT BAZAAR. Owns player
-- state, the market, income, rebirth, locks, and the thief/monsoon loops.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Config)

local PartKit = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.PartKit)

local Monsoon = require(script.Parent.Monsoon)

local world = World.Build()

local remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
remotesFolder.Name = Config.RemoteFolderName
remotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local Remotes = {}
for _, eventName in pairs(Config.Remotes) do
	local event = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	event.Name = eventName
	event.Parent = remotesFolder
	Remotes[eventName] = event
end

local rng = Random.new()
local states = {}
local nextBase = 1
local offers = { false, false, false, false }
local offerDisplays = { nil, nil, nil, nil }

local function characterPosition(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	return root.Position
end

local function near(player, target, range)
	local pos = characterPosition(player)
	if not pos then
		return false
	end
	return (pos - target).Magnitude <= range
end

local function totalRate(state)
	local sum = 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(state.Pedestals) do
		if slot then
			local entry = BrainrotData.Find(slot.Name)
			if entry then
				sum += BrainrotData.IncomePerSecond(entry, slot.Mutation, state.Rebirths)
			end
		end
	end
	return sum
end

local function sendState(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local now = os.time()
	local payload = {
		Cash = state.Cash,
		Rate = totalRate(state),
		Rebirths = state.Rebirths,
		Multiplier = BrainrotData.RebirthMultiplier(state.Rebirths),
		Carrying = state.Carrying and state.Carrying.Name or "",
		Locked = now < state.LockUntil,
		LockLeft = math.max(0, state.LockUntil - now),
		Pedestals = {},
	}
	for index, slot in ipairs(state.Pedestals) do
		if slot then
			payload.Pedestals[index] = { Name = slot.Name, Mutation = slot.Mutation }
		else
			payload.Pedestals[index] = false
		end
	end
	Remotes[Config.Remotes.State]:FireClient(player, payload)
end

local function notice(player, text)
	Remotes[Config.Remotes.Notice]:FireClient(player, text)
end

local function clearOfferDisplay(index)
	if offerDisplays[index] then
		offerDisplays[index]:Destroy()
		offerDisplays[index] = nil
	end
end

local function refreshMarket()
	for index = 1, Config.MarketOfferCount do
		clearOfferDisplay(index)
		local entry = BrainrotData.RandomCharacter(rng)
		local mutation = BrainrotData.RandomMutation(rng)
		offers[index] = { Name = entry.Name, Mutation = mutation }
		local anchor = world.StallAnchors[index]
		local ball = PartKit.Ball(workspace, 1.6, anchor.Position, BrainrotData.RarityColors[entry.Rarity], Enum.Material.Neon)
		ball.Name = "Offer" .. index
		local label = entry.Name .. "\n$" .. entry.Price .. "  " .. entry.Rarity
		if mutation ~= "NORMAL" then
			label ..= "  " .. mutation
		end
		PartKit.Label(ball, label, BrainrotData.RarityColors[entry.Rarity], 4)
		offerDisplays[index] = ball
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local baseIndex = nextBase
	nextBase = nextBase % Config.BaseCount + 1
	local base = world.Bases[baseIndex]
	base.SignText.Text = player.Name
	local pedestals = {}
	for _ = 1, Config.PedestalCount do
		table.insert(pedestals, false)
	end
	states[player] = {
		Cash = Config.StartCash,
		Pedestals = pedestals,
		Carrying = nil,
		Rebirths = 0,
		LockUntil = 0,
		LockCooldownUntil = 0,
		BaseIndex = baseIndex,
	}
	sendState(player)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if state then
		for _, slot in ipairs(state.Pedestals) do
			if slot and slot.Model then
				slot.Model:Destroy()
			end
		end
		world.Bases[state.BaseIndex].SignText.Text = "BASE " .. state.BaseIndex
	end
	states[player] = nil
end

local function onBuy(player, offerIndex)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or type(offerIndex) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local offer = offers[offerIndex]
	if not offer then
		notice(player, "That offer is gone.")
		return
	end
	if state.Carrying then
		notice(player, "Place what you carry first (F).")
		return
	end
	local entry = BrainrotData.Find(offer.Name)
	if not entry or state.Cash < entry.Price then
		notice(player, "Not enough cash.")
		return
	end
	local stallPos = Config.StallPositions[offerIndex]
	if not near(player, stallPos, Config.InteractRange) then
		notice(player, "Get closer to the stall.")
		return
	end
	state.Cash -= entry.Price
	state.Carrying = { Name = offer.Name, Mutation = offer.Mutation }
	offers[offerIndex] = false
	clearOfferDisplay(offerIndex)
	sendState(player)
	notice(player, "Picked up " .. offer.Name .. "!")
end

local function onPlace(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or not state.Carrying then
		return
	end
	local base = world.Bases[state.BaseIndex]
	if not near(player, base.Center, 30) then
		notice(player, "Go to your base to place it.")
		return
	end
	local slotIndex = 0
	for index, slot in ipairs(state.Pedestals) do
		if not slot then
			slotIndex = index
			break
		end
	end
	if slotIndex == 0 then
		notice(player, "Your base is full.")
		return
	end
	local carried = state.Carrying
	local entry = BrainrotData.Find(carried.Name)
	local displayRate = math.floor(BrainrotData.IncomePerSecond(entry, carried.Mutation, state.Rebirths))
	local model = BrainrotModels.Build(carried.Name, base.Pedestals[slotIndex], displayRate)
	if model then
		model.Parent = base.Folder
	end
	state.Pedestals[slotIndex] = { Name = carried.Name, Mutation = carried.Mutation, Model = model }
	state.Carrying = nil
	sendState(player)
end

local function onSell(player, slotIndex)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or type(slotIndex) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local slot = state.Pedestals[slotIndex]
	if not slot then
		return
	end
	local entry = BrainrotData.Find(slot.Name)
	if slot.Model then
		slot.Model:Destroy()
	end
	state.Pedestals[slotIndex] = false
	state.Cash += math.floor(entry.Price * Config.SellRefund)
	sendState(player)
	notice(player, "Sold " .. slot.Name .. ".")
end

local function onRebirth(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local cost = BrainrotData.RebirthCost(state.Rebirths)
	if state.Cash < cost then
		notice(player, "Rebirth costs $" .. cost .. ".")
		return
	end
	for index, slot in ipairs(state.Pedestals) do
		if slot and slot.Model then
			slot.Model:Destroy()
		end
		state.Pedestals[index] = false
	end
	state.Cash = Config.StartCash
	state.Rebirths += 1
	sendState(player)
	notice(player, "Rebirth! Income x" .. BrainrotData.RebirthMultiplier(state.Rebirths) .. ".")
end

local function onLock(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local now = os.time()
	if now < state.LockCooldownUntil then
		notice(player, "Lock recharging (" .. (state.LockCooldownUntil - now) .. "s).")
		return
	end
	state.LockUntil = now + Config.LockDuration
	state.LockCooldownUntil = now + Config.LockDuration + Config.LockCooldown
	sendState(player)
	notice(player, "Base locked for 60s.")
end

Remotes[Config.Remotes.Buy].OnServerEvent:Connect(onBuy)
Remotes[Config.Remotes.Place].OnServerEvent:Connect(onPlace)
Remotes[Config.Remotes.Sell].OnServerEvent:Connect(onSell)
Remotes[Config.Remotes.Rebirth].OnServerEvent:Connect(onRebirth)
Remotes[Config.Remotes.Lock].OnServerEvent:Connect(onLock)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

refreshMarket()

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.IncomeTick)
		for player, state in pairs(states) do
			local gain = math.floor(totalRate(state))
			if gain > 0 then
				state.Cash += gain
				Remotes[Config.Remotes.Income]:FireClient(player, gain, state.Cash, totalRate(state))
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.MarketCycle)
		refreshMarket()
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.ThiefInterval)
		local candidates = {}
		for player, state in pairs(states) do
			if os.time() >= state.LockUntil then
				for _, slot in ipairs(state.Pedestals) do
					if slot then
						table.insert(candidates, player)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if #candidates > 0 then
			local victim = candidates[rng:NextInteger(1, #candidates)]
			local victimState = states[victim]
			local base = world.Bases[victimState.BaseIndex]
			Thief.Run({
				BaseCenter = base.Center,
				Pedestals = victimState.Pedestals,
				IsLocked = function()
					return os.time() < victimState.LockUntil
				end,
				OnStolen = function(index)
					local slot = victimState.Pedestals[index]
					if slot then
						if slot.Model then
							slot.Model:Destroy()
						end
						victimState.Pedestals[index] = false
						sendState(victim)
						notice(victim, "A thief stole your " .. slot.Name .. "!")
					end
				end,
			})
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.MonsoonInterval)
		Monsoon.Run(
			Remotes[Config.Remotes.Notice],
			world.Bases,
			world.LighthousePosition,
			Players:GetPlayers(),
			Config.SpawnPosition
		)
	end
end)

-- RigBuilder: builds the 3D multi-part rigs for every brainrot, its overhead
-- billboard, its mutation look, and the painted signs of the lagoon.
local BootyCatalog = require(script.Parent.BootyCatalog)

local RigBuilder = {}

local function addPart(model, name, size, color, offset, shape, material, transparency)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Transparency = transparency or 0
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(offset)
	p.Parent = model
	return p
end

local function addEyes(model, y, z, spread, size)
	local eyeL = addPart(model, "EyeL", Vector3.new(size, size, size), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(-spread, y, z), Enum.PartType.Ball)
	local eyeR = addPart(model, "EyeR", Vector3.new(size, size, size), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(spread, y, z), Enum.PartType.Ball)
	addPart(model, "PupilL", Vector3.new(size * 0.5, size * 0.5, size * 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Vector3.new(-spread, y, z + size * 0.55), Enum.PartType.Ball)
	addPart(model, "PupilR", Vector3.new(size * 0.5, size * 0.5, size * 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Vector3.new(spread, y, z + size * 0.55), Enum.PartType.Ball)
	return eyeL, eyeR
end

function RigBuilder.buildBrainrotRig(def, mutationName)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = def.name
	local body = def.body
	local accent = def.accent
	local shape = def.shape

	if shape == "Fish" then
		addPart(model, "Body", Vector3.new(3, 2.4, 4.5), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Tail", Vector3.new(0.5, 2.2, 1.8), accent, Vector3.new(0, 1.6, -2.8), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "TopFin", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.4, 2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 3.2, -0.3), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Belly", Vector3.new(2.2, 1.4, 3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 220), Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0.4), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addEyes(model, 2.1, 2.1, 0.8, 0.7)
	elseif shape == "Bird" then
		addPart(model, "Body", Vector3.new(2.6, 3, 2.6), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Beak", Vector3.new(1.4, 0.8, 1.6), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40), Vector3.new(0, 1.9, 1.7), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "WingL", Vector3.new(0.4, 2, 2.4), accent, Vector3.new(-1.5, 1.8, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "WingR", Vector3.new(0.4, 2, 2.4), accent, Vector3.new(1.5, 1.8, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Hat", Vector3.new(2, 0.5, 2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "HatTop", Vector3.new(1.2, 1, 1.2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addEyes(model, 2.4, 1.2, 0.7, 0.6)
	elseif shape == "Crab" then
		addPart(model, "Body", Vector3.new(4, 1.8, 3), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "ClawL", Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 1.4), accent, Vector3.new(-2.6, 1.4, 0.8), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "ClawR", Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 1.4), accent, Vector3.new(2.6, 1.4, 0.8), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "LegL1", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.4, 0.4), body, Vector3.new(-2.2, 0.7, -0.8), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "LegR1", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.4, 0.4), body, Vector3.new(2.2, 0.7, -0.8), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "LegL2", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.4, 0.4), body, Vector3.new(-2.2, 0.7, 0.8), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "LegR2", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.4, 0.4), body, Vector3.new(2.2, 0.7, 0.8), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "EyeStalkL", Vector3.new(0.3, 1, 0.3), body, Vector3.new(-0.8, 2.4, 0.6), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "EyeStalkR", Vector3.new(0.3, 1, 0.3), body, Vector3.new(0.8, 2.4, 0.6), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addEyes(model, 3, 0.7, 0.8, 0.6)
	elseif shape == "Octo" then
		addPart(model, "Head", Vector3.new(3.6, 3.4, 3.6), body, Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local angle = (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 8)
			local x = math.cos(angle) * 1.4
			local z = math.sin(angle) * 1.4
			addPart(model, "Tentacle" .. i, Vector3.new(0.7, 1.8, 0.7), accent, Vector3.new(x, 0.9, z), Enum.PartType.Block)
		end
		addPart(model, "Crown", Vector3.new(2.2, 0.6, 2.2), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addEyes(model, 3, 1.7, 0.9, 0.7)
	elseif shape == "Shark" then
		addPart(model, "Body", Vector3.new(2.6, 2.6, 6), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Fin", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.8, 2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 3.2, -0.5), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "TailFin", Vector3.new(0.4, 2.4, 1.6), accent, Vector3.new(0, 1.8, -3.4), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Belly", Vector3.new(2, 1.6, 4.5), Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0.2), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "ToothRow", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.4, 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 2.9), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addEyes(model, 2.2, 2.4, 0.8, 0.6)
	elseif shape == "Turtle" then
		addPart(model, "Shell", Vector3.new(4, 2.4, 4.6), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "ShellTop", Vector3.new(3, 1, 3.4), accent, Vector3.new(0, 2.9, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Head", Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 1.4), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 2.9), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "FootL", Vector3.new(1, 0.8, 1.4), body, Vector3.new(-1.8, 0.5, 1.4), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "FootR", Vector3.new(1, 0.8, 1.4), body, Vector3.new(1.8, 0.5, 1.4), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "FootBackL", Vector3.new(1, 0.8, 1.4), body, Vector3.new(-1.8, 0.5, -1.6), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "FootBackR", Vector3.new(1, 0.8, 1.4), body, Vector3.new(1.8, 0.5, -1.6), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addEyes(model, 1.9, 3.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	elseif shape == "Chest" then
		addPart(model, "Box", Vector3.new(3.4, 2.4, 2.6), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Lid", Vector3.new(3.4, 1.2, 2.6), accent, Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Trim", Vector3.new(3.6, 0.4, 2.8), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Lock", Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 1.4), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "GoldPile", Vector3.new(2.4, 0.8, 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Vector3.new(0, 3.9, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addEyes(model, 1.6, 1.4, 0.8, 0.6)
	elseif shape == "Ghost" then
		addPart(model, "Body", Vector3.new(3, 3.6, 3), body, Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Skirt", Vector3.new(3.2, 1.2, 3.2), body, Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "WispL", Vector3.new(0.8, 2, 0.8), accent, Vector3.new(-1.8, 2, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "WispR", Vector3.new(0.8, 2, 0.8), accent, Vector3.new(1.8, 2, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Halo", Vector3.new(2.4, 0.4, 2.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120), Vector3.new(0, 4.4, 0), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addEyes(model, 2.6, 1.5, 0.8, 0.7)
	elseif shape == "Seal" then
		addPart(model, "Body", Vector3.new(2.6, 2.4, 4.4), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Head", Vector3.new(1.8, 1.8, 1.8), body, Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 2.2), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "FlipperL", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.2, 2), accent, Vector3.new(-1.4, 1.1, 0.6), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "FlipperR", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.2, 2), accent, Vector3.new(1.4, 1.1, 0.6), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "TailFluke", Vector3.new(2, 0.5, 1.4), accent, Vector3.new(0, 1, -2.4), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Ball", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 2.2), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addEyes(model, 2.5, 3, 0.6, 0.5)
	else -- Snake
		addPart(model, "Seg1", Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Seg2", Vector3.new(1.9, 1.9, 1.9), body, Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0.3), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Head", Vector3.new(1.8, 1.6, 2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 4, 0.6), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addPart(model, "Tongue", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 90), Vector3.new(0, 3.8, 1.9), Enum.PartType.Block)
		addPart(model, "Rattle", Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0.8, -1.4), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		addEyes(model, 4.3, 1.5, 0.6, 0.5)
	end

	local primary = model:FindFirstChild("Body") or model:FindFirstChild("Head") or model:GetChildren()[1]
	model.PrimaryPart = primary
	RigBuilder.applyMutationVisuals(model, mutationName)
	return model
end

function RigBuilder.applyMutationVisuals(model, mutationName)
	if mutationName == "NONE" or mutationName == nil then
		return
	end
	local color = BootyCatalog.getMutationColor(mutationName)
	local primary = model.PrimaryPart
	if mutationName == "GOLDEN" then
		for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				child.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				child.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40)
			end
		end
		local sparkles = Instance.new("Sparkles")
		sparkles.SparkleColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
		sparkles.Parent = primary
	elseif mutationName == "PEARL" then
		for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				child.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
				child.Transparency = 0.25
			end
		end
	elseif mutationName == "CURSED" then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 255)
		light.Range = 10
		light.Brightness = 2
		light.Parent = primary
		for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name ~= "EyeL" and child.Name ~= "EyeR" then
				child.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 40, 140)
			end
		end
	elseif mutationName == "GHOST" then
		for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				child.Transparency = 0.35
			end
		end
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 240)
		light.Range = 12
		light.Brightness = 2
		light.Parent = primary
	end
end

-- One billboard per rig, three lines inside a single label, so labels can
-- never overlap each other the way the old game's separate labels did.
function RigBuilder.replaceOverheadBillboard(model, def, mutationName, bottomLine)
	local primary = model.PrimaryPart
	if not primary then
		return nil
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(primary:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BillboardGui") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return RigBuilder.attachOverheadBillboard(model, def, mutationName, bottomLine)
end

function RigBuilder.attachOverheadBillboard(model, def, mutationName, bottomLine)
	local primary = model.PrimaryPart
	if not primary then
		return nil
	end
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "OverheadBillboard"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 78)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 4.6, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = primary
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "OverheadLabel"
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = 14
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.RichText = true
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	local rarity = def.rarity
	local rarityHex = "#" .. BootyCatalog.getRarityColor(rarity):ToHex()
	local mutText = ""
	if mutationName ~= "NONE" and mutationName ~= nil then
		local mutHex = "#" .. BootyCatalog.getMutationColor(mutationName):ToHex()
		mutText = ' • <font color="' .. mutHex .. '">[' .. mutationName .. ']</font>'
	end
	label.Text = '<font color="#FFFFFF">' .. def.name .. '</font>\n'
		.. '<font color="' .. rarityHex .. '">' .. rarity .. '</font>' .. mutText .. '\n'
		.. '<font color="#FFE066">' .. bottomLine .. '</font>'
	label.Parent = gui
	return gui
end

function RigBuilder.paintLagoonSign()
	local board = workspace:FindFirstChild("SignBoard")
	if not board then
		return
	end
	-- Painted on BOTH faces: the old version only painted Front, so the
	-- sign was a dark blank board seen from behind (the spawn side).
	for _, face in ipairs({ Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back }) do
		local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
		gui.Name = "LagoonSign"
		gui.Face = face
		gui.Parent = board
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Name = "SignTitle"
		title.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.65)
		title.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.05)
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		title.TextScaled = true
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
		title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		title.Text = "ROTBEARD'S LAGOON"
		title.Parent = gui
		local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		sub.Name = "SignSub"
		sub.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.25)
		sub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.7)
		sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		sub.TextScaled = true
		sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		sub.Text = "40 BRAINROTS  •  STEAL  •  LOCK  •  REBIRTH"
		sub.Parent = gui
	end
end

function RigBuilder.paintPedestalNumbers(prefix)
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild("Pedestal" .. prefix .. i)
		if pad then
			local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			gui.Name = "PedestalNumber"
			gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
			gui.Parent = pad
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextScaled = true
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
			label.Text = tostring(i)
			label.Parent = gui
		end
	end
end

return RigBuilder

--!nonstrict
local env = require("./env")
local Flux = env.Flux

local Model = {}

function Model.isolated(body: (owners: { any }) -> ())
	assert(type(body) == "function", "Model.isolated expects a function")
	local owners = {}
	local ok, err = pcall(body, owners)
	for index = #owners, 1, -1 do
		owners[index]:Destroy()
	end
	Flux.flush()
	if not ok then
		error(err, 0)
	end
end

function Model.ops(g: any, weights: { { any } }): { any }
	return g:list(function(g)
		return g:weighted(weights)
	end)
end

function Model.reader(owner: any, effect: boolean, read: () -> any): any
	local reader = { effect = effect, runs = 0, checkedRuns = 0, value = nil, node = nil }
	Flux.withOwner(owner, function()
		reader.node = (if effect then Flux.effect else Flux.computed)(function()
			reader.runs += 1
			reader.value = read()
			return reader.value
		end)
	end)
	if not effect then
		reader.node:get()
	end
	return reader
end

function Model.float(g: any, lo: number, hi: number): number
	return g:float(lo, hi)
end

return table.freeze(Model)

-- Monsoon.luau — the storm cycle. A 30-second warning darkens the sky,
-- then a neon wave sweeps the map and carries unsheltered players back
-- to spawn. Shelter is a base roof or the lighthouse.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Config)

local Monsoon = {}

local DARK_AMBIENT = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 51)

function Monsoon.IsSheltered(character, bases, lighthousePosition)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return true
	end
	local pos = root.Position
	for _, base in ipairs(bases) do
		local dx = math.abs(pos.X - base.Center.X)
		local dz = math.abs(pos.Z - base.Center.Z)
		if dx < 18 and dz < 15 then
			return true
		end
	end
	local lx = pos.X - lighthousePosition.X
	local lz = pos.Z - lighthousePosition.Z
	if math.sqrt(lx * lx + lz * lz) <= Config.ShelterRange then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function sweepWave(wave, fromZ, toZ, seconds)
	local steps = math.max(1, math.floor(seconds / 0.05))
	for step = 1, steps do
		local alpha = step / steps
		local z = fromZ + (toZ - fromZ) * alpha
		wave.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 10, z)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

-- noticeEvent: RemoteEvent fired to all clients with a text message.
-- players: array of Player objects currently in the game.
function Monsoon.Run(noticeEvent, bases, lighthousePosition, players, spawnPosition)
	task.spawn(function()
		local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
		local savedAmbient = lighting.Ambient
		lighting.Ambient = DARK_AMBIENT
		noticeEvent:FireAllClients("MONSOON INCOMING - TAKE SHELTER! (30s)")
		task.wait(Config.MonsoonWarning)
		local wave = Instance.new("Part")
		wave.Name = "MonsoonWave"
		wave.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		wave.Size = Vector3.new(300, 22, 12)
		wave.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, -95)
		wave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 255)
		wave.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		wave.Transparency = 0.35
		wave.Anchored = true
		wave.CanCollide = false
		wave.Parent = workspace
		sweepWave(wave, -95, 0, 4)
		for _, player in ipairs(players) do
			local character = player.Character
			if character and not Monsoon.IsSheltered(character, bases, lighthousePosition) then
				local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPosition)
					noticeEvent:FireClient(player, "Swept away by the monsoon!")
				end
			end
		end
		sweepWave(wave, 0, 110, 4)
		wave:Destroy()
		lighting.Ambient = savedAmbient
		noticeEvent:FireAllClients("The monsoon has passed.")
	end)
end

return Monsoon
