--!strict
-- Round status bar, toasts, and the coins/shop corner.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local Ui = require(script.Parent.Ui)

local Hud = {}
Hud.__index = Hud

export type RoundState = {
	phase: string,
	endsAt: number,
	wave: number,
	target: number?,
	alive: number,
	participants: number,
	inRound: boolean,
}

type State = {
	bar: Frame,
	stroke: UIStroke,
	title: TextLabel,
	timer: TextLabel,
	subtitle: TextLabel,
	swatch: Frame,
	swatchLetter: TextLabel,
	toast: TextLabel,
	coins: TextLabel,
	shopButton: TextButton,
	round: RoundState?,
	toastToken: number,
}

export type Hud = typeof(setmetatable({} :: State, Hud))

function Hud.new(parent: ScreenGui): Hud
	local bar = Ui.make("Frame", {
		Name = "RoundBar",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 92),
		BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.Panel,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
		Parent = parent,
	}) :: Frame
	Ui.corner(14).Parent = bar
	Ui.padding(10).Parent = bar
	Ui.make("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(480, math.huge), Parent = bar })
	local stroke = Ui.make("UIStroke", { Thickness = 3, Color = Ui.Theme.PanelLight, Parent = bar }) :: UIStroke

	local swatch = Ui.make("Frame", {
		Name = "Target",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY,
		BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.PanelLight,
		Visible = false,
		Parent = bar,
	}) :: Frame
	Ui.corner(10).Parent = swatch
	local swatchLetter = Ui.label({
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
		MaxTextSize = 44,
		Text = "",
		Parent = swatch,
	})
	Ui.make("UIStroke", { Thickness = 2, Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Transparency = 0.4, Parent = swatchLetter })

	local title = Ui.label({
		Name = "Title",
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.72, 0.5),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		MaxTextSize = 26,
		Text = "Loading...",
		Parent = bar,
	})
	local subtitle = Ui.label({
		Name = "Subtitle",
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.58),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.72, 0.36),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Muted,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		MaxTextSize = 18,
		Text = "",
		Parent = bar,
	})
	local timer = Ui.label({
		Name = "Timer",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 1),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
		TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Accent,
		MaxTextSize = 48,
		Text = "",
		Parent = bar,
	})

	local toast = Ui.label({
		Name = "Toast",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 112),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 34),
		BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.Panel,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		TextTransparency = 1,
		MaxTextSize = 20,
		Text = "",
		Parent = parent,
	})
	Ui.corner(10).Parent = toast
	Ui.make("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(460, math.huge), Parent = toast })

	local corner = Ui.make("Frame", {
		Name = "Wallet",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -12),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 48),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	}) :: Frame
	Ui.make("UIListLayout", {
		FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		Parent = corner,
	})
	local coins = Ui.label({
		Name = "Coins",
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 44),
		BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.Panel,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
		TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Accent,
		MaxTextSize = 20,
		Text = "0 coins",
		Parent = corner,
	})
	Ui.corner(10).Parent = coins
	local shopButton = Ui.button({
		Name = "ShopButton",
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 44),
		BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.Accent,
		TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Panel,
		Text = "Shop",
		Parent = corner,
	})

	return setmetatable({
		bar = bar,
		stroke = stroke,
		title = title,
		timer = timer,
		subtitle = subtitle,
		swatch = swatch,
		swatchLetter = swatchLetter,
		toast = toast,
		coins = coins,
		shopButton = shopButton,
		round = nil,
		toastToken = 0,
	}, Hud)
end

local function layoutText(self: Hud, withSwatch: boolean)
	self.swatch.Visible = withSwatch
	local offset = if withSwatch then 82 else 0
	self.title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(offset, 0)
	self.title.Size = UDim2.new(0.72, -offset, 0.5, 0)
	self.subtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, offset, 0.58, 0)
	self.subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(0.72, -offset, 0.36, 0)
end

function Hud.setRound(self: Hud, state: RoundState)
	self.round = state
	local target = if state.target then Config.Colors[state.target] else nil
	local waveLine = string.format("Wave %d  ·  %d of %d still standing", state.wave, state.alive, state.participants)

	if target then
		local color = Ui.rgb(target.rgb)
		layoutText(self, true)
		self.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
		self.swatchLetter.Text = target.letter
		self.stroke.Color = color
		if state.phase == "Warning" then
			self.title.Text = (if state.inRound then "Stand on " else "Next safe: ") .. string.upper(target.name)
		else
			self.title.Text = if state.inRound then "Hold on!" else "Tiles are falling..."
		end
		self.subtitle.Text = if state.inRound then waveLine else "Spectating  ·  " .. waveLine
		return
	end

	layoutText(self, false)
	self.stroke.Color = Ui.Theme.PanelLight
	if state.phase == "Waiting" then
		self.title.Text = "Waiting for players"
		self.subtitle.Text =
			string.format("A round needs %d player%s", Config.MinPlayers, if Config.MinPlayers == 1 then "" else "s")
	elseif state.phase == "Intermission" then
		self.title.Text = "Next round starts in"
		self.subtitle.Text = "Stand anywhere in the lobby to join"
	elseif state.phase == "RoundOver" then
		self.title.Text = "Round over"
		self.subtitle.Text = "Coins have been added to your wallet"
	else
		self.title.Text = "Round in progress"
		self.subtitle.Text = waveLine
	end
end

-- Called every frame with the server clock.
function Hud.update(self: Hud, serverNow: number)
	local state = self.round
	if not state or state.phase == "Waiting" then
		self.timer.Text = ""
		return
	end
	local left = math.max(0, state.endsAt - serverNow)
	if state.phase == "Warning" then
		self.timer.Text = string.format("%.1f", left)
		self.timer.TextColor3 = if left < 1 then Ui.Theme.Danger else Ui.Theme.Accent
	elseif state.phase == "Dropped" then
		self.timer.Text = ""
	else
		self.timer.Text = tostring(math.ceil(left))
		self.timer.TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Accent
	end
end

function Hud.toastMessage(self: Hud, text: string)
	self.toastToken += 1
	local token = self.toastToken
	local toast = self.toast
	toast.Text = text
	toast.TextTransparency = 0
	toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	task.delay(3, function()
		if self.toastToken ~= token then
			return
		end
		local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.4)
		TweenService:Create(toast, fade, { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	end)
end

function Hud.setCoins(self: Hud, coins: number)
	self.coins.Text = string.format("%d coins", coins)
end

return Hud

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
    StudioModelProbe.lua
    A reusable utility for summarizing the Roblox data model.

    Usage with MCP execute_luau:
        local probe = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.StudioModelProbe)
        print(probe.summarize(game.Workspace, { maxDepth = 2 }))

    This is a pattern you can adapt when asking an agent to explore a large place.
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local StudioModelProbe = {}

export type ProbeOptions = {
    maxDepth: number?,
    includeProperties: boolean?,
    propertyNames: { string }?,
    includeAttributes: boolean?,
    maxChildren: number?,
}

export type InstanceSummary = {
    name: string,
    className: string,
    path: string,
    attributes: { [string]: any }?,
    properties: { [string]: any }?,
    children: { InstanceSummary }?,
    childCount: number,
    truncated: boolean?,
}

type ResolvedOptions = {
    maxDepth: number,
    includeProperties: boolean,
    propertyNames: { string },
    includeAttributes: boolean,
    maxChildren: number,
}

local DEFAULT_OPTIONS: ResolvedOptions = {
    maxDepth = 2,
    includeProperties = false,
    propertyNames = {
        "Archivable",
        "Locked",
        "Enabled",
        "Visible",
        "Transparency",
        "Reflectance",
        "Value",
        "Text",
    },
    includeAttributes = true,
    maxChildren = 50,
}

local function mergeOptions(options: ProbeOptions?): ResolvedOptions
    local source: ProbeOptions = options or {}
    return {
        maxDepth = source.maxDepth or DEFAULT_OPTIONS.maxDepth,
        includeProperties = if source.includeProperties == nil
            then DEFAULT_OPTIONS.includeProperties
            else source.includeProperties,
        propertyNames = source.propertyNames or DEFAULT_OPTIONS.propertyNames,
        includeAttributes = if source.includeAttributes == nil
            then DEFAULT_OPTIONS.includeAttributes
            else source.includeAttributes,
        maxChildren = source.maxChildren or DEFAULT_OPTIONS.maxChildren,
    }
end

-- Recursively summarize an instance tree.
function StudioModelProbe.summarize(
    instance: Instance,
    options: ProbeOptions?,
    currentDepth: number?
): InstanceSummary
    local resolvedOptions = mergeOptions(options)
    local depth = currentDepth or 0

    local maxDepth = resolvedOptions.maxDepth
    local maxChildren = resolvedOptions.maxChildren

    local entry: InstanceSummary = {
        name = instance.Name,
        className = instance.ClassName,
        path = instance:GetFullName(),
        childCount = 0,
    }

    if resolvedOptions.includeAttributes then
        local attributes: { [string]: any } = {}
        for name, value in pairs(instance:GetAttributes()) do
            local valueType = typeof(value)
            if
                valueType == "string"
                or valueType == "number"
                or valueType == "boolean"
                or value == nil
            then
                attributes[name] = value
            else
                attributes[name] = tostring(value)
            end
        end
        if next(attributes) then
            entry.attributes = attributes
        end
    end

    if resolvedOptions.includeProperties then
        local props: { [string]: any } = {
            Parent = instance.Parent and instance.Parent.Name or nil,
        }
        for _, propName in ipairs(resolvedOptions.propertyNames) do
            local propOk, propValue = pcall(function()
                return (instance :: any)[propName]
            end)
            if propOk then
                local valueType = typeof(propValue)
                if
                    valueType == "string"
                    or valueType == "number"
                    or valueType == "boolean"
                    or propValue == nil
                then
                    props[propName] = propValue
                elseif valueType ~= "Instance" then
                    props[propName] = tostring(propValue)
                end
            end
        end
        if next(props) then
            entry.properties = props
        end
    end

    if depth < maxDepth then
        local children = instance:GetChildren()
        local childSummaries = {}
        for i = 1, math.min(#children, maxChildren) do
            table.insert(
                childSummaries,
                StudioModelProbe.summarize(children[i], resolvedOptions, depth + 1)
            )
        end
        entry.children = childSummaries
        entry.childCount = #children
        entry.truncated = #children > maxChildren
    else
        entry.childCount = #instance:GetChildren()
    end

    return entry
end

-- Summarize multiple top-level services at once.
function StudioModelProbe.summarizeServices(
    serviceNames: { string }?,
    options: ProbeOptions?
): { [string]: any }
    local resolvedServiceNames = serviceNames
        or {
            "Workspace",
            "ServerScriptService",
            "ReplicatedStorage",
            "StarterGui",
            "StarterPack",
            "Lighting",
        }

    local result: { [string]: any } = {
        placeName = workspace.Name,
    }
    for _, name in ipairs(resolvedServiceNames) do
        local ok, service = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService(name)
        end)
        if ok then
            result[name] = StudioModelProbe.summarize(service, options)
        else
            result[name] = { error = tostring(service) }
        end
    end
    return result
end

-- Encode a summary as JSON for easy MCP consumption.
function StudioModelProbe.summarizeAsJson(instance: Instance, options: ProbeOptions?): string
    local summary = StudioModelProbe.summarize(instance, options)
    local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONEncode(summary)
    end)
    if ok then
        return encoded
    end
    warn("StudioModelProbe JSON encoding failed: " .. tostring(encoded))
    return "Error encoding summary: " .. tostring(encoded)
end

-- Encode multiple service summaries as JSON.
function StudioModelProbe.summarizeServicesAsJson(
    serviceNames: { string }?,
    options: ProbeOptions?
): string
    local summary = StudioModelProbe.summarizeServices(serviceNames, options)
    local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONEncode(summary)
    end)
    if ok then
        return encoded
    end
    warn("StudioModelProbe JSON encoding failed: " .. tostring(encoded))
    return "Error encoding summary: " .. tostring(encoded)
end

return StudioModelProbe

-- Menu: the in-game menu. One panel with four sections: rebirth, stand
-- upgrades, the sixteen-character index, and a sell grid for the ten
-- stands. The index is built from the same BrainrotData the server uses,
-- so the prices it shows are the prices the game charges. Selling and
-- buying stands go through the server remotes, which validate everything.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)

local Menu = {}

local frame = nil
local remotes = nil
local open = false

local function makeButton(parent, name, size, pos, text, color)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.Size = size
	button.Position = pos
	button.BackgroundColor3 = color
	button.Text = text
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	button.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	button.Parent = parent
	return button
end

local function makeLabel(parent, name, size, pos, text)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.Size = size
	label.Position = pos
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

function Menu.setup(gui, remoteTable)
	remotes = remoteTable
	frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "BrainrotMenu"
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 560, 0, 640)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -280, 0.5, -320)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.Visible = false
	frame.Parent = gui

	makeLabel(frame, "MenuTitle", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), "BRAINROT BLITZ")
	local closeButton = makeButton(frame, "CloseButton", UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 44), UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 0), "X", Color3.fromRGB(239, 83, 80))
	closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Menu.toggle()
	end)

	-- Rebirth and stand upgrades.
	local rebirthButton = makeButton(frame, "RebirthButton", UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 56), "REBIRTH (+50% income)", Color3.fromRGB(171, 71, 188))
	rebirthButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		remotes.Rebirth:FireServer()
	end)
	local standButton = makeButton(frame, "StandButton", UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 48), UDim2.new(1, -272, 0, 56), "BUY STAND (up to 10)", Color3.fromRGB(66, 165, 245))
	standButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		remotes.BuyStand:FireServer()
	end)
	makeLabel(frame, "MenuHint", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 112), "Rebirth costs $12,000 x (rebirths + 1). Every 5 rebirths: +25% milestone.", 14)

	-- Character index: all sixteen, cheapest first.
	makeLabel(frame, "IndexTitle", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 148), "CHARACTER INDEX (16)", 18)
	local scroller = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroller.Name = "IndexScroller"
	scroller.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 240)
	scroller.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 184)
	scroller.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroller.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	scroller.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 16 * 28)
	scroller.Parent = frame
	for i, entry in ipairs(BrainrotData.Characters) do
		local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		row.Name = "IndexRow" .. tostring(i)
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
		row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (i - 1) * 28)
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Text = tostring(i) .. ". " .. entry.name .. " [" .. entry.tier .. "] - $" .. tostring(entry.price) .. " - $" .. tostring(entry.income) .. "/s"
		row.TextScaled = true
		row.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		row.TextColor3 = BrainrotData.TierColors[entry.tier] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		row.Parent = scroller
	end

	-- Sell grid: ten slots. Clicking one asks the server to sell whatever
	-- sits on that stand (the server checks it is really yours).
	makeLabel(frame, "SellTitle", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 432), "SELL A STAND (half price back)", 18)
	for slot = 1, 10 do

--!strict
-- Trail shop panel. Renders from the catalog and the last profile the server
-- sent; every purchase is decided by the server.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shop = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Shop"))

local Ui = require(script.Parent.Ui)

local ShopUi = {}
ShopUi.__index = ShopUi

export type Profile = {
	coins: number,
	wins: number,
	bestWave: number,
	ownedTrails: { [string]: boolean },
	equippedTrail: string?,
}

export type Response = { ok: boolean, message: string? }

type Row = { button: TextButton }

type State = {
	panel: Frame,
	stats: TextLabel,
	rows: { [string]: Row },
	profile: Profile?,
	busy: boolean,
	request: (action: string, id: string?) -> Response,
	notify: (text: string) -> (),
}

export type ShopUi = typeof(setmetatable({} :: State, ShopUi))

local function gradient(colors: { { number } }): UIGradient
	local keypoints = {}
	for i, c in colors do
		local t = if #colors == 1 then 0 else (i - 1) / (#colors - 1)
		table.insert(keypoints, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, Ui.rgb(c)))
	end
	if #keypoints == 1 then
		table.insert(keypoints, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, keypoints[1].Value))
	end
	return Ui.make("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(keypoints) })
end

function ShopUi.new(parent: ScreenGui, request: (string, string?) -> Response, notify: (string) -> ()): ShopUi
	local panel = Ui.make("Frame", {
		Name = "Shop",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.55),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.7),
		BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.Panel,
		Visible = false,
		Parent = parent,
	}) :: Frame
	Ui.corner(14).Parent = panel
	Ui.padding(14).Parent = panel
	Ui.make("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(520, 460), Parent = panel })

	Ui.label({
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 32),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Text = "Trail Shop",
		Parent = panel,
	})
	local stats = Ui.label({
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Muted,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		MaxTextSize = 16,
		Text = "",
		Parent = panel,
	})
	local close = Ui.button({
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 32),
		Text = "X",
		Parent = panel,
	})

	local list = Ui.make("ScrollingFrame", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -64),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 6,
		Parent = panel,
	}) :: ScrollingFrame
	Ui.make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = list })

	local self = setmetatable({
		panel = panel,
		stats = stats,
		rows = {},
		profile = nil,
		busy = false,
		request = request,
		notify = notify,
	}, ShopUi)

	for order, trail in Shop.Trails do
		local row = Ui.make("Frame", {
			Name = trail.id,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 52),
			BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.PanelLight,
			Parent = list,
		}) :: Frame
		Ui.corner(10).Parent = row
		Ui.padding(8).Parent = row

		local preview = Ui.make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Parent = row,
		}) :: Frame
		Ui.corner(8).Parent = preview
		gradient(trail.colors).Parent = preview

		Ui.label({
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -200, 1, 0),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			MaxTextSize = 20,
			Text = trail.name,
			Parent = row,
		})

		local button = Ui.button({
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, 0),
			Text = string.format("Buy  %d", trail.price),
			Parent = row,
		})
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:_onAction(trail.id)
		end)
		self.rows[trail.id] = { button = button }
	end

	close.Activated:Connect(function()
		panel.Visible = false
	end)

	return self
end

function ShopUi.toggle(self: ShopUi)
	self.panel.Visible = not self.panel.Visible
end

function ShopUi.setProfile(self: ShopUi, profile: Profile)
	self.profile = profile
	self.stats.Text =
		string.format("%d coins  ·  %d wins  ·  best wave %d", profile.coins, profile.wins, profile.bestWave)
	for _, trail in Shop.Trails do
		local button = self.rows[trail.id].button
		if profile.equippedTrail == trail.id then
			button.Text = "Equipped"
			button.BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.Ok
			button.TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Panel
		elseif profile.ownedTrails[trail.id] then
			button.Text = "Equip"
			button.BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.Accent
			button.TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Panel
		else
			local affordable = profile.coins >= trail.price
			button.Text = string.format("Buy  %d", trail.price)
			button.BackgroundColor3 = if affordable then Ui.Theme.Accent else Ui.Theme.PanelLight
			button.TextColor3 = if affordable then Ui.Theme.Panel else Ui.Theme.Muted
		end
	end
end

function ShopUi._onAction(self: ShopUi, id: string)
	local profile = self.profile
	if self.busy or not profile then
		return
	end
	local action: string, target: string?
	if profile.equippedTrail == id then
		action, target = "equip", nil
	elseif profile.ownedTrails[id] then
		action, target = "equip", id
	else
		action, target = "buy", id
	end

	self.busy = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, response = pcall(self.request, action, target)
		self.busy = false
		if not ok then
			self.notify("Shop is unavailable, try again")
		elseif not response.ok then
			self.notify(response.message or "That didn't work")
		elseif action == "buy" then
			-- Equip right away: that is what people buy a trail for.
			self:_onAction(id)
		end
	end)
end

return ShopUi

--!strict
-- Status: reviewed
-- Last verified: 2026-07-16
-- Test coverage: deterministic regression fixture in tests/RateLimiter.spec.lua
-- Intended use: example; adapt configuration and enforcement policy before production.
--[[
RateLimiter.lua
Per-player, per-action minimum-interval and token-bucket limiter.

The minimum interval is a hard rejection: rejected attempts do not consume a
bucket token or move the last-accepted timestamp. Dedicated instances must be
destroyed when their owning system shuts down.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 10
local DEFAULT_REFILL_RATE = 1
local DEFAULT_MIN_INTERVAL = 0.5
local MAX_ACTIONS_PER_PLAYER = 64
local MAX_ACTION_LENGTH = 100
local MAX_ABUSE_SCORE = 10

type Clock = () -> number

type AbuseRecord = {
    tokens: number,
    lastRefill: number,
    lastAccepted: number?,
    abuseScore: number,
}

export type DenialReason = "min_interval" | "token_bucket" | "action_limit" | "destroyed"
export type Config = {
    capacity: number?,
    refillRate: number?,
    defaultMinInterval: number?,
    maxActionsPerPlayer: number?,
    clock: Clock?,
}

type RateLimiterState = {
    records: { [number]: { [string]: AbuseRecord } },
    _connection: RBXScriptConnection?,
    _clock: Clock,
    _capacity: number,
    _refillRate: number,
    _defaultMinInterval: number,
    _maxActionsPerPlayer: number,
    _destroyed: boolean,
}

local RateLimiter = {}
RateLimiter.__index = RateLimiter

export type RateLimiter = typeof(setmetatable({} :: RateLimiterState, RateLimiter))

local function positiveNumber(value: number?, fallback: number, name: string): number
    local resolved = if value == nil then fallback else value
    if resolved ~= resolved or resolved == math.huge or resolved <= 0 then
        error(`RateLimiter.new: {name} must be a positive number`, 3)
    end
    return resolved
end

function RateLimiter.new(config: Config?): RateLimiter
    local options: Config = config or {}
    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            records = {},
            _connection = nil,
            _clock = options.clock or os.clock,
            _capacity = positiveNumber(options.capacity, DEFAULT_CAPACITY, "capacity"),
            _refillRate = positiveNumber(options.refillRate, DEFAULT_REFILL_RATE, "refillRate"),
            _defaultMinInterval = positiveNumber(
                options.defaultMinInterval,
                DEFAULT_MIN_INTERVAL,
                "defaultMinInterval"
            ),
            _maxActionsPerPlayer = math.floor(
                positiveNumber(
                    options.maxActionsPerPlayer,
                    MAX_ACTIONS_PER_PLAYER,
                    "maxActionsPerPlayer"
                )
            ),
            _destroyed = false,
        } :: RateLimiterState,
        RateLimiter
    )
    self._connection = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        self:clearPlayer(player)
    end)
    return self
end

function RateLimiter:_canPerformUserId(
    userId: number,
    action: string,
    minInterval: number?
): (boolean, DenialReason?)
    if self._destroyed then
        return false, "destroyed"
    end
    if userId ~= userId or userId == math.huge or userId == -math.huge or userId % 1 ~= 0 then
        error("RateLimiter: userId must be a finite integer", 2)
    end
    if action == "" or #action > MAX_ACTION_LENGTH then
        error(`RateLimiter: action must contain 1-{MAX_ACTION_LENGTH} bytes`, 2)
    end

    local interval = positiveNumber(minInterval, self._defaultMinInterval, "minInterval")
    local playerRecords = self.records[userId]
    if not playerRecords then
        playerRecords = {}
        self.records[userId] = playerRecords
    end

    local record = playerRecords[action]
    if not record then
        local actionCount = 0
        for _ in playerRecords do
            actionCount += 1
        end
        if actionCount >= self._maxActionsPerPlayer then
            return false, "action_limit"
        end

        local now = self._clock()
        record = {
            tokens = self._capacity,
            lastRefill = now,
            lastAccepted = nil,
            abuseScore = 0,
        }
        playerRecords[action] = record
    end

    local now = self._clock()
    local elapsed = math.max(0, now - record.lastRefill)
    record.tokens = math.min(self._capacity, record.tokens + elapsed * self._refillRate)
    record.lastRefill = now

    if record.lastAccepted ~= nil and now - record.lastAccepted < interval then
        record.abuseScore = math.min(record.abuseScore + 0.25, MAX_ABUSE_SCORE)
        return false, "min_interval"
    end
    if record.tokens < 1 then
        record.abuseScore = math.min(record.abuseScore + 0.5, MAX_ABUSE_SCORE)
        return false, "token_bucket"
    end

    record.tokens -= 1
    record.lastAccepted = now
    record.abuseScore = math.max(record.abuseScore - 0.1, 0)
    return true, nil
end

function RateLimiter:canPerform(
    player: Player,
    action: string,
    minInterval: number?
): (boolean, DenialReason?)
    if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then
        error("RateLimiter.canPerform: player must be a Player instance", 2)
    end
    if typeof(action) ~= "string" then
        error("RateLimiter.canPerform: action must be a string", 2)
    end
    return self:_canPerformUserId(player.UserId, action, minInterval)
end

function RateLimiter:clearPlayer(player: Player)
    if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then
        error("RateLimiter.clearPlayer: player must be a Player instance", 2)
    end
    self.records[player.UserId] = nil
end

function RateLimiter.destroy(self: RateLimiter)
    if self._destroyed then
        return
    end
    self._destroyed = true
    local connection = self._connection
    if connection then
        connection:Disconnect()
        self._connection = nil
    end
    table.clear(self.records)
end

local default = RateLimiter.new()
RateLimiter.default = default

return RateLimiter

--!strict

-- operations on any value (like Java's Objects)
-- author(s): @vuppyan

local fail = require("./Errors").errorWithScope("Values")

--[=[
    Protocol-aware operations that work on any value, similar to Java's
    `Objects` utility class.

    Each function dispatches to the matching protocol method when the value is a
    table that has it (such as [typing.Equatable] or [typing.Comparable]), and
    otherwise falls back to the built-in operator or function. This lets one
    function signature accept both primitives and classes:

    ```lua
    Values.equals(1, 1) -- true, using `==`
    Values.equals(Option.some(1), Option.some(1)) -- true, using `:equals()`

    Values.compare("a", "b") -- -1, using `<`
    Values.compare(Duration.SECOND, Duration.MINUTE) -- negative, using `:compareTo()`
    ```

    Error messages thrown by `Values` functions are prefixed with the function
    that threw them, such as `[Values.compare()]: `, after the usual position
    prefix added by `error()`.

    @class Values
    @since v0.1.3
]=]
local Values = {}

-- prevent function inlining for helpers that require call stack consistency
local Internal = {}

function Internal.compareFail<T>(a: T, b: T, functionName: string): never
    return fail(
        `Cannot meaningfully compare values of type {type(a)} and {type(b)}`,
        3,
        functionName
    )
end

function Internal.nanFail(functionName: string): never
    return fail("Cannot meaningfully compare NaN values", 3, functionName)
end

--[=[
    Returns `true` if the value is one of the given types.

    Types are checked with `type()`, not `typeof()`, so ROBLOX types such as
    `Instance` and `CFrame` are all `"userdata"`.

    ```lua
    Values.is(5, "number") -- true
    Values.is("hi", "number", "string") -- true
    Values.is(workspace, "Instance") -- false, since `type(workspace)` is "userdata"
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param v any -- The value to check
    @param t string -- The first type to check against (required)
    @param ... string -- Additional types to check against
    @return boolean -- Whether the value is one of the types
]=]
function Values.is(v: any, t: string, ...: string): boolean
    if type(v) == t then
        return true
    end

    for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
        if type(v) == select(i, ...) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

--[=[
    Returns `true` if the value is a primitive type.

    A value is primitive if its `type()` is one of:
    * `"string"`
    * `"number"`
    * `"boolean"`
    * `"nil"`

    Tables, functions, threads, userdata, buffers, and vectors are not
    considered primitive.

    Use [Values.isImmutable] to check whether a value can be modified instead.

    ```lua
    Values.isPrimitive("hi") -- true
    Values.isPrimitive(nil) -- true
    Values.isPrimitive(print) -- false
    Values.isPrimitive({}) -- false
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param v any -- The value to check
    @return boolean -- Whether the value is primitive
]=]
function Values.isPrimitive(v: any): boolean
    return Values.is(v, "string", "number", "boolean", "nil")
end

--[=[
    Returns `true` if the value is an immutable type.

    A value is immutable if its `type()` is one of:
    * `"string"`
    * `"number"`
    * `"boolean"`
    * `"nil"`
    * `"vector"` (including ROBLOX's `Vector3`)
    * `"function"`

    Tables, threads, userdata, and buffers are not considered immutable, even if
    they are frozen or have no methods that modify them.

    Immutable values are safe to share instead of copying, which is how
    [Values.clone] treats them.

    ```lua
    Values.isImmutable("hi") -- true
    Values.isImmutable(vector.create(1, 2, 3)) -- true
    Values.isImmutable(print) -- true
    Values.isImmutable(table.freeze({})) -- false, since tables never count
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param v any -- The value to check
    @return boolean -- Whether the value is immutable
]=]
function Values.isImmutable(v: any): boolean
    return Values.is(
        v,
        "string",
        "number",
        "boolean",
        "nil",
        "vector",
        "function"
    )
end

--[=[
    Returns `true` if the value has a method with the given name. In this case,
    a value is considered to have a method if `v:name()` would find a function.

    Tables and strings are indexed directly, while userdata and vectors go
    through `pcall`, meaning a table whose `__index` throws still throws.
    Callable tables (those with a `__call` metamethod) are not counted, since
    their `type` is `"function"`.

    ```lua
    Values.hasMethod({ method = function() end }, "method") -- true
    Values.hasMethod({}, "method") -- false
    Values.hasMethod(part, "Destroy") -- true
    ```

    @since [UNRELEASED]
    @param v any -- The value to check
    @param name string -- The name of the method to check for
    @return boolean -- Whether the value has the method
]=]
function Values.hasMethod(v: any, name: string): boolean
    local t = type(v)
    if t == "table" or t == "string" then
        return type(v[name]) == "function"
    elseif t == "userdata" or t == "vector" then
        local ok, member = pcall(function()
            return v[name]
        end)
        return ok and type(member) == "function"
    end
    return false
end

--[=[
    Returns `true` if the values are of types that can be compared with
    [Values.compare].

    This is `true` if `type(a) == type(b)` and either:
    * `a` and `b` are both tables with a `compareTo` method
      ([typing.Comparable]), or
    * `a` and `b` are both numbers or both strings.

    Only the types are checked: `NaN` counts as comparable here, but the
    comparison functions still throw an error for it.

    ```lua
    Values.isComparable(1, 2) -- true
    Values.isComparable("a", "b") -- true
    Values.isComparable(1, "a") -- false, since the types differ
    Values.isComparable(true, false) -- false, since booleans are not ordered
    Values.isComparable(Duration.SECOND, Duration.MINUTE) -- true
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param a T -- The first value
    @param b T -- The second value
    @return boolean -- Whether the values can be compared
]=]
function Values.isComparable<T>(a: T, b: T): boolean
    return type(a) == type(b)
        and (
            (
                Values.hasMethod(a, "compareTo")
                and Values.hasMethod(b, "compareTo")
            )
            or (type(a) == "number" or type(a) == "string")
        )
end

--[=[
    Returns `true` if the values are equal.

    Equality is checked in this order:
    1. If `rawequal(a, b)` is `true`, `true` is returned.
    2. If `a` is a table with an `equals` method ([typing.Equatable]),
       `a:equals(b)` is returned.
    3. Otherwise, `a == b` is returned.

    This means [typing.Equatable] classes compare by value even if they do not
    set an `__eq` metamethod. Plain tables still compare by reference.

    Matches the [typing.BiPredicate] signature, so it can be passed wherever an
    equality check is expected.

    ```lua
    Values.equals(1, 1) -- true
    Values.equals(Option.some(1), Option.some(1)) -- true
    Values.equals({}, {}) -- false, since plain tables compare by reference
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param a T -- The first value
    @param b T -- The second value
    @return boolean -- Whether the values are equal
]=]
function Values.equals<T>(a: T, b: T): boolean
    return if rawequal(a, b)
        then true
        elseif Values.hasMethod(a, "equals") then (a :: any):equals(b)
        else a == b
end

--[=[
    Compares two values, returning a negative number if `a < b`, a positive
    number if `a > b`, or `0` if they are equal.

    If `a` and `b` are both [typing.Comparable] tables, `a:compareTo(b)` is
    returned. Otherwise, if they are both numbers or both strings, they are
    compared with `<` and `==`, returning `-1`, `0`, or `1`. Strings are
    compared by byte value, the same as `<`.

    Matches the [typing.Comparator] signature. Use [Values.lessThan] for
    `table.sort`, which expects a `boolean` instead.

    ```lua
    Values.compare(1, 2) -- -1
    Values.compare("b", "a") -- 1
    Values.compare(Duration.MINUTE, Duration.SECOND) -- positive
    Values.compare(1, "a") -- error, since the types differ
    Values.compare(0 / 0, 1) -- error, since NaN is not ordered
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param a T -- The first value
    @param b T -- The second value
    @return number -- Negative if `a < b`, positive if `a > b`, or `0` if they are equal
    @error "[Values.compare()]: Cannot meaningfully compare values of type {type(a)} and {type(b)}" -- Thrown if the values cannot be compared; see [Values.isComparable]
    @error "[Values.compare()]: Cannot meaningfully compare NaN values" -- Thrown if `a` or `b` is `NaN`
]=]
function Values.compare<T>(a: T, b: T): number
    if not Values.isComparable(a, b) then
        Internal.compareFail(a, b, "compare")
    elseif
        (type(a) == "number" and math.isnan(a))
        or (type(b) == "number" and math.isnan(b))
    then
        Internal.nanFail("compare")
    end

    if Values.hasMethod(a, "compareTo") then
        return (a :: any):compareTo(b)
    else
        return if (a :: any) < b then -1 elseif a == b then 0 else 1
    end
end

--[=[
    Returns `true` if `a` is less than `b`, using [Values.compare].

    Can be passed directly to `table.sort` to sort an array of numbers, strings,
    or [typing.Comparable] values.

    ```lua
    local durations = { Duration.MINUTE, Duration.SECOND, Duration.HOUR }
    table.sort(durations, Values.lessThan)
    -- { Duration.SECOND, Duration.MINUTE, Duration.HOUR }
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param a T -- The first value
    @param b T -- The second value
    @return boolean -- Whether `a` is less than `b`
    @error "[Values.lessThan()]: Cannot meaningfully compare values of type {type(a)} and {type(b)}" -- Thrown if the values cannot be compared; see [Values.isComparable]
    @error "[Values.lessThan()]: Cannot meaningfully compare NaN values" -- Thrown if `a` or `b` is `NaN`
]=]
function Values.lessThan<T>(a: T, b: T): boolean
    if not Values.isComparable(a, b) then
        Internal.compareFail(a, b, "lessThan")
    elseif
        (type(a) == "number" and math.isnan(a))
        or (type(b) == "number" and math.isnan(b))
    then
        Internal.nanFail("lessThan")
    end

    return Values.compare(a, b) < 0
end

--[=[
    Returns the smaller of two values, using [Values.compare].

    If the values are equal, `a` is returned. Unlike `math.min`, this works on
    strings and [typing.Comparable] values as well as numbers.

    ```lua
    Values.min(3, 1) -- 1
    Values.min("b", "a") -- "a"
    Values.min(Duration.MINUTE, Duration.SECOND) -- Duration.SECOND
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param a T -- The first value
    @param b T -- The second value
    @return T -- The smaller value, or `a` if they are equal
    @error "[Values.min()]: Cannot meaningfully compare values of type {type(a)} and {type(b)}" -- Thrown if the values cannot be compared; see [Values.isComparable]
    @error "[Values.min()]: Cannot meaningfully compare NaN values" -- Thrown if `a` or `b` is `NaN`
]=]
function Values.min<T>(a: T, b: T): T
    if not Values.isComparable(a, b) then
        Internal.compareFail(a, b, "min")
    elseif
        (type(a) == "number" and math.isnan(a))
        or (type(b) == "number" and math.isnan(b))
    then
        Internal.nanFail("min")
    end

    return if Values.compare(a, b) <= 0 then a else b
end

--[=[
    Returns the larger of two values, using [Values.compare].

    If the values are equal, `a` is returned. Unlike `math.max`, this works on
    strings and [typing.Comparable] values as well as numbers.

    ```lua
    Values.max(3, 1) -- 3
    Values.max("b", "a") -- "b"
    Values.max(Duration.MINUTE, Duration.SECOND) -- Duration.MINUTE
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param a T -- The first value
    @param b T -- The second value
    @return T -- The larger value, or `a` if they are equal
    @error "[Values.max()]: Cannot meaningfully compare values of type {type(a)} and {type(b)}" -- Thrown if the values cannot be compared; see [Values.isComparable]
    @error "[Values.max()]: Cannot meaningfully compare NaN values" -- Thrown if `a` or `b` is `NaN`
]=]
function Values.max<T>(a: T, b: T): T
    if not Values.isComparable(a, b) then
        Internal.compareFail(a, b, "max")
    elseif
        (type(a) == "number" and math.isnan(a))
        or (type(b) == "number" and math.isnan(b))
    then
        Internal.nanFail("max")
    end

    return if Values.compare(a, b) >= 0 then a else b
end

--[=[
    Returns `v` limited to the range from `lo` to `hi`, using [Values.compare].

    If `v` is less than `lo`, `lo` is returned; if `v` is greater than `hi`,
    `hi` is returned; otherwise, `v` is returned. Unlike `math.clamp`, this
    works on strings and [typing.Comparable] values as well as numbers.

    ```lua
    Values.clamp(15, 0, 10) -- 10
    Values.clamp("m", "a", "f") -- "f"
    Values.clamp(Duration.HOUR, Duration.ZERO, Duration.MINUTE) -- Duration.MINUTE
    Values.clamp(5, 10, 0) -- error, since `lo` is greater than `hi`
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param v T -- The value to clamp
    @param lo T -- The lower bound
    @param hi T -- The upper bound
    @return T -- The clamped value
    @error "[Values.clamp()]: Cannot meaningfully compare values of type {type(v)} and {type(lo)}" -- Thrown if `v` and `lo` cannot be compared; see [Values.isComparable]
    @error "[Values.clamp()]: Cannot meaningfully compare values of type {type(v)} and {type(hi)}" -- Thrown if `v` and `hi` cannot be compared; see [Values.isComparable]
    @error "[Values.clamp()]: Cannot meaningfully compare NaN values" -- Thrown if `v`, `lo`, or `hi` is `NaN`
    @error "[Values.clamp()]: lo must be less than or equal to hi" -- Thrown if `lo` is greater than `hi`
]=]
function Values.clamp<T>(v: T, lo: T, hi: T): T
    if not Values.isComparable(v, lo) then
        Internal.compareFail(v, lo, "clamp")
    elseif not Values.isComparable(v, hi) then
        Internal.compareFail(v, hi, "clamp")
    elseif
        (type(v) == "number" and math.isnan(v))
        or (type(lo) == "number" and math.isnan(lo))
        or (type(hi) == "number" and math.isnan(hi))
    then
        Internal.nanFail("clamp")
    elseif Values.compare(lo, hi) > 0 then
        fail("lo must be less than or equal to hi")
    end

    return Values.min(Values.max(v, lo), hi)
end

--[=[
    Returns a value that can be used as a table key for `v`.

    If `v` is a table with a `toKey` method ([typing.Keyable]), `v:toKey()` is
    returned, so value-equal objects share a table slot. Otherwise, `v` itself
    is returned, so primitives keep their own value as the key and plain tables
    are keyed by reference.

    Keys from [typing.Keyable] values are strings, so they can collide with
    plain string keys in the same table. `NaN` and `nil` throw an error, since
    they cannot be used as table keys.

    ```lua
    local seen = {}
    for _, v in { 1, "a", 1, someKeyable } do
        seen[Values.toKey(v)] = true
    end
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param v any -- The value to get a key for
    @return any -- The key for the value
    @error "[Values.toKey()]: Cannot use NaN as a table key" -- Thrown if `v` is `NaN`
    @error "[Values.toKey()]: Cannot use nil as a table key" -- Thrown if `v` is `nil`
]=]
function Values.toKey(v: any): any
    if type(v) == "number" and math.isnan(v) then
        fail("Cannot use NaN as a table key")
    elseif v == nil then
        fail("Cannot use nil as a table key")
    end

    return if Values.hasMethod(v, "toKey") then (v :: any):toKey() else v
end

--[=[
    Returns a string representation of `v`.

    If `v` is a table with a `toString` method ([typing.Stringable]),
    `v:toString()` is returned. Otherwise, `tostring(v)` is returned, which uses
    a `__tostring` metamethod if `v` has one.

    Matches the [typing.Mapper] signature, so it can be passed directly to
    mapping functions.

    ```lua
    Values.toString(5) -- "5"
    Values.toString(Option.some("hi")) -- 'Some("hi")'
    Values.toString(Duration.WEEK) -- "P7D"
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param v any -- The value to convert
    @return string -- The string representation
]=]
function Values.toString(v: any): string
    return if Values.hasMethod(v, "toString")
        then (v :: any):toString()
        else tostring(v)
end

--[=[
    Returns a copy of `v`.

    If `v` is a table with a `clone` method ([typing.Cloneable]), `v:clone()` is
    returned. Otherwise, if `v` is immutable (see [Values.isImmutable]), `v`
    itself is returned, since it cannot be modified. Otherwise, an error is
    thrown: plain tables are not copied, since a shallow and a deep copy are
    both reasonable. Use `table.clone` or [Tables.deepCopy] for those.

    ```lua
    Values.clone(5) -- 5
    Values.clone(vector.create(1, 2, 3)) -- the same vector
    Values.clone(someCloneable) -- someCloneable:clone()
    Values.clone({}) -- error, use table.clone() or Tables.deepCopy()
    ```

    @since v0.1.3
    @param v T -- The value to copy
    @return T -- The copy, or `v` itself if it is immutable
    @error "[Values.clone()]: Cannot clone value of type {type(v)}. (...)" -- Thrown if `v` is not immutable and has no `clone` method. The message continues with a hint to add a `clone` method, or to use `table.clone()` or [Tables.deepCopy]
]=]
function Values.clone<T>(v: T): T
    return if Values.hasMethod(v, "clone")
        then (v :: any):clone()
        elseif Values.isImmutable(v) then v
        else fail(
            `Cannot clone value of type {type(v)}. `
                .. "(If you are trying to clone a class, "
                .. "give it a .clone() method to match the Cloneable protocol. "
                .. "If you are trying to clone a table, "
                .. "use table.clone() for shallow copies or "
                .. "Tables.deepCopy() for deep copies.)"
        )
end

return table.freeze(Values)

-- AdminService: chat commands that let an admin trigger events by hand
-- while testing, instead of waiting for the automatic schedule. Only the
-- game owner (or anyone, while the game runs inside Roblox Studio) may
-- use them — everyone else gets a short "not an admin" note and nothing
-- happens. Admin-triggered events are spectacular on purpose: the sky
-- changes colour for the whole event and every player sees an
-- "ADMIN EVENT" banner, so an admin event is easy to tell apart from
-- the ordinary scheduled ones (which do not change the sky and do not
-- show the banner).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)

local AdminService = {}

-- How long each admin sky lasts, in seconds. The golden sky stays for
-- half a minute (the golden character rides the belt for about a minute,
-- so the sky is back to normal before it reaches the end). The storm sky
-- lasts exactly as long as the wave it belongs to: warning plus sweep.
local GOLDEN_SKY_SECONDS = 30

-- The sky as the game normally has it. Captured once when the server
-- starts, so every admin sky can be undone cleanly afterwards.
local normalSky = {}

-- A counter that grows with every sky change. A delayed revert only
-- restores the normal sky if no newer sky change has happened since —
-- so two quick admin commands cannot make an old revert undo a new sky.
local skyToken = 0

local function saveNormalSky()
	normalSky.Ambient = Lighting.Ambient
	normalSky.OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
	normalSky.FogColor = Lighting.FogColor
	normalSky.FogStart = Lighting.FogStart
	normalSky.FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
	normalSky.ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime
	normalSky.Brightness = Lighting.Brightness
end

local function restoreNormalSky()
	Lighting.Ambient = normalSky.Ambient
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = normalSky.OutdoorAmbient
	Lighting.FogColor = normalSky.FogColor
	Lighting.FogStart = normalSky.FogStart
	Lighting.FogEnd = normalSky.FogEnd
	Lighting.ClockTime = normalSky.ClockTime
	Lighting.Brightness = normalSky.Brightness
end

-- Apply a sky preset now and schedule its revert. Returns the token for
-- this change so the revert can check it is still the newest one.
local function applySky(preset, revertAfterSeconds)
	skyToken += 1
	local token = skyToken
	Lighting.Ambient = preset.Ambient
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = preset.OutdoorAmbient
	Lighting.FogColor = preset.FogColor
	Lighting.FogStart = preset.FogStart
	Lighting.FogEnd = preset.FogEnd
	Lighting.ClockTime = preset.ClockTime
	Lighting.Brightness = preset.Brightness
	task.delay(revertAfterSeconds, function()
		if token == skyToken then
			restoreNormalSky()
		end
	end)
	return token
end

-- Golden hour: warm gold light, a honey-coloured haze, low sun.
local GOLDEN_SKY = {
	Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120),
	OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 110),
	FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 140),
	FogStart = 100,
	FogEnd = 600,
	ClockTime = 17.5,
	Brightness = 1.2,
}

-- Storm: dark and close, the fog thick and slate-blue.
local STORM_SKY = {
	Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 55),
	OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 50),
	FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 55, 70),
	FogStart = 50,
	FogEnd = 300,
	ClockTime = 19,
	Brightness = 0.6,
}

-- Admins are the game owner, plus everybody while the game runs inside
-- Roblox Studio (so testing never needs a permission step). For a
-- user-owned game the creator id is a user id; for a group-owned game
-- it is a group id, so group members count as admins there.
local function isAdmin(player)
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		return true
	end
	if game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.User then
		return player.UserId == game.CreatorId
	elseif game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group then
		return player:IsInGroup(game.CreatorId)
	end
	return false
end

function AdminService.init(ctx)
	local remotes = ctx.remotes
	local services = ctx.services

	saveNormalSky()

	local function handleGolden(admin)
		applySky(GOLDEN_SKY, GOLDEN_SKY_SECONDS)
		remotes.Notify:FireAllClients("ADMIN EVENT — Golden Brainrot!")
		services.ConveyorService.spawnGolden()
		remotes.Notify:FireClient(admin, "Golden Brainrot spawned — the sky turns gold for 30 seconds.")
	end

	local function handleTsunami(admin)
		local started = services.WaveService.triggerWave()
		if not started then
			remotes.Notify:FireClient(admin, "A wave is already running — wait for it to finish.")
			return
		end
		local waveSeconds = BrainrotData.Wave.warning + BrainrotData.Wave.sweep
		applySky(STORM_SKY, waveSeconds)
		remotes.Notify:FireAllClients("ADMIN EVENT — Tsunami!")
	end

	local function handleHelp(admin)
		remotes.Notify:FireClient(admin, "Admin commands: /golden (spawn Golden Brainrot), /tsunami (trigger tsunami), /help (this list).")
	end

	local function onChatted(player, message)
		local text = string.lower(string.gsub(message, "^%s+", ""))
		local command = string.match(text, "^/(%a+)")
		if not command then
			return
		end
		if command ~= "golden" and command ~= "tsunami" and command ~= "help" then
			return
		end
		if not isAdmin(player) then
			remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "You are not an admin.")
			return
		end
		if command == "golden" then
			handleGolden(player)
		elseif command == "tsunami" then
			handleTsunami(player)
		elseif command == "help" then
			handleHelp(player)
		end
	end

	local function watchPlayer(player)
		player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
			onChatted(player, message)
		end)
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		watchPlayer(player)
	end
end

return AdminService

--!strict
-- Small helpers for building UI from code.

local Ui = {}

Ui.Theme = {
	Panel = Color3.fromRGB(24, 27, 36),
	PanelLight = Color3.fromRGB(40, 45, 58),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 247),
	Muted = Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 182),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0),
	Danger = Color3.fromRGB(231, 76, 60),
	Ok = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113),
}

-- Creates an instance, applies properties, and parents children. The
-- return is untyped; callers cast to the class they asked for.
function Ui.make(className: string, props: { [string]: any }, children: { Instance }?): any
	local instance = Instance.new(className :: any)
	for key, value in props do
		if key ~= "Parent" then
			(instance :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	if children then
		for _, child in children do
			child.Parent = instance
		end
	end
	if props.Parent then
		instance.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return instance
end

function Ui.corner(radius: number): UICorner
	return Ui.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })
end

function Ui.padding(px: number): UIPadding
	return Ui.make("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, px),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, px),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, px),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, px),
	})
end

function Ui.label(props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	local defaults: { [string]: any } = {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Text,
		TextScaled = true,
	}
	for key, value in props do
		if key ~= "MaxTextSize" then
			defaults[key] = value
		end
	end
	local label = Ui.make("TextLabel", defaults) :: TextLabel
	Ui.make("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = props.MaxTextSize or 28, Parent = label })
	return label
end

function Ui.button(props: { [string]: any }): TextButton
	local defaults: { [string]: any } = {
		AutoButtonColor = true,
		BackgroundColor3 = Ui.Theme.PanelLight,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextColor3 = Ui.Theme.Text,
		TextScaled = true,
	}
	for key, value in props do
		if key ~= "MaxTextSize" then
			defaults[key] = value
		end
	end
	local button = Ui.make("TextButton", defaults) :: TextButton
	Ui.corner(8).Parent = button
	Ui.padding(6).Parent = button
	Ui.make("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = props.MaxTextSize or 20, Parent = button })
	return button
end

function Ui.rgb(rgb: { number }): Color3
	return Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3])
end

return Ui

--[[
    NPCPathFollower.lua
    A strict, Humanoid-based path follower with cleanup.

    Usage:
        local NPCPathFollower = require(path.to.NPCPathFollower)
        local humanoid = npcModel:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
        local follower = NPCPathFollower.new(humanoid)
        follower:follow(targetPosition)
        follower:stop()
        follower:Destroy()
]]

local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

local NPCPathFollower = {}
NPCPathFollower.__index = NPCPathFollower

export type PathWaypoint = typeof(PathfindingService:CreatePath():GetWaypoints()[1])

export type NPCPathFollowerOptions =
    {
        agentRadius: number?,
        agentHeight: number?,
        agentCanJump: boolean?,
        agentCanClimb: boolean?,
        waypointSpacing: number?,
        costs: { [string]: number }?,
        calculationSecondsTimeout: number?,
        moveToTimeout: number?,
        moveToRetryDelay: number?,
        maxMoveFailures: number?,
        customActionHandlers: {
            [string]: (humanoid: Humanoid, waypoint: PathWaypoint, follower: NPCPathFollower) -> (),
        }?,
    }

type NPCPathFollowerState =
    {
        humanoid: Humanoid,
        options: NPCPathFollowerOptions,
        agentRadius: number,
        agentHeight: number,
        agentCanJump: boolean,
        agentCanClimb: boolean,
        waypointSpacing: number,
        costs: { [string]: number },
        calculationSecondsTimeout: number,
        moveToTimeout: number,
        moveToRetryDelay: number,
        maxMoveFailures: number,
        customActionHandlers: {
            [string]: (humanoid: Humanoid, waypoint: PathWaypoint, follower: NPCPathFollower) -> (),
        },

        path: Path?,
        waypoints: { PathWaypoint },
        currentIndex: number,
        blockedConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
        reachedConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
        diedConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
        moveToTimeoutThread: thread?,
        recomputeThread: thread?,
        running: boolean,
        moveFailCount: number,
    }

export type NPCPathFollower = typeof(setmetatable({} :: NPCPathFollowerState, NPCPathFollower))

function NPCPathFollower.new(humanoid: Humanoid, options: NPCPathFollowerOptions?): NPCPathFollower
    local resolvedOptions: NPCPathFollowerOptions = options or {}
    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            humanoid = humanoid,
            options = resolvedOptions,
            agentRadius = resolvedOptions.agentRadius or 2,
            agentHeight = resolvedOptions.agentHeight or 5,
            agentCanJump = resolvedOptions.agentCanJump ~= false,
            agentCanClimb = resolvedOptions.agentCanClimb or false,
            waypointSpacing = resolvedOptions.waypointSpacing or 4,
            costs = resolvedOptions.costs or {},
            calculationSecondsTimeout = resolvedOptions.calculationSecondsTimeout or 1,
            moveToTimeout = resolvedOptions.moveToTimeout or 6,
            moveToRetryDelay = resolvedOptions.moveToRetryDelay or 0.2,
            maxMoveFailures = resolvedOptions.maxMoveFailures or 3,
            customActionHandlers = resolvedOptions.customActionHandlers or {},
            path = nil :: Path?,
            waypoints = {} :: { PathWaypoint },
            currentIndex = 1,
            blockedConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
            reachedConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
            diedConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
            moveToTimeoutThread = nil :: thread?,
            recomputeThread = nil :: thread?,
            running = false,
            moveFailCount = 0,
        } :: NPCPathFollowerState,
        NPCPathFollower
    )

    self.diedConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        self:stop()
    end)

    return self
end

function NPCPathFollower.createPath(self: NPCPathFollower): Path
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = self.agentRadius,
        AgentHeight = self.agentHeight,
        AgentCanJump = self.agentCanJump,
        AgentCanClimb = self.agentCanClimb,
        WaypointSpacing = self.waypointSpacing,
        Costs = self.costs,
    })
    path.CalculationSecondsTimeout = self.calculationSecondsTimeout
    return path
end

function NPCPathFollower._disconnectReached(self: NPCPathFollower)
    if self.reachedConnection then
        self.reachedConnection:Disconnect()
        self.reachedConnection = nil
    end
end

function NPCPathFollower._cancelMoveToTimeout(self: NPCPathFollower)
    if self.moveToTimeoutThread then
        task.cancel(self.moveToTimeoutThread)
        self.moveToTimeoutThread = nil
    end
end

function NPCPathFollower._cancelRecompute(self: NPCPathFollower)
    if self.recomputeThread then
        task.cancel(self.recomputeThread)
        self.recomputeThread = nil
    end
end

function NPCPathFollower._cleanupPathConnections(self: NPCPathFollower)
    self:_cancelRecompute()
    if self.blockedConnection then
        self.blockedConnection:Disconnect()
        self.blockedConnection = nil
    end
    self:_disconnectReached()
    self:_cancelMoveToTimeout()
end

function NPCPathFollower.follow(self: NPCPathFollower, targetPosition: Vector3)
    if self.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    self:stop()
    self.running = true
    self.moveFailCount = 0
    self:computeAndMove(targetPosition)
end

function NPCPathFollower.computeAndMove(self: NPCPathFollower, targetPosition: Vector3)
    if not self.running or self.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        self:stop()
        return
    end

    self:_cleanupPathConnections()
    local path = self:createPath()
    self.path = path

    local character = self.humanoid.Parent
    if not character then
        self:stop()
        return
    end
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
    if not rootPart then
        self:stop()
        return
    end

    local success, err = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetPosition)
    end)

    if not success or path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        warn("NPCPathFollower failed:", err or path.Status)
        self:stop()
        return
    end

    self.waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
    self.currentIndex = 1
    self.moveFailCount = 0

    self.blockedConnection = path.Blocked:Connect(function(blockedIndex: number)
        if not self.running or self.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return
        end
        if blockedIndex >= self.currentIndex then
            self:_cancelRecompute()
            self.recomputeThread = task.delay(0, function()
                self.recomputeThread = nil
                if self.running then
                    self:computeAndMove(targetPosition)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    self:moveToNextWaypoint()
end

function NPCPathFollower.moveToNextWaypoint(self: NPCPathFollower)
    if not self.running or self.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        self:stop()
        return
    end

    if self.currentIndex > #self.waypoints then
        self:stop()
        return
    end

    local waypoint = self.waypoints[self.currentIndex]

    self:_disconnectReached()
    self:_cancelMoveToTimeout()

    if waypoint.Label ~= "" then
        local handler = self.customActionHandlers[waypoint.Label]
        if handler then
            handler(self.humanoid, waypoint, self)
        end
    end

    if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
        self.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end

    self.humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)

    self.moveToTimeoutThread = task.delay(self.moveToTimeout, function()
        self:_onMoveToTimeout()
    end)

    self.reachedConnection = self.humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function(reached: boolean)
        self:_cancelMoveToTimeout()
        if not self.running then
            return
        end
        if self.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            self:stop()
            return
        end

        if reached then
            self.moveFailCount = 0
            self.currentIndex += 1
            self:moveToNextWaypoint()
        else
            self.moveFailCount += 1
            if self.moveFailCount > self.maxMoveFailures then
                warn("NPCPathFollower: MoveTo failed too many times, stopping.")
                self:stop()
                return
            end
            task.delay(self.moveToRetryDelay, function()
                if self.running then
                    self:moveToNextWaypoint()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

function NPCPathFollower._onMoveToTimeout(self: NPCPathFollower)
    if not self.running or self.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        self:stop()
        return
    end

    self:_disconnectReached()
    self.moveFailCount += 1
    if self.moveFailCount > self.maxMoveFailures then
        warn("NPCPathFollower: MoveTo timed out too many times, stopping.")
        self:stop()
        return
    end

    task.delay(self.moveToRetryDelay, function()
        if self.running then
            self:moveToNextWaypoint()
        end
    end)
end

function NPCPathFollower.stop(self: NPCPathFollower)
    self.running = false
    self:_cleanupPathConnections()

    local rootPart = self.humanoid.RootPart
    if rootPart then
        self.humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
    else
        self.humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
    end
end

function NPCPathFollower.Destroy(self: NPCPathFollower)
    self:stop()
    if self.diedConnection then
        self.diedConnection:Disconnect()
        self.diedConnection = nil
    end
end

return NPCPathFollower

-- BaseService: the six safehouses. Each player claims one base on join,
-- with four stands to start and room to upgrade to ten. When a purchase is
-- approved, the character is placed on the player's first free stand. When
-- a stand is bought, the player pays through MoneyService and a new pad
-- opens up. When a character leaves a stand (sold or stolen), the slot
-- frees up again.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)

local BaseService = {}

-- Per-base state: who owns it, how many stands are open, and what sits on
-- each of the ten pads (a record or nil).
local bases = {}
local playerBase = {}

local function setSignOwner(world, baseIndex, ownerName)
	local base = world.bases[baseIndex]
	if not base then
		return
	end
	local gui = base.signGui
	local ownerLabel = gui:FindFirstChild("BoardLine1")
	if ownerLabel then
		ownerLabel.Text = ownerName or "Unclaimed"
	end
end

local function freeStandCount(base)
	local free = 0
	for i = 1, base.standCount do
		if base.slots[i] == nil then
			free += 1
		end
	end
	return free
end

function BaseService.init(ctx)
	local world = ctx.world
	local events = ctx.events
	local remotes = ctx.remotes

	for i, base in ipairs(world.bases) do
		bases[i] = {
			owner = nil,
			standCount = BrainrotData.Economy.startStands,
			slots = {},
			record = base,
		}
	end

	local function assignBase(player)
		for i, base in ipairs(bases) do
			if base.owner == nil then
				base.owner = player
				playerBase[player] = i
				setSignOwner(world, i, player.Name .. "'s Base")
				return i
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function releaseBase(player)
		local index = playerBase[player]
		if not index then
			return
		end
		local base = bases[index]
		for slot, record in pairs(base.slots) do
			if record and record.model then
				record.model:Destroy()
			end
			base.slots[slot] = nil
		end
		base.owner = nil
		base.standCount = BrainrotData.Economy.startStands
		playerBase[player] = nil
		setSignOwner(world, index, "Unclaimed")
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		assignBase(player)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		releaseBase(player)
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		assignBase(player)
	end

	-- A purchase was approved: put the character on the player's first
	-- free stand. If there is no free stand, refund the player.
	events.PurchaseApproved.Event:Connect(function(player, entry, mutationId, price, model, isGolden)
		local index = playerBase[player]
		if not index then
			events.Refund:Fire(player, price)
			events.PurchaseDenied:Fire(player, "No base assigned", model)
			return
		end
		local base = bases[index]
		local slot = nil
		for i = 1, base.standCount do
			if base.slots[i] == nil then
				slot = i
				break
			end
		end
		if slot == nil then
			events.Refund:Fire(player, price)
			events.PurchaseDenied:Fire(player, "No free stand", model)
			return
		end
		local padPos = base.record.pads[slot]
		model.Parent = base.record.model
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(padPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)))
		local record = {
			entry = entry,
			mutationId = mutationId,
			model = model,
			isGolden = isGolden,
		}
		base.slots[slot] = record
		events.CharacterPlaced:Fire(player, slot, model, entry, mutationId)
	end)

	-- A character left a stand (sold or stolen): free the slot.
	events.CharacterRemoved.Event:Connect(function(player, slot)
		local index = playerBase[player]
		if not index then
			return
		end
		bases[index].slots[slot] = nil
	end)

	-- Buying a stand: charge through MoneyService, open the pad on approval.
	remotes.BuyStand.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local index = playerBase[player]
		if not index then
			return
		end
		local base = bases[index]
		if base.standCount >= BrainrotData.Economy.maxStands then
			remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Your stands are already maxed out!")
			return
		end
		local cost = BrainrotData.upgradeCost(base.standCount)
		events.ChargeRequested:Fire(player, cost, "stand", { baseIndex = index })
	end)

	events.ChargeApproved.Event:Connect(function(player, purpose, payload)
		if purpose ~= "stand" then
			return
		end
		local index = payload.baseIndex or playerBase[player]
		if not index then
			return
		end
		local base = bases[index]
		if base.standCount < BrainrotData.Economy.maxStands then
			base.standCount += 1
			remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Stand upgraded! You now have " .. tostring(base.standCount) .. " stands.")
		end
	end)
end

-- Read access for other services: the base a player owns, and whether it
-- has a free stand.
function BaseService.getBaseIndex(player)
	return playerBase[player]
end

function BaseService.getStandCount(player)
	local index = playerBase[player]
	if not index then
		return 0
	end
	return bases[index].standCount
end

function BaseService.getSlot(player, slot)
	local index = playerBase[player]
	if not index then
		return nil
	end
	return bases[index].slots[slot]
end

function BaseService.hasFreeStand(player)
	local index = playerBase[player]
	if not index then
		return false
	end
	return freeStandCount(bases[index]) > 0
end

return BaseService

end)

local function number(value: any): number
	return if type(value) == "number" then value else 0
end

local function readRound(): Hud.RoundState
	local phase = Round:GetAttribute("Phase")
	local target = number(Round:GetAttribute("Target"))
	return {
		phase = if type(phase) == "string" then phase else "Waiting",
		endsAt = number(Round:GetAttribute("EndsAt")),
		wave = number(Round:GetAttribute("Wave")),
		target = if target > 0 then target else nil,
		alive = number(Round:GetAttribute("Alive")),
		participants = number(Round:GetAttribute("Participants")),
		inRound = player:GetAttribute("InRound") == true,
	}
end

-- Several attributes change together; re-render once per frame instead of
-- once per attribute so the bar never shows a half-updated state.
local dirty = true
local round: Hud.RoundState? = nil
Round.AttributeChanged:Connect(function()
	dirty = true
end)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InRound"):Connect(function()
	dirty = true
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if dirty then
		dirty = false
		local state = readRound()
		round = state
		hud:setRound(state)
		effects:onState(state)
	end
	local now = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	hud:update(now)
	effects:update(round, now)
end)

Notice.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text: string)
	hud:toastMessage(text)
end)

Profile.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(profile: ShopUi.Profile)
	hud:setCoins(profile.coins)
	shop:setProfile(profile)
end)

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
    PathfindingUtility.lua
    Helpers for throttled recomputation and waypoint formatting.

    Usage:
        local util = require(path.to.PathfindingUtility)
        local shouldRecompute, newPos, newTime = util.throttleRecompute(
            target.Position, lastPos, 0.5, 5, lastTime
        )
        print(util.formatWaypoint(waypoint))
]]

local PathfindingUtility = {}

function PathfindingUtility.throttleRecompute(
    currentPosition: Vector3,
    lastPosition: Vector3?,
    interval: number,
    minDistance: number,
    lastTime: number?
): (boolean, Vector3?, number?)
    local now = time()
    if lastTime and (now - lastTime) < interval then
        return false, lastPosition, lastTime
    end
    if lastPosition and (currentPosition - lastPosition).Magnitude < minDistance then
        return false, lastPosition, lastTime
    end
    return true, currentPosition, now
end

function PathfindingUtility.formatWaypoint(waypoint: {
    Position: Vector3,
    Action: Enum.PathWaypointAction,
    Label: string,
}?): string
    if not waypoint then
        return "Waypoint(nil)"
    end
    return string.format(
        "Waypoint(%s, %s, %s)",
        tostring(waypoint.Position),
        tostring(waypoint.Action),
        tostring(waypoint.Label)
    )
end

return PathfindingUtility
