-- BatService: the free baseball bat every player gets for raid defense.
--
-- Every player spawns with a wooden baseball bat in their Backpack. When a
-- rival is raiding your safehouse, equip the bat and click to swing. A swing
-- has a short cooldown and only reaches a short distance in front of you, so
-- you have to get close. A player caught by the swing is shoved hard away
-- from you. If that player is carrying a stolen brainrot, the hit knocks the
-- brainrot out of their hands and the raid fails: the character drops to the
-- floor and the steal system is told the carry was interrupted.
--
-- The service talks to the steal system through the server bus, not by
-- requiring it: it watches the CharacterRemoved / CharacterPlaced bus events
-- to track who is carrying, and it fires a CarryInterrupted bus event when a
-- bat hit breaks a carry. It also checks the target's character directly for
-- a carried brainrot model, so the drop works even if the bus tracking and
-- the steal system disagree about the carry state.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterPack = game:GetService("StarterPack")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local BatService = {}

-- Tuning. Kept small and fair: a short cooldown, a short reach, a strong
-- shove, and a carry is always broken when the swing connects.
local SWING_COOLDOWN = 1.0
local HIT_RANGE = 8
local FRONT_DOT = 0.5
local KNOCKBACK_SPEED = 55
local KNOCKBACK_UP = 22
local KNOCKBACK_TIME = 0.25
local TRAIL_TIME = 0.35
local SWING_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://13107247" -- a whoosh; swap for any whoosh asset id

local TOOL_NAME = "Baseball Bat"

local lastSwing = {}
local carryingFlag = {}

local ctx = nil

local function findPlayerArg(...)
	for _, value in ipairs({ ... }) do
		if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
			return value
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function getRootPart(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

-- findCarriedModel: a carried brainrot is a Model attached to the player's
-- character. Body parts are BaseParts and accessories are Accessory
-- instances, so a Model child of the character can only be a carried
-- character. Returns nil when the player holds nothing.
local function findCarriedModel(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Model") then
			return child
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- isCarrying: true when the player is currently carrying a stolen character.
-- Two signals, either one is enough: the bus-tracked carry flag, or a
-- carried brainrot model physically attached to the player's character.
local function isCarrying(player)
	if carryingFlag[player] then
		return true
	end
	return findCarriedModel(player) ~= nil
end

-- dropCarried: make a carrying player drop the brainrot they hold. The model
-- is moved out of the character into the world at the player's feet, its
-- parts are unanchored and solid so it falls to the floor instead of
-- floating, and the steal system is told through the bus that the carry was
-- interrupted so it can clear its own carry state and handle the character
-- instead of letting the raider keep it.
local function dropCarried(player)
	local model = findCarriedModel(player)
	if model then
		local root = getRootPart(player)
		local dropAt = root and root.Position or Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
		for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.Anchored = false
				part.CanCollide = true
			end
		end
		model.Parent = Workspace
		pcall(function()
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(dropAt + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)))
		end)
	end
	carryingFlag[player] = nil
	if ctx and ctx.events and ctx.events.CarryInterrupted then
		ctx.events.CarryInterrupted:Fire(player, model)
	end
end

-- knockback: shove a player hard away from the swinger, with a small pop up.
-- A short-lived BodyVelocity does the push, then Debris removes it.
local function knockback(target, fromPosition)
	local root = getRootPart(target)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local away = root.Position - fromPosition
	away = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
	if away.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		away = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	end
	away = away.Unit
	local push = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	push.Name = "BatKnockback"
	push.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 100000
	push.Velocity = away * KNOCKBACK_SPEED + Vector3.new(0, KNOCKBACK_UP, 0)
	push.Parent = root
	Debris:AddItem(push, KNOCKBACK_TIME)
end

-- findTarget: the nearest other player inside the swing's reach and in front
-- of the swinger. Returns nil when nobody is close enough or in front, so
-- the bat can never hit the swinger themselves or a far-away player.
local function findTarget(swinger)
	local root = getRootPart(swinger)
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	local origin = root.Position
	local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
	look = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return nil
	end
	look = look.Unit

	local best = nil
	local bestDist = HIT_RANGE + 1
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if other ~= swinger then
			local otherRoot = getRootPart(other)
			if otherRoot then
				local toOther = otherRoot.Position - origin
				local dist = toOther.Magnitude
				if dist <= HIT_RANGE and dist < bestDist then
					local dir = Vector3.new(toOther.X, 0, toOther.Z)
					if dir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
						dir = dir.Unit
						if dir:Dot(look) >= FRONT_DOT then
							best = other
							bestDist = dist
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- makeBatTool: build one bat Tool. The Handle is a brown wooden bat with a
-- wider barrel welded to its top end. A Trail along the handle and a whoosh
-- sound give the swing its feedback.
local function makeBatTool()
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = TOOL_NAME
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.ToolTip = "Swing to knock back raiders — a hit makes a thief drop the brainrot they are carrying!"

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 2.2, 0.45)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(139, 90, 43)
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.CanQuery = false
	handle.Parent = tool

	local barrel = Instance.new("Part")
	barrel.Name = "Barrel"
	barrel.Size = Vector3.new(0.65, 0.9, 0.65)
	barrel.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 105, 50)
	barrel.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	barrel.CanCollide = false
	barrel.CanQuery = false
	local barrelWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
	barrelWeld.Part0 = handle
	barrelWeld.Part1 = barrel
	barrelWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.35, 0)
	barrelWeld.Parent = handle
	barrel.Parent = tool

	-- Trail along the bat, enabled only during a swing.
	local attachTop = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachTop.Name = "TrailTop"
	attachTop.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
	attachTop.Parent = handle
	local attachBottom = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachBottom.Name = "TrailBottom"
	attachBottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
	attachBottom.Parent = handle
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Name = "SwingTrail"
	trail.Attachment0 = attachTop
	trail.Attachment1 = attachBottom
	trail.Lifetime = 0.3
	trail.MinLength = 0.1
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
	trail.Enabled = false
	trail.Parent = handle

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "SwingSound"
	sound.SoundId = SWING_SOUND_ID
	sound.Volume = 0.6
	sound.Parent = handle

	return tool
end

-- playSwingEffects: the whoosh and a brief trail streak.
local function playSwingEffects(tool)
	local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if not handle then
		return
	end
	local sound = handle:FindFirstChild("SwingSound")
	if sound then
		sound:Play()
	end
	local trail = handle:FindFirstChild("SwingTrail")
	if trail then
		trail.Enabled = true
		task.delay(TRAIL_TIME, function()
			pcall(function()
				trail.Enabled = false
			end)
		end)
	end
end

-- onSwing: a player clicked while holding the bat. Enforce the cooldown,
-- play the effects, then find and hit the nearest player in front. A hit
-- always knocks the target back; if the target is carrying a stolen
-- brainrot, the hit also makes them drop it and the raid fails.
local function onSwing(player, tool)
	local now = os.clock()
	local last = lastSwing[player]
	if last and now - last < SWING_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastSwing[player] = now

	playSwingEffects(tool)

	local target = findTarget(player)
	if not target then
		return
	end

	local root = getRootPart(player)
	if root then
		knockback(target, root.Position)
	end

	local wasCarrying = isCarrying(target)
	if wasCarrying then
		dropCarried(target)
	end

	if ctx and ctx.remotes and ctx.remotes.Notify then
		if wasCarrying then
			ctx.remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "You smashed the raider and they dropped the stolen brainrot!")
			ctx.remotes.Notify:FireClient(target, "A bat smashed you — you dropped the brainrot you were carrying!")
		else
			ctx.remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "You knocked back " .. target.DisplayName .. "!")
			ctx.remotes.Notify:FireClient(target, "You were knocked back by a baseball bat!")
		end
	end
end

local function hasBat(player)
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	if backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME) then
		return true
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if character and character:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- giveBat: hand one bat to a player (once). Connects its Activated event so
-- a click while equipped swings it. The connection dies with the tool.
local function giveBat(player)
	if hasBat(player) then
		return
	end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	if not backpack then
		return
	end
	local tool = makeBatTool()
	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		onSwing(player, tool)
	end)
	tool.Parent = backpack
end

local function hookPlayer(player)
	giveBat(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.2)
		giveBat(player)
	end)
end

function BatService.init(serviceCtx)
	ctx = serviceCtx

	-- Track who is carrying through the bus: a character leaves a stand when
	-- it is picked up (CharacterRemoved) and stops being carried when it is
	-- placed again (CharacterPlaced). The payload order is not assumed; the
	-- player is found among the event arguments.
	if ctx.events.CharacterRemoved then
		ctx.events.CharacterRemoved.Event:Connect(function(...)
			local player = findPlayerArg(...)
			if player then
				carryingFlag[player] = true
			end
		end)
	end
	if ctx.events.CharacterPlaced then
		ctx.events.CharacterPlaced.Event:Connect(function(...)
			local player = findPlayerArg(...)
			if player then
				carryingFlag[player] = nil
			end
		end)
	end

	-- A bat in StarterPack means every respawn gets one automatically.
	local starterBat = makeBatTool()
	starterBat.Parent = StarterPack

	-- Hand a bat to everyone already in the game, and to each newcomer.
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hookPlayer(player)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)

	-- Cooldown and carry flags die with the player.
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastSwing[player] = nil
		carryingFlag[player] = nil
	end)
end

return BatService

--!strict
-- Session-locked player data on top of any store with UpdateAsync semantics.
--
-- Each record is { data = ..., lock = { jobId, at } }. A server only loads a
-- record it can lock, and only saves while it still holds the lock. That
-- stops the classic Roblox duplication bug: a player hops servers, the old
-- server saves late, and overwrites progress made on the new one.
--
-- Everything Roblox-specific (the store, the clock, waiting) is injected, so
-- this module runs unchanged in tests.

local DataService = {}
DataService.__index = DataService

export type Store = {
	update: (self: any, key: string, transform: (any) -> any) -> (boolean, any),
}

export type Schema = {
	reconcile: (raw: any) -> any,
}

export type Options = {
	store: Store,
	schema: Schema,
	jobId: string,
	now: () -> number,
	wait: (seconds: number) -> (),
	log: ((message: string) -> ())?,
	keyPrefix: string,
	lockTimeoutSeconds: number,
	lockWaitAttempts: number,
	lockWaitSeconds: number,
	maxRetries: number,
	retryBaseSeconds: number,
}

type Lock = { jobId: string, at: number }

type Profile = {
	data: any,
	lost: boolean,
	-- Set once unload starts. Leaving and server shutdown both unload the
	-- same player, and only the first call may do it.
	releasing: boolean,
}

type State = {
	options: Options,
	profiles: { [number]: Profile },
}

export type DataService = typeof(setmetatable({} :: State, DataService))

local function deepCopy(value: any): any
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in value do
		copy[k] = deepCopy(v)
	end
	return copy
end

local function readLock(record: any): Lock?
	if type(record) ~= "table" or type(record.lock) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local lock = record.lock
	if type(lock.jobId) ~= "string" or type(lock.at) ~= "number" then
		return nil
	end
	return lock
end

function DataService.new(options: Options): DataService
	return setmetatable({ options = options, profiles = {} }, DataService)
end

function DataService.key(self: DataService, userId: number): string
	return self.options.keyPrefix .. tostring(userId)
end

function DataService._log(self: DataService, message: string)
	local log = self.options.log
	if log then
		log(message)
	end
end

-- Retries transient store errors with exponential backoff.
function DataService._update(self: DataService, key: string, transform: (any) -> any): (boolean, any)
	local o = self.options
	local lastError: any = nil
	for attempt = 1, o.maxRetries do
		local ok, result = o.store:update(key, transform)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		lastError = result
		self:_log(string.format("store error on %s (attempt %d/%d): %s", key, attempt, o.maxRetries, tostring(result)))
		if attempt < o.maxRetries then
			o.wait(o.retryBaseSeconds * 2 ^ (attempt - 1))
		end
	end
	return false, lastError
end

-- Loads and locks a player's record. Returns false and a reason when the
-- store is down or another live server still holds the lock.
function DataService.load(self: DataService, userId: number): (boolean, any)
	local o = self.options
	local key = self:key(userId)

	for attempt = 1, o.lockWaitAttempts do
		-- The transform may run more than once (UpdateAsync retries on
		-- conflict), so it only reports through these locals.
		local acquired = false
		local loaded: any = nil

		local ok, err = self:_update(key, function(old: any): any
			acquired = false
			local lock = readLock(old)
			local now = o.now()
			local free = lock == nil or lock.jobId == o.jobId or now - lock.at >= o.lockTimeoutSeconds
			if not free then
				return nil
			end
			if lock and lock.jobId ~= o.jobId then
				self:_log(string.format("taking over stale lock on %s from %s", key, lock.jobId))
			end
			loaded = o.schema.reconcile(if type(old) == "table" then old.data else nil)
			acquired = true
			return { data = loaded, lock = { jobId = o.jobId, at = now } }
		end)

		if not ok then
			return false, "Could not reach the data store: " .. tostring(err)
		end
		if acquired then
			self.profiles[userId] = { data = loaded, lost = false, releasing = false }
			return true, loaded
		end
		if attempt < o.lockWaitAttempts then
			o.wait(o.lockWaitSeconds)
		end
	end

	return false, "Your data is still open on another server. Please rejoin in a minute."
end

function DataService.get(self: DataService, userId: number): any
	local profile = self.profiles[userId]
	return if profile then profile.data else nil
end

function DataService.isLoaded(self: DataService, userId: number): boolean
	local profile = self.profiles[userId]
	return profile ~= nil and not profile.releasing
end

function DataService.userIds(self: DataService): { number }
	local ids = {}
	for userId, profile in self.profiles do
		if not profile.releasing then
			table.insert(ids, userId)
		end
	end
	return ids
end

-- Writes the current data. With release, also gives up the lock so another
-- server can load the player immediately.
function DataService.save(self: DataService, userId: number, release: boolean): (boolean, string?)
	local o = self.options
	local profile = self.profiles[userId]
	if not profile then
		return false, "not loaded"
	end
	if profile.lost then
		return false, "session lost"
	end
	if profile.releasing and not release then
		-- The release save already in flight writes this same data.
		return true, nil
	end

	local snapshot = deepCopy(profile.data)
	local stillOwned = false

	local ok, err = self:_update(self:key(userId), function(old: any): any
		local lock = readLock(old)
		stillOwned = lock ~= nil and lock.jobId == o.jobId
		if not stillOwned then
			-- Another server took the record over. Writing now would
			-- overwrite its newer progress.
			return nil
		end
		return {
			data = snapshot,
			lock = if release then nil else { jobId = o.jobId, at = o.now() },
		}
	end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end
	if not stillOwned then
		profile.lost = true
		self:_log(string.format("session lost for %d; save skipped", userId))
		return false, "session lost"
	end
	return true, nil
end

-- Saves with release and forgets the player.
function DataService.unload(self: DataService, userId: number): (boolean, string?)
	local profile = self.profiles[userId]
	if not profile or profile.releasing then
		return false, "not loaded"
	end
	profile.releasing = true
	local ok, err = self:save(userId, true)
	self.profiles[userId] = nil
	return ok, err
end

return DataService

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
    PatrolBehavior.lua
    A simple state machine: Idle → Patrol → Chase → Attack → Return.

    Usage:
        local PatrolBehavior = require(path.to.PatrolBehavior)
        local NPCPathFollower = require(path.to.NPCPathFollower)

        local behavior = PatrolBehavior.new(npcModel, {
            patrolPoints = {
                workspace:WaitForChild("PatrolA").Position,
                workspace:WaitForChild("PatrolB").Position,
            },
            detectionRange = 30,
            attackRange = 5,
            chaseTimeout = 10,
            recomputeInterval = 0.5,
            recomputeMinDistance = 4,
            attackCooldown = 1,
        })
        behavior:start()
        behavior:Destroy()
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local NPCPathFollower = require(script.Parent.NPCPathFollower)

type PatrolState = "Idle" | "Patrol" | "Chase" | "Attack" | "Return"

export type PatrolBehaviorConfig = {
    patrolPoints: { Vector3 }?,
    detectionRange: number?,
    attackRange: number?,
    chaseTimeout: number?,
    recomputeInterval: number?,
    recomputeMinDistance: number?,
    attackCooldown: number?,
}

type PathFollower = NPCPathFollower.NPCPathFollower

type PatrolBehaviorState = {
    model: Model?,
    humanoid: Humanoid?,
    rootPart: BasePart?,
    config: PatrolBehaviorConfig,
    patrolPoints: { Vector3 },
    detectionRange: number,
    attackRange: number,
    chaseTimeout: number,
    recomputeInterval: number,
    recomputeMinDistance: number,
    attackCooldown: number,
    state: PatrolState,
    patrolIndex: number,
    target: Model?,
    chaseTimer: number,
    follower: PathFollower?,
    connection: RBXScriptConnection?,
    destroyed: boolean,
    lastRecomputeTime: number,
    lastRecomputePosition: Vector3?,
    lastAttackTime: number,
}

local PatrolBehavior = {}
PatrolBehavior.__index = PatrolBehavior

export type PatrolBehavior = typeof(setmetatable({} :: PatrolBehaviorState, PatrolBehavior))

function PatrolBehavior.new(model: Model, config: PatrolBehaviorConfig?): PatrolBehavior
    local resolvedConfig: PatrolBehaviorConfig = config or {}
    local humanoid = model:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            model = model,
            humanoid = humanoid,
            rootPart = model:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart,
            config = resolvedConfig,
            patrolPoints = resolvedConfig.patrolPoints or {},
            detectionRange = resolvedConfig.detectionRange or 30,
            attackRange = resolvedConfig.attackRange or 5,
            chaseTimeout = resolvedConfig.chaseTimeout or 10,
            recomputeInterval = resolvedConfig.recomputeInterval or 0.5,
            recomputeMinDistance = resolvedConfig.recomputeMinDistance or 4,
            attackCooldown = resolvedConfig.attackCooldown or 1,
            state = "Idle" :: PatrolState,
            patrolIndex = 1,
            target = nil :: Model?,
            chaseTimer = 0,
            follower = nil :: PathFollower?,
            connection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
            destroyed = false,
            lastRecomputeTime = 0,
            lastRecomputePosition = nil :: Vector3?,
            lastAttackTime = 0,
        } :: PatrolBehaviorState,
        PatrolBehavior
    )

    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        self:Destroy()
    end)

    return self
end

function PatrolBehavior.start(self: PatrolBehavior)
    if self.destroyed then
        return
    end
    if self.connection then
        return
    end

    self.connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
        self:tick(dt)
    end)

    if #self.patrolPoints == 0 then
        self:setState("Idle")
    else
        self:setState("Patrol")
    end
end

function PatrolBehavior.stop(self: PatrolBehavior)
    if self.connection then
        self.connection:Disconnect()
        self.connection = nil
    end
    if self.follower then
        self.follower:stop()
        self.follower = nil
    end
end

function PatrolBehavior.Destroy(self: PatrolBehavior)
    if self.destroyed then
        return
    end
    self.destroyed = true
    self:stop()
    self.model = nil
    self.humanoid = nil
    self.rootPart = nil
    self.target = nil
end

function PatrolBehavior.setState(self: PatrolBehavior, newState: PatrolState)
    self.state = newState
    if newState == "Patrol" then
        self.target = nil
        self:nextPatrolPoint()
    elseif newState == "Idle" then
        self.target = nil
        local humanoid = self.humanoid
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
        end
        if self.follower then
            self.follower:stop()
            self.follower = nil
        end
    elseif newState == "Chase" then
        self.lastRecomputeTime = 0
        self.lastRecomputePosition = nil
        self.chaseTimer = 0
    elseif newState == "Return" then
        self.target = nil
        self.lastRecomputeTime = 0
        self.lastRecomputePosition = nil
    end
end

function PatrolBehavior.nextPatrolPoint(self: PatrolBehavior)
    if #self.patrolPoints == 0 then
        return
    end
    self.patrolIndex = (self.patrolIndex % #self.patrolPoints) + 1
    self:moveTo(self.patrolPoints[self.patrolIndex])
end

function PatrolBehavior.moveTo(self: PatrolBehavior, position: Vector3)
    if self.destroyed then
        return
    end
    if not self.follower then
        local humanoid = self.humanoid
        if not humanoid then
            return
        end
        self.follower = NPCPathFollower.new(humanoid)
    end
    local follower = self.follower
    if follower then
        follower:follow(position)
    end
    self.lastRecomputeTime = time()
    self.lastRecomputePosition = position
end

function PatrolBehavior.findTarget(self: PatrolBehavior): Model?
    local model = self.model
    local rootPart = self.rootPart
    if not model or not rootPart then
        return nil
    end
    local closest: Model? = nil
    local closestDist = self.detectionRange

    local characters: { Instance } = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            table.insert(characters, player.Character)
        end
    end
    if #characters == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local params = OverlapParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = characters
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    params.MaxParts = 100

    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(rootPart.Position, self.detectionRange, params)
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        local character = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if not character or character == model then
            continue
        end
        local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid?
        if hrp and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local dist = (hrp.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < closestDist then
                closestDist = dist
                closest = character
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

function PatrolBehavior.shouldRecompute(self: PatrolBehavior, position: Vector3): boolean
    local now = time()
    if (now - self.lastRecomputeTime) < self.recomputeInterval then
        return false
    end
    if
        self.lastRecomputePosition
        and (position - self.lastRecomputePosition).Magnitude < self.recomputeMinDistance
    then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

function PatrolBehavior.tick(self: PatrolBehavior, dt: number)
    if self.destroyed then
        return
    end
    local humanoid = self.humanoid
    local rootPart = self.rootPart
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        return
    end
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        self:Destroy()
        return
    end

    if self.state == "Patrol" or self.state == "Idle" then
        local target = self:findTarget()
        if target then
            self.target = target
            self:setState("Chase")
            return
        elseif self.state == "Patrol" and self.follower and not self.follower.running then
            self:nextPatrolPoint()
        end
    elseif self.state == "Chase" then
        if not self.target or not self.target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            self:setState("Return")
            return
        end
        local hrp = self.target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
        if not hrp then
            self:setState("Return")
            return
        end

        local dist = (hrp.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
        if dist <= self.attackRange then
            self:setState("Attack")
            return
        end

        self.chaseTimer += dt
        if self.chaseTimer >= self.chaseTimeout then
            self:setState("Return")
            return
        end

        if self:shouldRecompute(hrp.Position) then
            self:moveTo(hrp.Position)
        end
    elseif self.state == "Attack" then
        if not self.target or not self.target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            self:setState("Return")
            return
        end
        local hrp = self.target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
        if not hrp then
            self:setState("Return")
            return
        end

        local dist = (hrp.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
        if dist > self.attackRange then
            self:setState("Chase")
            return
        end

        local now = time()
        if now - self.lastAttackTime >= self.attackCooldown then
            self.lastAttackTime = now
            -- trigger server-side attack logic
        end
    elseif self.state == "Return" then
        self.target = nil
        if #self.patrolPoints == 0 then
            self:setState("Idle")
            return
        end
        local returnPos = self.patrolPoints[self.patrolIndex]
        if self:shouldRecompute(returnPos) then
            self:moveTo(returnPos)
        end
        if self.follower and not self.follower.running then
            self:setState("Patrol")
        end
    end
end

return PatrolBehavior

-- Bootstrap: the server entry point. It builds the island, creates the
-- server event bus (BindableEvents) and the client remotes (RemoteEvents),
-- then starts every service with the same context table so the services can
-- find each other through ctx.services instead of requiring each other —
-- which is what keeps the module graph free of cycles.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local World = require(script.Parent.World)
local BrainrotModels = require(script.Parent.BrainrotModels)
local ConveyorService = require(script.Parent.ConveyorService)
local BaseService = require(script.Parent.BaseService)
local MoneyService = require(script.Parent.MoneyService)
local StealService = require(script.Parent.StealService)
local BatService = require(script.Parent.BatService)
local ShieldService = require(script.Parent.ShieldService)
local WaveService = require(script.Parent.WaveService)
local MerchantService = require(script.Parent.MerchantService)
local AdminService = require(script.Parent.AdminService)

-- Server bus: BindableEvents the services use to talk to each other.
local busFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
busFolder.Name = "BrainrotBus"
busFolder.Parent = ServerScriptService
local events = {}
for _, name in ipairs({
	"PurchaseRequested",
	"PurchaseApproved",
	"PurchaseDenied",
	"Refund",
	"ChargeRequested",
	"ChargeApproved",
	"ChargeDenied",
	"CharacterPlaced",
	"CharacterRemoved",
	"CarryInterrupted",
	"SellRequested",
	"ShieldChanged",
	"WaveWarning",
	"WaveSweep",
	"MerchantStockChanged",
}) do
	local event = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	event.Name = name
	event.Parent = busFolder
	events[name] = event
end

-- Client remotes: RemoteEvents the client scripts use to talk to the server
-- and the server uses to push updates to the clients.
local remoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
remoteFolder.Name = "BrainrotRemotes"
remoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local remotes = {}
for _, name in ipairs({
	"ShieldActivate",
	"BuyStand",
	"SellCharacter",
	"Rebirth",
	"BuyMerchant",
	"WaveWarning",
	"WaveSweep",
	"GoldenAnnounce",
	"TopThree",
	"Notify",
}) do
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = remoteFolder
	remotes[name] = remote
end

-- Build the island first: every service works with the world it returns.
local world = World.build()

-- The context every service receives. The services table is filled before
-- any init runs, so a service can call a sibling through ctx.services.
local ctx = {
	world = world,
	events = events,
	remotes = remotes,
	services = {},
}

ctx.services.World = World
ctx.services.BrainrotModels = BrainrotModels
ctx.services.ConveyorService = ConveyorService
ctx.services.BaseService = BaseService
ctx.services.MoneyService = MoneyService
ctx.services.StealService = StealService
ctx.services.BatService = BatService
ctx.services.ShieldService = ShieldService
ctx.services.WaveService = WaveService
ctx.services.MerchantService = MerchantService
ctx.services.AdminService = AdminService

-- Start the services. BaseService first (it owns the safehouses the other
-- services place things into), then the economy, then the rest.
BaseService.init(ctx)
MoneyService.init(ctx)
ConveyorService.init(ctx)
StealService.init(ctx)
BatService.init(ctx)
ShieldService.init(ctx)
WaveService.init(ctx)
MerchantService.init(ctx)
AdminService.init(ctx)

-- Heartbeat: a light status line every minute, so the server log shows the
-- game is alive and how many players are in.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		local count = #game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
		print("[Brainrot Blitz] heartbeat: " .. tostring(count) .. " players in game")
	end
end)

print("[Brainrot Blitz] server started: island built, 9 services running")

--!strict
-- Collects win counts and writes them to the ordered store in batches.
--
-- Writing on every win would spend the OrderedDataStore budget on players
-- who win several rounds in a row. Instead each player keeps only their
-- latest count until the next flush, so a flush costs at most one write per
-- player whose wins changed.

local LeaderboardBuffer = {}
LeaderboardBuffer.__index = LeaderboardBuffer

export type OrderedStore = {
	set: (self: any, key: string, value: number) -> (boolean, any),
	top: (self: any, count: number) -> (boolean, any),
}

type State = {
	store: OrderedStore,
	pending: { [number]: number },
	-- Last value each player has in the store, so unchanged counts (a coin
	-- update, a rejoin) cost no write.
	stored: { [number]: number },
}

export type LeaderboardBuffer = typeof(setmetatable({} :: State, LeaderboardBuffer))

function LeaderboardBuffer.new(store: OrderedStore): LeaderboardBuffer
	return setmetatable({ store = store, pending = {}, stored = {} }, LeaderboardBuffer)
end

function LeaderboardBuffer.record(self: LeaderboardBuffer, userId: number, wins: number)
	if wins > 0 and wins ~= self.stored[userId] then
		self.pending[userId] = wins
	end
end

function LeaderboardBuffer.pendingCount(self: LeaderboardBuffer): number
	local n = 0
	for _ in self.pending do
		n += 1
	end
	return n
end

-- Writes everything pending. Returns how many writes succeeded and failed;
-- failed entries stay queued for the next flush.
function LeaderboardBuffer.flush(self: LeaderboardBuffer): (number, number)
	-- Swap the table first: store calls yield, and wins recorded meanwhile
	-- must land in the next batch rather than be lost.
	local batch = self.pending
	self.pending = {}

	local written, failed = 0, 0
	for userId, wins in batch do
		local ok = self.store:set(tostring(userId), wins)
		if ok then
			written += 1
			self.stored[userId] = wins
		else
			failed += 1
			-- Don't clobber a newer count recorded while we were writing.
			if self.pending[userId] == nil then
				self.pending[userId] = wins
			end
		end
	end
	return written, failed
end

return LeaderboardBuffer

--!strict
-- Status: reviewed
-- Last verified: 2026-07-16
-- Test coverage: retry-policy regression fixture in tests/OpenCloudRequest.spec.lua; endpoint integration still required.
-- Intended use: example; confirm endpoint-specific idempotency and authentication requirements.
--[[
OpenCloudRequest.lua

GET/HEAD/OPTIONS retry transient failures by default. Mutation retries require
an explicit idempotent=true declaration from the caller. In-experience Open
Cloud currently restricts request headers to x-api-key and content-type, so
idempotency must come from the endpoint/resource semantics rather than a custom
Idempotency-Key header.
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

export type CloudResponse = {
    Success: boolean,
    StatusCode: number,
    StatusMessage: string,
    Body: string,
    Headers: { [string]: string },
}
export type RequestOptions = {
    maxAttempts: number?,
    idempotent: boolean?,
}

local BASE_URL = "https://apis.roblox.com/cloud/v2/"
local SAFE_METHODS = {
    GET = true,
    HEAD = true,
    OPTIONS = true,
}
local SUPPORTED_METHODS = {
    GET = true,
    HEAD = true,
    OPTIONS = true,
    POST = true,
    PUT = true,
    PATCH = true,
    DELETE = true,
}

local OpenCloudRequest = {}

local function getHeader(headers: { [string]: string }, wanted: string): string?
    local lowerWanted = string.lower(wanted)
    for name, value in headers do
        if string.lower(name) == lowerWanted then
            return value
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function retryDelay(response: CloudResponse?, attempt: number): number
    if response then
        local retryAfter = tonumber(getHeader(response.Headers, "retry-after") or "")
        if retryAfter and retryAfter >= 0 then
            return retryAfter
        end
        local reset = tonumber(getHeader(response.Headers, "x-ratelimit-reset") or "")
        if reset and reset >= 0 then
            return reset
        end
    end
    return 0.5 * (2 ^ (attempt - 1))
end

local function transientStatus(response: CloudResponse): boolean
    local status = response.StatusCode
    return status == 408
        or status == 429
        or status == 500
        or status == 502
        or status == 503
        or status == 504
end

function OpenCloudRequest._retryPlan(method: string, options: RequestOptions?): (boolean, number)
    local requestOptions: RequestOptions = options or {}
    local normalizedMethod = string.upper(method)
    local mayRetry = SAFE_METHODS[normalizedMethod] == true or requestOptions.idempotent == true
    return mayRetry, if mayRetry then requestOptions.maxAttempts or 3 else 1
end

OpenCloudRequest._retryDelay = retryDelay

local function getApiKey()
    local secret = HttpService:GetSecret("APIKey")
    if not secret then
        error('APIKey secret not found. Store the key as a Secret named "APIKey".', 0)
    end
    return secret
end

function OpenCloudRequest.call(
    method: string,
    path: string,
    body: any?,
    options: RequestOptions?
): (boolean, CloudResponse?, any?)
    local requestOptions: RequestOptions = options or {}
    local normalizedMethod = string.upper(method)
    if SUPPORTED_METHODS[normalizedMethod] ~= true then
        return false, nil, `unsupported HTTP method: {method}`
    end
    local maxAttempts = requestOptions.maxAttempts or 3
    if
        maxAttempts ~= maxAttempts
        or maxAttempts == math.huge
        or maxAttempts % 1 ~= 0
        or maxAttempts < 1
    then
        return false, nil, "maxAttempts must be a positive integer"
    end
    if path == "" then
        return false, nil, "path must not be empty"
    end
    if path:find("..", 1, true) then
        return false, nil, "path must not contain '..'"
    end
    if body ~= nil and (normalizedMethod == "GET" or normalizedMethod == "HEAD") then
        return false, nil, `{normalizedMethod} requests must not include a body`
    end

    local setupOk, apiKey, encodedBody = pcall(function()
        local encoded = if body == nil then nil else HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
        return getApiKey(), encoded
    end)
    if not setupOk then
        return false, nil, apiKey
    end

    local _, allowedAttempts = OpenCloudRequest._retryPlan(normalizedMethod, requestOptions)
    local lastResponse: CloudResponse? = nil
    local lastError: any? = nil

    for attempt = 1, allowedAttempts do
        local headers = {
            ["content-type"] = "application/json",
            ["x-api-key"] = apiKey,
        }
        local response: CloudResponse? = nil
        local requestOk, requestError = pcall(function()
            response = HttpService:RequestAsync({
                Url = BASE_URL .. path,
                Method = normalizedMethod,
                Headers = headers,
                Body = encodedBody,
            }) :: CloudResponse
        end)

        if requestOk and response then
            lastResponse = response
            if response.Success then
                return true, response, nil
            end
            lastError = response.StatusMessage
            if not transientStatus(response) then
                return false, response, lastError
            end
        else
            lastError = requestError
        end

        if attempt < allowedAttempts then
            local delay = retryDelay(lastResponse, attempt)
            warn(`Open Cloud attempt {attempt} failed; retrying in {delay}s: {tostring(lastError)}`)
            task.wait(delay)
        end
    end

    return false, lastResponse, lastError
end

function OpenCloudRequest.decodeBody(body: string): (any?, any?)
    if body == "" then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(body)
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, decoded
    end
    return decoded, nil
end

return OpenCloudRequest

--!strict
-- In-memory stand-in for an OrderedDataStore: integer values, read back as a
-- descending top-N. Used in unpublished Studio places and in tests.

local MemoryOrderedStore = {}
MemoryOrderedStore.__index = MemoryOrderedStore

export type Entry = { key: string, value: number }

type State = {
	values: { [string]: number },
	failuresLeft: number,
	writes: number,
}

export type MemoryOrderedStore = typeof(setmetatable({} :: State, MemoryOrderedStore))

function MemoryOrderedStore.new(): MemoryOrderedStore
	return setmetatable({ values = {}, failuresLeft = 0, writes = 0 }, MemoryOrderedStore)
end

-- Makes the next n calls fail as if the service were down.
function MemoryOrderedStore.failNext(self: MemoryOrderedStore, n: number)
	self.failuresLeft = n
end

local function outage(self: MemoryOrderedStore): boolean
	if self.failuresLeft > 0 then
		self.failuresLeft -= 1
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function MemoryOrderedStore.set(self: MemoryOrderedStore, key: string, value: number): (boolean, any)
	if outage(self) then
		return false, "simulated OrderedDataStore outage"
	end
	-- OrderedDataStores only hold integers.
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= math.floor(value) then
		return false, "value must be an integer"
	end
	self.values[key] = value
	self.writes += 1
	return true, nil
end

function MemoryOrderedStore.top(self: MemoryOrderedStore, count: number): (boolean, any)
	if outage(self) then
		return false, "simulated OrderedDataStore outage"
	end
	local entries: { Entry } = {}
	for key, value in self.values do
		table.insert(entries, { key = key, value = value })
	end
	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		if a.value ~= b.value then
			return a.value > b.value
		end
		return a.key < b.key
	end)
	local out: { Entry } = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(count, #entries) do
		out[i] = entries[i]
	end
	return true, out
end

return MemoryOrderedStore

-- BrainrotModels: builds the 3D model of one brainrot character from parts.
-- Every model faces -Z, stands on Y 0, carries a readable name label, and
-- gets a glowing trim when it carries a mutation. The conveyor and the
-- safehouse stands both ask this module for models, so the same character
-- always looks the same wherever it appears.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)

local BrainrotModels = {}

local function addPart(model, name, size, pos, color, material, shape)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = pos
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Parent = model
	return part
end

-- Two eyes on the front face (-Z), so every character has a face.
local function addEyes(model, y)
	addPart(model, "EyeLeft", Vector3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.1), Vector3.new(-0.35, y, -0.62), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	addPart(model, "EyeRight", Vector3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.1), Vector3.new(0.35, y, -0.62), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
end

	elseif id == "frigo" then
		addPart(model, "FridgeDoor", Vector3.new(1.7, 1.9, 0.15), Vector3.new(0, 1.6, -0.65), Color3.fromRGB(207, 216, 220))
		addPart(model, "Handle", Vector3.new(0.18, 1.0, 0.18), Vector3.new(0.6, 1.7, -0.75), Color3.fromRGB(96, 125, 139))
	elseif id == "chimpanzini" then
		addPart(model, "Banana", Vector3.new(0.45, 1.6, 0.45), Vector3.new(0.9, 2.6, -0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 59))

		addPart(model, "Steam", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.8, 0.3), Vector3.new(0.3, 4.8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(224, 224, 224))

		addPart(model, "TentacleRight", Vector3.new(0.25, 1.3, 0.25), Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0), Color3.fromRGB(186, 104, 200))
		addPart(model, "TentacleMid", Vector3.new(0.25, 1.5, 0.25), Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(186, 104, 200))
	end
end

-- A glowing trim above the head for mutated characters, so a rare spawn
-- is visible from across the island at a glance.
local function addMutationTrim(model, mutationId)
	if mutationId == "normal" then
		return
	end
	local trimColor = BrainrotData.MutationColors[mutationId] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	local crown = addPart(model, "MutationTrim", Vector3.new(1.9, 0.3, 1.4), Vector3.new(0, 3.65, 0), trimColor, Enum.Material.Neon)
	crown.Transparency = 0.15
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "MutationLight"
	light.Color = trimColor
	light.Range = 6
	light.Brightness = 1.5
	light.Parent = crown
end

-- The name label every character wears: name, tier, and income per second.
local function addLabel(model, entry, mutationId)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "NameLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 56)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.6, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = model
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Title"
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	local income = BrainrotData.characterIncome(entry, mutationId)
	local tag = ""
	if mutationId ~= "normal" then
		tag = " [" .. string.upper(mutationId) .. "]"
	end
	label.Text = entry.name .. tag .. "\n" .. entry.tier .. " - $" .. tostring(income) .. "/s"
	label.Parent = gui
end

-- Build one character model. entry is a row from BrainrotData.Characters,
-- mutationId is "normal", "gold", "diamond" or "rainbow". The model is
-- parented nowhere; the caller places it.
function BrainrotModels.build(entry, mutationId)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = entry.id
	local body = addPart(model, "Body", Vector3.new(2.0, 2.4, 1.2), Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), entry.color)
	local head = addPart(model, "Head", Vector3.new(1.4, 1.2, 1.2), Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0), entry.color)
	addEyes(model, 3.1)
	addFeature(model, entry.id, entry.color)
	addMutationTrim(model, mutationId)
	addLabel(model, entry, mutationId)
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	return model
end

-- A golden-event character: the same model, but wrapped in gold — a gold
-- crown, a gold light, and a gold label, so it screams "rare" from afar.
function BrainrotModels.buildGolden(entry)
	local model = BrainrotModels.build(entry, "gold")
	model.Name = entry.id .. "_golden"
	local crown = addPart(model, "GoldenCrown", Vector3.new(2.1, 0.4, 1.5), Vector3.new(0, 3.7, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Enum.Material.Neon)

--[[
    DoorHinge.lua
    A servo-powered door with open/close state.

    Setup:
    - A door part with a HingeConstraint named "Hinge".
    - The hinge's Attachment0 should be on the door frame, Attachment1 on the door.
    - The hinge Axis should point up (rotation axis).
    - Keep the door assembly server-owned for authoritative collision; call
      :destroy() when the door is removed to clean up the servo state.

    Usage:
        local DoorHinge = require(path.to.DoorHinge)
        local door = DoorHinge.new(workspace.DoorModel.Hinge)
        door:open()
        door:close()
        door:destroy()
]]

local DoorHinge = {}
DoorHinge.__index = DoorHinge

type DoorHingeState = {
    hinge: HingeConstraint?,
    isOpen: boolean,
}

export type DoorHinge = typeof(setmetatable({} :: DoorHingeState, DoorHinge))

function DoorHinge.new(hinge: HingeConstraint): DoorHinge
    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            hinge = hinge,
            isOpen = false,
        } :: DoorHingeState,
        DoorHinge
    )
    hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
    hinge.ServoMaxTorque = 2000
    hinge.AngularSpeed = 3
    hinge.LimitsEnabled = true
    hinge.LowerAngle = 0
    hinge.UpperAngle = 90
    return self
end

function DoorHinge.open(self: DoorHinge)
    local hinge = self.hinge
    if not hinge then
        return
    end
    hinge.TargetAngle = hinge.UpperAngle
    self.isOpen = true
end

function DoorHinge.close(self: DoorHinge)
    local hinge = self.hinge
    if not hinge then
        return
    end
    hinge.TargetAngle = hinge.LowerAngle
    self.isOpen = false
end

function DoorHinge.toggle(self: DoorHinge)
    if self.isOpen then
        self:close()
    else
        self:open()
    end
end

function DoorHinge.destroy(self: DoorHinge)
    -- Release the servo so the hinge becomes passive after cleanup.
    local hinge = self.hinge
    if hinge then
        hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.None
    end
    self.hinge = nil
end

return DoorHinge

--!strict
-- In-memory stand-in for a DataStore with the same UpdateAsync contract.
-- Used in unpublished Studio places and in tests. Values are deep-copied on
-- the way in and out, like the real store's serialization, so callers cannot
-- mutate stored data by accident.

local MemoryStore = {}
MemoryStore.__index = MemoryStore

type State = {
	values: { [string]: any },
	failuresLeft: number,
	calls: number,
}

export type MemoryStore = typeof(setmetatable({} :: State, MemoryStore))

local function deepCopy(value: any): any
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in value do
		copy[deepCopy(k)] = deepCopy(v)
	end
	return copy
end

function MemoryStore.new(): MemoryStore
	return setmetatable({ values = {}, failuresLeft = 0, calls = 0 }, MemoryStore)
end

-- Makes the next n calls fail as if the service were down.
function MemoryStore.failNext(self: MemoryStore, n: number)
	self.failuresLeft = n
end

function MemoryStore.peek(self: MemoryStore, key: string): any
	return deepCopy(self.values[key])
end

function MemoryStore.update(self: MemoryStore, key: string, transform: (any) -> any): (boolean, any)
	self.calls += 1
	if self.failuresLeft > 0 then
		self.failuresLeft -= 1
		return false, "simulated DataStore outage"
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(transform, deepCopy(self.values[key]))
	if not ok then
		return false, result
	end
	if result == nil then
		-- Returning nil cancels the write, as with UpdateAsync.
		return true, nil
	end
	self.values[key] = deepCopy(result)
	return true, deepCopy(result)
end

return MemoryStore

-- Test coverage: no automated coverage

--[[
    PlatformMover.lua
    A moving platform using AlignPosition + AlignOrientation.

    Setup:
    - A platform part (must be unanchored for AlignPosition to simulate it).
    - An AlignPosition and AlignOrientation inside the platform.
    - Attachment0 on platform, Attachment1 optional (leave unset for world mode).
    - Configure AlignPosition.Mode = OneAttachment to use world Position.

    Usage:
        local PlatformMover = require(path.to.PlatformMover)
        local platform = PlatformMover.new(workspace.MovingPlatform, {
            workspace.PointA.Position,
            workspace.PointB.Position,
        }, 5)
        platform:start()
        platform:stop()
        platform:destroy()
]]

local PlatformMover = {}
PlatformMover.__index = PlatformMover

type PlatformMoverState = {
    platform: BasePart,
    waypoints: { Vector3 },
    waitTime: number,
    index: number,
    direction: number,
    running: boolean,
    delayTask: thread?,
    alignPos: AlignPosition?,
    alignOrn: AlignOrientation?,
}

export type PlatformMover = typeof(setmetatable({} :: PlatformMoverState, PlatformMover))

function PlatformMover.new(
    platform: BasePart,
    waypoints: { Vector3 }?,
    waitTime: number?
): PlatformMover
    -- AlignPosition cannot move an anchored assembly.
    platform.Anchored = false

    local alignPos = platform:FindFirstChildOfClass("AlignPosition")
        or Instance.new("AlignPosition")
    alignPos.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    alignPos.RigidityEnabled = false
    alignPos.MaxForce = platform.AssemblyMass * 1000
    alignPos.MaxVelocity = 20
    alignPos.Responsiveness = 20
    alignPos.Parent = platform

    local alignOrn = platform:FindFirstChildOfClass("AlignOrientation")
        or Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
    alignOrn.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    alignOrn.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
    alignOrn.RigidityEnabled = false
    alignOrn.MaxTorque = platform.AssemblyMass * 500
    alignOrn.MaxAngularVelocity = 5
    alignOrn.Responsiveness = 20
    alignOrn.CFrame = platform.CFrame.Rotation
    alignOrn.Parent = platform

    if not alignPos.Attachment0 then
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Parent = platform
        alignPos.Attachment0 = att
    end
    if not alignOrn.Attachment0 then
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Parent = platform
        alignOrn.Attachment0 = att
    end

    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            platform = platform,
            waypoints = waypoints or {},
            waitTime = waitTime or 2,
            index = 1,
            direction = 1,
            running = false,
            delayTask = nil :: thread?,
            alignPos = alignPos,
            alignOrn = alignOrn,
        } :: PlatformMoverState,
        PlatformMover
    )

    return self
end

function PlatformMover.moveToNext(self: PlatformMover)
    if #self.waypoints == 0 then
        return
    end

    local target = self.waypoints[self.index]
    local alignPos = self.alignPos
    if not alignPos then
        return
    end
    alignPos.Position = target

    self.delayTask = task.delay(self.waitTime, function()
        self.delayTask = nil
        if not self.running then
            return
        end
        self.index += self.direction
        if self.index > #self.waypoints then
            self.index = #self.waypoints - 1
            self.direction = -1
        elseif self.index < 1 then
            self.index = 2
            self.direction = 1
        end
        self:moveToNext()
    end)
end

function PlatformMover.start(self: PlatformMover)
    if self.running then
        return
    end
    self.running = true
    self:moveToNext()
end

function PlatformMover.stop(self: PlatformMover)
    self.running = false
    if self.delayTask then
        task.cancel(self.delayTask)
        self.delayTask = nil
    end
end

function PlatformMover.destroy(self: PlatformMover)
    self:stop()
    if self.alignPos then
        self.alignPos:Destroy()
        self.alignPos = nil
    end
    if self.alignOrn then
        self.alignOrn:Destroy()
        self.alignOrn = nil
    end
end

return PlatformMover

-- ConveyorService: the belt that supplies the whole game. A new character
-- rolls out every few seconds, rides the belt from one end to the other,
-- and despawns if nobody buys it. Clicking a character starts a purchase:
-- the model is reserved, MoneyService checks the cash, and BaseService
-- places it on a free stand. Every few minutes a Golden Brainrot appears —
-- five times the price and income of its tier, announced to everyone.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)
local BrainrotModels = require(script.Parent.BrainrotModels)

local ConveyorService = {}

-- One belt item: the model, its character entry, its mutation, its price,
-- whether it is a golden-event spawn, and whether a purchase is pending.
local active = {}

local function placeOnBelt(model, x, y)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, y, 0))
end

function ConveyorService.init(ctx)
	local world = ctx.world
	local events = ctx.events
	local remotes = ctx.remotes
	local beltY = world.conveyor.beltY
	local reserved = {}

	local function spawnOne(isGolden)
		local entry = BrainrotData.pickRandomCharacter()
		local mutationId = BrainrotData.rollMutation()
		local model
		local price = entry.price
		local income = entry.income
		if isGolden then
			model = BrainrotModels.buildGolden(entry)
			price = entry.price * BrainrotData.Golden.mult
			income = entry.income * BrainrotData.Golden.mult
		else
			model = BrainrotModels.build(entry, mutationId)
		end
		model.Parent = world.folder
		placeOnBelt(model, BrainrotData.Conveyor.minX, beltY)
		local record = {
			model = model,
			entry = entry,
			mutationId = mutationId,
			price = price,
			income = income,
			isGolden = isGolden,
		}
		table.insert(active, record)
		local detector = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
		detector.MaxActivationDistance = 32
		detector.Parent = model
		detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
			if reserved[model] then
				return
			end
			reserved[model] = true
			events.PurchaseRequested:Fire(player, entry, mutationId, price, model, isGolden)
		end)
		if isGolden then
			remotes.GoldenAnnounce:FireAllClients(entry.name, price)
		end
		return record
	end

	-- Public trigger so the admin service can spawn a golden on demand.
	-- The scheduled golden loop below keeps using spawnOne directly.
	ConveyorService.spawnGolden = function()
		spawnOne(true)
	end

	-- A single movement loop drives every item on the belt, so the belt
	-- never needs one thread per character.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.1)
			local dt = 0.1
			local step = BrainrotData.Conveyor.speed * dt
			for i = #active, 1, -1 do
				local record = active[i]
				local model = record.model
				if not model.Parent then
					table.remove(active, i)
				else
					local pos = model:GetPivot().Position
					local nextX = pos.X + step
					if nextX >= BrainrotData.Conveyor.maxX then
						model:Destroy()
						table.remove(active, i)
					else
						placeOnBelt(model, nextX, beltY)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Spawn loop: a fresh character every few seconds.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(BrainrotData.Conveyor.spawnInterval)
			spawnOne(false)
		end
	end)

	-- Golden Brainrot event: a rare golden character every few minutes.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(BrainrotData.Golden.interval)
			spawnOne(true)
		end
	end)

	-- When a purchase is approved, the model leaves the belt for good.
	events.PurchaseApproved.Event:Connect(function(_player, _entry, _mutationId, _price, model, _isGolden)
		reserved[model] = nil
		for i = #active, 1, -1 do
			if active[i].model == model then
				table.remove(active, i)
				break
			end
		end
	end)

	-- When a purchase is denied, the model goes back on sale on the belt.
	events.PurchaseDenied.Event:Connect(function(_player, _reason, model)
		if model then
			reserved[model] = nil
		end
	end)
end

return ConveyorService

--!strict
-- The saved player record and how to repair whatever comes out of the store.

local PlayerData = {}

PlayerData.VERSION = 1

export type Data = {
	version: number,
	coins: number,
	wins: number,
	roundsPlayed: number,
	bestWave: number,
	ownedTrails: { [string]: boolean },
	equippedTrail: string?,
}

function PlayerData.default(): Data
	return {
		version = PlayerData.VERSION,
		coins = 0,
		wins = 0,
		roundsPlayed = 0,
		bestWave = 0,
		ownedTrails = {},
		equippedTrail = nil,
	}
end

local function count(value: any): number
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value == math.huge then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, math.floor(value))
end

-- Accepts anything (nil for a new player, a record from an older version,
-- a corrupted value) and returns valid data. Never throws: a bad record must
-- not lock a player out of the game.
function PlayerData.reconcile(raw: any): Data
	local data = PlayerData.default()
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then
		return data
	end

	data.coins = count(raw.coins)
	data.wins = count(raw.wins)
	data.roundsPlayed = count(raw.roundsPlayed)
	data.bestWave = count(raw.bestWave)

	if type(raw.ownedTrails) == "table" then
		for id, owned in raw.ownedTrails do
			if type(id) == "string" and owned == true then
				data.ownedTrails[id] = true
			end
		end
	end

	local equipped = raw.equippedTrail
	if type(equipped) == "string" and data.ownedTrails[equipped] then
		data.equippedTrail = equipped
	end

	return data
end

return PlayerData

-- MerchantService: the travelling merchant by the dock. He sells three
-- characters at a time, at one and a quarter times their normal price, and
-- his stock rotates every ninety seconds — so a character you want may be
-- gone by the time you save up for it. Buying from him charges through
-- MoneyService and places the character on your first free stand, exactly
-- like a conveyor purchase.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)
local BrainrotModels = require(script.Parent.BrainrotModels)

local MerchantService = {}

local STOCK_SIZE = 3
local STOCK_INTERVAL = 90
local PRICE_MULT = 1.25

function MerchantService.init(ctx)
	local world = ctx.world
	local events = ctx.events
	local remotes = ctx.remotes

	local spot = world.merchantSpot
	local merchant = Instance.new("Model")
	merchant.Name = "Merchant"
	merchant.Parent = world.folder
	local function addPart(name, size, pos, color, material, shape)
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = name
		part.Size = size
		part.Position = pos
		part.Color = color
		part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		part.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.Parent = merchant
		return part
	end
	addPart("Body", Vector3.new(2.2, 2.6, 1.4), Vector3.new(spot.X, 1.3, spot.Z), Color3.fromRGB(121, 85, 72))
	addPart("Head", Vector3.new(1.5, 1.3, 1.3), Vector3.new(spot.X, 3.2, spot.Z), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 180))
	addPart("Apron", Vector3.new(1.8, 1.8, 0.3), Vector3.new(spot.X, 1.5, spot.Z - 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	addPart("Hat", Vector3.new(2.0, 0.5, 2.0), Vector3.new(spot.X, 4.1, spot.Z), Color3.fromRGB(255, 213, 79))
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "MerchantLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 40)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = merchant
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "MERCHANT"
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 213, 79)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Parent = gui

	-- The shop board next to the merchant lists the three items for sale.
	local board = Instance.new("Part")
	board.Name = "MerchantBoard"
	board.Size = Vector3.new(8, 6, 0.5)
	board.Position = Vector3.new(spot.X + 6, 3, spot.Z)
	board.Color = Color3.fromRGB(93, 64, 55)
	board.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	board.Anchored = true
	board.Parent = world.folder
	local boardGui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	boardGui.Name = "ShopGui"
	boardGui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	boardGui.Parent = board
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "ShopTitle"
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.25, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "MERCHANT SHOP"
	title.TextScaled = true
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 213, 79)
	title.Parent = boardGui

	local stock = {}
	local stockButtons = {}

	local function updateBoard()
		for i = 1, STOCK_SIZE do
			local line = boardGui:FindFirstChild("ShopLine" .. tostring(i))
			local entry = stock[i]
			if not line then
				line = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				line.Name = "ShopLine" .. tostring(i)
				line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.22, 0)
				line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.24 + (i - 1) * 0.22, 0)
				line.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				line.TextScaled = true
				line.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
				line.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				line.Parent = boardGui
			end
			if entry then
				local price = math.floor(entry.price * PRICE_MULT)
				line.Text = tostring(i) .. ". " .. entry.name .. " - $" .. tostring(price)
			else
				line.Text = tostring(i) .. ". ---"
			end
		end
	end

	local function rotateStock()
		stock = {}
		local pool = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotData.Characters) do
			table.insert(pool, entry)
		end
		for i = 1, STOCK_SIZE do
			if #pool == 0 then
				break
			end
			local pick = math.random(1, #pool)
			table.insert(stock, pool[pick])
			table.remove(pool, pick)
		end
		updateBoard()
		events.MerchantStockChanged:Fire(stock)
	end

	-- Three click pads in front of the merchant, one per stock slot.
	for i = 1, STOCK_SIZE do
		local pad = Instance.new("Part")
		pad.Name = "StockPad" .. tostring(i)
		pad.Size = Vector3.new(3, 0.5, 3)
		pad.Position = Vector3.new(spot.X - 3 + (i - 1) * 3, 0.75, spot.Z + 4)
		pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 213, 79)
		pad.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		pad.Anchored = true
		pad.CanCollide = false
		pad.Parent = world.folder
		stockButtons[i] = pad
		local detector = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
		detector.MaxActivationDistance = 24
		detector.Parent = pad
		detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
			local entry = stock[i]
			if not entry then
				return
			end
			local price = math.floor(entry.price * PRICE_MULT)
			events.ChargeRequested:Fire(player, price, "merchant", { entryId = entry.id, price = price })
		end)
	end

	-- When the charge clears, build the character and hand it to BaseService
	-- through the same approved-purchase path the conveyor uses.
	events.ChargeApproved.Event:Connect(function(player, purpose, payload)
		if purpose ~= "merchant" then
			return
		end
		local entry = BrainrotData.getCharacter(payload.entryId)
		if not entry then
			events.Refund:Fire(player, payload.price or 0)
			return
		end
		local model = BrainrotModels.build(entry, "normal")
		events.PurchaseApproved:Fire(player, entry, "normal", payload.price, model, false)
	end)

	rotateStock()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(STOCK_INTERVAL)
			rotateStock()
			remotes.Notify:FireAllClients("The merchant has new stock!")
		end
	end)
end

return MerchantService

-- deepCopy function
-- by @vuppyan

local Core = require("../Core")
type Map<K, V> = Core.Map<K, V>

local fail = Core.Errors.errorWithScope("Tables")

-- stop optimizations from inlining helpers that need to track call stack
local Internal = {}

function Internal.deepCopyImpl(
    t: Map<any, any>,
    visited: Map<Map<any, any>, Map<any, any>>,
    level: number
): Map<any, any>
    local copy = {}
    visited[t] = copy

    local mt = getmetatable(t)
    if mt ~= nil and type(mt) ~= "table" then
        fail("Cannot copy a table with a locked metatable", level, "deepCopy")
    end

    -- bypass a table's __iter with using next directly
    for key, value in next, t do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            copy[key] = visited[value]
                or Internal.deepCopyImpl(value, visited, level + 1)
        else
            copy[key] = value
        end
    end

    if type(mt) == "table" then
        setmetatable(copy, mt)
    end
    if table.isfrozen(t) then
        table.freeze(copy)
    end

    return copy :: Map<any, any>
end

--[=[
    Returns a deep copy of the given table.

    Table keys are shared with the original, not copied. Copies of frozen tables
    are also frozen. Metatables are shared with the original, not copied, and
    `__iter` metamethods are bypassed so every raw key/value pair is copied.

    If a non-table value is passed, it is returned as-is.

    @function deepCopy
    @within Tables
    @since v0.1.0
    @param tbl T -- The table to copy
    @return T -- The copied table
    @error "[Tables.deepCopy()]: Cannot copy a table with a locked metatable" -- Thrown if the table, or any table inside it, has a metatable locked with a non-table `__metatable` value. Tables locked with a table `__metatable` value are not detected, and their copy is given that `__metatable` value as its metatable instead of the real one
]=]
return function<T>(tbl: T): T
    return (
        if type(tbl) ~= "table" then tbl else Internal.deepCopyImpl(tbl, {}, 3)
    ) :: T
end

--[[
    VehicleController.lua
    A client-authoritative vehicle chassis with server-side validation.

    Setup:
    - Four wheels as cylinders or spheres, each connected to the chassis via
      HingeConstraints or bearings (do not rigidly weld drive wheels).
    - Two HingeConstraints for front wheels (steering).
    - Two HingeConstraints for drive wheels with Motor actuator.
    - A VehicleSeat parented to the chassis.

    Usage:
        local VehicleController = require(path.to.VehicleController)
        local controller = VehicleController.new(vehicleModel)
        controller:destroy() -- call when the vehicle is removed
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local VehicleController = {}
VehicleController.__index = VehicleController

export type VehicleControllerConfig = {
    maxSpeed: number?,
    turnAngle: number?,
    wheelRadius: number?,
    motorMaxTorque: number?,
    motorMaxAcceleration: number?,
    servoMaxTorque: number?,
    angularSpeed: number?,
}

type VehicleControllerState = {
    model: Model,
    seat: VehicleSeat,
    maxSpeed: number,
    turnAngle: number,
    wheelRadius: number,
    driveMotors: { HingeConstraint },
    steerHinges: { HingeConstraint },
    heartbeatConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
    validationConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
    occupantConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
}

export type VehicleController =
    typeof(setmetatable({} :: VehicleControllerState, VehicleController))

function VehicleController.new(model: Model, config: VehicleControllerConfig?): VehicleController
    local resolvedConfig: VehicleControllerConfig = config or {}
    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            model = model,
            seat = model:WaitForChild("VehicleSeat") :: VehicleSeat,
            maxSpeed = resolvedConfig.maxSpeed or 50,
            turnAngle = resolvedConfig.turnAngle or 30,
            wheelRadius = resolvedConfig.wheelRadius or 2,
            driveMotors = {} :: { HingeConstraint },
            steerHinges = {} :: { HingeConstraint },
            heartbeatConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
            validationConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
            occupantConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
        } :: VehicleControllerState,
        VehicleController
    )

    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("HingeConstraint") then
            if obj.Name == "DriveMotor" then
                obj.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Motor
                obj.MotorMaxTorque = resolvedConfig.motorMaxTorque or 5000
                obj.MotorMaxAcceleration = resolvedConfig.motorMaxAcceleration or 1500
                table.insert(self.driveMotors, obj)
            elseif obj.Name == "SteerHinge" then
                obj.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
                obj.ServoMaxTorque = resolvedConfig.servoMaxTorque or 5000
                obj.AngularSpeed = resolvedConfig.angularSpeed or 3
                table.insert(self.steerHinges, obj)
            end
        end
    end

    self:setupOwnership()
    self:startLoop()

    return self
end

function VehicleController.setupOwnership(self: VehicleController)
    self.occupantConnection = self.seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
        local humanoid = self.seat.Occupant
        if humanoid then
            local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
            if player then
                self.seat:SetNetworkOwner(player)
            end
        else
            self.seat:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
        end
    end)
end

function VehicleController.validateState(self: VehicleController)
    if not self.seat:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return
    end

    local assemblyMass = self.seat.AssemblyMass
    if assemblyMass == math.huge then
        return
    end

    -- Simple server-side sanity check: if the client-owned assembly moves
    -- much faster than the configured limit, revoke ownership to stop exploits.
    local speed = self.seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
    if speed > self.maxSpeed * 1.5 then
        self.seat:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
        for _, motor in ipairs(self.driveMotors) do
            motor.AngularVelocity = 0
        end
    end
end

function VehicleController.startLoop(self: VehicleController)
    self.heartbeatConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not self.seat:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            self:destroy()
            return
        end

        local steer = math.clamp(self.seat.Steer, -1, 1)
        local throttle = math.clamp(self.seat.Throttle, -1, 1)

        local targetAngle = -steer * self.turnAngle
        for _, hinge in ipairs(self.steerHinges) do
            hinge.TargetAngle = targetAngle
        end

        -- Convert linear speed (studs/s) to angular velocity (rad/s).
        local targetLinearVelocity = throttle * self.maxSpeed
        local targetAngularVelocity = targetLinearVelocity / self.wheelRadius
        for _, motor in ipairs(self.driveMotors) do
            motor.AngularVelocity = targetAngularVelocity
        end
    end)

    self.validationConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        self:validateState()
    end)
end

function VehicleController.destroy(self: VehicleController)
    if self.heartbeatConnection then
        self.heartbeatConnection:Disconnect()
        self.heartbeatConnection = nil
    end
    if self.validationConnection then
        self.validationConnection:Disconnect()
        self.validationConnection = nil
    end
    if self.occupantConnection then
        self.occupantConnection:Disconnect()
        self.occupantConnection = nil
    end

    for _, motor in ipairs(self.driveMotors) do
        motor.AngularVelocity = 0
    end
    for _, hinge in ipairs(self.steerHinges) do
        hinge.TargetAngle = 0
    end
end

return VehicleController

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local ArenaService = {}

local arena = Config.Arena
local ORIGIN = Vector3.new(arena.Origin[1], arena.Origin[2], arena.Origin[3])
local LOBBY = ORIGIN + Vector3.new(arena.LobbyOffset[1], arena.LobbyOffset[2], arena.LobbyOffset[3])
local NEUTRAL = Color3.fromRGB(arena.NeutralRgb[1], arena.NeutralRgb[2], arena.NeutralRgb[3])
local FADE = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local tiles: { Part } = {}
local letters: { TextLabel } = {}
local lobbySpawn: SpawnLocation

local function colorOf(index: number): Color3
	local rgb = Config.Colors[index].rgb
	return Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3])
end

local function part(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	for key, value in props do
		(p :: any)[key] = value
	end
	return p
end

local function buildLobby(folder: Folder)
	local size = LOBBY_SIZE
	local floor = part({
		Name = "LobbyFloor",
		Size = size,
		Position = LOBBY,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(52, 58, 72),
	})
	floor.Parent = folder

	-- Low glass walls so nobody walks off the lobby by accident.
	local wallHeight = 6
	local walls = {
		{ Vector3.new(size.X, wallHeight, 1), Vector3.new(0, wallHeight / 2 + 1, size.Z / 2) },
		{ Vector3.new(size.X, wallHeight, 1), Vector3.new(0, wallHeight / 2 + 1, -size.Z / 2) },
		{ Vector3.new(1, wallHeight, size.Z), Vector3.new(size.X / 2, wallHeight / 2 + 1, 0) },
		{ Vector3.new(1, wallHeight, size.Z), Vector3.new(-size.X / 2, wallHeight / 2 + 1, 0) },
	}
	for i, wall in walls do
		local p = part({
			Name = "LobbyWall" .. i,
			Size = wall[1],
			Position = LOBBY + wall[2],
			Transparency = 0.7,
			Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 220, 255),
		})
		p.Parent = folder
	end

	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name = "LobbySpawn"
	spawn.Anchored = true
	spawn.Neutral = true
	spawn.Duration = 0
	spawn.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
	spawn.Position = LOBBY + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	spawn.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0)
	spawn.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	spawn.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	spawn.Parent = folder
	lobbySpawn = spawn
end

local function buildGrid(folder: Folder)
	local n, s, gap = arena.GridSize, arena.TileSize, arena.TileGap
	local span = n * s + (n - 1) * gap
	local first = -span / 2 + s / 2

	for z = 0, n - 1 do
		for x = 0, n - 1 do
			local tile = part({
				Name = string.format("Tile_%d_%d", x, z),
				Size = Vector3.new(s, 2, s),
				Position = ORIGIN + Vector3.new(first + x * (s + gap), 0, first + z * (s + gap)),
				Color = NEUTRAL,
			})

			local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
			gui.LightInfluence = 0
			gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
			gui.PixelsPerStud = 25
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextScaled = true
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			label.TextTransparency = 0.45
			label.Text = ""
			label.Parent = gui
			gui.Parent = tile

			tile.Parent = folder
			tiles[z * n + x + 1] = tile
			letters[z * n + x + 1] = label
		end
	end
end

function ArenaService.build()
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Arena"
	buildLobby(folder)
	buildGrid(folder)
	folder.Parent = Workspace
end

local function show(index: number, color: Color3, letter: string)
	local tile = tiles[index]
	tile.Color = color
	tile.Transparency = 0
	tile.CanCollide = true
	tile.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	letters[index].Text = letter
	letters[index].TextTransparency = 0.45
end

function ArenaService.reset()
	for i in tiles do
		show(i, NEUTRAL, "")
	end
end

function ArenaService.applyLayout(layout: Pattern.Layout)
	for i, colorIndex in layout.cells do
		show(i, colorOf(colorIndex), Config.Colors[colorIndex].letter)
	end
end

function ArenaService.drop(layout: Pattern.Layout)
	for i, tile in tiles do
		if Pattern.isSafe(layout, i) then
			tile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		else
			tile.CanCollide = false
			TweenService:Create(tile, FADE, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			TweenService:Create(letters[i], FADE, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		end
	end
end

-- Height below which a character counts as fallen.
function ArenaService.killHeight(): number
	return ORIGIN.Y - arena.KillDepth
end

local function placeCharacter(player: Player, position: Vector3)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not root then
		return
	end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
end

function ArenaService.sendToTile(player: Player, index: number)
	placeCharacter(player, tiles[index].Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
end

function ArenaService.sendToLobby(player: Player)
	local jitter = Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), 0, math.random(-6, 6))
	placeCharacter(player, lobbySpawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) + jitter)
end

-- Where the leaderboard stands: just behind the lobby's back wall. Its Back
-- face (+Z) looks into the lobby.
function ArenaService.boardCFrame(): CFrame
	return CFrame.new(LOBBY + Vector3.new(0, 11, -(LOBBY_SIZE.Z / 2 + 1)))
end

function ArenaService.tileCount(): number
	return #tiles
end

return ArenaService
