--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
UIParticlePool.lua
Simple 2D UI particle pool using ImageLabels + TweenService.

Usage (client LocalScript or module):
local UIParticlePool = require(path.to.UIParticlePool)
local pool = UIParticlePool.new(parentFrame, { poolSize = 40 })

pool:emit({
    texture = "rbxassetid://...",
    count = 12,
    lifetime = 0.8,
    velocity = NumberRange.new(0.1, 0.2), -- scale units per second
    size = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.04),
    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100),
    spread = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),         -- random direction multiplier
})

Cleanup:
pool:destroy()
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

export type UIParticlePoolOptions = {
    poolSize: number?,
    maxActive: number?,
    zIndex: number?,
}

export type UIParticleConfig = {
    texture: string?,
    count: number?,
    lifetime: number?,
    velocity: NumberRange | number?, -- scale units per second
    size: UDim2?,
    color: Color3?,
    spread: Vector2?,
    origin: UDim2?,
    startTransparency: number?,
    endTransparency: number?,
    rotation: number?,
    spin: number?,
}

local UIParticlePool = {}
UIParticlePool.__index = UIParticlePool

export type UIParticlePool = typeof(setmetatable(
    {} :: {
        _parent: GuiObject?,
        _pool: { ImageLabel },
        _active: { [ImageLabel]: boolean },
        _tweens: { [ImageLabel]: Tween },
        _connections: { [Tween]: RBXScriptConnection },
        _maxActive: number,
        _zIndex: number,
        _activeCount: number,
        _destroyed: boolean,
    },
    UIParticlePool
))

local function randomInRange(range: NumberRange | number): number
    if typeof(range) == "NumberRange" then
        return range.Min + math.random() * (range.Max - range.Min)
    end
    return range
end

local function createLabel(parent: GuiObject, zIndex: number): ImageLabel
    local label = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Visible = false
    label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    label.ZIndex = zIndex
    label.Parent = parent
    return label
end

function UIParticlePool.new(parent: GuiObject, options: UIParticlePoolOptions?): UIParticlePool
    assert(
        typeof(parent) == "Instance" and parent:IsA("GuiObject"),
        "UIParticlePool.new expects a GuiObject parent"
    )
    local resolvedOptions: UIParticlePoolOptions = options or {}

    local self = setmetatable({}, UIParticlePool) :: UIParticlePool
    self._parent = parent
    self._pool = {}
    self._active = {}
    self._tweens = {}
    self._connections = {}
    self._maxActive = resolvedOptions.maxActive or 80
    self._zIndex = resolvedOptions.zIndex or 10
    self._activeCount = 0
    self._destroyed = false

    local initialSize = resolvedOptions.poolSize or math.max(30, self._maxActive)
    initialSize = math.min(initialSize, self._maxActive)

    for _ = 1, initialSize do
        table.insert(self._pool, createLabel(parent, self._zIndex))
    end

    return self
end

function UIParticlePool._acquire(self: UIParticlePool): ImageLabel?
    for _, label in ipairs(self._pool) do
        if not self._active[label] then
            return label
        end
    end

    if #self._pool < self._maxActive then
        local parent = self._parent
        assert(parent, "Cannot acquire a particle from a destroyed UIParticlePool")
        local label = createLabel(parent, self._zIndex)
        table.insert(self._pool, label)
        return label
    end

    return nil
end

function UIParticlePool._cleanupTween(self: UIParticlePool, label: ImageLabel)
    local tween = self._tweens[label]
    if tween then
        local conn = self._connections[tween]
        if conn then
            conn:Disconnect()
            self._connections[tween] = nil
        end
        tween:Cancel()
        self._tweens[label] = nil
    end
end

function UIParticlePool._release(self: UIParticlePool, label: ImageLabel)
    self:_cleanupTween(label)
    if self._active[label] then
        self._active[label] = nil
        self._activeCount -= 1
    end
    label.Visible = false
    label.Image = ""
end

function UIParticlePool.emit(self: UIParticlePool, config: UIParticleConfig?)
    assert(not self._destroyed, "Cannot emit from a destroyed UIParticlePool")
    local resolvedConfig: UIParticleConfig = config or {}

    local count = math.min(resolvedConfig.count or 10, self._maxActive - self._activeCount)
    if count <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local texture = resolvedConfig.texture or ""
    local lifetime = resolvedConfig.lifetime or 0.6
    local size = resolvedConfig.size or UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.05)
    local color = resolvedConfig.color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local spread = resolvedConfig.spread or Vector2.new(1, 1)
    local origin = resolvedConfig.origin or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    local velocityRange = resolvedConfig.velocity or NumberRange.new(0.1, 0.2)
    local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(lifetime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

    for _ = 1, count do
        local label = self:_acquire()
        if not label then
            break
        end

        self._active[label] = true
        self._activeCount += 1

        label.Image = texture
        label.ImageColor3 = color
        label.ImageTransparency = resolvedConfig.startTransparency or 0
        label.Rotation = resolvedConfig.rotation or math.random(0, 360)
        label.Size = size
        label.Position = origin
        label.Visible = true

        local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local speed = randomInRange(velocityRange)
        local distance = speed * lifetime

        local offset = UDim2.fromScale(
            spread.X * math.cos(angle) * distance,
            spread.Y * math.sin(angle) * distance
        )
        local goal = {
            Position = origin + offset,
            ImageTransparency = resolvedConfig.endTransparency or 1,
            Rotation = label.Rotation + (resolvedConfig.spin or math.random(-90, 90)),
        }

        local tween = TweenService:Create(label, fadeInfo, goal)
        self._tweens[label] = tween
        self._connections[tween] = tween.Completed:Once(function()
            self:_release(label)
        end)
        tween:Play()
    end
end

function UIParticlePool.destroy(self: UIParticlePool)
    self._destroyed = true

    for _, label in ipairs(self._pool) do
        self:_cleanupTween(label)
        label:Destroy()
    end

    table.clear(self._pool)
    table.clear(self._active)
    table.clear(self._tweens)
    table.clear(self._connections)
    self._activeCount = 0
    self._parent = nil
end

return UIParticlePool

-- BrainrotData: single source of truth for every tuning value in Brainrot Blitz.
-- Pure data plus pure helper functions. No service depends on this module's
-- callers, and this module depends on nobody, so requiring it can never cycle.
-- Every price, chance, timer and position the game uses lives here, in one
-- place, so the services can never disagree about the rules.

local BrainrotData = {}

-- Sixteen characters, cheapest first. Five rarities. Prices and incomes climb
-- with tier: Common costs tens and earns a few per second, Mythic costs
-- tens of thousands and earns over a thousand per second. Each entry carries
-- its own body colour and a one-line caption for the in-game label.
BrainrotData.Characters = {
	{ id = "tungtung", name = "Tung Tung Tung Sahur", tier = "Common", price = 40, income = 2, color = Color3.fromRGB(139, 90, 43), caption = "The log that knocks three times." },

}

	gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0),
	diamond = Color3.fromRGB(185, 242, 255),

-- then a new wave every 54 seconds.

-- worth five times a normal character of the same tier.
BrainrotData.Golden = { interval = 240, mult = 5 }

-- Selling returns half the buy price. Rebirth costs 12000 times (rebirths + 1)
-- and adds 50% income; every 5 rebirths add another 25% permanent milestone.
BrainrotData.Economy = {
	startCash = 150,
	startStands = 4,
	maxStands = 10,
	sellFraction = 0.5,
	rebirthBase = 12000,
	rebirthBoost = 0.5,
	milestoneEvery = 5,
	milestoneBoost = 0.25,
}

	Vector3.new(82, 0, 0),

}

	"Default",
	"Players",
	"Brainrots",
	"Shield",
	"Stands",
	"Conveyor",
	"Water",
	"Decor",
	"Bases",
	"Merchant",
	"Carry",
	"Wave",
	"Props",
}

-- Pure helpers below. They take numbers and return numbers, so any service
-- can call them without touching game state.

function BrainrotData.getCharacter(id)
	for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotData.Characters) do
		if entry.id == id then
			return entry
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function BrainrotData.getCharactersByTier(tier)
	local out = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotData.Characters) do
		if entry.tier == tier then
			table.insert(out, entry)
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Roll a mutation by its chances. Returns the mutation id.
function BrainrotData.rollMutation()
	local roll = math.random()
	local acc = 0
	for _, m in ipairs(BrainrotData.Mutations) do
		acc += m.chance
		if roll <= acc then
			return m.id
		end
	end
	return "normal"
end

function BrainrotData.mutationMult(id)
	for _, m in ipairs(BrainrotData.Mutations) do
		if m.id == id then
			return m.mult
		end
	end
	return 1
end

-- Income of one placed character, after its mutation multiplier.
function BrainrotData.characterIncome(entry, mutationId)
	return entry.income * BrainrotData.mutationMult(mutationId)
end

-- Rebirth price grows with the number of rebirths already done.
function BrainrotData.rebirthCost(rebirths)
	return BrainrotData.Economy.rebirthBase * (rebirths + 1)
end

-- Milestone bonus: +25% for every full set of 5 rebirths.
function BrainrotData.milestoneBonus(rebirths)
	return math.floor(rebirths / BrainrotData.Economy.milestoneEvery) * BrainrotData.Economy.milestoneBoost
end

-- Total income multiplier from rebirths and milestones.
function BrainrotData.incomeMultiplier(rebirths)
	return 1 + rebirths * BrainrotData.Economy.rebirthBoost + BrainrotData.milestoneBonus(rebirths)
end

-- Stand upgrade price rises with the square of the target stand count.
function BrainrotData.upgradeCost(currentStands)
	local target = currentStands + 1
	return 100 * target * target
end

-- Weighted random pick: cheaper tiers show up far more often than Mythic.
function BrainrotData.pickRandomCharacter()
	local weights = { Common = 45, Rare = 30, Epic = 15, Legendary = 7, Mythic = 3 }
	local total = 0
	for _, w in pairs(weights) do
		total += w
	end
	local roll = math.random() * total
	local acc = 0
	local chosenTier = "Common"
	for tier, w in pairs(weights) do
		acc += w
		if roll <= acc then
			chosenTier = tier
			break
		end
	end
	local pool = BrainrotData.getCharactersByTier(chosenTier)
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

return BrainrotData

--!strict
-- Server entry point: wires the data layer, then starts every service.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local DataService = require(script.Data.DataService)
local PlayerData = require(script.Data.PlayerData)
local RobloxStore = require(script.Data.RobloxStore)
local LeaderboardService = require(script.Services.LeaderboardService)
local Profiles = require(script.Services.Profiles)
local RoundService = require(script.Services.RoundService)
local ShopService = require(script.Services.ShopService)
local TrailService = require(script.Services.TrailService)

local store, persistent = RobloxStore.open(Config.Data.StoreName)
local cfg = Config.Data

Profiles.init(DataService.new({
	store = store,
	schema = PlayerData,
	-- JobId is empty in Studio; any unique string works as long as it is
	-- stable for this server's lifetime.
	jobId = if game.JobId ~= "" then game.JobId else "studio-" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1e9)),
	now = os.time,
	wait = function(seconds: number)
		task.wait(seconds)
	end,
	log = function(message: string)
		warn("[Data] " .. message)
	end,
	keyPrefix = cfg.KeyPrefix,
	lockTimeoutSeconds = cfg.LockTimeoutSeconds,
	lockWaitAttempts = cfg.LockWaitAttempts,
	lockWaitSeconds = cfg.LockWaitSeconds,
	maxRetries = cfg.MaxRetries,
	retryBaseSeconds = cfg.RetryBaseSeconds,
}))

TrailService.start()
ShopService.start()
RoundService.start()
LeaderboardService.start()

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	Profiles.load(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	Profiles.release(player)
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(cfg.AutosaveSeconds)
		Profiles.saveAll(false)
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	task.spawn(LeaderboardService.flush)
	Profiles.saveAll(true)
end)

if not persistent then
	warn("[Data] Running without a DataStore: publish the place and enable API access to keep progress.")
end

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
    EffectBurst.lua

    Clone-and-destroy helper for one-shot particle bursts.

    Given a template ParticleEmitter (or a BasePart/Attachment that contains
    emitters), this module clones the emitters, parents them, emits a burst,
    and automatically cleans them up after the longest possible lifetime.

    Why clone-and-destroy?
    - The shared live emitter is never mutated, so there is no race condition
      between bursts and no gap in continuous emitters.
    - One-shot effects become self-contained instances that can outlive their
      caller and be destroyed safely when finished.

    Most one-shot effects should be emitted on the client only. Spawn the
    clone locally and call :Emit() from a LocalScript/Client module. This
    avoids replicating individual particles across the network and keeps
    authoritative ownership simple: the server tells the client *that* an
    effect happened (e.g. via a remote event); the client decides *how* to
    render it.

    Example:
        local EffectBurst = require(path.to.EffectBurst)
        EffectBurst.emitFrom(templateAttachment, {
            count = 25,
            clear = true, -- clear any existing particles before bursting
        })
]]

export type BurstConfig = {
    count: number?,
    clear: boolean?,
    parent: Instance?,
}

local DEFAULT_CONFIG: BurstConfig = {
    count = 20,
    clear = false,
}

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local function getMaxLifetime(emitter: ParticleEmitter): number
    local lifetime = emitter.Lifetime
    if typeof(lifetime) == "NumberRange" then
        return lifetime.Max
    end
    return tonumber(lifetime) or 1
end

local function cloneAndBurst(templateEmitter: ParticleEmitter, config: BurstConfig): ParticleEmitter
    local clone: ParticleEmitter = templateEmitter:Clone()
    clone.Name ..= "_Burst"
    clone.Enabled = false
    clone.Rate = 0

    local burstParent = config.parent or templateEmitter.Parent
    if burstParent then
        clone.Parent = burstParent
    end

    if config.clear then
        clone:Clear()
    end

    local count = config.count or DEFAULT_CONFIG.count
    clone:Emit(count)

    local maxLifetime = getMaxLifetime(clone)
    Debris:AddItem(clone, maxLifetime)

    return clone
end

local function findTemplates(parent: Instance): { ParticleEmitter }
    local templates: { ParticleEmitter } = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            table.insert(templates, child)
        end
    end
    return templates
end

local EffectBurst = {}

-- Emit from every ParticleEmitter found inside `parent`.
function EffectBurst.emitFrom(parent: Instance?, config: BurstConfig?): { ParticleEmitter }
    local resolvedConfig = config or DEFAULT_CONFIG
    local clones: { ParticleEmitter } = {}

    if not parent then
        return clones
    end

    local templates = findTemplates(parent)
    for _, templateEmitter in ipairs(templates) do
        local clone = cloneAndBurst(templateEmitter, resolvedConfig)
        table.insert(clones, clone)
    end

    return clones
end

-- Emit from a single ParticleEmitter template.
function EffectBurst.emitFromEmitter(
    templateEmitter: ParticleEmitter?,
    config: BurstConfig?
): ParticleEmitter?
    if not templateEmitter then
        return nil
    end

    local resolvedConfig = config or DEFAULT_CONFIG

--!strict
-- Builds the colored tile layout for one wave.

local Pattern = {}

export type Layout = {
	size: number,
	-- Row-major: index = z * size + x + 1.
	cells: { number },
	target: number,
	colors: number,
}

export type Options = {
	size: number,
	colors: number,
	-- Side length of the square patches that share one color. Big patches
	-- are easy to read, single tiles are a scramble.
	patch: number,
	minTargetShare: number,
	maxTargetShare: number,
}

-- Uniform integer in [min, max]. A plain function keeps this module free of
-- any particular generator.
export type RandInt = (min: number, max: number) -> number

function Pattern.count(cells: { number }, color: number): number
	local n = 0
	for _, c in cells do
		if c == color then
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return n
end

local function indicesWhere(cells: { number }, predicate: (number) -> boolean): { number }
	local out = {}
	for i, c in cells do
		if predicate(c) then
			table.insert(out, i)
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function shuffle(randInt: RandInt, list: { number })
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = randInt(1, i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

function Pattern.generate(randInt: RandInt, options: Options): Layout
	local size, colors, patch = options.size, options.colors, options.patch
	assert(size >= 2, "grid too small")
	assert(colors >= 2, "need at least two colors")
	assert(patch >= 1, "patch must be >= 1")
	assert(options.minTargetShare <= options.maxTargetShare, "min share above max share")

	local patchesPerRow = math.ceil(size / patch)
	local patchColors = table.create(patchesPerRow * patchesPerRow, 0)
	for i = 1, patchesPerRow * patchesPerRow do
		patchColors[i] = randInt(1, colors)
	end

	local total = size * size
	local cells = table.create(total, 0)
	for z = 0, size - 1 do
		for x = 0, size - 1 do
			local p = (z // patch) * patchesPerRow + (x // patch) + 1
			cells[z * size + x + 1] = patchColors[p]
		end
	end

	local target = randInt(1, colors)

	-- Random patches can leave almost no safe ground, or almost no danger.
	-- Clamp the safe share so every wave is survivable and still a threat.
	local minSafe = math.max(1, math.ceil(total * options.minTargetShare))
	local maxSafe = math.max(minSafe, math.floor(total * options.maxTargetShare))
	local safe = Pattern.count(cells, target)

	if safe < minSafe then
		local others = indicesWhere(cells, function(c)
			return c ~= target
		end)
		shuffle(randInt, others)
		for k = 1, minSafe - safe do
			cells[others[k]] = target
		end
	elseif safe > maxSafe then
		local targets = indicesWhere(cells, function(c)
			return c == target
		end)
		shuffle(randInt, targets)
		for k = 1, safe - maxSafe do
			-- Any color but the target: shift by 1..colors-1 and wrap.
			cells[targets[k]] = (target - 1 + randInt(1, colors - 1)) % colors + 1
		end
	end

	return {
		size = size,
		cells = cells,
		target = target,
		colors = colors,
	}
end

function Pattern.isSafe(layout: Layout, index: number): boolean
	return layout.cells[index] == layout.target
end

return Pattern

--!strict
-- Token bucket per key, for throttling remote calls from clients.

local RateLimiter = {}
RateLimiter.__index = RateLimiter

type Bucket = { tokens: number, at: number }

type State = {
	rate: number,
	burst: number,
	now: () -> number,
	buckets: { [any]: Bucket },
}

export type RateLimiter = typeof(setmetatable({} :: State, RateLimiter))

function RateLimiter.new(rate: number, burst: number, now: () -> number): RateLimiter
	assert(rate > 0 and burst >= 1, "invalid limits")
	return setmetatable({ rate = rate, burst = burst, now = now, buckets = {} }, RateLimiter)
end

function RateLimiter.allow(self: RateLimiter, key: any): boolean
	local t = self.now()
	local bucket = self.buckets[key]
	if not bucket then
		bucket = { tokens = self.burst, at = t }
		self.buckets[key] = bucket
	end
	bucket.tokens = math.min(self.burst, bucket.tokens + (t - bucket.at) * self.rate)
	bucket.at = t
	if bucket.tokens < 1 then
		return false
	end
	bucket.tokens -= 1
	return true
end

function RateLimiter.forget(self: RateLimiter, key: any)
	self.buckets[key] = nil
end

return RateLimiter

-- CarryPose: raises both arms while the player carries a brainrot, and
-- puts them back down when the carry ends. Carrying is detected by the
-- CarryWeld the server puts on the carried model: its Part0 is the
-- carrier's HumanoidRootPart.

local CarryPose = {}

-- Find the shoulder joints of a character (R6 and R15 both) and remember
-- their resting angles.
local function findShoulders(character)
	local torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	if torso == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(torso:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Motor6D") and (child.Name == "Left Shoulder" or child.Name == "Right Shoulder" or child.Name == "LeftShoulder" or child.Name == "RightShoulder") then
			out[child.Name] = { joint = child, rest = child.C0 }
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Is this character carrying a brainrot right now? The carried model
-- lives under the island and carries a CarryWeld pointing at the root.
local function isCarrying(character)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root == nil then
		return false
	end
	local island = workspace:FindFirstChild("Island")
	if island == nil then
		return false
	end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(island:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("Weld") and descendant.Name == "CarryWeld" and descendant.Part0 == root then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Raise both arms forward, as if holding something up in front.
local function raise(shoulders)
	for name, entry in pairs(shoulders) do
		local joint = entry.joint
		if name:find("Left") then
			joint.C0 = entry.rest * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-120))
		else
			joint.C0 = entry.rest * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(120))
		end
	end
end

-- Put the arms back where they were.
local function lower(shoulders)
	for _, entry in pairs(shoulders) do
		entry.joint.C0 = entry.rest
	end
end

-- Watch one character: check the carry state a few times a second and
-- pose the arms to match.
local function watchCharacter(character)
	local shoulders = findShoulders(character)
	if next(shoulders) == nil then
		return
	end
	local raised = false
	task.spawn(function()
		while character.Parent ~= nil do
			local carrying = isCarrying(character)
			if carrying and not raised then
				raise(shoulders)
				raised = true
			elseif not carrying and raised then
				lower(shoulders)
				raised = false
			end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		if raised then
			lower(shoulders)
		end
	end)
end

-- Watch the player's character, now and on every respawn.
function CarryPose.watch(player)
	local function onCharacter(character)
		task.wait(0.5)
		watchCharacter(character)
	end
	if player.Character then
		onCharacter(player.Character)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
end

return CarryPose

--!strict
-- Coins and stats earned in one round.

local Rewards = {}

export type Rules = {
	PerWave: number,
	Participation: number,
	WinBonus: number,
}

export type Payout = {
	coins: number,
	won: boolean,
	wavesSurvived: number,
}

function Rewards.compute(
	rules: Rules,
	participants: { number },
	survived: { [number]: number },
	winners: { number }
): { [number]: Payout }
	local winnerSet: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	for _, userId in winners do
		winnerSet[userId] = true
	end

	local payouts: { [number]: Payout } = {}
	for _, userId in participants do
		local waves = survived[userId] or 0
		local won = winnerSet[userId] == true
		payouts[userId] = {
			coins = rules.Participation + waves * rules.PerWave + (if won then rules.WinBonus else 0),
			won = won,
			wavesSurvived = waves,
		}
	end
	return payouts
end

return Rewards

-- Game.client: the client entry point. It builds the HUD (cash, income,
-- rebirths), the shield and menu buttons, the tsunami warning banner, and
-- a short camera sweep over the island when the player first spawns.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Menu = require(script.Parent.Menu)
local CarryPose = require(script.Parent.CarryPose)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- The HUD: a top bar with the numbers that matter.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Name = "BlitzHUD"
screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
screen.Parent = playerGui

local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
bar.Name = "TopBar"
bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56)
bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15

local function statLabel(name, x, text, color)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

end

local cashLabel = statLabel("Cash", 12, "Cash: $0", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90))
local incomeLabel = statLabel("Income", 190, "Income: $0/s", Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 120))

-- The shield button: raises the shield, then shows its cooldown.
local shieldButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
shieldButton.Name = "ShieldButton"
shieldButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 40)
shieldButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -330, 0, 8)
shieldButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 220)
shieldButton.Text = "SHIELD"
shieldButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
shieldButton.TextScaled = true
shieldButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
shieldButton.Parent = bar

-- The menu button: opens rebirth and the character index.
local menuButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
menuButton.Name = "MenuButton"
menuButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 40)
menuButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 8)
menuButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 160)
menuButton.Text = "MENU"
menuButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
menuButton.TextScaled = true
menuButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
menuButton.Parent = bar

-- The tsunami banner: hidden until a wave is announced.
local banner = Instance.new("TextLabel")
banner.Name = "WaveBanner"
banner.Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 64)
banner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -260, 0, 70)
banner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 30)
banner.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
banner.Text = ""
banner.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
banner.TextScaled = true
banner.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
banner.Visible = false
banner.Parent = screen

-- Keep the numbers in step with the server's leaderstats.
local function bindStats()
	local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
	local cashValue = stats:WaitForChild("Cash")
	local incomeValue = stats:WaitForChild("Income")
	local rebirthValue = stats:WaitForChild("Rebirths")
	local function refresh()
		cashLabel.Text = "Cash: $" .. tostring(cashValue.Value)
		incomeLabel.Text = "Income: $" .. tostring(incomeValue.Value) .. "/s"
		rebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirths: " .. tostring(rebirthValue.Value)
	end
	cashValue.Changed:Connect(refresh)
	incomeValue.Changed:Connect(refresh)
	rebirthValue.Changed:Connect(refresh)
	refresh()
end

-- The shield button: fire the raise remote, then count the full cycle
-- (twenty-six seconds up, forty-eight cooling down) on the button itself.
local shieldCooling = false
local function onShield()
	if shieldCooling then
		return
	end
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RaiseShield")
	remote:FireServer()
	shieldCooling = true
	task.spawn(function()
		for left = 74, 1, -1 do
			shieldButton.Text = "SHIELD " .. tostring(left) .. "s"
			task.wait(1)
		end
		shieldButton.Text = "SHIELD"
		shieldCooling = false
	end)
end
shieldButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onShield)

-- The menu button and the B key both toggle the menu.
menuButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Menu.toggle()
end)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then
		Menu.toggle()
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
		onShield()
	end
end)

-- The tsunami remote drives the warning banner.
local tsunami = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Tsunami")
tsunami.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, seconds)
	if kind == "warn" then
		banner.Visible = true
		banner.Text = "TSUNAMI IN " .. tostring(seconds) .. "s - GET TO HIGH GROUND!"
		task.spawn(function()
			for left = seconds, 1, -1 do
				if not banner.Visible then
					return
				end
				banner.Text = "TSUNAMI IN " .. tostring(left) .. "s - GET TO HIGH GROUND!"
				task.wait(1)
			end
		end)
	elseif kind == "sweep" then
		banner.Visible = true
		banner.Text = "WAVE! STAY HIGH!"
	elseif kind == "clear" then
		banner.Visible = false
		banner.Text = ""
	end
end)

-- The merchant stock is handed to the menu whenever it turns over.
local merchantStock = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MerchantStock")
merchantStock.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	Menu.setMerchantStock(payload)
end)

-- The carry pose: arms up whenever the player is carrying a brainrot.
CarryPose.watch(player)

-- A short camera sweep over the island on first spawn, then the normal
-- camera takes over. Any failure leaves the default camera alone.
local function introCamera()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera == nil then
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local ok = pcall(function()
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 90, 120) * CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 90, 120), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
		local tween = TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 14, 22), root.Position),
		})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		camera.CameraSubject = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	end)
	if not ok then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	end
end

bindStats()
task.spawn(introCamera)

--!strict
-- Seeded xorshift32. Roblox's Random would do in game, but a pure-Luau
-- generator lets the same seed reproduce a layout in tests outside Roblox.

local Rng = {}
Rng.__index = Rng

export type Rng = typeof(setmetatable({} :: { state: number }, Rng))

local TWO_32 = 4294967296

function Rng.new(seed: number): Rng
	local state = math.floor(seed) % TWO_32
	if state == 0 then
		-- xorshift never leaves the all-zero state.
		state = 0x9E3779B9
	end
	return setmetatable({ state = state }, Rng)
end

function Rng.nextU32(self: Rng): number
	local x = self.state
	x = bit32.bxor(x, bit32.lshift(x, 13))
	x = bit32.bxor(x, bit32.rshift(x, 17))
	x = bit32.bxor(x, bit32.lshift(x, 5))
	self.state = x
	return x
end

-- Uniform integer in [min, max], both inclusive.
function Rng.nextInt(self: Rng, min: number, max: number): number
	assert(max >= min, "max must be >= min")
	return min + self:nextU32() % (max - min + 1)
end

-- Uniform number in [0, 1).
function Rng.nextNumber(self: Rng): number
	return self:nextU32() / TWO_32
end

function Rng.shuffle<T>(self: Rng, list: { T })
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = self:nextInt(1, i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

return Rng

-- Menu: the rebirth menu, the character index, the merchant stall and the
-- sell grid, all in one panel the player opens with the MENU button or B.
-- The index reads the shared character data; rebirth and selling go to the
-- server through remotes, which validate everything.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local BrainrotData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.BrainrotData)

local Menu = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local panel = nil
local merchantList = nil
local merchantStock = {}

-- A section heading inside the panel.
local function heading(parent, text, y)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, y)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

-- A button row: a label on the left, a button on the right.
local function rowButton(parent, text, buttonText, y, onClick)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 34)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, y)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = parent
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 34)
	button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, y)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 90)
	button.Text = buttonText
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	button.Parent = parent
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick)
	return button
end

-- Build the panel once. Sections: rebirth, merchant, character index,
-- and the sell grid.
local function buildPanel()
	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "BlitzMenu"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.Parent = playerGui

	panel = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	panel.Name = "Panel"
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 460, 0, 520)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -230, 0.5, -260)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	panel.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	panel.Parent = screen

	local y = 10
	heading(panel, "REBIRTH", y)
	y += 34
	local rebirthLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	rebirthLabel.Name = "RebirthInfo"
	rebirthLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
	rebirthLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, y)
	rebirthLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rebirthLabel.Text = ""
	rebirthLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	rebirthLabel.TextScaled = true
	rebirthLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	rebirthLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	rebirthLabel.Parent = panel
	y += 34
	rowButton(panel, "Rebirth: +50% income forever", "REBIRTH", y, function()
		ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Rebirth"):FireServer()
	end)
	y += 44

	heading(panel, "MERCHANT", y)
	y += 34
	merchantList = Instance.new("Frame")
	merchantList.Name = "MerchantList"
	merchantList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 120)
	merchantList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, y)
	merchantList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	merchantList.Parent = panel
	y += 130

	heading(panel, "CHARACTER INDEX", y)
	y += 34
	for _, char in ipairs(BrainrotData.Characters) do
		local line = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26)
		line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, y)
		line.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		line.Text = char.name .. "  •  " .. char.tier .. "  •  $" .. tostring(char.price) .. "  •  $" .. tostring(char.income) .. "/s"
		line.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
		line.TextScaled = true
		line.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		line.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		line.Parent = panel
		y += 28
	end
	y += 8

	heading(panel, "SELL (your stands)", y)
	y += 34
	for stand = 1, 8 do
		rowButton(panel, "Stand " .. tostring(stand) .. " - sell for half price", "SELL", y, function()
			ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SellBrainrot"):FireServer(stand)
		end)
		y += 38
	end

	panel.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y + 10)

	-- Keep the rebirth line honest: it shows the next cost from the
	-- player's current rebirth count.
	local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
	local rebirthsValue = stats:WaitForChild("Rebirths")
	local function refreshRebirth()
		local count = rebirthsValue.Value
		rebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirths: " .. tostring(count) .. "  •  next costs $" .. tostring(BrainrotData.rebirthCost(count))
	end
	rebirthsValue.Changed:Connect(refreshRebirth)
	refreshRebirth()
end

-- Refresh the merchant rows from the latest stock.
local function refreshMerchant()
	if merchantList == nil then
		return
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(merchantList:GetChildren()) do
		child:Destroy()
	end
	local y = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(merchantStock) do
		local char = BrainrotData.byId(entry.id)
		if char ~= nil then
			rowButton(merchantList, char.name .. "  •  $" .. tostring(entry.price), "BUY", y, function()
				ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyMerchant"):FireServer(entry.id)
			end)
			y += 38
		end
	end
end

-- The server turns the merchant stock over; the menu shows the new one.
function Menu.setMerchantStock(payload)
	merchantStock = payload or {}
	refreshMerchant()
end

-- Show or hide the panel.
function Menu.toggle()
	if panel == nil then
		buildPanel()
	end
	panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
end

return Menu

--!strict
-- The whole round flow as a pure state machine. It never touches Roblox:
-- the server feeds it time and eliminations, and acts on the effects it
-- returns. That keeps every rule testable, including a fuzz test that plays
-- thousands of rounds outside Studio.

local RoundMachine = {}
RoundMachine.__index = RoundMachine

export type Phase = "Waiting" | "Intermission" | "Warning" | "Dropped" | "RoundOver"

export type WaveRules = {
	StartWarnSeconds: number,
	MinWarnSeconds: number,
	WarnDecaySeconds: number,
	StartColors: number,
	MaxColors: number,
	ColorsEvery: number,
	MaxWaves: number,
}

export type Settings = {
	MinPlayers: number,
	IntermissionSeconds: number,
	RoundOverSeconds: number,
	DropSeconds: number,
	Waves: WaveRules,
}

export type WaveSettings = {
	warnSeconds: number,
	colors: number,
	patch: number,
}

export type Effect =
	{ kind: "PhaseChanged", phase: Phase }
	| { kind: "StartRound", participants: { number } }
	| { kind: "NewWave", wave: number, settings: WaveSettings }
	| { kind: "Drop", wave: number }
	| { kind: "Eliminated", userId: number, place: number }
	| { kind: "EndRound", winners: { number }, participants: { number }, survived: { [number]: number } }

export type Snapshot = {
	phase: Phase,
	timeLeft: number,
	wave: number,
	aliveCount: number,
	participantCount: number,
}

type State = {
	settings: Settings,
	phase: Phase,
	timeLeft: number,
	wave: number,
	participants: { number },
	alive: { [number]: boolean },
	aliveCount: number,
	survived: { [number]: number },
	-- Players who fell during the current drop. If everyone falls at once,
	-- they share the win instead of the round having no winner.
	fellThisWave: { number },
}

export type RoundMachine = typeof(setmetatable({} :: State, RoundMachine))

function RoundMachine.new(settings: Settings): RoundMachine
	return setmetatable({
		settings = settings,
		phase = "Waiting" :: Phase,
		timeLeft = 0,
		wave = 0,
		participants = {},
		alive = {},
		aliveCount = 0,
		survived = {},
		fellThisWave = {},
	}, RoundMachine)
end

function RoundMachine.waveSettings(rules: WaveRules, wave: number): WaveSettings
	local warn = math.max(rules.MinWarnSeconds, rules.StartWarnSeconds - (wave - 1) * rules.WarnDecaySeconds)
	local colors = math.min(rules.MaxColors, rules.StartColors + (wave - 1) // rules.ColorsEvery)
	local patch = if wave <= 5 then 3 elseif wave <= 12 then 2 else 1
	return { warnSeconds = warn, colors = colors, patch = patch }
end

function RoundMachine.snapshot(self: RoundMachine): Snapshot
	return {
		phase = self.phase,
		timeLeft = math.max(0, self.timeLeft),
		wave = self.wave,
		aliveCount = self.aliveCount,
		participantCount = #self.participants,
	}
end

function RoundMachine.isAlive(self: RoundMachine, userId: number): boolean
	return self.alive[userId] == true
end

function RoundMachine.aliveUserIds(self: RoundMachine): { number }
	local list = {}
	for _, userId in self.participants do
		if self.alive[userId] then
			table.insert(list, userId)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function enter(self: RoundMachine, phase: Phase, seconds: number, effects: { Effect })
	self.phase = phase
	self.timeLeft = seconds
	table.insert(effects, { kind = "PhaseChanged", phase = phase } :: Effect)
end

local function nextWave(self: RoundMachine, effects: { Effect })
	self.wave += 1
	self.fellThisWave = {}
	local settings = RoundMachine.waveSettings(self.settings.Waves, self.wave)
	table.insert(effects, { kind = "NewWave", wave = self.wave, settings = settings } :: Effect)
	enter(self, "Warning", settings.warnSeconds, effects)
end

local function startRound(self: RoundMachine, ready: { number }, effects: { Effect })
	self.participants = table.clone(ready)
	self.alive = {}
	self.survived = {}
	for _, userId in ready do
		self.alive[userId] = true
		self.survived[userId] = 0
	end
	self.aliveCount = #ready
	self.wave = 0
	table.insert(effects, { kind = "StartRound", participants = table.clone(ready) } :: Effect)
	nextWave(self, effects)
end

local function endRound(self: RoundMachine, winners: { number }, effects: { Effect })
	table.insert(
		effects,
		{
			kind = "EndRound",
			winners = winners,
			participants = table.clone(self.participants),
			survived = table.clone(self.survived),
		} :: Effect
	)
	self.alive = {}
	self.aliveCount = 0
	enter(self, "RoundOver", self.settings.RoundOverSeconds, effects)
end

local function finishWave(self: RoundMachine, effects: { Effect })
	for userId in self.alive do
		self.survived[userId] += 1
	end

	local solo = #self.participants == 1
	local lastWave = self.wave >= self.settings.Waves.MaxWaves

	if self.aliveCount == 0 then
		-- Solo players only win by clearing every wave.
		endRound(self, if solo then {} else table.clone(self.fellThisWave), effects)
	elseif lastWave or (not solo and self.aliveCount == 1) then
		endRound(self, self:aliveUserIds(), effects)
	else
		nextWave(self, effects)
	end
end

-- Advances time by dt seconds. `ready` lists the players who could join a
-- round right now (data loaded, character alive).
function RoundMachine.tick(self: RoundMachine, dt: number, ready: { number }): { Effect }
	local effects: { Effect } = {}
	local minPlayers = self.settings.MinPlayers
	local phase = self.phase

	if phase == "Waiting" then
		if #ready >= minPlayers then
			enter(self, "Intermission", self.settings.IntermissionSeconds, effects)
		end
		return effects
	end

	self.timeLeft -= dt

	if phase == "Intermission" then
		if #ready < minPlayers then
			enter(self, "Waiting", 0, effects)
		elseif self.timeLeft <= 0 then
			startRound(self, ready, effects)
		end
	elseif phase == "Warning" then
		if self.timeLeft <= 0 then
			enter(self, "Dropped", self.settings.DropSeconds, effects)
			table.insert(effects, { kind = "Drop", wave = self.wave } :: Effect)
		end
	elseif phase == "Dropped" then
		if self.timeLeft <= 0 then
			finishWave(self, effects)
		end
	elseif phase == "RoundOver" then
		if self.timeLeft <= 0 then
			if #ready >= minPlayers then
				enter(self, "Intermission", self.settings.IntermissionSeconds, effects)
			else
				enter(self, "Waiting", 0, effects)
			end
		end
	end

	return effects
end

-- `fell` is true when the player dropped off the arena, false when they
-- left the game or their character was removed some other way.
function RoundMachine.eliminate(self: RoundMachine, userId: number, fell: boolean): { Effect }
	local effects: { Effect } = {}
	if not self.alive[userId] or (self.phase ~= "Warning" and self.phase ~= "Dropped") then
		return effects
	end

	self.alive[userId] = nil
	self.aliveCount -= 1
	table.insert(effects, { kind = "Eliminated", userId = userId, place = self.aliveCount + 1 } :: Effect)

	if self.phase == "Dropped" then
		if fell then
			table.insert(self.fellThisWave, userId)
		end
		-- The wave resolves when the drop ends, so players falling together
		-- are judged together.
		return effects
	end

	-- Outside a drop nobody else is falling: settle the round right away.
	local solo = #self.participants == 1
	if self.aliveCount == 0 then
		endRound(self, {}, effects)
	elseif not solo and self.aliveCount == 1 then
		endRound(self, self:aliveUserIds(), effects)
	end
	return effects
end

return RoundMachine

-- BaseService: owns the six safehouses and everything that sits on them.
-- Each player who joins claims one free base. A base holds stands (four at
-- first, up to eight), each stand holding one brainrot that earns money.
-- The service also builds the shield shell and the roof each base wears.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)
local BrainrotModels = require(script.Parent.BrainrotModels)

local BaseService = {}

local services = nil
local bases = {}
local byPlayer = {}

-- The eight stand slots inside one base, two rows of four.
local slotOffsets = {
	{ x = -7.5, z = -4 },
	{ x = -2.5, z = -4 },
	{ x = 2.5, z = -4 },
	{ x = 7.5, z = -4 },
	{ x = -7.5, z = 4 },
	{ x = -2.5, z = 4 },
	{ x = 2.5, z = 4 },
	{ x = 7.5, z = 4 },
}

local function mkPart(parent, name, size, pos, color, material)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Position = pos
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = true
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- Build one base plot: floor, sign, stand pads, roof with a ramp, and the
-- shield shell (invisible until the shield rises).
local function buildBase(index, pos)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Base" .. index
	folder.Parent = workspace.Island

	-- The floor slab, flush with the island ground.
	mkPart(folder, "Floor", Vector3.new(22, 1, 18), Vector3.new(pos.x, -0.5, pos.z), Color3.fromRGB(200, 190, 170), { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })

	-- A coloured border so each base reads as its own plot.
	mkPart(folder, "BorderN", Vector3.new(22, 0.4, 1), Vector3.new(pos.x, 0.2, pos.z - 8.5), Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 220), { material = Enum.Material.Neon })
	mkPart(folder, "BorderS", Vector3.new(22, 0.4, 1), Vector3.new(pos.x, 0.2, pos.z + 8.5), Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 220), { material = Enum.Material.Neon })

	-- The sign naming the base.
	local sign = mkPart(folder, "Sign", Vector3.new(8, 2.5, 0.6), Vector3.new(pos.x, 3.5, pos.z - 8.5), Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40))
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.Parent = sign
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "BASE " .. index
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.Parent = gui

	-- The stand pads: a low disc per slot. Only the first four are live
	-- until the owner upgrades.
	local pads = {}
	for i, off in ipairs(slotOffsets) do
		local pad = mkPart(folder, "Pad" .. i, Vector3.new(3.4, 0.4, 3.4), Vector3.new(pos.x + off.x, 0.2, pos.z + off.z), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135), { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		pad.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		pads[i] = pad
	end

	-- The roof: a flat platform high enough to stay dry, with a ramp up
	-- from the south side and four posts holding it.
	mkPart(folder, "Roof", Vector3.new(22, 1, 18), Vector3.new(pos.x, 7, pos.z), Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 70), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
	for _, dx in ipairs({ -10, 10 }) do
		for _, dz in ipairs({ -8, 8 }) do
			mkPart(folder, "Post", Vector3.new(1, 7, 1), Vector3.new(pos.x + dx, 3.5, pos.z + dz), Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 60), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
		end
	end
	local ramp = mkPart(folder, "Ramp", Vector3.new(4, 0.6, 10), Vector3.new(pos.x, 3.5, pos.z + 13), Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
	ramp.Rotation = Vector3.new(-35, 0, 0)

	-- The shield shell: a glowing box around the whole base, hidden until
	-- the shield is raised.
	local shell = mkPart(folder, "ShieldShell", Vector3.new(23, 9, 19), Vector3.new(pos.x, 4.5, pos.z), Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 255), { material = Enum.Material.Neon })
	shell.Transparency = 1
	shell.CanCollide = false

	return {
		index = index,
		pos = pos,
		folder = folder,
		pads = pads,
		shieldPart = shell,
		owner = nil,
		stands = BrainrotData.Economy.startStands,
		placed = {},
	}
end

-- Give a joining player the first base nobody owns.
local function assignBase(player)
	for _, base in ipairs(bases) do
		if base.owner == nil then
			base.owner = player
			byPlayer[player.UserId] = base
			return base
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The base a player owns, or nil.
function BaseService.getBase(player)
	return byPlayer[player.UserId]
end

-- Does the player have a stand with nothing on it?
function BaseService.hasFreeStand(player)
	local base = byPlayer[player.UserId]
	if base == nil then
		return false
	end
	for i = 1, base.stands do
		if base.placed[i] == nil then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Put a character on the player's first free stand. Returns the record.
function BaseService.place(player, char, mutation)
	local base = byPlayer[player.UserId]
	if base == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local slot = nil
	for i = 1, base.stands do
		if base.placed[i] == nil then
			slot = i
			break
		end
	end
	if slot == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local off = slotOffsets[slot]
	local model = BrainrotModels.build(char, mutation)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(base.pos.x + off.x, 0.4, base.pos.z + off.z))
	model.Parent = base.folder
	local record = {
		standId = slot,
		char = char,
		mutation = mutation,
		model = model,
	}
	base.placed[slot] = record
	-- Clicking a placed character is a steal attempt by anyone but its
	-- owner (the owner's own clicks do nothing; selling goes through the
	-- character menu instead).
	local detector = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
	detector.MaxActivationDistance = 24
	detector.Parent = model.Body
	detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(clicker)
		if clicker ~= player then
			services.Steal:trySteal(clicker, player, slot)
		end
	end)
	return record
end

-- Take a character off a stand and hand its record back WITHOUT destroying
-- the model, so the caller can carry it somewhere else (a steal). The
-- caller owns the model from here on.
function BaseService.takePlaced(player, standId)
	local base = byPlayer[player.UserId]
	if base == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local record = base.placed[standId]
	if record == nil then
		return nil
	end
	base.placed[standId] = nil
	return record
end

-- Take a character off a stand and hand its record back (for a steal or
-- a sale). The model is destroyed; the caller decides what happens next.
function BaseService.removePlaced(player, standId)
	local record = BaseService.takePlaced(player, standId)
	if record == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if record.model then
		record.model:Destroy()
	end
	return record
end

-- Every character the player currently has on stands.
function BaseService.getPlaced(player)
	local base = byPlayer[player.UserId]
	if base == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, record in pairs(base.placed) do
		table.insert(out, record)
	end
	return out
end

-- How many stands the player owns right now.
function BaseService.getStandCount(player)
	local base = byPlayer[player.UserId]
	if base == nil then
		return 0
	end
	return base.stands
end

-- Buy one more stand, up to the maximum. Returns true when it worked.
function BaseService.upgrade(player)
	local base = byPlayer[player.UserId]
	if base == nil then
		return false
	end
	if base.stands >= BrainrotData.Economy.maxStands then
		return false
	end
	local cost = BrainrotData.upgradeCost(base.stands)
	if not services.Money:canAfford(player, cost) then
		return false
	end
	services.Money:spend(player, cost)
	base.stands += 1
	return true
end

-- Show or hide the shield shell around a player's base. When the shield
-- is up the shell is both visible and solid, so it really blocks raiders;
-- when it is down the shell is invisible and lets everyone through. The
-- shell's CanCollide flag is what makes the Shield collision group matter.
function BaseService.setShield(player, visible)
	local base = byPlayer[player.UserId]
	if base == nil then
		return
	end
	base.shieldPart.Transparency = visible and 0.6 or 1
	base.shieldPart.CanCollide = visible
end

-- Release a player's base when they leave.
local function freeBase(player)
	local base = byPlayer[player.UserId]
	if base == nil then
		return
	end
	for _, record in pairs(base.placed) do
		if record.model then
			record.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	base.placed = {}
	base.stands = BrainrotData.Economy.startStands
	base.owner = nil
	base.shieldPart.Transparency = 1
	byPlayer[player.UserId] = nil
end

-- Build all six bases and hook player join/leave.
function BaseService.init(deps)
	services = deps
	for i, pos in ipairs(BrainrotData.Bases) do
		bases[i] = buildBase(i, pos)
	end
	-- The client buys a stand upgrade through this remote.
	local upgradeRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	upgradeRemote.Name = "UpgradeStand"
	upgradeRemote.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	upgradeRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		BaseService.upgrade(player)
	end)
	local players = game:GetService("Players")
	players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		assignBase(player)
	end)
	players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		freeBase(player)
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		assignBase(player)
	end
end

return BaseService

-- Bootstrap: the server entry point. It builds the island, wires every
-- service together through one shared table (each service receives the
-- others through init, so no module requires another service at load
-- time), and keeps a slow heartbeat in the server log.

local World = require(script.Parent.World)
local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)
local MoneyService = require(script.Parent.MoneyService)
local BaseService = require(script.Parent.BaseService)
local ShieldService = require(script.Parent.ShieldService)
local ConveyorService = require(script.Parent.ConveyorService)
local StealService = require(script.Parent.StealService)
local WaveService = require(script.Parent.WaveService)
local MerchantService = require(script.Parent.MerchantService)

-- The island first: everything else stands on it.
local refs = World.build()

-- The service table every service receives in init.
local services = {
	Money = MoneyService,
	Base = BaseService,
	Shield = ShieldService,
	Conveyor = ConveyorService,
	Steal = StealService,
	Wave = WaveService,
	Merchant = MerchantService,
	World = refs,
}

-- Start the services in a fixed order: money and bases first (players
-- need cash and a plot the moment they arrive), then the shield, the
-- belt, the stealing rules, the waves and the merchant.
MoneyService.init(services)
BaseService.init(services)
ShieldService.init(services)
ConveyorService.init(services)
StealService.init(services)
WaveService.init(services)
MerchantService.init(services)

print("[Brainrot Blitz] Server ready: " .. #BrainrotData.Bases .. " bases, " .. #BrainrotData.Characters .. " characters, island built.")

-- The heartbeat: a slow status line in the server log, so the run can be
-- told apart from a stalled one.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(30)
		local players = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
		print("[Brainrot Blitz] Heartbeat: " .. #players .. " players, " .. #ConveyorService.getItems() .. " on the belt.")
	end
end)

--!strict
type FrameProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").FrameProps)

type ComposeModule = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ComposeModule)
type ReadOnlyValue<T> = typeof(require("@repo/src/vendor/compose/core").accumulator<<T, number>>(nil :: never))
type Use = <T>(ReadOnlyValue<T>) -> T
type NumberReadOnlyValue = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").NumberReadOnlyValue)
type Child = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").Child)
local nativeApp = require("./native_app")
return function(automatic: boolean)
	local world = nativeApp({ viewport = { w = 900, h = 900 } })
	local Compose: ComposeModule, Host = world.Compose, world.Host
	local tall = Compose.cell(false)
	local height = Compose.cell(4)
	local observed: NumberReadOnlyValue
	world.runtime.mount(function()
		local children: { Child } = { Host.UIListLayout {} }
		for index = 1, 100 do
			local animated = world.runtime.tween(function(use: Use): number
				return if automatic then (if use(tall) then 6 else 4) else use(height)
			end, { seconds = 0.2 })
			observed = animated
			table.insert(
				children,
				Host.Frame {
					Name = `Row{index}`,
					Size = function(use: Use)
						return world.types.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, use(animated))
					end,
				}
			)
		end
		return Host.Frame((children :: unknown) :: FrameProps)
	end, world.target)
	local iteration = 0
	return {
		run = function()
			iteration += 1
			if automatic then
				tall:set(not tall:peek())
			else
				height:set(if iteration % 2 == 1 then 6 else 4)
			end
			world.frame()
			assert(observed:peek() > 4 and observed:peek() < 6, "motion workload did not animate")
		end,
		dispose = world.dispose,
	}
end

-- BrainrotModels: builds the 3D model of one brainrot character from parts.
-- Every model faces -Z, its base sits at Y 0, and it carries a readable
-- name label. The model is built fresh for each spawn, so a character on the
-- conveyor, on a stand, or being carried is always the same construction.

local BrainrotModels = {}

-- A plain part, anchored, with the given size, position and colour.
local function part(parent, name, size, pos, color, material)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Position = pos
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- The name label every model wears: name on top, tier and mutation below,
-- coloured by rarity so a Mythic reads at a glance.
local function nameLabel(model, char, mutation)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "NameLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 44)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = model

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.55, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = char.name
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	title.TextScaled = true
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.Parent = gui

	local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	sub.Name = "Sub"
	sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.45, 0)
	sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.55, 0)
	sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local tag = char.tier
	if mutation == "Gold" then
		tag = tag .. " • GOLD x2"
		sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
	elseif mutation == "Diamond" then
		tag = tag .. " • DIAMOND x3"
		sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
	else
		sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	end
	sub.Text = tag
	sub.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	sub.TextScaled = true
	sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	sub.Parent = gui
end

-- The trait feature: a few extra parts that make each character read as
-- what its name says. Kept deliberately simple so every model builds fast.
local function addTrait(model, trait, body, accent)
	if trait == "log" then
		-- A wooden log with rings on its face.
		local ring = part(model, "Ring", Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 0.2), Vector3.new(0, 1.6, -0.65), accent, Enum.Material.Wood)
		ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		ring.Rotation = Vector3.new(90, 0, 0)
		part(model, "Knob", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.4), Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), body, Enum.Material.Wood)
	elseif trait == "doll" then
		-- A doll with a bow and button eyes.
		part(model, "Bow", Vector3.new(1.2, 0.4, 0.3), Vector3.new(0, 2.5, -0.6), accent, Enum.Material.Fabric)
		part(model, "EyeL", Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, 0.2), Vector3.new(-0.4, 1.9, -0.65), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "EyeR", Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, 0.2), Vector3.new(0.4, 1.9, -0.65), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	elseif trait == "fish" then
		-- A fish with a tail fin and a dorsal fin.
		part(model, "Tail", Vector3.new(0.3, 1.0, 0.8), Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0.8), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Fin", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.9, 0.6), Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0.1), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	elseif trait == "cactus" then
		-- A cactus with two arms and a flower.
		part(model, "ArmL", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.0, 0.4), Vector3.new(-1.1, 1.6, 0), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "ArmR", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.0, 0.4), Vector3.new(1.1, 1.9, 0), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Flower", Vector3.new(0.6, 0.3, 0.6), Vector3.new(0, 3.1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 180), Enum.Material.Neon)
	elseif trait == "fridge" then
		-- A fridge with a handle and a cold glow strip.
		part(model, "Handle", Vector3.new(0.2, 1.2, 0.2), Vector3.new(0.7, 1.6, -0.7), accent, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part(model, "Glow", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.2, 0.2), Vector3.new(0, 2.2, -0.65), Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), Enum.Material.Neon)
	elseif trait == "banana" then
		-- A banana with a peel tip and a cheeky face.
		part(model, "Tip", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.6, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Peel", Vector3.new(1.8, 0.4, 0.4), Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0.3), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	elseif trait == "ice" then
		-- An ice creature with crystal spikes.
		part(model, "SpikeL", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.9, 0.3), Vector3.new(-0.7, 2.8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 235, 255), Enum.Material.Ice)
		part(model, "SpikeR", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.9, 0.3), Vector3.new(0.7, 2.8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 235, 255), Enum.Material.Ice)
		part(model, "SpikeM", Vector3.new(0.3, 1.2, 0.3), Vector3.new(0, 3.1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 235, 255), Enum.Material.Ice)
	elseif trait == "dancer" then
		-- A dancer with a tutu and a bun.
		local tutu = part(model, "Tutu", Vector3.new(2.4, 0.3, 2.4), Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.Fabric)
		tutu.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		part(model, "Bun", Vector3.new(0.6, 0.5, 0.6), Vector3.new(0, 3.1, 0), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	elseif trait == "assassin" then
		-- An assassin with a mask band and a foam blade.
		part(model, "Mask", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.4, 0.2), Vector3.new(0, 1.9, -0.65), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Blade", Vector3.new(0.2, 1.1, 0.5), Vector3.new(1.1, 1.4, -0.2), Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230), Enum.Material.Metal)
	elseif trait == "pineapple" then
		-- A pineapple with leafy crown and a belly patch.
		part(model, "LeafL", Vector3.new(0.3, 1.0, 0.3), Vector3.new(-0.4, 3.1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 70), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "LeafR", Vector3.new(0.3, 1.0, 0.3), Vector3.new(0.4, 3.1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 70), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Patch", Vector3.new(1.0, 1.0, 0.2), Vector3.new(0, 1.2, -0.65), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	elseif trait == "cow" then
		-- A cow with horns and a ring around its middle like a planet.
		part(model, "HornL", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.7, 0.3), Vector3.new(-0.8, 3.0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(240, 230, 210), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "HornR", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.7, 0.3), Vector3.new(0.8, 3.0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(240, 230, 210), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		local ring = part(model, "Ring", Vector3.new(3.2, 0.15, 3.2), Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), accent, Enum.Material.Neon)
		ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	elseif trait == "shark" then
		-- A shark with a dorsal fin, a tail and three little legs.
		part(model, "Fin", Vector3.new(0.2, 1.0, 0.7), Vector3.new(0, 2.9, 0.2), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Tail", Vector3.new(0.3, 1.1, 0.9), Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0.9), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Leg1", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.6, 0.3), Vector3.new(-0.5, 0.3, -0.3), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Leg2", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.6, 0.3), Vector3.new(0.5, 0.3, -0.3), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Leg3", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.6, 0.3), Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0.5), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	elseif trait == "croc" then
		-- A crocodile with a long snout, a tail and a bomb fin.
		part(model, "Snout", Vector3.new(1.2, 0.6, 1.4), Vector3.new(0, 1.2, -1.1), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Tail", Vector3.new(0.4, 0.5, 1.6), Vector3.new(0, 1.0, 1.4), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		part(model, "Bomb", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7), Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), Enum.Material.Metal)
	end
end

-- Build one character model. `char` is a BrainrotData entry, `mutation` is
-- "Normal", "Gold" or "Diamond". The model is anchored and ready to be
-- placed; the caller positions it with PivotTo.
function BrainrotModels.build(char, mutation)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = char.id

	-- The body: a rounded block in the character's colour.
	local body = part(model, "Body", Vector3.new(2, 2.2, 1.3), Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), char.body, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	body.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block

	-- The head: a smaller block on top, in the accent colour.
	part(model, "Head", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.9, 1.1), Vector3.new(0, 2.85, 0), char.accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

	-- Two eyes on the front face, so the character reads from the front.
	part(model, "EyeL", Vector3.new(0.25, 0.35, 0.15), Vector3.new(-0.4, 2.9, -0.6), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	part(model, "EyeR", Vector3.new(0.25, 0.35, 0.15), Vector3.new(0.4, 2.9, -0.6), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

	-- The trait feature that makes this one different from the rest.
	addTrait(model, char.trait, char.body, char.accent)

	-- A mutated character wears a glowing trim so its value is visible.
	if mutation == "Gold" then
		part(model, "Trim", Vector3.new(2.3, 0.25, 1.6), Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Enum.Material.Neon)
	elseif mutation == "Diamond" then
		part(model, "Trim", Vector3.new(2.3, 0.25, 1.6), Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0), Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	-- The readable name label above the model.
	nameLabel(model, char, mutation)

	model.PrimaryPart = body
	return model
end

return BrainrotModels

--!strict

local Facet = require("../../src")
local Types = require("./types")
local S = require("./support")
local Roblox = require("../../tools/vendor/verify/src/roblox")

local workloads: { Types.Workload } = {}

for _, count in { 100, 500 } do
	table.insert(workloads, {
		id = "inventory-" .. count,
		iterations = 200,
		what = `Select among {count} retained slots 200 times; each slot has an activation target and selected state.`,
		prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
			local UI = world.UI
			local initial: { [number]: boolean } = { [1] = true }
			local selected = S.model(world, lane, initial)
			local data: { number } = {}
			for i = 1, count do
				table.insert(data, i)
			end
			local current = 1
			local buttons: { Roblox.Instance } = {}
			local labels: { Roblox.Instance } = {}
			local plates: { Roblox.Instance } = {}
			local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
				local spec: Facet.KeyedCollectionSpec<number, number> = {
					from = data,
					key = function(id)
						return id
					end,
					mode = "all",
					columns = 10,
					itemSize = 44,
					gap = 8,
					measure = false,
					selection = assert(selected),
					Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
					render = function(item)
						return UI.Text("Slot" .. item:peek())({
							text = function(use: Facet.Use)
								return `Item {use(item)}`
							end,
						})
					end,
				}
				return UI.VirtualGrid "Inventory"(spec)
			end, function(screen)
				local root = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Inventory", screen, {
					Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
					CanvasSize = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.ceil(count / 10) * 52),
				})
				local items = S.create(
					world,
					"Frame",
					"Items",
					root,
					{ BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, math.ceil(count / 10) * 52) }
				)
				S.create(world, "UIPadding", "Padding", items)
				for i = 1, count do
					local plate = S.create(
						world,
						"CanvasGroup",
						tostring(i),
						items,
						{ BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(56, 44) }
					)
					plate.Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset((i - 1) % 10 * 64, math.floor((i - 1) / 10) * 52)
					plates[i] = plate
					local button = S.button(world, plate, "RowHit", "", function()
						plates[current]:RemoveTag("facet-selected")
						current = i
						plates[current]:AddTag("facet-selected")
					end)
					button.Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					if i == 1 then
						plate:AddTag("facet-selected")
					end
					buttons[i] = button
					labels[i] = S.text(world, plate, "Slot" .. i, `Item {i}`)
				end
			end)
			if lane == "facet" then
				for i = 1, count do
					labels[i] = S.find(world, "Slot" .. i)
					local row = S.find(world, tostring(i))
					local hit = row:FindFirstChild("RowHit", true)
					assert(hit)
					plates[i] = assert(hit.Parent)
					buttons[i] = hit
				end
			end
			local root = S.find(world, "Inventory")
			world.engine.environment.poke(root, "AbsoluteSize", world.types.Vector2.new(640, 480))
			world.engine.environment.poke(root, "AbsoluteWindowSize", world.types.Vector2.new(640, 480))
			local mouse = { UserInputType = world.types.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 }
			return {
				step = function(index: number)
					world.engine.environment.fire(buttons[index % count + 1], "Activated", mouse, 1)
				end,
				snapshot = function()
					local key = current
					if lane == "facet" then
						for id in assert(selected):peek() do
							key = id
						end
					end
					local selectedKeys: { string } = {}
					for i, plate in plates do
						local active = plate:HasTag("facet-selected")
						if active then
							table.insert(selectedKeys, tostring(i))
						end
					end
					assert(#selectedKeys == 1, "inventory must show one selected slot")
					return tostring(key) .. ":" .. tostring(labels[key].Text) .. ":" .. table.concat(selectedKeys, ",")
				end,
				stop = stop,
			}
		end,
	})
end

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "shop-filter-200",
	iterations = 10,
	what = "Edit a native TextBox with ten queries, including empty and no match; retain the 200 catalog rows and set their visibility.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local query = S.model(world, lane, "")
		local queries = { "1", "20", "Item", "99", "missing", "2", "10", "50", "200", "" }
		local items: { S.Node } = {}
		local function matches(label: string, value: string): boolean
			return string.find(label, value, 1, true) ~= nil
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } =
				{ UI.TextInput "Filter" { value = assert(query), placeholder = "Filter items" } }
			for i = 1, 200 do
				local label = `Item {i}`
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Button("Item" .. i)({
						label = label,
						onActivate = function() end,
						Visible = function(use: Facet.Use)
							return matches(label, use(assert(query)))
						end,
					})
				)
			end
			return UI.ScrollView(
				{ gap = 8, Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480), table.unpack(children) },
				"Shop"
			)
		end, function(screen)
			local scroll = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Shop", screen, {
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				AutomaticCanvasSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			})
			local content = S.stack(world, scroll, "Content")
			local input = S.create(world, "TextBox", "Filter", content, {
				Text = "",
				PlaceholderText = "Filter items",
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44),
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			})
			input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
				local value = input.Text
				assert(type(value) == "string")
				for i = 1, 200 do
					items[i].Visible = matches(`Item {i}`, value)
				end
			end)
			for i = 1, 200 do
				local item = S.button(world, content, "Item" .. i, `Item {i}`, function() end)
				item.Visible = true
				table.insert(items, item)
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "virtual-scroll-2000",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Scroll a fixed 40-pixel row window from top to bottom; the plain lane keeps a small reusable row pool.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local data: { string } = {}
		for i = 1, 2000 do
			table.insert(data, `Row {i}`)
		end
		local scroll: S.Node? = nil
		local pool: { S.Node } = {}
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local spec: Facet.KeyedCollectionSpec<string, string> = {
				from = data,
				key = function(item)
					return item
				end,
				itemSize = 40,
				measure = false,
				overscan = 2,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 400),
				render = function(current)
					return UI.Text { text = current }
				end,
			}
			return UI.VirtualList "Rows"(spec)
		end, function(screen)
			scroll = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Rows", screen, {
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 400),
				CanvasSize = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 80000),
				CanvasPosition = world.types.Vector2.zero,
			})
			local container = assert(scroll)
			for i = 1, 15 do
				local row = S.text(world, container, "Pool" .. i, data[i], true)
				row.Visible = i <= 12
				row.Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 40)
				row.Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, (i - 1) * 40)
				table.insert(pool, row)
			end
			container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
				local position: unknown = container.CanvasPosition
				assert(typeof(position) == "Vector2")
				local first = math.max(1, math.floor(position.Y / 40) - 1)
				local last = math.min(2000, math.ceil((position.Y + 400) / 40) + 2)
				for i = 1, 15 do
					local row = pool[i]
					local index = first + i - 1
					S.setText(world, row, data[index] or "")
					row.Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, (index - 1) * 40)
					row.Visible = index <= last
				end
			end)
		end)
		scroll = S.find(world, "Rows")
		world.engine.environment.poke(assert(scroll), "AbsoluteSize", world.types.Vector2.new(640, 400))
		world.engine.environment.poke(assert(scroll), "AbsoluteWindowSize", world.types.Vector2.new(640, 400))
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				assert(scroll).CanvasPosition = world.types.Vector2.new(0, math.floor(index * 79600 / 100))
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local labels: { string } = {}
				for _, node in assert(scroll):GetDescendants() do
					if
						node:IsA("TextLabel")
						and node.Visible ~= false
						and type(node.Text) == "string"
						and node.Text ~= ""
					then
						table.insert(labels, node.Text)
					end
				end
				table.sort(labels)
				return table.concat(labels, ",")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local initial: { number } = {}
		local messages = S.model(world, lane, initial)
		local plainRows: { S.Node } = {}
		local plainContent: S.Node? = nil
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.ScrollView "Chat" {
				gap = 8,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				Compose.keyed({
					from = assert(messages),
					key = function(id: number)
						return id
					end,
					render = function(current: Facet.ReadOnlyValue<number>)
						return UI.Text {
							text = function(use: Facet.Use)
								return `Player: message {use(current)}`
							end,
						}
					end,
				}),
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local scroll = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Chat", screen, {
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				AutomaticCanvasSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			})
			plainContent = S.stack(world, scroll, "Content")
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if lane == "facet" then
					local nextRows = table.clone(assert(messages):peek())
					table.insert(nextRows, index)
					if #nextRows > 100 then
						table.remove(nextRows, 1)
					end
					assert(messages):set(nextRows)
				else
					table.insert(
						plainRows,
						S.text(world, assert(plainContent), "Message" .. index, `Player: message {index}`, true)
					)
					if #plainRows > 100 then
						assert(table.remove(plainRows, 1)):Destroy()
					end
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local labels: { string } = {}
				for _, node in S.find(world, "Chat"):GetDescendants() do
					if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
						table.insert(labels, tostring(node.Text))
					end
				end
				table.sort(labels)
				return table.concat(labels, "\n")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})
