table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "mixed-scroll-300",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Scroll 300 retained mixed rows: 100 text rows, 100 action buttons and 100 text cards.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i = 1, 300 do
				local name, label = "Row" .. i, `Row {i}`
				if i % 3 == 0 then
					table.insert(children, UI.Card(name)({ title = label }))
				elseif i % 3 == 1 then
					table.insert(children, UI.Text(name)({ text = label }))
				else
					table.insert(children, UI.Button(name)({ label = label, onActivate = function() end }))
				end
			end
			return UI.ScrollView "Mixed" {
				gap = 8,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				table.unpack(children),
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Mixed", screen, {
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				AutomaticCanvasSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			})
			local content = S.stack(world, root, "Content")
			for i = 1, 300 do
				local name, label = "Row" .. i, `Row {i}`
				if i % 3 == 0 then
					local card = S.stack(world, content, name)
					local body = S.stack(world, card, "Body")
					S.create(world, "UIPadding", "Padding", body)
					S.text(world, body, "Title", label)
				elseif i % 3 == 1 then
					S.text(world, content, name, label)
				else
					S.button(world, content, name, label, function() end)
				end
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				S.find(world, "Mixed").CanvasPosition = world.types.Vector2.new(0, index * 100)
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local rows = {}
				for i = 1, 300 do
					local node = S.find(world, "Row" .. i)
					table.insert(
						rows,
						tostring(if i % 3 == 0 then assert(node:FindFirstChild("Title", true)).Text else node.Text)
					)
				end
				local position: unknown = S.find(world, "Mixed").CanvasPosition
				assert(typeof(position) == "Vector2")
				table.insert(rows, tostring(position.Y))
				return table.concat(rows, "\n")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

return workloads

-- ConveyorService: runs the belt down the middle of the island.
-- A new character rolls out every few seconds, rides the belt from one end
-- to the other, and either gets bought (a player clicks it) or falls off
-- the far end. Services are injected through init, so no module requires
-- another service at load time.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)
local BrainrotModels = require(script.Parent.BrainrotModels)

local ConveyorService = {}

local services = nil
local items = {}
local nextId = 1
local spawnTimer = 0

-- How likely a rolled character is to actually appear, by tier. Cheap
-- characters flood the belt; Mythics are a rare sight.
local tierAccept = {
	Common = 1.0,
	Rare = 0.6,
	Epic = 0.35,
	Legendary = 0.18,
	Mythic = 0.08,
}

-- Pick a character to spawn, weighted so cheap ones show up most.
local function pickCharacter()
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		local char = BrainrotData.Characters[math.random(#BrainrotData.Characters)]
		if math.random() <= (tierAccept[char.tier] or 0.3) then
			return char
		end
	end
	return BrainrotData.Characters[1]
end

-- The price tag floating over a character on the belt.
local function priceTag(model, char, mutation)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "PriceTag"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 40)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, -1.2, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = model
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	label.Text = "$" .. tostring(char.price) .. "  •  $" .. tostring(BrainrotData.mutationIncome(char, mutation)) .. "/s"
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.Parent = gui
end

-- Spawn one character at the start of the belt.
local function spawnOne()
	local char = pickCharacter()
	local mutation = BrainrotData.rollMutation()
	local model = BrainrotModels.build(char, mutation)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(BrainrotData.Conveyor.startX, 1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
	model.Parent = workspace.Island

	priceTag(model, char, mutation)

	local item = {
		id = nextId,
		char = char,
		mutation = mutation,
		model = model,
		x = BrainrotData.Conveyor.startX,
	}
	nextId += 1

	-- Clicking the model buys it: the server checks cash and a free stand.
	local detector = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
	detector.MaxActivationDistance = 24
	detector.Parent = model.Body
	detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
		ConveyorService.buy(player, item.id)
	end)

	table.insert(items, item)
	return item
end

-- Move every item along the belt; drop the ones that reach the far end.
local function tick(dt)
	for i = #items, 1, -1 do
		local item = items[i]
		item.x += BrainrotData.Conveyor.speed * dt
		if item.x >= BrainrotData.Conveyor.endX then
			item.model:Destroy()
			table.remove(items, i)
		else
			item.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(item.x, 1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
		end
	end
end

-- Buy the character on the belt. Cash and a free stand are both required.
function ConveyorService.buy(player, itemId)
	local idx = nil
	for i, item in ipairs(items) do
		if item.id == itemId then
			idx = i
			break
		end
	end
	if idx == nil then
		return false
	end
	local item = items[idx]
	if not services.Money:canAfford(player, item.char.price) then
		return false
	end
	if not services.Base:hasFreeStand(player) then
		return false
	end
	services.Money:spend(player, item.char.price)
	table.remove(items, idx)
	item.model:Destroy()
	services.Base:place(player, item.char, item.mutation)
	return true
end

-- The items currently on the belt (a copy, so callers cannot mutate it).
function ConveyorService.getItems()
	local copy = {}
	for i, item in ipairs(items) do
		copy[i] = item
	end
	return copy
end

-- Start the spawn timer and the movement loop.
function ConveyorService.init(deps)
	services = deps
	spawnTimer = 0
	game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		spawnTimer += dt
		if spawnTimer >= BrainrotData.Conveyor.spawnInterval then
			spawnTimer = 0
			spawnOne()
		end
		tick(dt)
	end)
	-- A few characters already on the belt when the first player arrives.
	spawnOne()
	spawnOne()
end

return ConveyorService

--!strict

local Facet = require("../../src")
local Types = require("./types")
local S = require("./support")

local workloads: { Types.Workload } = {}

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "settings-17-values",
	iterations = 17,
	what = "Change each of ten toggle, four slider and three segmented-picker model values; native value readouts show the result.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local toggles: { Facet.Value<boolean> } = {}
		local sliders: { Facet.Value<number> } = {}
		local pickers: { Facet.Value<string> } = {}
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(toggles, Compose.cell(false))
			end
		end
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(sliders, Compose.cell(0))
			end
		end
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(pickers, Compose.cell("low"))
			end
		end
		local options: { Facet.PickerOption<string> } =
			{ { value = "low", label = "Low" }, { value = "high", label = "High" } }
		local plainValues: { string } = table.create(17, "0")
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i, value in toggles do
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Toggle("Toggle" .. i)({ label = `Option {i}`, value = value, presentation = "button" })
				)
			end
			for i, value in sliders do
				table.insert(children, UI.Slider("Slider" .. i)({ value = value, min = 0, max = 1, step = 0.1 }))
			end
			for i, selected in pickers do
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Picker("Picker" .. i)({ selected = assert(selected), options = options, style = "segmented" })
				)
			end
			for i = 1, 17 do
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Text("Value" .. i)({
						text = function(use: Facet.Use)
							if i <= 10 then
								return if use(toggles[i]) then "1" else "0"
							end
							if i <= 14 then
								return tostring(use(sliders[i - 10]))
							end
							return if use(pickers[i - 14]) == "high" then "1" else "0"
						end,
					})
				)
			end
			return UI.VStack "Settings" { width = 640, gap = 8, table.unpack(children) }
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Settings")
			for i = 1, 10 do
				S.button(world, root, "Toggle" .. i, `Option {i}`, function()
					plainValues[i] = if plainValues[i] == "0" then "1" else "0"
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value" .. i), plainValues[i])
				end)
			end
			for i = 1, 4 do
				local slider = S.stack(world, root, "Slider" .. i, true)
				local track =
					S.create(world, "Frame", "Track", slider, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44) })
				S.create(world, "Frame", "Fill", track, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) })
				local thumb = S.create(world, "Frame", "Thumb", track, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24) })
				local drag = S.create(world, "UIDragDetector", "Drag", thumb)
				S.connect(world, drag, "DragEnd", function()
					plainValues[10 + i] = "1"
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value" .. (10 + i)), "1")
				end)
			end
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local picker = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Picker" .. i, root, {
					Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44),
					ScrollingDirection = world.types.Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
				})
				S.stack(world, picker, "Segments", true)
				for _, option in options do
					local label = option.label
					assert(type(label) == "string")
					S.button(world, picker, option.value .. i, label, function()
						plainValues[14 + i] = if option.value == "high" then "1" else "0"
						S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value" .. (14 + i)), plainValues[14 + i])
					end)
				end
			end
			for i = 1, 17 do
				S.text(world, root, "Value" .. i, "0", true)
			end
		end)
		local names = {}
		for i = 1, 17 do
			table.insert(names, "Value" .. i)
		end
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if lane == "facet" then
					if index <= 10 then
						toggles[index]:set(true)
					elseif index <= 14 then
						sliders[index - 10]:set(1)
					else
						pickers[index - 14]:set("high")
					end
				else
					plainValues[index] = "1"
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value" .. index), "1")
					if index <= 10 then
						S.find(world, "Toggle" .. index):AddTag("facet-selected")
					elseif index <= 14 then
						local slider = S.find(world, "Slider" .. (index - 10))
						assert(slider:FindFirstChild("Fill", true)).Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
						assert(slider:FindFirstChild("Thumb", true)).Position = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
					end
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return S.snapshot(world, names)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "text-input-200",
	iterations = 200,
	what = "Type 200 characters through a native TextBox; validation rejects punctuation and accepts letters.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local value = S.model(world, lane, "")
		local accepted = ""
		local function validate(proposed: string): string?
			return if string.find(proposed, "[^a-z]") then nil else proposed
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.TextInput "Name" { value = assert(value), validate = validate, placeholder = "Player name" }
		end, function(screen)
			local input = S.create(world, "TextBox", "Name", screen, {
				Text = "",
				PlaceholderText = "Player name",
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44),
			})
			input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
				local proposed = input.Text
				assert(type(proposed) == "string")
				local nextValue = validate(proposed)
				if nextValue then
					accepted = nextValue
				elseif proposed ~= accepted then
					input.Text = accepted
				end
			end)
		end)
		S.fire(world, "Name", "Focused")
		local editor = S.find(world, "Name")
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local text = editor.Text
				assert(type(text) == "string")
				editor.Text = text .. (if index % 10 == 0 then "!" else "a")
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return tostring(editor.Text)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

	what = "Set native GuiState to Hover, Press and Idle on 50 buttons; native StyleSheet transitions are outside this double's paint model.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene

			local children: { Instance } = {}

				button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(function()
					local state = button.GuiState
					button.BackgroundTransparency = if state == world.types.Enum.GuiState.Press
						then 0.25

						else 0
				end)

		end)

		for i = 1, 50 do
			table.insert(buttons, S.find(world, "Action" .. i))
		end
		return {

					world.engine.environment.poke(button, "GuiState", states[index])
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local rows = {}
				for _, button in buttons do
					table.insert(rows, tostring(button.Text) .. ":" .. tostring(button.GuiState))

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "stepper-segments-100",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Change a bounded quantity and a segmented choice 100 times through the application model.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local quantity, selected = S.model(world, lane, 0), S.model(world, lane, "a")
		local options: { Facet.PickerOption<string> } =
			{ { value = "a", label = "Solo" }, { value = "b", label = "Team" } }
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.VStack "Choices" {
				width = 640,
				gap = 8,
				UI.Stepper "Quantity" { value = assert(quantity), min = 0, max = 100 },
				UI.Picker "Mode" { selected = assert(selected), options = options, style = "segmented" },
				UI.Text "Summary" {
					text = function(use: Facet.Use)
						return `{use(assert(quantity))}:{use(assert(selected))}`
					end,
				},
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Choices")
			local stepper = S.stack(world, root, "Quantity", true)
			local count = 0
			S.button(world, stepper, "Decrease", "−", function()
				count = math.max(0, count - 1)
				S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value"), tostring(count))
			end)
			S.text(world, stepper, "Value", "0", true)
			S.button(world, stepper, "Increase", "+", function()
				count = math.min(100, count + 1)
				S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value"), tostring(count))
			end)
			local mode =
				S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Mode", root, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44) })
			S.stack(world, mode, "Segments", true)
			for _, option in options do
				local label = option.label
				assert(type(label) == "string")
				S.button(world, mode, option.value, label, function() end)
			end
			S.text(world, root, "Summary", "0:a", true)
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local choice = if index % 2 == 0 then "a" else "b"
				if lane == "facet" then
					assert(quantity):set(index)
					assert(selected):set(choice)
				else
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value"), tostring(index))
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Summary"), `{index}:{choice}`)
					local chosen, other = S.find(world, choice), S.find(world, if choice == "a" then "b" else "a")
					if not chosen:HasTag("facet-selected") then
						chosen:AddTag("facet-selected")
					end
					if other:HasTag("facet-selected") then
						other:RemoveTag("facet-selected")
					end
					local decrease, increase = S.find(world, "Decrease"), S.find(world, "Increase")
					if (index <= 0) ~= decrease:HasTag("facet-disabled") then
						if index <= 0 then
							decrease:AddTag("facet-disabled")
						else
							decrease:RemoveTag("facet-disabled")
						end
					end
					if (index >= 100) ~= increase:HasTag("facet-disabled") then
						if index >= 100 then
							increase:AddTag("facet-disabled")
						else
							increase:RemoveTag("facet-disabled")
						end
					end
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return tostring(S.find(world, "Summary").Text)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

return workloads

-- MerchantService: the merchant who sells brainrots from a stall by the
-- conveyor. The stall stocks three characters at a time, priced a quarter
-- above the conveyor for the certainty of buying at once, and the stock
-- turns over every ninety seconds. Clients learn the stock through a
-- remote; buying goes through another one, validated on the server.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)
local BrainrotModels = require(script.Parent.BrainrotModels)

local MerchantService = {}

local services = nil
local stock = {}
local stockRemote = nil
local rotateTime = 90
local markup = 1.25

-- The merchant's price for a character: a quarter over the conveyor price.
local function merchantPrice(char)
	return math.floor(char.price * markup)
end

-- Pick three different characters for the stall, leaning toward the
-- pricier ones so the stall feels different from the belt.
local function rollStock()
	local pool = {}
	for _, char in ipairs(BrainrotData.Characters) do
		table.insert(pool, char)
	end
	local picked = {}
	while #picked < 3 and #pool > 0 do
		local idx = math.random(#pool)
		local char = pool[idx]
		table.remove(pool, idx)
		-- A pricey character is more likely to make the stall.
		if char.price >= 900 or math.random() < 0.5 then
			table.insert(picked, char)
		end
	end
	while #picked < 3 do
		local char = BrainrotData.Characters[math.random(#BrainrotData.Characters)]
		local seen = false
		for _, other in ipairs(picked) do
			if other.id == char.id then
				seen = true
			end
		end
		if not seen then
			table.insert(picked, char)
		end
	end
	stock = {}
	for _, char in ipairs(picked) do
		table.insert(stock, { id = char.id, price = merchantPrice(char) })
	end
end

-- Tell every client what the stall holds right now.
local function broadcastStock()
	local payload = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(stock) do
		table.insert(payload, { id = entry.id, price = entry.price })
	end
	stockRemote:FireAllClients(payload)
end

-- Build the merchant: a stall counter and a figure behind it, by the belt.
local function buildMerchant()
	local stall = Instance.new("Folder")
	stall.Name = "MerchantStall"
	stall.Parent = workspace.Island
	local function mkPart(name, size, pos, color, material)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.Position = pos
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Anchored = true
		p.Parent = stall
		return p
	end
	-- The counter and its striped awning.
	mkPart("Counter", Vector3.new(8, 2, 3), Vector3.new(-40, 1, -12), Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70), Enum.Material.Wood)
	mkPart("Awning", Vector3.new(9, 0.4, 5), Vector3.new(-40, 6, -12), Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 60), Enum.Material.Fabric)
	mkPart("PostL", Vector3.new(0.5, 6, 0.5), Vector3.new(-44, 3, -12), Color3.fromRGB(90, 70, 50), Enum.Material.Wood)
	mkPart("PostR", Vector3.new(0.5, 6, 0.5), Vector3.new(-36, 3, -12), Color3.fromRGB(90, 70, 50), Enum.Material.Wood)
	-- The merchant figure: a body, a head, and a wide hat.
	mkPart("Body", Vector3.new(2, 2.2, 1.3), Vector3.new(-40, 1.1, -14), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 160), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	mkPart("Head", Vector3.new(1.5, 1, 1.2), Vector3.new(-40, 2.7, -14), Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 160), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	mkPart("Hat", Vector3.new(2.6, 0.4, 2.6), Vector3.new(-40, 3.4, -14), Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "NameLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.4, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = stall
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "MERCHANT"
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.Parent = gui
end

-- Buy one of the stocked characters. It lands straight on a free stand.
function MerchantService.buy(player, charId)
	local entry = nil
	for _, item in ipairs(stock) do
		if item.id == charId then
			entry = item
			break
		end
	end
	if entry == nil then
		return false
	end
	local char = BrainrotData.byId(charId)
	if char == nil then
		return false
	end
	if not services.Money:canAfford(player, entry.price) then
		return false
	end
	if not services.Base:hasFreeStand(player) then
		return false
	end
	services.Money:spend(player, entry.price)
	services.Base:place(player, char, "Normal")
	return true
end

-- Build the stall, open the remotes, and rotate the stock.
function MerchantService.init(deps)
	services = deps
	buildMerchant()
	stockRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	stockRemote.Name = "MerchantStock"
	stockRemote.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local buyRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	buyRemote.Name = "BuyMerchant"
	buyRemote.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	buyRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, charId)
		if typeof(charId) == "string" then
			MerchantService.buy(player, charId)
		end
	end)
	rollStock()
	broadcastStock()
	game:GetService("Players").PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		task.wait(2)
		local payload = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(stock) do
			table.insert(payload, { id = entry.id, price = entry.price })
		end
		stockRemote:FireClient(player, payload)
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(rotateTime)
			rollStock()
			broadcastStock()
		end
	end)
end

return MerchantService

local fs = require("@std/fs")
local json = require("@std/json")
local path = require("@std/path")
local query = require("@std/syntax/query")
local syntax = require("@std/syntax")
local utils = require("@std/syntax/utils")

type Side = "server" | "client" | "shared"
type InstancePath = { string }
type Sourcemap = { byFile: { [string]: InstancePath }, instances: { [string]: boolean } }
type Scope = { script: InstancePath, values: { [any]: any }, seen: { [any]: boolean } }

local name = "require_boundaries"

local SIDES: { [string]: Side } = {
	ServerScriptService = "server",
	ServerStorage = "server",
	StarterPlayer = "client",
	StarterGui = "client",
	ReplicatedFirst = "client",
	ReplicatedStorage = "shared",
	Workspace = "shared",
}

local MAY_REQUIRE: { [Side]: { [Side]: boolean } } = {
	server = { server = true, shared = true },
	client = { client = true, shared = true },
	shared = { shared = true },
}

local sourcemaps: { [string]: Sourcemap } = {}

local function loadSourcemap(file: string): Sourcemap
	local absolute = path.format(path.resolve(file))
	if sourcemaps[absolute] then
		return sourcemaps[absolute]
	end
	local result: Sourcemap = { byFile = {}, instances = {} }
	local function walk(node: any, at: InstancePath)
		result.instances[table.concat(at, ".")] = true
		for _, filePath in node.filePaths or {} do
			result.byFile[path.format(path.resolve(path.dirname(absolute), filePath))] = at
		end
		for _, child in node.children or {} do
			local childAt = table.clone(at)
			table.insert(childAt, child.name)
			walk(child, childAt)
		end
	end
	walk(json.deserialize(fs.readFileToString(absolute)), {})
	sourcemaps[absolute] = result
	return result
end

-- The instance path an expression names, or nil when it isn't static.
local function resolve(expr: any, scope: Scope): InstancePath?
	if expr.tag == "group" then
		return resolve(expr.expression, scope)
	elseif expr.tag == "global" then
		if expr.name.text == "game" then
			return {}
		elseif expr.name.text == "script" then
			return table.clone(scope.script)
		end
	elseif expr.tag == "local" then
		local value = scope.values[expr["local"]]
		if value and not scope.seen[value] then
			scope.seen[value] = true
			return resolve(value, scope)
		end
	elseif expr.tag == "indexname" and expr.accessor.text == "." then
		local parent = resolve(expr.expression, scope)
		if parent and expr.index.text == "Parent" then
			return if #parent > 0 then { table.unpack(parent, 1, #parent - 1) } else nil
		elseif parent then
			table.insert(parent, expr.index.text)
			return parent
		end
	elseif expr.tag == "index" and expr.index.tag == "string" then
		local parent = resolve(expr.expression, scope)
		if parent then
			table.insert(parent, expr.index.token.text)
			return parent
		end
	elseif expr.tag == "call" and expr.self then
		local argument = expr.arguments[1]
		local child = argument and argument.node.tag == "string" and argument.node.token.text
		local receiver = child and resolve(expr.func.expression, scope)
		local method = expr.func.index.text
		if receiver and method == "GetService" and #receiver == 0 then
			return { child }
		elseif receiver and (method == "WaitForChild" or method == "FindFirstChild") then
			table.insert(receiver, child)
			return receiver
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The side and feature of an instance, where the feature is the child of the deepest feature root.
local function locate(at: InstancePath, featureRoots: { string }): (Side?, string?)
	local joined = table.concat(at, ".")
	local deepest = 0
	for _, root in featureRoots do
		local depth = #string.split(root, ".")
		if depth > deepest and string.sub(joined, 1, #root + 1) == root .. "." then
			deepest = depth
		end
	end
	return SIDES[at[1]], if deepest > 0 then at[deepest + 1] else nil
end

local function lint(ast: syntax.AstStatBlock, sourcepath: path.Path?, context: any)
	local options = context.options
	local sourcemap = loadSourcemap(options.sourcemap or "sourcemap.json")
	local script = sourcepath and sourcemap.byFile[path.format(path.resolve(sourcepath))]
	if script == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local featureRoots = options.featureRoots or {}
	local helpers = {}
	for _, feature in options.sharedFeatures or {} do
		helpers[feature] = true
	end
	local fromSide, fromFeature = locate(script, featureRoots)

	local values = {}
	query.findAllFromRoot(ast, utils.isStatLocal):forEach(function(stat: any)
		if #stat.variables == 1 and #stat.values == 1 then
			values[stat.variables[1].node] = stat.values[1].node
		end
	end)

	local violations = {}
	query.findAllFromRoot(ast, utils.isRequireCall):forEach(function(call: any)
		local argument = call.arguments[1]
		local target = argument and resolve(argument.node, { script = script, values = values, seen = {} })
		if target == nil then
			return
		end
		local targetName = table.concat(target, ".")
		local toSide, toFeature = locate(target, featureRoots)
		local message
		if not sourcemap.instances[targetName] then
			message = `{targetName} is not in the sourcemap`
		elseif fromSide and toSide and not MAY_REQUIRE[fromSide][toSide] then
			message = `{fromSide} code requires {toSide} code: {targetName}`
		elseif fromFeature and toFeature and fromFeature ~= toFeature and not helpers[toFeature] then
			message = `feature {fromFeature} requires feature {toFeature}: {targetName}`
		end
		if message then
			table.insert(violations, {
				lintname = name,
				location = call.location,
				message = message,
				severity = "error",
				sourcepath = sourcepath,
			})
		end
	end)
	return violations
end

return table.freeze({ name = name, lint = lint })

-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

--!strict

local NativeApp = require("../native_app")
local Types = require("./types")

return function(workload: Types.Workload)
	local snapshots: { string } = {}
	local lanes: { Types.Lane } = { "plain", "facet" }
	for _, lane in lanes do
		assert(lane == "plain" or lane == "facet")
		local world = NativeApp { textService = true }
		local before = world.engine.census()
		local scene = workload.prepare(world, lane)
		local ok, problem = pcall(function()
			for checkpoint = 0, workload.iterations do
				if checkpoint > 0 then
					scene.step(checkpoint)
				end
				local snapshot = scene.snapshot()
				if lane == "plain" then
					snapshots[checkpoint + 1] = snapshot
				else
					local reference = snapshots[checkpoint + 1]
					local difference = 1
					while
						difference <= math.min(#reference, #snapshot)
						and string.byte(reference, difference) == string.byte(snapshot, difference)
					do
						difference += 1
					end
					assert(
						snapshot == reference,
						`{workload.id} differs at checkpoint {checkpoint}, byte {difference}\nPLAIN: {string.sub(
							reference,
							difference,
							difference + 300
						)}\nFACET: {string.sub(snapshot, difference, difference + 300)}`
					)
				end
			end
		end)
		scene.stop()
		world.dispose()
		local after = world.engine.census()
		assert(after.live <= before.live, workload.id .. " leaked instances")
		assert(after.connections <= before.connections, workload.id .. " leaked connections")
		assert(ok, tostring(problem))
	end
end

-- MoneyService: holds every player's cash and pays their income.
-- Cash starts at the opening amount, income is summed once a second from
-- the characters on the player's stands (mutation and rebirth included),
-- and the numbers are mirrored into leaderstats so the client HUD can read
-- them. Rebirths persist in a DataStore; a failed load or save just falls
-- back to zero rather than breaking the game.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)

local MoneyService = {}

local services = nil
local cash = {}
local rebirths = {}
local store = nil

local function getStore()
	if store ~= nil then
		return store
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore(BrainrotData.Economy.rebirthStore)
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
	end
	return store
end

-- Build the leaderstats folder a player sees, with live Cash, Income and
-- Rebirths values.
local function makeLeaderstats(player)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "leaderstats"
	folder.Parent = player
	local cashValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cashValue.Name = "Cash"
	cashValue.Value = BrainrotData.Economy.startCash
	cashValue.Parent = folder
	local incomeValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	incomeValue.Name = "Income"
	incomeValue.Value = 0
	incomeValue.Parent = folder
	local rebirthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	rebirthValue.Name = "Rebirths"
	rebirthValue.Value = 0
	rebirthValue.Parent = folder
	return folder
end

-- The income rate right now: every placed character's mutated income,
-- boosted by half again per rebirth the player has.
function MoneyService.getIncomePerSecond(player)
	local total = 0
	for _, record in ipairs(services.Base:getPlaced(player)) do
		total += BrainrotData.mutationIncome(record.char, record.mutation)
	end
	local boost = 1 + BrainrotData.Economy.rebirthBoost * (rebirths[player.UserId] or 0)
	return math.floor(total * boost)
end

-- How much cash the player holds.
function MoneyService.getCash(player)
	return cash[player.UserId] or BrainrotData.Economy.startCash
end

-- Can the player pay this amount?
function MoneyService.canAfford(player, amount)
	return MoneyService.getCash(player) >= amount
end

-- Take cash away. Returns false when the player cannot pay.
function MoneyService.spend(player, amount)
	if not MoneyService.canAfford(player, amount) then
		return false
	end
	cash[player.UserId] = MoneyService.getCash(player) - amount
	MoneyService.sync(player)
	return true
end

-- Add cash (a sale, a merchant deal, a reward).
function MoneyService.earn(player, amount)
	cash[player.UserId] = MoneyService.getCash(player) + amount
	MoneyService.sync(player)
end

-- How many rebirths the player has.
function MoneyService.getRebirths(player)
	return rebirths[player.UserId] or 0
end

-- Buy a rebirth: it costs more each time and permanently lifts income by
-- half again. The count is saved right away.
function MoneyService.rebirth(player)
	local count = MoneyService.getRebirths(player)
	local cost = BrainrotData.rebirthCost(count)
	if not MoneyService.canAfford(player, cost) then
		return false
	end
	MoneyService.spend(player, cost)
	rebirths[player.UserId] = count + 1
	MoneyService.sync(player)
	local ds = getStore()
	if ds ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			ds:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), rebirths[player.UserId])
		end)
	end
	return true
end

-- Push the current numbers into the player's leaderstats.
function MoneyService.sync(player)
	local folder = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if folder == nil then
		return
	end
	local cashValue = folder:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if cashValue then
		cashValue.Value = MoneyService.getCash(player)
	end
	local incomeValue = folder:FindFirstChild("Income")
	if incomeValue then
		incomeValue.Value = MoneyService.getIncomePerSecond(player)
	end
	local rebirthValue = folder:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
	if rebirthValue then
		rebirthValue.Value = MoneyService.getRebirths(player)
	end
end

-- Load a player's rebirth count when they join, defaulting to zero.
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	cash[player.UserId] = BrainrotData.Economy.startCash
	rebirths[player.UserId] = 0
	makeLeaderstats(player)
	local ds = getStore()
	if ds ~= nil then
		local ok, saved = pcall(function()
			return ds:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
		end)
		if ok and typeof(saved) == "number" then
			rebirths[player.UserId] = saved
		end
	end
	MoneyService.sync(player)
end

-- Save a player's rebirth count and drop their state when they leave.
local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	local ds = getStore()
	if ds ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			ds:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), rebirths[player.UserId] or 0)
		end)
	end
	cash[player.UserId] = nil
	rebirths[player.UserId] = nil
end

-- Pay every player their income once a second.
local function payLoop()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
			local income = MoneyService.getIncomePerSecond(player)
			if income > 0 then
				MoneyService.earn(player, income)
			else
				MoneyService.sync(player)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Hook players and start the pay loop.
function MoneyService.init(deps)
	services = deps
	-- The client buys a rebirth through this remote.
	local rebirthRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	rebirthRemote.Name = "Rebirth"
	rebirthRemote.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	rebirthRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		MoneyService.rebirth(player)
	end)
	local players = game:GetService("Players")
	players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		onPlayerAdded(player)
	end
	task.spawn(payLoop)
end

return MoneyService

local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local roblox = require("@lune/roblox")

local db = roblox.getReflectionDatabase()
local game = roblox.deserializePlace(fs.readFile(process.args[1]))

local function propertiesOf(className)
	local names = {}
	local class = db:GetClass(className)
	while class do
		for name, property in class.Properties do
			if not table.find(property.Tags, "NotScriptable") and not table.find(property.Tags, "ReadOnly") and not table.find(property.Tags, "Deprecated") and not table.find(property.Tags, "Hidden") then
				table.insert(names, name)
			end
		end
		class = class.Superclass and db:GetClass(class.Superclass)
	end
	table.sort(names)
	return names
end

local lines = {}
local function visit(instance, path)
	local okDefault, default = pcall(roblox.Instance.new, instance.ClassName)
	table.insert(lines, path .. " (" .. instance.ClassName .. ")")
	for _, name in propertiesOf(instance.ClassName) do
		local ok, value = pcall(function() return instance[name] end)
		local same = okDefault and pcall(function() return default[name] end) and default[name] == value
		if ok and not same and name ~= "Name" and name ~= "Parent" then
			table.insert(lines, "  " .. name .. " = " .. tostring(value))
		end
	end
	local children = instance:GetChildren()
	table.sort(children, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	for _, child in children do
		visit(child, path .. "/" .. child.Name)
	end
end
local services = game:GetChildren()
table.sort(services, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
for _, service in services do visit(service, service.Name) end
fs.writeFile(process.args[2], table.concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n")

--!strict

local Types = require("./types")
local S = require("./support")
local Facet = require("../../src")
type BillboardProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").BillboardGuiNativeProps)
type FolderProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").FolderNativeProps)

local workloads: { Types.Workload } = {}

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "main-menu-cold",
	iterations = 1,
	what = "Mount a background, title, six actions and footer; runtime and control-factory setup is excluded.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local labels = { "Play", "Inventory", "Shop", "Settings", "Credits", "Exit" }
		local stop: () -> () = function() end
		return {
			step = function()
				stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
					local children: { Instance } = { UI.Text "Title" { text = "Outpost", textRole = "title" } }
					for _, label in labels do
						table.insert(children, UI.Button(label)({ label = label, onActivate = function() end }))
					end
					table.insert(children, UI.Text "Footer" { text = "Season 4" })
					return UI.VStack "Menu" { width = 640, gap = 8, surface = "surface", table.unpack(children) }
				end, function(screen)
					local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Menu")
					root.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					S.text(world, root, "Title", "Outpost")
					for _, label in labels do
						S.button(world, root, label, label, function() end)
					end
					S.text(world, root, "Footer", "Season 4")
				end)
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				if #world.target:GetChildren() == 0 then
					return "unmounted"
				end
				return S.snapshot(
					world,
					{ "Title", "Play", "Inventory", "Shop", "Settings", "Credits", "Exit", "Footer" }
				)
			end,
			stop = function()
				stop()
			end,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "hud-600-frames",
	iterations = 600,
	what = "Update health fill, ammo, currency and timer once per simulated frame.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local health, ammo, coins, timer =
			S.model(world, lane, 1), S.model(world, lane, "30"), S.model(world, lane, "0"), S.model(world, lane, "0:00")
		local plainFill: S.Node? = nil
		local plainAmmo: S.Node? = nil
		local plainCoins: S.Node? = nil
		local plainTimer: S.Node? = nil
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.HStack "HUD" {
				width = 640,
				gap = 8,
				UI.ProgressView "Health" { value = assert(health) },
				UI.Text "Ammo" { text = assert(ammo) },
				UI.Text "Coins" { text = assert(coins) },
				UI.Text "Timer" { text = assert(timer) },
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "HUD", true)
			plainFill = S.progress(world, root, "Health", 1)
			plainAmmo = S.text(world, root, "Ammo", "30", true)
			plainCoins = S.text(world, root, "Coins", "0", true)
			plainTimer = S.text(world, root, "Timer", "0:00", true)
		end)
		return {
			step = function(frame: number)
				local h, a, c, t =
					1 - frame % 100 / 100,
					tostring(30 - frame % 30),
					tostring(frame * 5),
					string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(frame / 60), frame % 60)
				if lane == "facet" then
					assert(health):set(h)
					assert(ammo):set(a)
					assert(coins):set(c)
					assert(timer):set(t)
				else
					assert(plainFill).Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(h, 1)
					S.setText(world, assert(plainAmmo), a)
					S.setText(world, assert(plainCoins), c)
					S.setText(world, assert(plainTimer), t)
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return S.snapshot(world, { "Ammo", "Coins", "Timer" }) .. "\nHealth:" .. S.fraction(world, "Health")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "progress-20-120-frames",
	iterations = 120,
	what = "Drive 20 measured progress fills with per-frame values; both lanes use the same linear frame sequence.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local values: { Facet.Value<number> } = {}
		local fills: { S.Node } = {}
		for _ = 1, 20 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(values, Compose.cell(0))
			end
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i, value in values do
				table.insert(children, UI.ProgressView("Progress" .. i)({ value = value }))
			end
			return UI.VStack "Progress" { width = 640, gap = 8, table.unpack(children) }
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Progress")
			for i = 1, 20 do
				table.insert(fills, S.progress(world, root, "Progress" .. i, 0))
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(frame: number)
				for i = 1, 20 do
					local fraction = math.min(1, frame / 120)
					if lane == "facet" then
						values[i]:set(fraction)
					else
						fills[i].Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)
					end
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local rows = {}
				for i = 1, 20 do
					table.insert(rows, S.fraction(world, "Progress" .. i))
				end
				return table.concat(rows, ",")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "badges-30-300-updates",
	iterations = 300,
	what = "Update all 30 notification counts, 300 times; badges keep their native text nodes.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local values: { Facet.Value<string> } = {}
		local names: { string } = {}
		local nodes: { S.Node } = {}
		for i = 1, 30 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(values, Compose.cell("1"))
			end
			table.insert(names, "Badge" .. i)
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i, value in values do
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Badge(names[i])({
						label = function(use: Facet.Use)
							return use(value)
						end,
					})
				)
			end
			return UI.Grid "Badges" { columns = 6, gap = 8, table.unpack(children) }
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.grid(world, screen, "Badges", 6)
			for _, name in names do
				local node = S.text(world, root, name, "1", true)
				node:RemoveTag("facet-type-body")
				S.tag(node, "facet-badge", "facet-badge-standard")
				table.insert(nodes, node)
				S.create(world, "UIPadding", "Padding", node)
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(frame: number)
				for i = 1, 30 do
					local label = tostring((frame + i) % 99 + 1)
					if lane == "facet" then
						values[i]:set(label)
					else
						S.setText(world, nodes[i], label)
					end
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return S.snapshot(world, names)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "world-markers-50",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Update the labels of 50 native BillboardGui markers anchored to Parts.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose, Host = world.UI, world.Compose, world.Host
		local values: { Facet.Value<string> } = {}
		local names: { string } = {}
		local nodes: { S.Node } = {}
		for i = 1, 50 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(values, Compose.cell("Target " .. i))
			end
			table.insert(names, "MarkerLabel" .. i)
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i, value in values do
				local anchor = Host.Part { Name = "Anchor" .. i, Anchored = true }
				table.insert(children, anchor)
				local props: BillboardProps = {
					Name = "Marker" .. i,
					Adornee = Compose.static(anchor),
					Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(120, 32),
					UI.Text(names[i])({ text = value }),
				}
				table.insert(children, Host.BillboardGui(props))
			end
			local props: FolderProps = { Name = "Markers", table.unpack(children) }
			return Host.Folder(props)
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.create(world, "Folder", "Markers", screen)
			for i, name in names do

-- ShieldService: the laser shield around each safehouse, and the thirteen
-- collision groups the island uses. Raising a shield turns its glowing
-- shell solid, so raiders cannot walk in, and any steal attempt against
-- that base is refused outright. A shield holds for twenty-six seconds;
-- once it falls, forty-eight seconds must pass before it can rise again,
-- so the full cycle from one activation to the next is seventy-four.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)

local ShieldService = {}

local services = nil
local physics = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

-- The thirteen collision groups: the actors, the places, and one group per
-- base so a base's parts can be told apart from the rest of the island.
local groupNames = {
	"Players",
	"Brainrots",
	"Conveyor",
	"Shield",
	"Water",
	"Decor",
	"Merchant",
	"Base1",
	"Base2",
	"Base3",
	"Base4",
	"Base5",
	"Base6",
}

-- Per player: when their shield was raised, when it ends, and when the
-- next one may rise.
local shields = {}

-- Is the player's shield up right now?
function ShieldService.isActive(player)
	local record = shields[player.UserId]
	if record == nil then
		return false
	end
	return os.clock() < record.endsAt
end

-- When the player's shield may next be raised (a Unix-free clock time).
function ShieldService.getReadyAt(player)
	local record = shields[player.UserId]
	if record == nil then
		return 0
	end
	return record.readyAgainAt
end

-- Raise the player's shield. Refused while it is already up or cooling down.
function ShieldService.activate(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local record = shields[player.UserId]
	if record ~= nil and now < record.readyAgainAt then
		return false
	end
	local endsAt = now + BrainrotData.Shield.duration
	-- The cooldown is counted AFTER the shield ends, not from activation:
	-- twenty-six seconds of shield, then forty-eight of cooldown.
	local readyAgainAt = endsAt + BrainrotData.Shield.cooldown
	shields[player.UserId] = {
		activatedAt = now,
		endsAt = endsAt,
		readyAgainAt = readyAgainAt,
	}
	services.Base:setShield(player, true)
	return true
end

-- Drop a shield early (when the player leaves, for instance).
function ShieldService.deactivate(player)
	shields[player.UserId] = nil
	services.Base:setShield(player, false)
end

-- The watch: hide shells whose shields have run out. The shell's own
-- CanCollide flag is what blocks or lets players through, so the watch
-- only has to hide the shell.
local function shieldWatch()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.5)
		for userId, record in pairs(shields) do
			if os.clock() >= record.endsAt then
				local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
				if player then
					services.Base:setShield(player, false)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Register the groups, set their default relationships, and open the
-- raise-shield remote.
function ShieldService.init(deps)
	services = deps
	for _, name in ipairs(groupNames) do
		physics:RegisterCollisionGroup(name)
	end
	-- The sea never blocks anyone, and carried brainrots never push their
	-- carrier around. Everything else collides by default. The Shield
	-- group stays collidable with Players at all times: whether a shield
	-- shell actually blocks is decided by the shell's own CanCollide flag,
	-- which BaseService flips when the shield rises and falls.
	physics:SetCollisionGroupCollidable("Shield", "Players", true)

	local raiseRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	raiseRemote.Name = "RaiseShield"
	raiseRemote.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	raiseRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		ShieldService.activate(player)
	end)
	game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		ShieldService.deactivate(player)
	end)
	task.spawn(shieldWatch)
end

return ShieldService

-- StealService: stealing, carrying, returning and selling brainrots.
-- A player clicks a character on someone else's stand to steal it. If the
-- victim's shield is up the raid is refused. Otherwise the character is
-- lifted off the stand and welded in front of the thief, who must walk it
-- home: reaching their own base places it on a free stand, while the victim
-- catching up with them sends it straight back. Selling is a RemoteEvent
-- the client fires from the character menu.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)
local BrainrotModels = require(script.Parent.BrainrotModels)

local StealService = {}

local services = nil
local carrying = {}

-- Unanchor every part of a model and weld its primary part in front of a
-- character, so the model rides along as the player walks.
local function attachCarry(model, character)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = false
			descendant.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root == nil then
		return false
	end
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "CarryWeld"
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = model.PrimaryPart
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -2.5)
	weld.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -2.5))
	return true
end

-- Is a position inside a base's plot?
local function inBase(base, pos)
	return math.abs(pos.X - base.pos.x) < 11 and math.abs(pos.Z - base.pos.z) < 9
end

-- Try to steal the character on a victim's stand. Returns true on success.
function StealService.trySteal(thief, victim, standId)
	if thief == victim then
		return false
	end
	if carrying[thief.UserId] ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	if not services.Base:hasFreeStand(thief) then
		return false
	end
	if services.Shield:isActive(victim) then
		return false
	end
	local record = services.Base:takePlaced(victim, standId)
	if record == nil then
		return false
	end
	local character = thief.Character
	if character == nil then
		-- The thief has no character to carry with: put it back.
		services.Base:place(victim, record.char, record.mutation)
		return false
	end
	if not attachCarry(record.model, character) then
		services.Base:place(victim, record.char, record.mutation)
		return false
	end
	carrying[thief.UserId] = {
		thief = thief,
		victim = victim,
		standId = standId,
		char = record.char,
		mutation = record.mutation,
		model = record.model,
	}
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			StealService.returnCarried(thief)
		end)
	end
	return true
end

-- Place the carried character on the thief's first free stand.
function StealService.deliver(thief)
	local carry = carrying[thief.UserId]
	if carry == nil then
		return false
	end
	if not services.Base:hasFreeStand(thief) then
		return false
	end
	local weld = carry.model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
	if weld then
		weld:Destroy()
	end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(carry.model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = true
		end
	end
	carry.model:Destroy()
	carrying[thief.UserId] = nil
	services.Base:place(thief, carry.char, carry.mutation)
	return true
end

-- Send a carried character back to its owner's stand. If the original
-- stand is taken, any free stand of the victim will do; with nowhere to
-- go, the victim is paid the full price instead.
function StealService.returnCarried(thief)
	local carry = carrying[thief.UserId]
	if carry == nil then
		return false
	end
	carrying[thief.UserId] = nil
	carry.model:Destroy()
	local victim = carry.victim
	local base = services.Base:getBase(victim)
	if base == nil then
		return false
	end
	if base.placed[carry.standId] == nil and base.stands >= carry.standId then
		services.Base:place(victim, carry.char, carry.mutation)
	elseif services.Base:hasFreeStand(victim) then
		services.Base:place(victim, carry.char, carry.mutation)
	else
		services.Money:earn(victim, carry.char.price)
	end
	return true
end

-- Sell the character on one of the player's own stands for half its price.
function StealService.sell(player, standId)
	local record = services.Base:removePlaced(player, standId)
	if record == nil then
		return false
	end
	services.Money:earn(player, BrainrotData.sellPrice(record.char.price))
	return true
end

-- The carry watch: victims catching up send the character home, and
-- thieves reaching their own base deliver it.
local function carryWatch()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.2)
		for userId, carry in pairs(carrying) do
			local thief = carry.thief
			local victim = carry.victim
			local thiefChar = thief.Character
			local victimChar = victim.Character
			if thiefChar == nil or victimChar == nil then
				StealService.returnCarried(thief)
			else
				local thiefRoot = thiefChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local victimRoot = victimChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if thiefRoot == nil or victimRoot == nil then
					StealService.returnCarried(thief)
				elseif (thiefRoot.Position - victimRoot.Position).Magnitude < 4 then
					StealService.returnCarried(thief)
				else
					local base = services.Base:getBase(thief)
					if base ~= nil and inBase(base, thiefRoot.Position) then
						StealService.deliver(thief)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Create the sell remote and start the carry watch.
function StealService.init(deps)
	services = deps
	local sellRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	sellRemote.Name = "SellBrainrot"
	sellRemote.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	sellRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, standId)
		if typeof(standId) == "number" then
			StealService.sell(player, standId)
		end
	end)
	game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		if carrying[player.UserId] ~= nil then
			StealService.returnCarried(player)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(carryWatch)
end

return StealService

local Types = require("./types")
local Roblox = require("../../tools/vendor/verify/src/roblox")

type ScreenProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ScreenGuiNativeProps)

export type Node = Roblox.Instance & {
	Activated: Roblox.Signal<>,
	DragEnd: Roblox.Signal<>,
	Completed: Roblox.Signal<unknown>,
	Pressed: Roblox.Signal<>,

}
export type Motion = {
	dialog: { enter: number, exit: number },
	toast: { enter: number, exit: number },

	travel: number,
	present: string,
	travelEase: string,
}
type Tweener = { Create: (Tweener, Node, unknown, { [string]: unknown }) -> Node }
type Playable = { Play: (Playable) -> () }
export type Path = { SetControlPoints: (Path, { unknown }) -> () }
type Binding = { name: string, keys: { Enum.KeyCode }, pressed: (() -> ())?, aim: ((unknown) -> ())? }
type Properties = {
	Text: string?,
	AutoLocalize: boolean?,
	BackgroundTransparency: number?,
	BorderSizePixel: number?,
	TextSize: number?,
	Size: UDim2?,
	TextXAlignment: Enum.TextXAlignment?,

local function model<T>(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane, value: T): Facet.Value<T>?
	return if lane == "facet" then world.Compose.cell(value) else nil
end

local function create(
	world: Types.World,
	class: string,
	name: string,
	parent: Roblox.Instance?,
	props: Properties?
): Node
	local node: Node = world.engine.new(class)
	node.Name = name
	if props then
		if props.Text ~= nil then
			node.Text = props.Text
		end
		if props.AutoLocalize ~= nil then

		end

		end

		end

		end

		end
		if props.Padding ~= nil then

		if props.ZIndexBehavior ~= nil then

		end
		if props.CellSize ~= nil then

			node.CellPadding = props.CellPadding
		end
		if props.FillDirectionMaxCells ~= nil then

			node.PlaceholderText = props.PlaceholderText
		end
		if props.ClearTextOnFocus ~= nil then
			node.ClearTextOnFocus = props.ClearTextOnFocus
		end
		if props.CanvasSize ~= nil then
			node.CanvasSize = props.CanvasSize
		end

		end

			node.Adornee = props.Adornee
		end
	end
	node.Parent = parent
	return node
end

local function find(world: Types.World, name: string): Node
	local node: Node? = world.target:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	assert(node, "missing node " .. name)
	return node
end

local function tag(node: Node, ...: string)
	for _, name in { ... } do
		node:AddTag(name)
	end
end

local prepareHold: (Types.World, Node) -> () = function(_world: Types.World, _node: Node) end

local function text(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, value: string, bound: boolean?, kind: string?): Node
	local node = create(world, "TextLabel", name, nil, {
		Text = value,
		AutoLocalize = if bound then false else nil,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		TextXAlignment = world.types.Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	tag(node, "facet-text")
	if kind ~= "" then
		tag(node, "facet-type-" .. (kind or "body"))
	end
	node.Parent = parent
	if bound then
		prepareHold(world, node)
	end
	return node
end

local function button(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, label: string, activate: () -> ()): Node
	local node = create(world, "TextButton", name, nil, {
		Text = label,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Selectable = true,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
	})
	tag(node, "facet-button", "facet-role-default")
	node.Parent = parent
	node.Activated:Connect(function(...: unknown)
		activate()
	end)
	return node
end

type Hold = { constraint: Node, widest: number, length: number }
type Styled = { GetStyled: (Styled, string) -> unknown }

local function styled(node: Node, key: string): unknown
	return ((node :: unknown) :: Styled):GetStyled(key)
end
local holds = (setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: unknown) :: { [Node]: Hold }
local widths: { [string]: number } = {}

local function widthOf(world: Types.World, node: Node, value: string, ready: (number) -> ()): number?
	local service = world.textService
	if service == nil then
		local bounds: unknown = node.TextBounds
		return if typeof(bounds) == "Vector2" then bounds.X else 0
	end
	local face, size = styled(node, "FontFace"), styled(node, "TextSize")
	local key = `{tostring(face)}|{tostring(size)}|{value}`
	local known = widths[key]
	if known ~= nil then
		return known
	end
	local params = world.engine.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
	params.Text, params.Font, params.Size, params.Width = value, face, size, 0
	local function measure()
		local ok, measured: unknown = pcall(service.GetTextBoundsAsync, service, params)
		params:Destroy()
		if ok and typeof(measured) == "Vector2" then
			widths[key] = measured.X
			ready(measured.X)
		end
	end
	if task then
		task.spawn(measure)
	else
		measure()
	end
	return widths[key]
end

local function widen(world: Types.World, held: Hold, length: number, width: number)
	if length == held.length and width > held.widest then
		held.widest = width
		held.constraint.MinSize = world.types.Vector2.new(width, 0)
	end
end

local function holdFor(world: Types.World, node: Node): Hold
	local hold = holds[node]
	if hold == nil then
		local current = tostring(node.Text)
		local length = utf8.len(current) or #current
		local created: Hold = {
			constraint = create(world, "UISizeConstraint", "Hold", node),
			widest = 0,
			length = length,
		}
		holds[node] = created
		hold = created
		local width = widthOf(world, node, current, function(measured: number)
			widen(world, created, length, measured)
		end)
		if width then
			widen(world, created, length, width)
		end
	end
	return assert(hold)
end

prepareHold = function(world: Types.World, node: Node)
	holdFor(world, node)
end

local function setText(world: Types.World, node: Node, value: string)
	local previous = tostring(node.Text)
	if previous == value then
		return
	end
	local held = holdFor(world, node)
	node.Text = value
	local length = utf8.len(value) or #value
	if length ~= held.length then
		held.widest, held.length = 0, length
		held.constraint.MinSize = world.types.Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
	local width = widthOf(world, node, value, function(measured: number)
		widen(world, held, length, measured)
	end)
	if width then
		widen(world, held, length, width)
	end
end

local function stack(world: Types.World, parent: Node?, name: string, horizontal: boolean?): Node
	local node = create(world, "Frame", name, parent, {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
	})
	create(world, "UIListLayout", "Layout", node, {
		FillDirection = if horizontal
			then world.types.Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
			else world.types.Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
		SortOrder = world.types.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		Padding = world.types.UDim.new(0, 8),
	})
	return node
end

local function connect(_world: Types.World, node: Node, event: string, callback: (...unknown) -> ())
	assert(event == "DragEnd")
	node.DragEnd:Connect(callback)
end

local function fire(world: Types.World, name: string, event: string, ...: unknown)
	world.engine.environment.fire(find(world, name), event, ...)
end

local function snapshot(world: Types.World, names: { string }): string
	local rows: { string } = {}
	for _, name in names do
		local node = find(world, name)
		local value = node.Text
		table.insert(rows, name .. ":" .. tostring(value))
	end
	return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

local metrics = Facet.themes.neutralPackage().metrics.motion
local motion: Motion = {
	dialog = assert(metrics.dialog),
	toast = assert(metrics.toast),
	radial = assert(metrics.radial),
	travel = assert(assert(metrics.durations).travel),
	present = assert(assert(metrics.easing).present),
	travelEase = assert(assert(metrics.easing).travel),
}

type Tweens = { service: Node, live: { [Node]: boolean }, stop: () -> () }
local tweening = (setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: unknown) :: { [Types.World]: Tweens }

local function tweensFor(world: Types.World): Tweens
	local existing = tweening[world]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	local service: Node = world.engine.new("TweenService")
	local live: { [Node]: boolean } = {}
	local created: Tweens = {
		service = service,
		live = live,
		stop = function()
			for tween in live do
				tween:Destroy()
			end
			table.clear(live)
			service:Destroy()
			tweening[world] = nil
		end,
	}
	tweening[world] = created
	return created
end

local function animate(
	world: Types.World,
	node: Node,
	seconds: number,
	ease: string,
	goal: { [string]: unknown },
	done: (() -> ())?
)
	local tweens = tweensFor(world)
	local Enum = world.types.Enum
	local direction, name = string.match(ease, "^(%l+)(%u%a*)$")
	local style = if direction then (Enum.EasingStyle :: unknown) :: { [string]: Enum.EasingStyle } else nil
	local info = world.types.TweenInfo.new(
		seconds,
		if style and name then style[name] else Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
		if direction == "inOut"
			then Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
			elseif direction == "in" then Enum.EasingDirection.In
			else Enum.EasingDirection.Out
	)
	local tween = ((tweens.service :: unknown) :: Tweener):Create(node, info, goal)
	tweens.live[tween] = true
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		tweens.live[tween] = nil
		tween:Destroy()
		if done then
			done()
		end
	end)
	local playable = (tween :: unknown) :: Playable
	playable:Play()
end

local function inputs(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, priority: number, bindings: { Binding }): Node
	local context = create(world, "InputContext", name)
	context.Priority = priority
	context.Sink = true
	for _, binding in bindings do
		local action = create(world, "InputAction", binding.name, context)
		if binding.aim then
			action.Type = world.types.Enum.InputActionType.Direction2D
			action.StateChanged:Connect(binding.aim)
		end
		for _, key in binding.keys do
			local bound = create(world, "InputBinding", "InputBinding", action)
			bound.KeyCode = key
		end
		local pressed = binding.pressed
		if pressed then
			action.Pressed:Connect(function(...: unknown)
				pressed()
			end)
		end
	end
	context.Parent = parent
	return context
end

local function trap(world: Types.World, panel: Node)
	local Stop = world.types.Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
	panel.SelectionGroup = true
	panel.SelectionBehaviorUp = Stop
	panel.SelectionBehaviorDown = Stop
	panel.SelectionBehaviorLeft = Stop
	panel.SelectionBehaviorRight = Stop
end

local function focus(world: Types.World, target: Node): () -> ()
	local gui: Node? = world.guiService
	if gui == nil then
		return function() end
	end
	local service = gui
	local previous = service.SelectedObject
	service.SelectedObject = target
	return function()
		if service.SelectedObject == target then
			service.SelectedObject = previous
		end
	end
end

local function layer(world: Types.World, name: string, dismiss: () -> (), scrimTag: string?): Node
	local root = create(world, "CanvasGroup", name, nil, {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	})
	root.GroupTransparency = 1
	root.Active = true
	root.ZIndex = 100
	local scrim = create(world, "Frame", "Scrim", root, {
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	})
	if scrimTag then
		tag(scrim, scrimTag)
	else
		scrim.BackgroundColor3 = world.types.Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		scrim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
	end
	local outside = create(world, "TextButton", "DismissTarget", root, {
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Selectable = false,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	})
	outside.Activated:Connect(function(...: unknown)
		dismiss()
	end)
	return root
end

local function tagged(world: Types.World, name: string): number
	local count = 0
	for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
		if node:HasTag(name) and (not node:IsA("GuiObject") or node.Visible == true) then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function sinks(world: Types.World): number
	local count = 0
	for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
		if node:IsA("InputContext") and node.Sink == true and node.Enabled == true then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function tagsOf(world: Types.World, name: string): string
	local node = world.target:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if node == nil then
		return "absent"
	end
	local names = node:GetTags()
	table.sort(names)
	return table.concat(names, ",")
end

local function themed(world: Types.World, screen: Node): () -> ()
	local stop = world.runtime.mount(function()
		return Facet.themes.createStyleSheet(world.runtime, Facet.themes.neutralPackage(), { types = world.types })
	end, screen)
	local sheet = screen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("StyleSheet")
	local link: Node = world.engine.new("StyleLink")
	link.StyleSheet = sheet
	link.Parent = screen
	local warm: Node = world.engine.new("Folder")
	warm.Name = "StateTags"
	for _, name in { "facet-selected", "facet-disabled", "facet-busy" } do
		warm:AddTag(name)
	end
	warm.Parent = screen
	return stop
end

local function mount(
	world: Types.World,
	lane: Types.Lane,
	facet: () -> Instance,
	plain: (Node) -> (),
	unthemed: boolean?
): () -> ()
	if lane == "facet" then
		local Host = world.Host
		local screen: Instance? = nil
		local stop = world.runtime.mount(function()
			return world.UI.provide(function()
				local props: ScreenProps = { Name = "Comparison", facet() }
				local made = Host.ScreenGui(props)
				screen = made
				return made
			end)
		end, world.target)
		local unstyle = if unthemed then nil else themed(world, (assert(screen) :: unknown) :: Node)
		return function()
			if unstyle then
				unstyle()
			end
			stop()
		end
	end
	local screen = create(world, "ScreenGui", "Comparison", world.target, {
		ZIndexBehavior = world.types.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	})
	plain(screen)
	local unstyle = if unthemed then nil else themed(world, screen)
	for _, node in screen:GetDescendants() do
		if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
			((node :: unknown) :: Styled):GetStyled("Visible")
		end
	end
	return function()
		if unstyle then
			unstyle()
		end
		local tweens = tweening[world]
		if tweens then
			tweens.stop()
		end
		screen:Destroy()
	end
end

local function grid(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, columns: number): Node
	local node = create(world, "Frame", name, parent, {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
	})
	create(world, "UIGridLayout", "Layout", node, {
		CellSize = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640 / columns - 8, 44),
		CellPadding = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
		FillDirectionMaxCells = columns,
		SortOrder = world.types.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	})
	return node
end

local function progress(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, value: number): Node
	local root = stack(world, parent, name, true)
	local track = create(world, "Frame", "Track", root, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 6) })
	local clip = create(world, "Frame", "FillClip", track, {
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	})
	return create(world, "Frame", "Fill1", clip, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(value, 1) })
end

local function fraction(world: Types.World, name: string): string
	local clip = find(world, name):FindFirstChild("Fill1", true)
	assert(clip)
	local size: unknown = clip.Size
	assert(typeof(size) == "UDim2")
	return string.format("%.4f", size.X.Scale)
end

local function setProgress(world: Types.World, name: string, value: number)
	local fill = assert(find(world, name):FindFirstChild("Fill1", true))
	fill.Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(value, 1)
end

return {
	model = model,
	create = create,
	find = find,
	text = text,
	button = button,
	tag = tag,
	setText = setText,
	stack = stack,
	connect = connect,
	fire = fire,
	snapshot = snapshot,
	mount = mount,
	grid = grid,
	progress = progress,
	fraction = fraction,
	setProgress = setProgress,
	motion = motion,
	animate = animate,
	inputs = inputs,
	trap = trap,
	focus = focus,
	layer = layer,
	tagged = tagged,
	sinks = sinks,
	tagsOf = tagsOf,
}

--!strict

local Facet = require("../../src")
local Types = require("./types")
local S = require("./support")
type FrameProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").FrameNativeProps)

local workloads: { Types.Workload } = {}

local function labels(world: Types.World, prefix: string): string
	local rows: { string } = {}
	for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
		if node:IsA("TextLabel") and type(node.Text) == "string" and string.sub(node.Text, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
			table.insert(rows, node.Text)
		end
	end
	table.sort(rows)
	return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "dialog-50-cycles",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Open a confirmation dialog, then activate Confirm and close it, 50 times. Both lanes add a scrim, an outside dismiss target, a selection trap, Back and Return input contexts and the theme dialog fade.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local open = S.model(world, lane, false)
		local confirmed = 0
		local panel: S.Node? = nil
		local parent: S.Node? = nil
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local actions: { Facet.DialogAction } = {
				{
					id = "Confirm",
					label = "Confirm",
					role = "default",
					onActivate = function()
						confirmed += 1
					end,
				},
			}
			local spec: Facet.DialogSpec = {
				isPresented = assert(open),
				onPresentedChange = function(value)
					assert(open):set(value)
				end,
				title = "Buy kart?",
				content = function()
					return UI.Text "Terms" { text = "Purchase costs 100 coins." }
				end,
				actions = actions,
			}
			return UI.Dialog "ConfirmDialog"(spec)
		end, function(screen)
			parent = screen
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if index % 2 == 1 then
					if lane == "facet" then
						assert(open):set(true)
					else
						local Enum = world.types.Enum
						local contexts: { S.Node } = {}
						local restore = function() end
						local closing = false
						local function close()
							local shown = panel
							if shown == nil or closing then
								return
							end
							closing = true
							shown.Interactable = false
							for _, context in contexts do
								context.Enabled = false
							end
							restore()
							S.animate(
								world,
								shown,
								S.motion.dialog.exit,
								S.motion.present,
								{ GroupTransparency = 1 },
								function()
									shown:Destroy()
									panel = nil
								end
							)
						end
						local layer = S.layer(world, "DialogModal", close, "facet-scrim")
						panel = layer
						local body = S.stack(world, layer, "Panel")
						S.tag(body, "facet-dialog", "facet-panel")
						S.trap(world, body)
						body.ZIndex = 101
						local padding = S.create(world, "UIPadding", "UIPadding", body)
						for _, side in { "PaddingTop", "PaddingBottom", "PaddingLeft", "PaddingRight" } do
							padding[side] = world.types.UDim.new(0, 16)
						end
						S.create(world, "UICorner", "UICorner", body)
						S.text(world, body, "Title", "Buy kart?", nil, "heading")
						local scroll = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Content", body, {
							AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(320, 120),
						})
						S.text(world, scroll, "Terms", "Purchase costs 100 coins.")
						local row = S.stack(world, body, "Actions", true)
						local function confirm()
							if closing then
								return
							end
							confirmed += 1
							close()
						end
						local default = S.button(world, row, "Confirm", "Confirm", confirm)
						S.tag(default, "facet-accent")
						table.insert(
							contexts,
							S.inputs(world, layer, "FacetModalBack", 2000, {
								{
									name = "ModalBack",
									keys = { Enum.KeyCode.Escape, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB },
									pressed = close,
								},
							})
						)
						table.insert(
							contexts,
							S.inputs(world, layer, "FacetShortcut", 1999, {
								{ name = "Shortcut", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.Return }, pressed = confirm },
							})
						)
						layer.Parent = assert(parent)
						restore = S.focus(world, default)
						S.animate(world, layer, S.motion.dialog.enter, S.motion.present, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
					end
				else
					S.fire(world, "Confirm", "Activated")
				end
				world.frame(1)
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return `{confirmed}:{labels(world, "Purchase costs")}\ndialog={S.tagged(world, "facet-dialog")} scrim={S.tagged(
					world,
					"facet-scrim"
				)} sinks={S.sinks(world)} confirm={S.tagsOf(world, "Confirm")} heading={S.tagged(
					world,
					"facet-type-heading"
				)}`
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "toast-stream-100",
	iterations = 200,
	what = "Show 100 one-shot result toasts. Each toast stays for four seconds and then closes. Both lanes put the toast in a panel row in a stack and use the theme toast enter and exit motion.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local initial: { number } = {}
		local messages = S.model(world, lane, initial)
		local panel: S.Node? = nil
		local parent: S.Node? = nil
		local remaining = 0
		local connection = world.engine.heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
			local shown = panel
			if lane == "plain" and shown then
				remaining -= dt
				if remaining <= 0 then
					panel = nil
					local row = assert(shown:FindFirstChild("ToastRow")) :: S.Node
					S.animate(world, row, S.motion.toast.exit, S.motion.present, {
						GroupTransparency = 1,
						Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, -16),
					}, function()
						shown:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
		end)
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local Host = world.Host
			local props: FrameProps = {
				Name = "Toasts",
				Compose.keyed {
					from = assert(messages),
					key = function(id: number)
						return id
					end,
					render = function(current: Facet.ReadOnlyValue<number>)
						return UI.Toast {
							message = function(use: Facet.Use)
								return `Reward {use(current)}`
							end,
						}
					end,
				},
			}
			return Host.Frame(props)
		end, function(screen)
			local stack = S.stack(world, screen, "ToastStack")
			local padding = S.create(world, "UIPadding", "UIPadding", stack)
			padding.PaddingTop = world.types.UDim.new(0, 16)
			parent = stack
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
