					if lane == "facet" then
						assert(messages):set({ id })
					else
						local slot = S.create(world, "Frame", "ToastSlot", nil, {
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
							AutomaticSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
						})
						local row = S.create(world, "CanvasGroup", "ToastRow", slot, {
							Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
							AutomaticSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
						})
						S.tag(row, "facet-snackbar", "facet-panel", "facet-floating")
						row.GroupTransparency = 1
						row.Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, -16)
						local padding = S.create(world, "UIPadding", "UIPadding", row)
						padding.PaddingLeft, padding.PaddingRight =
							world.types.UDim.new(0, 12), world.types.UDim.new(0, 12)
						padding.PaddingTop, padding.PaddingBottom =
							world.types.UDim.new(0, 8), world.types.UDim.new(0, 8)
						S.create(world, "UICorner", "UICorner", row)
						S.text(world, row, "Message", `Reward {id}`, nil, "")
						slot.Parent = assert(parent)
						panel = slot
						remaining = 4
						S.animate(world, row, S.motion.toast.enter, S.motion.present, {
							GroupTransparency = 0,
							Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
						})
					end
					world.frame()
				else
					world.frame(5)
					world.frame(1)
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return `{labels(world, "Reward ")}\nsnackbar={S.tagged(world, "facet-snackbar")}`
			end,
			stop = function()
				connection:Disconnect()
				stop()
			end,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "tabs-5-100-switches",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Switch 100 times among five peer pages and keep each visited page and its content. Both lanes mark the current tab, show its selection indicator and add shoulder-button input contexts.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local selection = S.model(world, lane, "1")
		local current = "1"
		local pages: { [string]: S.Node } = {}
		local tabs: { Facet.Tab } = {}
		for i = 1, 5 do
			table.insert(tabs, {
				id = tostring(i),
				label = `Tab {i}`,
				content = function()
					return UI.Text("Page" .. i)({ text = `Page {i} content` })
				end,
			})
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.TabView "Tabs" {
				selection = assert(selection),
				tabs = tabs,
				placement = "topBar",
				transition = false,
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local Enum = world.types.Enum
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Tabs")
			local bar = S.stack(world, root, "TabBar", true)
			local content = S.create(world, "Frame", "Content", root, {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			})
			local buttons: { [string]: S.Node } = {}
			local marks: { [string]: S.Node } = {}
			local function select(id: string)
				local previous = pages[current]
				if previous then
					previous.Visible = false
					buttons[current]:RemoveTag("facet-tab-current")
					marks[current].Visible = false
				end
				current = id
				local page = pages[id]
				if page == nil then
					local made = S.create(world, "Frame", id, nil, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					})
					made.SelectionGroup = true
					S.text(world, made, "Page" .. id, `Page {id} content`)
					made.Parent = content
					pages[id] = made
					page = made
				end
				assert(page).Visible = true
				buttons[id]:AddTag("facet-tab-current")
				marks[id].Visible = true
			end
			for i = 1, 5 do
				local id = tostring(i)
				local button = S.button(world, bar, "Tab" .. i, `Tab {i}`, function()
					select(id)
				end)
				S.tag(button, "facet-tab-item")
				local mark = S.create(world, "Frame", "SelectionIndicator", button, { BorderSizePixel = 0 })
				mark.Visible = false
				S.tag(mark, "facet-selection-indicator")
				buttons[id], marks[id] = button, mark
			end
			local function shift(by: number)
				select(tostring((tonumber(current) :: number - 1 + by) % 5 + 1))
			end
			local bumpers = {
				S.inputs(world, screen, "FacetPreviousTab", 50, {
					{
						name = "PreviousTab",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 },
						pressed = function()
							shift(-1)
						end,
					},
				}),
				S.inputs(world, screen, "FacetNextTab", 50, {
					{
						name = "NextTab",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 },
						pressed = function()
							shift(1)
						end,
					},
				}),
			}
			local gui: S.Node? = world.guiService
			local function sync()
				local selected: S.Node? = if gui then gui.SelectedObject :: S.Node? else nil
				local inside = selected ~= nil and selected:IsDescendantOf(bar)
				for _, context in bumpers do
					context.Enabled = inside
				end
			end
			if gui then
				gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SelectedObject"):Connect(sync)
			end
			sync()
			select("1")
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local id = tostring(index % 5 + 1)
				if lane == "facet" then
					assert(selection):set(id)
				else
					S.fire(world, "Tab" .. id, "Activated")
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local id = if lane == "facet" then assert(selection):peek() else current
				local marked: { string } = {}
				for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
					if node:HasTag("facet-tab-current") then
						table.insert(marked, tostring(node.Text))
					end
				end
				return `{S.find(world, "Page" .. id).Text}:{labels(world, "Page ")}\ncurrent={table.concat(marked, ",")} indicators={S.tagged(
					world,
					"facet-selection-indicator"
				)} sinks={S.sinks(world)}`
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "radial-50-cycles",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Open a four-command radial menu, select Wave and close it, 50 times. Both lanes draw four Path2D ring sectors, a centre close button, a selection preview, a scrim, gamepad and keyboard input contexts and the theme radial fade, and hide the launcher while the menu is open.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local open = S.model(world, lane, false)
		local actions = { "Wave", "Dance", "Point", "Cheer" }
		local items: { Facet.RadialItem<string> } = {}
		local selected = ""
		for _, label in actions do
			local item: Facet.RadialAction<string> = {
				id = label,
				label = label,
				onSelect = function()
					selected = label
				end,
			}
			table.insert(items, item)
		end
		local parent: S.Node? = nil
		local launcher: S.Node? = nil
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local spec: Facet.RadialMenuSpec<string> =
				{ label = "Emotes", isPresented = assert(open), items = items, preset = "donut" }
			local RadialMenu: typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RadialMenuBuilder) = UI.RadialMenu
			return RadialMenu<<string>>(spec, "Emotes")
		end, function(screen)
			parent = screen
			launcher = S.button(world, screen, "Launcher", "Emotes", function() end)
		end)
		local Enum, D2, V2 = world.types.Enum, world.types.UDim2, world.types.Vector2
		local inner, outer, gap = 72, 152, 2
		local radius = (inner + outer) / 2
		local function arc(angle: number): { unknown }
			local trim = math.deg(math.asin(gap / 2 / radius))
			local from, to = math.rad(angle - 45 + trim), math.rad(angle + 45 - trim)
			local handle = 4 / 3 * math.tan((to - from) / 4) * radius
			local points: { unknown } = {}
			for _, at in { from, to } do
				local x, y = outer + math.sin(at) * radius, outer - math.cos(at) * radius
				local dx, dy = math.cos(at) * handle, math.sin(at) * handle
				table.insert(
					points,
					world.types.Path2DControlPoint.new(
						D2.fromOffset(x, y),
						D2.fromOffset(-dx, -dy),
						D2.fromOffset(dx, dy)
					)
				)
			end
			return points
		end
		local function openRing()
			local closing = false
			local candidate: number? = nil
			local buttons: { S.Node } = {}
			local wedges: { S.Node } = {}
			local contexts: { S.Node } = {}
			local restore = function() end
			local root: S.Node
			local function close()
				if closing then
					return
				end
				closing = true
				root.Interactable = false
				for _, context in contexts do
					context.Enabled = false
				end
				restore()
				assert(launcher).Visible = true
				S.animate(world, root, S.motion.radial.exit, S.motion.present, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, function()
					root:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			root = S.layer(world, "RadialModal", close)
			local ring = S.create(world, "Frame", "RadialPanel", root, {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = D2.fromOffset(2 * outer, 2 * outer),
			})
			ring.AnchorPoint = V2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			ring.Position = D2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			ring.ZIndex = 101
			S.trap(world, ring)
			local plate = S.create(world, "Frame", "SelectionPlate", root, { BorderSizePixel = 0 })
			plate.Visible = false
			S.tag(plate, "facet-tooltip")
			local preview = S.text(world, root, "SelectionPreview", "", nil, "caption")
			preview.Visible = false
			local function highlight(index: number?)
				local previous = candidate
				if previous then
					buttons[previous]:RemoveTag("facet-selected")
					wedges[previous]:RemoveTag("facet-radial-candidate")
				end
				candidate = index
				if index then
					S.tag(buttons[index], "facet-selected")
					S.tag(wedges[index], "facet-radial-candidate")
					preview.Text = actions[index]
				end
				preview.Visible = index ~= nil
				plate.Visible = index ~= nil
			end
			local function choose(index: number)
				if closing then
					return
				end
				selected = actions[index]
				close()
			end
			for index, label in actions do
				local angle = (index - 1) * 90
				local sector = S.create(world, "Frame", "Sector-" .. label, ring, {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = D2.fromScale(1, 1),
				})
				local wedge = S.create(world, "Path2D", "Sector", sector)
				wedge.Thickness = outer - inner
				wedge.Closed = false
				wedge.ZIndex = 102
				S.tag(wedge, "facet-radial-sector")
				local path = (wedge :: unknown) :: S.Path
				path:SetControlPoints(arc(angle))
				local button = S.button(world, sector, label, label, function()
					choose(index)
				end)
				S.tag(button, "facet-radial-item", "facet-radial-label", "facet-appearance-utility")
				button.AnchorPoint = V2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				button.Position = D2.fromOffset(
					outer + math.sin(math.rad(angle)) * radius,
					outer - math.cos(math.rad(angle)) * radius
				)
				button.ZIndex = 105
				button.MouseEnter:Connect(function(...: unknown)
					highlight(index)
				end)
				button.MouseLeave:Connect(function(...: unknown)
					highlight(nil)
				end)
				button.SelectionGained:Connect(function(...: unknown)
					highlight(index)
				end)
				buttons[index], wedges[index] = button, wedge
			end
			local center = S.button(world, root, "Center", "", close)
			S.tag(center, "facet-button-glyph", "facet-appearance-utility")
			center.AnchorPoint = V2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			center.Position = D2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			center.ZIndex = 106
			S.create(world, "UICorner", "UICorner", center)
			local icon = S.create(world, "ImageLabel", "LeadingIcon", center, {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = D2.fromOffset(20, 20),
			})
			S.tag(icon, "facet-icon")
			local function toward(index: number): () -> ()
				return function()
					highlight(index)
				end
			end
			table.insert(
				contexts,
				S.inputs(world, root, "FacetModalBack", 2000, {
					{ name = "ModalBack", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.Escape, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB }, pressed = close },
				})
			)
			table.insert(
				contexts,
				S.inputs(world, root, "FacetRadial", 2000, {
					{
						name = "RadialAim",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 },
						aim = function(value: unknown)
							if typeof(value) ~= "Vector2" or value.Magnitude < 0.5 then
								return
							end
							highlight(math.floor((math.deg(math.atan2(value.X, value.Y)) + 45) % 360 / 90) + 1)
						end,
					},
					{
						name = "RadialCommit",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA, Enum.KeyCode.Return },
						pressed = function()
							if candidate then
								choose(candidate)
							end
						end,
					},
					{ name = "Radial-up", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp, Enum.KeyCode.Up }, pressed = toward(1) },
					{
						name = "Radial-right",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight, Enum.KeyCode.Right },
						pressed = toward(2),
					},
					{ name = "Radial-down", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown, Enum.KeyCode.Down }, pressed = toward(3) },
					{ name = "Radial-left", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft, Enum.KeyCode.Left }, pressed = toward(4) },
				})
			)
			assert(launcher).Visible = false
			root.Parent = assert(parent)
			restore = S.focus(world, buttons[1])
			S.animate(world, root, S.motion.radial.enter, S.motion.present, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
		end
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if index % 2 == 1 then
					if lane == "facet" then
						assert(open):set(true)
					else
						openRing()
					end
				else
					local target: S.Node? = nil
					for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
						if node:IsA("TextButton") and node.Text == "Wave" then
							target = node
							break
						end
					end
					assert(target, "Wave target missing")
					world.engine.environment.fire(target, "Activated")
					if lane == "facet" then
						assert(open):set(false)
					end
				end
				world.frame(1)
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return `{selected}\nitems={S.tagged(world, "facet-radial-item")} sectors={S.tagged(
					world,
					"facet-radial-sector"
				)} sinks={S.sinks(world)} launcher={S.find(world, "Launcher").Visible} wave={S.tagsOf(world, "Wave")}`
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "navigation-5-20-cycles",
	iterations = 200,
	what = "Push five child pages and pop them, 20 times; root has no Back action and covered pages remain retained.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local initial: { Facet.NavigationEntry<number> } = {}
		local path = S.model(world, lane, initial)
		local depth = 0
		local pages: { S.Node } = {}
		local parent: S.Node? = nil
		local function plainPush(level: number)
			if #pages > 0 then
				pages[#pages].Visible = false
			end
			local page = S.stack(world, assert(parent), "Level" .. level)
			local bar = S.stack(world, page, "NavigationBar", true)
			if level > 0 then
				local back = S.button(world, bar, "Back" .. level, "", function() end)
				local row = S.stack(world, back, "Content", true)
				S.create(world, "ImageLabel", "LeadingIcon", row, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20) })
				S.text(world, row, "Title", "Back")
			end
			S.text(world, bar, "Title", `Level {level}`)
			local destination = S.stack(world, page, "Destination")
			S.text(world, destination, "PageText" .. level, `Destination {level}`)
			table.insert(pages, page)
		end
		local destinations: { [string]: Facet.NavigationDestination<number> } = {
			level = {
				title = "Details",
				content = function(entry)
					assert(entry and entry.value)
					return UI.Text("PageText" .. entry.value)({ text = `Destination {entry.value}` })
				end,
			},
		}
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.NavigationStack "Navigation" {
				path = assert(path),
				root = {
					title = "Home",
					content = function()
						return UI.Text "PageText0" { text = "Destination 0" }
					end,
				},
				destinations = destinations,
				transition = false,
			}
		end, function(screen)
			parent = S.stack(world, screen, "Navigation")
			plainPush(0)
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local phase = (index - 1) % 10
				depth += if phase < 5 then 1 else -1
				if lane == "facet" then
					local nextPath = table.clone(assert(path):peek())
					if phase < 5 then
						table.insert(nextPath, { id = "level", value = depth })
					else
						table.remove(nextPath)
					end
					assert(path):set(nextPath)
				elseif phase < 5 then
					plainPush(depth)
				else
					assert(table.remove(pages)):Destroy()
					pages[#pages].Visible = true
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return tostring(S.find(world, "PageText" .. depth).Text) .. ":" .. labels(world, "Destination ")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

return workloads

-- WaveService: the tsunami that sweeps the island on a schedule.
-- A wave is announced fourteen seconds before it arrives, then a wall of
-- water crosses the island for eight seconds. Anyone still on low ground
-- when it passes is knocked about, loses a little cash, and drops whatever
-- they were carrying. Roofs and the lookout deck are the safe places.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotData)

local WaveService = {}

local services = nil
local warnRemote = nil
local waveWall = nil

-- The height that counts as safe: roofs and the lookout sit above it.
local safeHeight = 6

-- Build the wall of water once, hidden, and keep it for every wave.
local function buildWall()
	local wall = Instance.new("Part")
	wall.Name = "TsunamiWall"
	wall.Size = Vector3.new(268, 14, 6)
	wall.Position = Vector3.new(0, 7, -120)
	wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 220)
	wall.Material = Enum.Material.Water
	wall.Transparency = 0.45
	wall.Anchored = true
	wall.CanCollide = false
	wall.Parent = workspace.Island
	return wall
end

-- Hit every player who is still on low ground: a shove, a small fine, and
-- a dropped carry. Each player is hit at most once per wave.
local function sweepHit(hit)
	for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
		if hit[player.UserId] then
			continue
		end
		local character = player.Character
		if character == nil then
			continue
		end
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root == nil then
			continue
		end
		if root.Position.Y >= safeHeight then
			continue
		end
		if math.abs(root.Position.X) > 134 or math.abs(root.Position.Z) > 100 then
			continue
		end
		hit[player.UserId] = true
		-- A shove toward the south dock.
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 12, 30)
			task.delay(0.6, function()
				if humanoid.Parent ~= nil then
					humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
				end
			end)
		end
		-- A small fine: five percent of what the player holds.
		local fine = math.floor(services.Money:getCash(player) * 0.05)
		if fine > 0 then
			services.Money:spend(player, fine)
		end
		-- A carried brainrot is dropped and goes home.
		services.Steal:returnCarried(player)
	end
end

-- One wave: warn, then sweep the wall across the island.
local function runWave()
	warnRemote:FireAllClients("warn", BrainrotData.Wave.warnTime)
	task.wait(BrainrotData.Wave.warnTime)
	warnRemote:FireAllClients("sweep", BrainrotData.Wave.sweepTime)
	local hit = {}
	local start = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - start < BrainrotData.Wave.sweepTime do
		local progress = (os.clock() - start) / BrainrotData.Wave.sweepTime
		local z = -120 + progress * 240
		waveWall.Position = Vector3.new(0, 7, z)
		sweepHit(hit)
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	waveWall.Position = Vector3.new(0, 7, -120)
	warnRemote:FireAllClients("clear")
end

-- The wave loop: first wave after the opening delay, then one every gap.
local function waveLoop()
	task.wait(BrainrotData.Wave.firstAt)
	while true do
		runWave()
		task.wait(BrainrotData.Wave.gap)
	end
end

-- Build the wall, open the warning remote, and start the loop.
function WaveService.init(deps)
	services = deps
	waveWall = buildWall()
	warnRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	warnRemote.Name = "Tsunami"
	warnRemote.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	task.spawn(waveLoop)
end

return WaveService

type RobloxHost = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RobloxHost)
type RobloxTypes = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RobloxTypes)
type ComposeRuntime = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ComposeRuntime)
local Facet = require("../src")
local engineLib = require("../tests/lib/native_engine")

export type State = {
	Facet: Facet.Facet,
	Compose: Facet.ComposeModule,
	runtime: Facet.Runtime,
	Host: RobloxHost,
	UI: Facet.Controls,
	engine: engineLib.Engine,
	target: any,
	types: RobloxTypes,
	viewport: { w: number, h: number },
	frame: (number?) -> (),
	dispose: () -> (),
	[string]: any,
}
return function(options: any?): State
	local opts = options or {}
	local measured = opts.textService == true
	local engine = engineLib.new(if measured
		then {
			textFits = function()
				return true
			end,
		}
		else nil)
	local elapsed = 0
	engine.clock = function()
		return elapsed
	end
	local runtime: ComposeRuntime = Facet.Roblox.createRuntime(engine)
	local target = engine.new("Folder")
	local textService: TextService? = nil
	if measured then
		textService = engine.new("TextService")
		engine.environment.fake(
			"TextService.GetTextBoundsAsync",
			function(_service: unknown, params: GetTextBoundsParams): Vector2
				return engine.types.Vector2.new(#params.Text * params.Size * 0.5, params.Size)
			end
		)
	end
	local root = Facet.Compose.createRootOwner(function()
		runtime.adopt(target)
	end, runtime.reactor)
	return {
		Facet = Facet,
		Compose = Facet.Compose,
		runtime = runtime,
		Host = (runtime.constructors :: unknown) :: RobloxHost,
		UI = Facet.controls(runtime, {
			types = engine.types,
			services = if textService then { TextService = textService } else nil,
		}),
		textService = textService,
		engine = engine,
		target = target,
		types = engine.types,
		viewport = opts.viewport or { w = 800, h = 600 },
		frame = function(dt: number?)
			elapsed += dt or 1 / 60
			engine.heartbeat:Fire(dt or 1 / 60)
		end,
		dispose = function()
			root.dispose()
			runtime:dispose()
			assert(#target:GetChildren() == 0, "benchmark leaked mounted nodes")
		end,
	}
end

-- World: builds the island of Brainrot Blitz once, when the server starts.
-- The island is a harbour rectangle, the conveyor runs down its middle, six
-- safehouse plots sit on either side of the belt, and a few raised roofs
-- give players somewhere dry to stand when the tsunami comes.

local World = {}

-- The island's footprint, in studs.
World.Width = 268
World.Depth = 200

-- Make one anchored part. `opts` may carry shape, material, transparency
-- and whether players can collide with it.
local function mkPart(parent, name, size, pos, color, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Position = pos
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = opts.material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = opts.canCollide ~= false
	if opts.shape then
		p.Shape = opts.shape
	end
	if opts.transparency then
		p.Transparency = opts.transparency
	end
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- A floating text board: a part with a SurfaceGui on its front face.
local function mkSign(parent, name, text, pos, size, color)
	local board = mkPart(parent, name, size, pos, Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40), { material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic })
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.Parent = board
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.Parent = gui
	return board
end

-- A ProximityPrompt on a part, with a short hold. The caller connects to
-- its Triggered event.
function World.prompt(parent, action, object, hold)
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = action
	prompt.ObjectText = object
	prompt.HoldDuration = hold or 0.3
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.Parent = parent
	return prompt
end

-- Build the whole island. Returns the references other services need:
-- the belt, the base plots, the roofs, and the lookout deck.
function World.build()
	local island = Instance.new("Folder")
	island.Name = "Island"
	island.Parent = workspace

	-- The ground: a grass slab whose top surface sits at Y 0, so every
	-- character model (base at Y 0) stands on it.
	mkPart(island, "Ground", Vector3.new(World.Width, 2, World.Depth), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(110, 190, 90), { material = Enum.Material.Grass })

	-- The sea around the island, a little lower and see-through.
	mkPart(island, "Sea", Vector3.new(420, 1, 340), Vector3.new(0, -1.4, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 220), { material = Enum.Material.Water, transparency = 0.25, canCollide = false })

	-- A sand rim along the shore, so the island reads as a beach.
	mkPart(island, "SandNorth", Vector3.new(World.Width, 0.4, 8), Vector3.new(0, 0.1, -96), Color3.fromRGB(235, 210, 150), { material = Enum.Material.Sand, canCollide = false })
	mkPart(island, "SandSouth", Vector3.new(World.Width, 0.4, 8), Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 96), Color3.fromRGB(235, 210, 150), { material = Enum.Material.Sand, canCollide = false })

	-- The conveyor belt: a long dark platform down the middle of the island,
	-- from one end to the other, with a pale stripe down its centre.
	local belt = mkPart(island, "Belt", Vector3.new(262, 1, 6), Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55), { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	mkPart(island, "BeltStripe", Vector3.new(262, 0.2, 1), Vector3.new(0, 1.05, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90), { material = Enum.Material.Neon, canCollide = false })
	-- Low rails on both sides of the belt, so the characters stay on it.
	mkPart(island, "RailNorth", Vector3.new(262, 1.2, 0.6), Vector3.new(0, 1.1, -3.2), Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	mkPart(island, "RailSouth", Vector3.new(262, 1.2, 0.6), Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 3.2), Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	-- End gates: a frame at each end of the belt.
	for _, x in ipairs({ -131, 131 }) do
		mkPart(island, "Gate", Vector3.new(1, 6, 8), Vector3.new(x, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 60), { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	end

	-- Perimeter walls: low blocks around the island edge, with gaps at the
	-- two short ends where the docks stick out.
	for _, z in ipairs({ -98, 98 }) do
		mkPart(island, "Wall", Vector3.new(World.Width, 3, 2), Vector3.new(0, 1.5, z), Color3.fromRGB(180, 170, 150), { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	end
	for _, x in ipairs({ -132, 132 }) do
		mkPart(island, "Wall", Vector3.new(2, 3, 120), Vector3.new(x, 1.5, -40), Color3.fromRGB(180, 170, 150), { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
		mkPart(island, "Wall", Vector3.new(2, 3, 120), Vector3.new(x, 1.5, 40), Color3.fromRGB(180, 170, 150), { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	end

	-- The big welcome arch at the south dock.
	mkSign(island, "Welcome", "BRAINROT BLITZ", Vector3.new(0, 6, 92), Vector3.new(30, 7, 1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90))
	mkPart(island, "ArchL", Vector3.new(1.5, 7, 1.5), Vector3.new(-15, 3.5, 92), Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 60), { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	mkPart(island, "ArchR", Vector3.new(1.5, 7, 1.5), Vector3.new(15, 3.5, 92), Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 60), { material = Enum.Material.Metal })

	-- Harbour decoration: crates stacked near the belt, lamps along it, and
	-- palm trees at the corners.
	local crateSpots = { { -60, -20 }, { -58, 22 }, { 60, -22 }, { 58, 20 }, { -20, -70 }, { 24, 70 } }
	for i, spot in ipairs(crateSpots) do
		mkPart(island, "Crate" .. i, Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), Vector3.new(spot[1], 2, spot[2]), Color3.fromRGB(180, 130, 70), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
		mkPart(island, "CrateTop" .. i, Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), Vector3.new(spot[1] + 0.5, 5.5, spot[2]), Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 85), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
	end
	for _, x in ipairs({ -100, -50, 0, 50, 100 }) do
		mkPart(island, "LampPost", Vector3.new(0.6, 7, 0.6), Vector3.new(x, 3.5, -8), Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70), { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		mkPart(island, "Lamp", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), Vector3.new(x, 7.4, -8), Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 180), { material = Enum.Material.Neon, canCollide = false })
	end
	local palmSpots = { { -120, -85 }, { 120, -85 }, { -120, 85 }, { 120, 85 } }
	for i, spot in ipairs(palmSpots) do
		mkPart(island, "PalmTrunk" .. i, Vector3.new(1.2, 9, 1.2), Vector3.new(spot[1], 4.5, spot[2]), Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 60), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
		local leaves = mkPart(island, "PalmTop" .. i, Vector3.new(7, 2, 7), Vector3.new(spot[1], 9.6, spot[2]), Color3.fromRGB(60, 170, 80), { material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball })
		leaves.CanCollide = false
	end

	-- The lookout deck in the middle of the north side: the tallest safe
	-- spot when the wave comes.
	local deck = mkPart(island, "Lookout", Vector3.new(16, 1, 10), Vector3.new(0, 9, -78), Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
	mkPart(island, "LookoutLegL", Vector3.new(1, 9, 1), Vector3.new(-7, 4.5, -82), Color3.fromRGB(120, 85, 55), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
	mkPart(island, "LookoutLegR", Vector3.new(1, 9, 1), Vector3.new(7, 4.5, -82), Color3.fromRGB(120, 85, 55), { material = Enum.Material.Wood })
	mkSign(island, "LookoutSign", "LOOKOUT - HIGH GROUND", Vector3.new(0, 12, -78), Vector3.new(14, 3, 1), Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255))

	-- The spawn pads near the south dock.
	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name = "Spawn"
	spawn.Size = Vector3.new(20, 1, 8)
	spawn.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 80)
	spawn.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 120)
	spawn.Anchored = true
	spawn.Parent = island

	-- Daylight: a bright late-morning sky, so the island reads clearly.
	local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	lighting.ClockTime = 10.5
	lighting.Brightness = 2
	lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)

	return {
		island = island,
		belt = belt,
		deck = deck,
		spawn = spawn,
	}
end

return World
